verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍没驮南！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, buddhānām!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: A certain, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 如来佛顶肉髻相
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + Uṣṇīṣa
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说，离一切相无相·造作离相·真如实际，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿曩嚩路枳多母 㗚䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 服务天神忧苦，闢驮，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Serve a god + not-joy, settle + dha, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三揭幕、一些
verses.meaningEn: Cleaving, rending, opening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢揭幕
verses.meaningEn: Settle + cleaving again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，暴恶者、恶心障难，不特，六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，怖畏、灾难惊恐
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, not + bull, perfection of the six pāramitās & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, fear, peril, danger, dread
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩訥瑟吒曩誐韈㗚灑娑擔 婆野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），泮吒（摧破魔障）！彼、此尊（阳性主格），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, Phaṭ! he, that one, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 囉惹難拏婆夜 ｜ 素 鉢哩抳婆夜 ｜ 曩誐婆夜 ｜ 尾你聿婆夜 ｜ 祢嚩屹囉賀

verses.meaningZh: 荼吉尼九渊，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，斩断结缚·离覆障清凉，以汝即是（当体即是），我今以金刚杵钉伏禁制，以金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Ḍākinī + cleft, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, severing, by Thou art, I stake/seal with the vajra, by/through Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 建姹迦 弭𩕳屹囉賀 ｜ 鄔惹賀哩抳野 ｜ 櫱婆賀哩抳野 ｜ 惹多賀 哩抳野 ｜ 尒尾多賀哩抳野

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚕地囉賀哩抳野 ｜ 嚩娑賀哩 抳野 ｜ 莾娑賀哩抳野 ｜ 謎娜 賀哩抳野 ｜ 沫惹賀哩抳野

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ ṭrūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾你琰親娜夜弭 ｜ 枳攞野 弭 ｜ 跛哩沒囉惹迦 ｜ 訖㗚擔 尾你琰 ｜ 親娜夜弭

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 枳攞野 弭 ｜ 拏迦拏枳𩕳 ｜ 訖㗚擔尾 你琰 ｜ 親娜野弭 ｜ 枳攞野弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 1 · 三合 0 · 引 2 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀鉢戍跛底嚕捺囉 ｜ 訖㗚 擔尾你琰 ｜ 親娜夜弭 ｜ 枳攞 野弭 ｜ 曩囉演拏半左摩賀母 捺囉

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍没驮南！

verses.meaningZh: 一切处·曜执·内制·工具

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 1 · 三合 0 · 引 2 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加·无明·除断佛母

verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，乐趣诸执拗之，能作摧灭尊
verses.meaningEn: Of all eight, gladden + of niggardliness, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 親娜親娜 ｜ 牝娜牝娜 ｜ 吽吽 ｜ 癹吒癹吒 ｜ 娑嚩 賀

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & primordial tranquil peace
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩巘達吠毗藥癹 吒 ｜ 薩嚩阿素𭋸毗藥癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩緊娜𭋸毗藥癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩 麼護囉藝毗藥癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩麼 弩曬毗藥癹吒

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 癹吒 ｜ 吽 ｜ 豽嚕唵 ｜ 癹吒 ｜ 娑嚩賀

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 ｜ 曩莫颯跢南 ｜ 三𦴭三沒䭾 ｜ 句 致南

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩室囉嚩迦僧伽南 ｜ 曩謨路計囉曷擔 ｜ 曩莫素嚕 跢半曩南 ｜ 曩莫塞訖㗚娜誐 弭南 ｜ 曩莫阿曩誐弭南

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼阿弥陀佛（无量光如来）·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Amitābha, Buddha of Infinite Light, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 路計三𦴭櫱跢南 ｜ 三𦴭鉢囉底半曩南 ｜ 曩謨祢嚩㗚史 喃 ｜ 曩莫悉馱尾你也䭾囉㗚史 喃 ｜ 舍播弩屹囉賀娑沫㗚他南

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·勇猛丈夫金刚总持·大海责任·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, heroic, to, ocean, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨沒囉憾麼妳 曩 莫印捺囉野 ｜ 曩謨婆誐嚩 帝 ｜ 嚕捺囉野 ｜ 塢麼鉢底娑 呬夜野 ｜ 曩謨曩囉演拏野

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍没驮南！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, buddhānām!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 落乞讖弭 ｜ 半左摩賀母捺囉 ｜ 曩莫塞訖㗚跢野 ｜ 曩謨婆誐嚩 帝 ｜ 摩賀迦攞野

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大白伞盖（清净护庇）尊，佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，向般罗底扬吉罗（大回遮母、总破邪咒母）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O White Parasol (pure protective canopy) / in White Parasol (pure protective canopy), Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, to/for Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底哩補囉 曩誐囉 ｜ 尾捺囉跛拏迦囉野 ｜ 阿 地穆訖得迦濕麼舍曩嚩枲 寧 ｜ 麼底哩誐拏 ｜ 曩莫塞訖㗚 跢野

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾你琰親娜夜弭 ｜ 枳攞野 弭 ｜ 跛哩沒囉惹迦 ｜ 訖㗚擔 尾你琰 ｜ 親娜夜弭

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 枳攞野 弭 ｜ 拏迦拏枳𩕳 ｜ 訖㗚擔尾 你琰 ｜ 親娜野弭 ｜ 枳攞野弭

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦播理 曵癹吒 ｜ 阿地穆訖得迦濕麼 舍曩嚩枲𩕳曵癹吒 ｜ 曵計唧 多薩怛嚩麼麼 ｜ 訥瑟吒唧多 ｜ 播跛唧哆

verses.iast: vajratuṇḍī ca śvetā ca kamalākṣā śaśiprabhā
verses.meaningZh: 金刚觜佛母以及洁白、清净白色以及妙莲华眼目，月轮光明
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + beak and white, bright, pure-colored and lotus blossom + eye, moon + light
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嘮捺囉唧哆 ｜ 尾 你吠灑 ｜ 阿每怛囉唧跢 ｜ 嗢荅播 娜演底 ｜ 枳攞演底

verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, these, Mudrā + assembly, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, protection, safeguarding, may they all perform/grant! my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 滿怛囉 演底 ｜ 惹半底 ｜ 汙𡦗賀囉 ｜ 櫱婆賀囉 ｜ 嚕地囉賀囉

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向仙人海会众善祥，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi + assembly + to, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩娑賀囉 ｜ 沫惹賀囉 ｜ 惹跢賀囉 ｜ 尒尾跢賀囉 ｜ 沫理野賀囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 能作令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Maker of crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 彥䭾賀 囉 ｜ 補澁播賀囉 ｜ 頗攞賀 囉 ｜ 薩冩賀囉 ｜ 播跛唧跢

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 訥瑟吒唧跢 ｜ 嘮捺囉唧跢 ｜ 藥乞灑屹囉賀 ｜ 囉乞灑娑 屹囉賀

verses.meaningZh: 能作作昏尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Maker of stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 畢𭋸多屹囉賀 ｜ 比 舍左屹囉賀 ｜ 部多屹囉賀 ｜ 禁畔拏屹囉賀 ｜ 塞蹇娜 屹囉賀

verses.meaningZh: 能作大明咒·桑·星宿一刹那，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嗢怛麼娜屹囉賀 ｜ 蹉野屹囉賀 ｜ 阿鉢娑麼囉 屹囉賀 ｜ 拏迦拏枳𩕳屹囉賀 ｜ 𭋸嚩底屹囉賀

verses.meaningZh: 能作愈加·无明·桑·星宿一刹那，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + ignorance + saṃ + star + maker of birth under favorable conditions, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 惹弭迦 屹囉賀 ｜ 爍矩𩕳屹囉賀 ｜ 滿怛囉 難你迦屹囉賀 ｜ 覧尾迦屹囉 賀 ｜ 賀弩建姹播抳屹囉賀

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸暴恶者，能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: All + of all wicked, maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 入嚩囉曀迦呬迦 ｜ 你吠底野 迦 ｜ 娑怛𡃤底野迦 ｜ 拶咄他迦 ｜ 𩕳底野入嚩囉

verses.meaningZh: 一切·坚持下去·解脱自在·诸曜执，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: All + press on + free from Rākṣasas + of planet, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾灑麼入嚩 囉 ｜ 嚩底迦背底迦 ｜ 始𭋸澁弭 迦 ｜ 散𩕳跛底迦 ｜ 薩嚩入嚩囉

verses.meaningZh: 诸八十四之，曜执诸千，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Caturaśītīnāṃ, planet + of thousand, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 始嚕㗚底 ｜ 遏囉䭾嚩陛娜迦 ｜ 阿嚧左迦 ｜ 𢙣乞史嚕儼 ｜ 曩 娑嚧儼

verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我

verses.meaningZh: 出有坏，如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖·大·金刚·佛顶肉髻相，大般罗底扬吉罗，大·千·臂，截至成千羨慕尊，俱胝·百千·眼目
verses.meaningEn: Bhagavan, Tathāgata + Uṣṇīṣa + White Parasol + great + Vajra + Uṣṇīṣa, great + Pratyaṅgirā, great + thousand + O arm, by thousands + O envy, ten million + sgl + O eye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 紇㗚 乃野戍藍 ｜ 沫麼戍藍 ｜ 播 囉濕嚩戍藍 ｜ 鉢哩瑟姹戍 藍 ｜ 鄔娜囉戍藍

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 建致戍 藍 ｜ 嚩悉底戍藍 ｜ 塢嚕戍 藍 ｜ 穰伽戍藍 ｜ 賀娑多戍 藍

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 播娜戍藍 ｜ 薩𠕀誐 鉢囉底孕誐戍藍 ｜ 部多吠 跢拏 ｜ 拏迦拏枳𩕳 ｜ 入嚩囉

verses.iast: ye kecit sattvā mama ahitaiṣiṇaḥ pāpacittā rudracittā vidveṣacittā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，任何众生、凡有诸类，器物盘子已，我之（行者所有），因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·六度满行清净，罪业心，啼非心，众瞋心
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), any, some (plural), having a vessel or dish, my, of me (the practitioner), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, evil + mind, to weep + without thought, = + mind
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 捺訥嚕建拏 ｜ 枳致婆路多吠 ｜ 薩跛虜賀陵誐 ｜ 戍灑怛囉 ｜ 娑誐囉尾灑𢈔誐
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，斩断结缚·离覆障清凉，以汝即是（当体即是）
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, severing, by Thou art
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿儗𩕳塢娜迦 ｜ 跛囉吠囉建 跢囉 ｜ 阿迦藍沒㗚底𢈔 ｜ 怛𡃤穆迦 ｜ 怛𡃤攞吒迦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 我今以金刚杵钉伏禁制，以金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: I stake/seal with the vajra, by/through Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 勿㗚 室止迦 ｜ 薩跛曩矩攞 ｜ 僧 伽尾野竭囉 ｜ 哩乞灑多囉乞𱽧 ｜ 沒哩誐
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.iast: parivrājakakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmy asinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa
verses.meaningZh: 普行九渊，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，斩断结缚·离覆障清凉，以汝即是（当体即是），我今以金刚杵钉伏禁制，以金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: The same + cleft, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, severing, by Thou art, I stake/seal with the vajra, by/through Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑嚩跛囉尒嚩 ｜ 帝釤薩吠釤 ｜ 悉跢多鉢怛𫬠 ｜ 摩賀嚩日嚧瑟抳釤 ｜ 摩賀 鉢囉底孕儗㘕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.iast: ḍākinīkṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmy asinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa
verses.meaningZh: 荼吉尼九渊，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，斩断结缚·离覆障清凉，以汝即是（当体即是），我今以金刚杵钉伏禁制，以金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Ḍākinī + cleft, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, severing, by Thou art, I stake/seal with the vajra, by/through Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 夜嚩納嚩娜 捨𢈔惹曩辮怛𭋸拏 ｜ 枲麼 滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 你捨滿鄧迦嚧 弭 ｜ 播囉尾你也滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 帝乳滿鄧迦嚕弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 除断尊，能作非时横死·般·守护掩蔽·出拏尊
verses.meaningEn: O removing, untimely + wisdom + protect shelter + income + maker of na
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 賀娑多 滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 播娜滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 薩𠕀誐鉢囉底孕誐滿鄧 迦嚧弭 ｜ 怛你野他 ｜ 唵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿 曩𥠖阿曩𥠖 ｜ 尾捨祢尾捨祢 ｜ 吠囉嚩日囉䭾𭋸 ｜ 滿䭾滿䭾𩕳 ｜ 嚩日囉播抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.iast: oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ ṭrūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 癹吒 ｜ 吽 ｜ 豽嚕唵 ｜ 癹吒 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫娑怛 他櫱多野 ｜ 蘇櫱多夜囉曷 帝 ｜ 三藐三沒䭾野 ｜ 悉殿覩滿 怛囉跛娜 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 417 · 三合 22 · 引 564 · 弹舌 5

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩底吠 毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无住安立·以彼配称·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·桑祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, worthy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ, may You intelligent!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫娑怛他櫱跢夜囉曷 帝三𦴭三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向彼尊（为格），归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: To him, to that one, homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛娑每曩 莫塞訖㗚怛吠南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 才鸣呼，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无住安立，真如实际·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Excellence, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆誐嚩多 娑怛他櫱妬瑟抳釤
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩祢 吠曩莫塞訖㗚擔
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，天人、诸天护法尊，所恭敬
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, O god, celestial deity (Deva) / in god, celestial deity (Deva), honored
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），勇健自然，调忧苦
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, strong + certainly, tame + not-joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·诸根清净自在），幅度忧苦

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 呼请仁者圣众叹词，破有相福德光·生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，离一切相无相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: O Venerable Ones! blessedness transcending existence & transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 70 · 三合 8 · 引 77 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 65 · 三合 6 · 引 147 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼彼、此尊（阳性主格）·如来佛顶肉髻相·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to he, that one, Tathāgata, Uṣṇīṣa, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!

verses.meaningZh: 向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 65 · 三合 6 · 引 147 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，弯曲、超群，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，他人，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, crossing, surpassing, overcoming, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, someone else, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛囉阿 鉢囉底賀跢野

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐 地薩怛嚩曩莫塞訖㗚跢野

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无我大慈三昧，惛沈

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 65 · 三合 6 · 引 147 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席是的，惛沈

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 3 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 胜佛顶，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！

verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — supreme compassionate guidance, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 3 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒（摧破魔障）！

verses.meaningZh: 愈加石头，真如实际·最上真言离言说·破有相福德光

verses.meaningZh: 垢染胸严

verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），化作辐条

verses.meaningZh: 行脚一起、途径

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）

verses.meaningZh: 再三表面地面

verses.meaningZh: 桑表面地面

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·离一切相无相

verses.meaningZh: 再三离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢

verses.meaningZh: 贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，柔善

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 随一下尊
verses.meaningEn: Mostly ) look + O lower
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 随一下，烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Mostly ) look + then, O passion, sin, depravity
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三远离虚妄安立·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Beyond conceptual fabrication & stainless purity free from dust again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，胜伏、最胜吉祥！具御尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, conquer! victory! O bearer of to transport
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三胸严
verses.meaningEn: Clump, mass, thicket again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·造作离相，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，觉知路尊
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, know + O road
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，愈加不是了知，波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满）尊
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, beyond + not knowing, O Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond / in Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩鉢囉枳娘播囉弭帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），他人，星宿·不·彼，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, someone else, star + not + he, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 鉢囉底婆曩娑半寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），世间、世界尊
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, O world, realm / in world, realm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 水星闢，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Intelligent + settle, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 唤醒必然，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Wake + a certain, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒䭾鉢囉 底滿旎帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 多水分、潮湿，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Juicy, moist, humid, fresh, new, tasty, pleasant, charming, passionate, enamoured, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人彼，絮叨辐条，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + he, chatter + spoke of a wheel, flow forth and pervade with blessing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，彼日轮，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — purified faculties, he + the sun, flow forth and pervade with blessing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，离名相假立·六度满行清净·第一义谛，度越吧、已往彼岸尊！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & ultimate truth, gone, O One gone beyond!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量，演说、有言，不、非、无
verses.meaningEn: Vast, extensive, abundant, profound, speaking, speaker, not, non-
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，真如实际·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人星宿，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + star, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — samādhi invocation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉婆 娑計覩母㗚䭾寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 参半尔时，去之
verses.meaningEn: Equally + now, of understood, grasped
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），造作离相·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，意趣尊
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, O direction of the will
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，以彼，舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, tayā, leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, may You intelligent, clever
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢夜 囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼尊所属之、彼之，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Belonging to That One, His/Her, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三菩提、无上正觉
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，行境尊
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, O scope, range
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三胸严
verses.meaningEn: Clump, mass, thicket again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三他人胸严
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + clump again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉賀囉 鉢囉賀囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·妙行迁变空·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘辐条，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Cut in pieces + spoke of a wheel, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 設多喇濕弭 散祖你帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，破有相福德光·六度满行清净·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多 鼻色訖帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 功德、殊胜妙德，鸣呼尊
verses.meaningEn: Virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, vate
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 唤醒贫苦，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Wake + having no cows, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 虚空、清净苍穹，表面地面尊
verses.meaningEn: Sky, boundless space, firmament, O surface of the ground
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，依止处、在于尊
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, O standing, sticking
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛 他櫱多地瑟恥帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不星宿，彼表面地面尊
verses.meaningEn: Not + star, he + O surface of the ground
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三息
verses.meaningEn: Rest again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，息
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, rest
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉陜 麼鉢囉陜麼
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，他人，寂静息灭、止息灾障（古译「奢摩奴」）尊
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, someone else, O pacifying, calming, extinguishing afflictions / in pacifying, calming, extinguishing afflictions
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩播跛鉢囉 陜麼寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，闢·净化·自然
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, settle + purify + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Awakening, awakened spiritual movement
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 桑他人，立尊
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + someone else, O standing, abiding, remaining
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，他人，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, someone else, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他 櫱多鉢囉底瑟恥多秫第
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 2 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以世尊此！

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立，妙行趣入·真如实际·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一乘如实之道，佛母
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, mother

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，唤醒自然
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, wake + certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 61 · 三合 1 · 引 145 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 顶首鸿毛，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·破暗合集

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩室囉嚩 迦僧伽南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 61 · 三合 1 · 引 145 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·空心、坑洞！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 61 · 三合 1 · 引 145 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 61 · 三合 1 · 引 145 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 61 · 三合 1 · 引 145 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三水星

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以世尊此·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离名相假立·真如实际，施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! O staggering, reeling / in staggering, reeling

verses.meaningZh: 日复一日、之后，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·生起不可得·尊胜，离名相假立·离一切相无相·支分寂静，真如实际·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Day after day, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & transcending birth & victorious, beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs, immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿努 尾琰惹曩楞訖㗚多設哩囉 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，功德桑，祈请富楼那
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, virtue + saṃ, may You Purna
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨曩莫鉢囉賀悉多穆佉囉尾引那
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，洁白垢染
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, white + stain
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，炽耀融
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), practicing (imperative seal), blazing + blending
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼 抳嚕唧囉佐嚕你鉢妬荅鉢跢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 遥远、淡薄，随着汝即是，真如实际·施度调伏·本性寂静止息，意趣
verses.meaningEn: Having interstices or intervals, separated , distant, thin, rare, along with + Thou art, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, direction of the will
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾囉攞娑麼悉多娜捨曩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 日轮、圆满全体，本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Sun, primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, flow forth and pervade with blessing! blaze forth with wisdom radiance!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 素哩琰戍娑賀娑囉入嚩攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·第一义谛，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦攞跛紇𭋸比多滿拏攞也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，意趣尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三息灾、寂静、安隐

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三息

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 息灾寂静·本性寂静止息，摄伏本刹

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼打，离名相假立·妙行趣入，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: That + smitten, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛闥多努櫱 多娑嚩婆嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三愿成、善住

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 随着无垢

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 种类、绵羊，清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Favourable, kind, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 病人、我身，垢染、尘垢瑕疵，垢染、尘垢瑕疵

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破暗合集

verses.meaningZh: 再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·最上大悲化导）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — supreme compassionate guidance again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·摄受法流灌顶）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — consecrating Dharma-stream again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·破有相福德光，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，最上真言离言说·真如实际·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & blessedness transcending existence, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 呬婆 誐吻婆挽多迦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 慈柔呼请仁者圣众叹词，妙行趣入·第一义谛·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Gentle + O Venerable Ones! awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 扇底羯啰
verses.meaningEn: Peace and prosperity
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 糟糕、恶障尊，离一切相无相·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，本性寂静止息·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: O bad, evil, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 播跛吉 里尾灑曩捨曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 30 · 三合 1 · 引 46 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，怖畏闢，度越吧、已往彼岸尊！耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，面门、尊颜、法门入口尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, O face, mouth, gateway/door / in face, mouth, gateway/door, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningZh: 不动尊威猛降魔心印大空无碍法界虚空种子

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 9 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然，真如实际·因缘空寂大乐

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼造作离相·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨金鼻囉嚩日囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·施度调伏·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 地狱道
verses.meaningEn: Of a hell
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 乐趣胸
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + womb?
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），碎块、份额
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, a piece split off, fragment, portion
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·法界总持任持·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & Dharma-realm retention & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离垢、清净无瑕
verses.meaningEn: Immaculate, stainless, crystal-pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·净琉璃宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), lapis lazuli, beryl!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨佩殺尒也麌嚕吠𠯆哩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人星宿，祈请尘，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + star, may You dyer, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉婆囉惹也怛他櫱跢 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜，一乘如实之道·解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 佩殺尒曵佩殺 尒曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜，一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·妙行趣入·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·无我大慈三昧

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，离诸诤论无诤·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), conflict-free peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不已他，去，三摩地、正定等持
verses.meaningEn: Continual + tha, understood, grasped, Samādhi, meditative absorption
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 䬃跢怛他 櫱多三摩地
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·真如实际

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，真如实际·无我大慈三昧

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·第一义谛·离一切相无相

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·本性寂静止息·法界总持任持，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·钩召发起三昧）

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，祈请散失走失、隐退
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, may You be lost or missing, vanish, disappear, wane, perish, fly, escape, be gone
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，暗尊
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), O dark / in dark
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·造作离相

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·造作离相

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，财尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，驮于我

verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，凶尊

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝，他人，破有相福德光·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Jewel, someone else, blessedness transcending existence & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 喇怛曩鉢囉 婆賛捺囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向头汝，生起不可得·尊胜·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，箭大象尊，自在主、主宰尊，祈请尘
verses.meaningEn: Head + to Thee, transcending birth & victorious & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), reed + O an elephant, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, may You dyer
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 室囉悉帝惹室哩設囉迦哩 濕嚩囉囉惹野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，桑祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ + may You intelligent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱多 夜囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三摩尼宝尊
verses.meaningEn: O jewel / in jewel again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），真如实际·离名相假立·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝，他人，向认为在于汝
verses.meaningEn: Jewel, someone else, think + in + to Thee
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 喇怛曩鉢囉底 滿旎帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝，三婆婆尊
verses.meaningEn: Jewel, O Sambhava / in Sambhava
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），裔胄女阴尊
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, offspring + O vulva
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 珍宝净水，度越吧、已往彼岸尊！
verses.meaningEn: Jewel + water, gone, O One gone beyond!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 21 · 三合 0 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），最胜、第一、无上，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, flow forth and pervade with blessing! supreme, highest, ultimate, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉娑囉 鉢囉沫㗚你寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，以彼，舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, tayā, leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, may You intelligent, clever
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢夜 囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向大汝，速度公亩
verses.meaningEn: Great + to Thee, quickness + O acre
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），菩提觉知·因缘空寂大乐，感觉鸿毛，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, awakening (vocative invocation), perceive + down, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩 賀冐地唧多嚩日𭋸
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提认为，息灭诤怨·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + think, pacifying conflict & turmoil & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冐地滿 𠯆跛僧訖囉麼拏嚩日𭋸
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，嚩逻那，贪劣
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, a kind of tree, ardent desire, passion, attachment
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩嚩囉拏嚩娑曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，认为鸿毛，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, think + down, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，宝藏尊，一切义利成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，水星尊
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), O intelligent, clever

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 具足世间、世界尊

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·真如实际

verses.meaningZh: 彼·勇健·鸿毛，随一勇健

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·法界总持任持，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·真如实际

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，尸吊踊跃，充分、充分称计，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, curse + eager, full, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 打败·正勤·请执持
verses.meaningEn: Overpower + effort + O hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 驮齿相尊，最上真言离言说·第一义谛，摧尊
verses.meaningEn: Dha + O scratching, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, O to conquer / in to conquer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·造作离相·圣智通达，不驮，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, not + dha, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — samādhi invocation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢枳孃曩達 替
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·法界总持任持·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，世间报刊往外，等虚空无碍·破有相福德光·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, world + press out, space-like boundlessness & blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切事，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，向尽
verses.meaningEn: All + actions, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, to/for exhaustion
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 羯磨跛哩乞义夜也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有）之，一切众生、普皆有情，离名相假立·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Of my, of me (the practitioner), all sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼麼冩 薩嚩薩怛嚩難左
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净，最上真言离言说·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·法界总持任持·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊疾速！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Bhagavān, O hastening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加不是了知，修养、霸权，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + not knowing, mastery, supremacy, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉枳孃 播囉弭多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿格局，告诉严，凡彼等诸有情
verses.meaningEn: Star + structure, say, those who, whoever (pl.)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然尊，邮件贫苦，离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: O a certain, post + having no cows, conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，向利养、尊胜
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, to gain, victory, conquest
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩怛他櫱多跛哩布尒跢曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva tathaga tanujña tanu jñatavi jñataye
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，薄了知，薄，了知汝之，以了知彼尊
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, thin + knowing, thin, knowing + O your, knowing
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱跢努枳孃多努 枳孃多尾枳孃多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人·了知·星宿，一切、本刹尊
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + knowing + star, O all
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加不是了知，世间掌尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + not knowing, world + O palm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，法界总持任持·造作离相，日轮驮，自尊尊
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, the sun + dha, O pride / in pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 趣往一切处、圆通，极妙尊
verses.meaningEn: Going everywhere, all-pervading, omnipresent, universal, O beautiful, fair
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿·断除·犹如，震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊
verses.meaningEn: Star + cut + like, O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人彼，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·因缘空寂大乐，洁白、光净尊
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + he, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, O white, bright, clear, pure / in white, bright, clear, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·本性寂静止息，能作成办·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: Awake! perceive! behend! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成就、速赐悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Be accomplished! succeed! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙音
verses.meaningEn: Sound again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三宝树宝山醝
verses.meaningEn: Tree or mountain + tsa again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 25 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，称计粒子·驮·于我
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, a measure of grain + dha + to me
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 9 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 桑理趣，离名相假立·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + thought, beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！

verses.iast: namaḥ ariya veroca nayata thaga tayā
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·不拘牵·无住安立·妙行趣入·以彼！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, not, held, non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, tayā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 阿哩野吠嚧左曩也怛他櫱 跢夜

verses.meaningZh: 舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, may You intelligent, clever
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·普皆周遍（samanta）·最上真言离言说·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, all-pervading, universal, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也三滿多跋捺囉 也

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相

verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & beyond nominal designation, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净，肝脏希望

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 次复家庭，九十

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 27 · 三合 1 · 引 35 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You blow, exhale!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala·驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — dispelling sorrow, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，真如实际·最上真言离言说，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 喇怛曩怛囉夜也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·妙行迁变空·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩也摩賀𠟃你曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼器物盘子·曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a vessel or dish, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，水星大地，远离虚妄安立·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, intelligent + earth, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 警觉震动·妙行迁变空，离一切相无相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Stirring (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 87 · 三合 1 · 引 63 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 身心爽快降低，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·圣智通达，归命，酒席是的，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Refreshment + hither, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, homage to feast + yes, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼𢈔囉囉枳孃 曩謨摩賀麼𢈔哩曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·圣智通达
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 断除憍慢执障，演说、有言
verses.meaningEn: Cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), speaking, speaker
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 远离虚妄安立·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 远离虚妄安立·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond conceptual fabrication & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·妙行趣入，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，妙音尊
verses.meaningEn: Great (imperative seal), O sound / in sound
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满），调趣往
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor, tame + O going to or in
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 眉暖气，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Brow + heating, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，破暗合集·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, dissolving dense ignorance & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Great (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namo namaḥ atita nagata para tyutpane bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼真如实际·不去·他人·真如实际·一乘如实之道·第一义谛·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to immutable Suchness, not, understood, someone else, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨曩莫阿底多曩櫱多鉢囉 底聿荅半寧毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一乘如实之道，造作离相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 遏囉罕鉢囉底曵 迦沒第毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You blow, exhale!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼彼裔胄！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to he, offspring!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，唤醒自然
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, wake + certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），摧碎鸿毛，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·破暗合集
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, crushing + down, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & dissolving dense ignorance
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 室囉嚩迦僧伽南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦）·显色鸿毛·咀嚼、吞食！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, color, down, chew, devour, consume!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨蘇 韈㗚拏嚩婆薩冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 0 · 引 61 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: imāni cānena catvāry aparājitāmahāmantrahṛdayāni satatasamitaṃ likhitvā kāyagatāni kṛtvā dhārayitavyāni satatasamitaṃ manasikartavyāni svādhyāyitavyāni bhāvayitavyāni cādhyāśayena
verses.meaningZh: 一切本刹，妙行迁变空·离名相假立，妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说，无能胜佛母·大·真言·一切心，永不断，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际，一切住房尊身，既作已、行持已，放置·极微·一切勇健，永不断，事关一切任务，自性善妙·怀念·极微·一切勇健，光净·禽鸟·趣往·气息尊，妙行迁变空·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: This (plural), awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, Aparājitā + great + Mantra + heart, satatasamitaṃ, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness, dwelling in the body (plural), having done, having performed, put + or interrog + strong, satatasamitaṃ, concentrates the mind on + to be made or done, auspicious self-blessing + think of + or interrog + strong, be bright + fowl + going + O breath, awakened conduct beyond flux & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening (by spiritual power)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无能胜佛母心
verses.meaningEn: Aparājitā
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 跋囉跋囉 ｜ 三婆囉三婆囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ vimale jayavare amṛte hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毘磨利，胜伏殊胜，甘露、不死妙法尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! pure, conquer! victory! + O choicest, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 印涅哩也尾戍䭾𩕳 ｜ 吽吽
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ bhara bhara saṃbhara indriyabalaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ ruru cale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三方位、战斗，桑方位，根·力·闢·理由，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！大悲流注、光明赫奕！震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing, an organ + power + settle + O also means of purification, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! radiate compassionate light! O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚕嚕 左𥠖 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0
