verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼正法、诸法实相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namo bhagavate śākyamunaye mahākāruṇikāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Greatly Compassionate One, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切向汝、彼等·一切正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to Thee / they, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 物·勇健·趣往，归命业行，向佛陀传长阶
verses.meaningEn: Becoming + strong + going, homage + actions, Buddha + chastising + to lengthened grade vowel change
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 我、吾身，如今，桑·坡度宝山·慧眼·夜摩天尊，以一切众生日复一日疟疾
verses.meaningEn: I, myself, immediately, just, saṃ + slope of a mountain + eye + O Yama Heaven, all sentient beings + day after day + with
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢夜囉曷帝 三𦴭三沒䭾也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，大威光，大力威神勇调伏镇被处
verses.meaningEn: This (feminine accusative), Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, great + sharpness, of great power and might + sgl
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: vighnāś ca santi ye kecit tatkṣaṇād vilayaṃ gatāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 摧灭除遣·最上真言离言说以及一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，凡彼等诸有情，任何众生、凡有诸类，真如实际·造作离相·六度满行清净，闢惛沈，诸去
verses.meaningEn: Destroying obstacles and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), those who, whoever (pl.), any, some (plural), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, settle + dulling or hebetating the mind, understood, grasped
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三𦴭三沒第毗藥 ｜ 曀 釤曩莫塞訖哩怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒䭾舍 娑曩物嚧䭾曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! steadfast sacred mountain peak again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 具歌咏、歌手尊
verses.meaningEn: O bearer of singing, singer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 97 · 三合 5 · 引 154 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 具足宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护尊
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with steadfast sacred mountain peak

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼器物盘子·多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在）·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a vessel or dish, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，法界总持任持·造作离相·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency & beyond conceptual fabrication
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，法界总持任持·造作离相，麦，造作离相·妙行迁变空·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (imperative seal), Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, any grain or corn, barley or a barley-corn, freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 跛哩秫䭾迦也嚩 枳唧多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 病人、我身，一样此尊之，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，彼之、其（属格）
verses.meaningEn: Sick, the same + of this, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, his, of that
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿弭跢 𢈔灑瀉怛他櫱多冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立，妙行趣入·真如实际·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），胸严桑，胸严
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, clump + saṃ, clump, mass, thicket
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，豪气，以垢染、尘垢瑕疵
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, heroism, by/through stain, impurity, defilement
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多 尾哩也麼𥠖曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加·太·桑，胸严，一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + very + saṃ, clump, mass, thicket, supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉底僧 賀囉阿欲
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三遭遇、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Encounter, fight again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，桑过去
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, saṃ + made or consisting of
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三菩提、无上正觉
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — dispelling sorrow, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds (imperative seal), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悟，菩提觉知·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Waking, awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，阿婆罗，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, lower, inferior, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩播跛阿嚩囉拏尾秫第
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离，再三垢染、尘垢瑕疵，向星宿、那乞叉多罗
verses.meaningEn: Lost, hopeless, stain, impurity, defilement again and again, to star, asterism, lunar mansion
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 26 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，广大、宽博无量，凡彼等诸有情，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, vast, extensive, abundant, profound, those who, whoever (pl.), cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — purified faculties
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多尾補攞拽 瑟置
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无用、珍宝，能生不、非、无，生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Worthless, causing not, non-, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，以彼祭祠，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), impulse, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾步史多拽瑟置度嚕度嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），众观
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, O look, gaze
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，闢·净化·自然
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, settle + purify + O certainly
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩播跛尾戍䭾寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力
verses.meaningEn: Awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加鸿毛，活期祭祠
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + down, current + impulse
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，宝幢、胜幡尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), O victory banner, standard / in victory banner, standard
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 光明本刹，离一切相无相·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Light + this, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼星宿特·推广鸿毛·九十·曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to star, bull, extend, down, ninety, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨婆誐嚩旦曩嚩曩嚩底 南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，水星大地，远离虚妄安立·离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, intelligent + earth, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 百彼，因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Hundred + he, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: gagana dīvalu kasamanāṃ namaḥ sarva ṇivara ṇaviṣi kaṃbhiṇibo dhisata vaya
verses.meaningZh: 虚空、清净苍穹，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，归命，一切、普皆遍满，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，造作离相·破有相福德光·离诸诤论无诤，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Sky, boundless space, firmament, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, homage to all, every, complete, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence & conflict-free peace, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 凝誐曩 你嚩虜迦娑麼南曩莫薩嚩 𩕳嚩囉拏尾色劒鼻抳冐 地薩怛嚩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，嚩逻那，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, a kind of tree, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩嚩囉拏尾戍䭾𩕳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，一乘如实之道·第一义谛，离一切相无相·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, freedom from conditioned marks & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛 他櫱多阿欲播攞𩕳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量尊
verses.meaningEn: O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊
verses.meaningEn: O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持，归命，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化），除此之外、此外
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention, homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, except, besides, without
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩悉䭾曩莫 塞訖㗚帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三方位、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Bearing, carrying again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，转动具故乡
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, turn + O bearer of home
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩薩 怛嚩嚩路枳𩕳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说，烦恼闢，六度满行清净·造作离相·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech, passion + settle, perfection of the six pāramitās & freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩𩕳嚩 囉拏尾色劒鼻抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪业，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，法界总持任持·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All + evil, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace (imperative seal), Dharma-realm retention & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 1 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，光明照耀、笑眯眯
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, shining, beaming
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，狱王
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, O holder, bridle or driver
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 7 · 三合 0 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·六度满行清净，咤遇到，过去、阿修罗尊
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — dispelling sorrow, Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, tha + meet, O made or consisting of

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼九·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to nine, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼笑声，真如实际·造作离相·远离虚妄安立，以意趣及百彼，因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: That + laughter, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), direction of the will + and hundred + he, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他薩 多句置曩𢈔多設多娑賀薩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 虚空、清净苍穹，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Sky, boundless space, firmament, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 具震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊
verses.meaningEn: O bearer of stir awake and shake off delusion!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊，短暂裤子，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: O stir awake and shake off delusion! a waist-cloth used by a nun, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，离一切相无相·支分寂静·造作离相，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 2 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 42 · 三合 0 · 引 40 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，妙行趣入·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, awakened spiritual movement & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑 櫱囉捏具灑也怛他櫱多 也

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，具足揭幕、一些尊
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, O one endowed with cleaving, rending, opening

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切事，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，嚩逻那，离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: All + actions, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, a kind of tree, conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩羯磨阿 嚩囉拏𩕳銘
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），一切众生、普皆有情，离名相假立·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), all sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼麼薩嚩薩怛嚩 難左
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，施予饮料尊
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, O giving to drink / in giving to drink
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切苦，祈请渴饮
verses.meaningEn: All + suffering, may You drinking, beverage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三施度调伏·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三席
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请击碎、破除一切结缚！请摧裂、粉碎一切灾障恶星！耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Shatter! split open! burst asunder! shatter obstacles! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑怖吒也娑怖吒 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，阿婆罗，离诸诤论无诤·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，施度调伏·妙行趣入，真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, lower, inferior, conflict-free peace & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩阿嚩囉拏播也訥櫱 底寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 胜者、最胜诸佛，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti
verses.meaningEn: Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·生起不可得·尊胜，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，活期我
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, current + me
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 滿乳室哩也素室哩也跢 囉也𤚥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，苦、一切逼恼苦厄尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, O suffering, pain, sorrow, distress / in suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三息
verses.meaningEn: May You rest! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，真如实际·施度调伏·破有相福德光，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿蜜㗚 妬納婆務納婆嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·无住安立，脂睡
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise, sleep
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 2 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普皆周遍（samanta）·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading, universal, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 周遍彼，泮吒（摧破魔障）！烦恼闢，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持·解脱系缚大力，法界总持任持·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: No rest or remainder + he, Phaṭ! passion + settle, primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention & spiritual strength freeing bonds (imperative seal), Dharma-realm retention & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿勢灑娑癹 囉拏尾秫䭾沒地毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: daśadī sarva tathaga tebhyo arhatebhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·本性寂静止息，一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，向诸向汝、彼等，向诸应供、阿罗汉（破烦恼贼），向诸正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, to/from to Thee / they, to all Arhat, Worthy One, to all Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娜捨溺 薩嚩怛他櫱帝毗喻囉曷毗藥 三𦴭三沒第毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·摧碎此处尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal), crushing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 全部、圆满一切，垢染、尘垢瑕疵
verses.meaningEn: Entire, complete, all, stain, impurity, defilement
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 点子、相好标帜，第一义谛·妙行趣入·真如实际，生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Spot, mark, ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦楞迦 跛櫱多際多細
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离垢、清净无瑕，功德、殊胜妙德，离一切相无相·支分寂静·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Immaculate, stainless, crystal-pure, virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾麼攞麌拏 楞訖㗚跢也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 仙人、天神，男子报刊往外，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Immortal, man + press out, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，持守摄受·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障，天冠、宝冠
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride, crown, diadem, crest
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊足·押·不动尊威猛降魔心印，尊胜降伏·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Foot + to press + Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable, conquering
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 49 · 三合 1 · 引 92 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·唤醒自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, wake, certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无碍诸传
verses.meaningEn: Unobstructed + of all chastising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿鉢囉底 賀多舍娑曩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Conquering
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙胜伏
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing + conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，具色相尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, O bearer of form
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙住埸
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing + coming into existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，施度调伏·离名相假立·本性寂静止息，闢祈请龙卷
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — dispelling sorrow, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace, settle + may You turner
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒 憚室左尾薩㗚惹也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼般，殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: He + wisdom, choicest, supreme boon, excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙愿成，离名相假立·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing + be! become! beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 日复一日、之后，向成员，睡
verses.meaningEn: Day after day, to limb, member, sleep
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 桑所成，那罗本刹，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Made of saṃ, man + this, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三麼也麼努娑麼 囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，清净离诸尘垢·无住安立·本性寂静止息，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, stainless purity free from dust & non-abiding equipoise & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），施度调伏·离名相假立·真如实际，弯曲然而
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — purified faculties, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, crossing + but
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 悉 殿覩滿怛囉跛諾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 那罗能使车，于我、为我
verses.meaningEn: Man + waggon, to me, my
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，活期、流程
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 14 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以莲华及·尊胜降伏·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to lotus flower and conquering!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨鉢納謨多囉囉惹也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: ta thagata yāraha tesaṃmya saṃbudha ya
verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），他去，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，桑水星，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, tha + understood, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ + intelligent, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛 他櫱多夜囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·因缘空寂大乐·他祈请去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to lotus flower (pure, unstained), supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, tha, may You understood!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨鉢納麼尾𢈔賀也怛 他櫱跢也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼造作离相·圣智通达·离名相假立·理趣·一乘如实之道·真如实际·无住安立·祈请去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & beyond nominal designation, thought, believed, supposed, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, may You understood, grasped!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨枳孃曩麼多 曵怛他櫱跢也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也 滿乳室哩夜也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向诸向汝、彼等，归命，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化），真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: To/from to Thee / they, homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 帝毗喻曩莫塞訖㗚怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 此闢，施度调伏·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: This + settle, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊𤚥尾你也鉢囉嚩入乞义也 弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，莲华桑，愿成、善住尊
verses.meaningEn: O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), lotus flower + saṃ, O be! become! / in be! become!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢納銘鉢納麼叄 婆吠
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 钵头摩弯曲
verses.meaningEn: O crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大吉祥草，惛沈
verses.meaningEn: Mahākuśa, O dulling or hebetating the mind
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 闢隙弃罗，水星尊
verses.meaningEn: Settle + staff, O intelligent, clever
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，舍离·床坐·此处尊
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, leave + seat
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他 櫱多囉賀細曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 2 · 引 28 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙愿成，平

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，平

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满

verses.meaningZh: 驮理趣，无住安立·真如实际，平

verses.meaningZh: 再三平

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三施度调伏·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 11 · 三合 0 · 引 14 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼星宿特·真如实际·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to star, bull, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，圣智通达·第一义谛，向体育、娱乐
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), non-dual wisdom awareness & ultimate truth, to sport, amusement
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉枳孃播 囉弭跢曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·以弯曲、超群·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, with/by crossing, surpassing, overcoming, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨喇怛曩怛囉夜 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼病人、我身·星宿拘牵·他去·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sick, star, held, tha, understood, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨阿弭跢婆也怛他櫱跢 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩 囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），彼祈请汝之
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, he + may You your
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，眉薄，之后祈请彼岸
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, brow + thin, or emphasizing particle + may You carrying over
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，入，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, moving hither and thither, activity, industry, propensity or devotion to, zeal for, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩薩 怛嚩弭也娑曩伽底寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，究竟解脱·无我大慈三昧，祈请掌
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, emancipating, may You palm
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩薩怛 嚩謨乞叉迦囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，发现物此边，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, finding + the hither, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩尾你也囉惹尾訖㗚跢也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），发现物此边，耳语辐条，无我大慈三昧·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, finding + the hither, whisper + spoke of a wheel, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 尾你也囉惹鉢囉穆訖帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息，归命，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化），真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace, homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊南阿 哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·造作离相·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 认为弯曲，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Think + crossing, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 滿怛囉麼韈㗚多逸 史夜弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，义利彼，驮之后
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, meaning + he, dha + or emphasizing particle
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，障碍虚空，长柄、融通
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, obstacle + hole, stem, demin
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，毒害不，本性寂静止息·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, poison + not, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，障碍想必，长柄、融通
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, obstacle + surely, stem, demin
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）尊，真如实际·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，离一切相无相·支分寂静·妙行趣入，笑声、欢喜
verses.meaningEn: O blaze forth with wisdom radiance! immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 入嚩理多尾娑普陵誐吒賀娑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 花鬘，妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障·一切诸谛圆满，断除憍慢执障·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Also filament, of a lotus, awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, cutting rigid pride & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，想必裔胄
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, surely + offspring
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 齲囉捏伽多曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 动，财物，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, good, wholesome, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离一切相无相·离诸诤论无诤，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，天神，真如实际·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, god, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 多攞𩕳濕嚩娑麼嚕妬 得乞插多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大地，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: The earth, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·六度满行清净，离诸诤论无诤·断除憍慢执障·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās, conflict-free peace & cutting rigid pride & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然尊，邮件无垢
verses.meaningEn: O a certain, post + stainless
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，幸运、财富
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, gladdening, delighting
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·真如实际，真如实际·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三唤醒此处
verses.meaningEn: Wake again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & generosity & self-mastery again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人认为，弯曲、超群
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + think, crossing, surpassing, overcoming
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自我认为，莽娑尊，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Self + think, O flesh, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 遏荅麼滿 怛囉悉朕銘
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），种类鹿科不是
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! a kind of deer + also not
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，曜执、星曜鬼神执障尊，六度满行清净·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, O planet, seizing spirit/graha / in planet, seizing spirit/graha, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），离名相假立·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，演出缓缓汝即是
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, act slowly + Thou art
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉能瑟吒囉緊唧囉也枲
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·施度调伏，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性），曜执、星曜鬼神执障
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising, planet, seizing spirit/graha
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 暴恶者、恶心障难，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三护摩献供·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Offering oblation again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他）
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三褐子
verses.meaningEn: Cloth again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 水星，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Intelligent, clever, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·造作离相，圣智通达·真如实际·造作离相，无我大慈三昧·造作离相，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), non-dual wisdom awareness & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿努枳孃擔羯磨矩 嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 賀也屹㗚嚩也 癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），牯牛祈请弯曲，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, bull + may You crossing, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日 囉遇怛囉也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 寧怛囉也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），离名相假立·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉能瑟 吒囉也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），蹄，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, razor, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉齲囉 也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，破暗合集·真如实际，意趣，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness, direction of the will, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉齲囉捏伽哆 曩也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人认为，弯曲·闢·不，祈请行星土曜，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + think, crossing + settle + not, may You the planet Saturn! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 跛囉滿怛囉尾曩 捨曩也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，造作离相·一乘如实之道·破有相福德光，祈请哪些，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & blessedness transcending existence, may You = who, which! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛𡃤路枳也婆 孕迦囉也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva kamiṣi va a parati hātaya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·六度满行清净，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，他人，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·一乘如实之道，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, someone else, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩羯弭澁嚩阿 鉢囉底賀多也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），造作离相·离一切相无相·真如实际，祈请叫声、水深，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, may You roaring, screaming, sounding! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 矩攞怛囉娑曩也癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 4 · 引 75 · 弹舌 0

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩謨喇怛曩怛囉夜也 ｜ 曩莫阿 哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉也 ｜ 冐 地薩怛嚩也 ｜ 摩賀薩怛嚩 也 ｜ 摩賀迦嚕抳迦也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩 薩怛嚩弭也娑曩伽底寧 ｜ 曩莫薩 嚩薩怛嚩弭也娑曩賀哩妳 ｜ 曩莫 薩嚩薩怛嚩婆聿跢囉拏也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩婆也鉢囉陜麼曩 迦囉也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩弭也地 唧吉攃曩迦囉也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩 滿䭾曩砌娜曩迦囉也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩薩 怛嚩耨佉鉢囉捨麼拏迦囉也 ｜ 曩 莫薩嚩尾你演䭾迦囉尾䭾麼曩迦囉 也 ｜ 曩莫薩嚩尾你也地櫱多母㗚多曵 ｜ 摩賀迦嚕抳迦也 ｜ 曩莫薩 嚩尾你也囉惹鉢囉鉢多曵 ｜ 摩賀喻儗濕嚩囉也 ｜ 怛娑 每曩莫塞訖㗚怛嚩 ｜ 伊南阿哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉 ｜ 木屈 娜儗㗚喃 ｜ 乙㗚史尾你也䭾 囉 ｜ 祢嚩曩誐藥乞叉𠸪乞叉 娑 ｜ 必底哩比捨左巘達嚩 ｜ 賛捺 囉阿捏底也屹囉賀諾乞察 怛囉 ｜ 爍訖囉沒囉憾麼路迦 播攞 ｜ 尾瑟拏麼係濕嚩囉塞建 娜麼底哩誐拏 ｜ 曩莫塞訖㗚擔 ｜ 賀也屹哩挽曩麼跛囉麼紇㗚 乃也 ｜ 麼韈㗚多逸史夜弭 ｜ 薩嚩羯磨遏㗚他娑䭾劒 ｜ 秫𠴞 ｜ 阿娑訖𭌇 ｜ 薩嚩步跢南 ｜ 尾 灑𧹞際尾伽多劒 ｜ 薩嚩訥瑟吒 南 ｜ 娜麼劒 ｜ 怛你也他 ｜ 唵 ｜ 多嚕攞多嚕攞 ｜ 尾嚕攞尾嚕攞 ｜ 薩嚩 尾灑伽多迦 ｜ 薩嚩步多尾捺囉 麼迦 ｜ 入嚩里多曩攞 ｜ 尾娑普 陵誐吒賀娑 ｜ 計娑囉娑吒 跓跛 ｜ 鉢囉勿㗚䭾吠誐 ｜ 嚩日囉齲囉捏伽多曩 ｜ 左里多 嚩素䭾 ｜ 多攞𩕳濕嚩悉多賀悉多 ｜ 麼嚕妬得乞插多 ｜ 䭾囉抳䭾囉 鉢囉勃㗚底 ｜ 步多誐拏娑母賀 ｜ 尾屈𱽧婆拏迦囉 ｜ 跛囉尾你 也三薄乞叉拏羯囉 ｜ 跛囉麼扇 底迦囉 ｜ 沒地也沒地也 ｜ 婆 誐挽賀也屹哩嚩 ｜ 佉娜佉娜 ｜ 跛囉滿怛囉 ｜ 𠸪乞叉𠸪乞叉遏荅 麼滿怛囒悉地銘 ｜ 鉢囉尾捨鉢 囉尾捨 ｜ 麼麼試竭𫬠 ｜ 捺㗚 捨嚕𠰢 ｜ 阿尾捨阿尾捨 ｜ 入 嚩囉比舍左 ｜ 藥乞叉𠸪乞叉 娑誐𧹞 ｜ 薩怛嚩尾係姹建 ｜ 薩嚩 屹囉係澁嚩鉢囉底賀妬麼麼嚩囉 ｜ 嚩日囉能瑟吒囉緊唧囉也 枲 ｜ 伊南訥瑟吒屹囉憾訥瑟 吒比舍𭨚嚩 ｜ 阿度曩阿度曩 ｜ 尾度曩尾度曩 ｜ 伊滿左訥瑟吒 薩跛吠薩跛 ｜ 路多遇拏枲迦囉 理勿㗚室唧迦尾釤 ｜ 度曩度曩 ｜ 尾度曩尾度曩 ｜ 末他末他 ｜ 鉢囉 末他鉢囉末他 ｜ 捏嚩賀也 ｜ 阿戍婆滿底𭋸拏囉誐尾釤 ｜ 每 底唎滿底𭋸拏你吠灑尾釤 ｜ 鉢囉枳孃滿底𭋸拏謨賀尾釤 ｜ 補娜誐囉奈𫬠銘曩 ｜ 吉礼舍 嚩囉拏尾釤 ｜ 達磨奈囉遏荅弭也 滿底𭋸拏 ｜ 枳𡰱夜嚩囉拏尾 釤 ｜ 沒䭾達磨僧伽枳孃也羯磨 試竭𫬠 ｜ 矩嚕矩嚕 ｜ 賀也屹哩 嚩也癹吒 ｜ 嚩日囉齲囉 也癹吒 ｜ 尾曩舍曩迦囉也癹吒 ｜ 嚩日囉能瑟跓嚧得迦吒佩 囉嚩也癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩訥瑟吒滿怛囉 尾曩捨曩也癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩屹囉 護蹉娜曩迦囉也癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩屹囉 係澁嚩鉢囉底賀妬跛麼也癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩怛囉阿鉢囉底賀多羯磨抳 癹吒 ｜ 跛囉尾你也三薄乞叉拏也癹吒 ｜ 嚩拏嚩木佉也癹吒 ｜ 薩嚩屹囉賀比舍左寧曵嚩捨麼 曩也癹吒 ｜ 夜韈妬麼麼呬帶史拏娑旦薩鍐嚩拏嚩木契曩 𩕳 訖㗚跢也癹吒 ｜ 達弭迦拏左銘羯 磨抳 ｜ 試竭𫬠矩嚕 ｜ 吽吽吽 ｜ 癹吒癹吒癹吒 ｜ 娑嚩賀」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·入·破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, moving hither and thither, activity, industry, propensity or devotion to, zeal for, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩 薩怛嚩弭也娑曩伽底寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·入·以拿来净水！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, moving hither and thither, activity, industry, propensity or devotion to, zeal for, by to fetch water!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩 嚩薩怛嚩弭也娑曩賀哩妳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·真如实际·祈请烦恼！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, may You passion, sin, depravity!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 薩嚩薩怛嚩婆聿跢囉拏也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·第一义谛·息灾寂静·清净离诸尘垢·祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, pacifying, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩婆也鉢囉陜麼曩 迦囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·刺骨尊·妙行迁变空·造作离相·不祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, O piercing, hitting, perforation, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency, not, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩弭也地 唧吉攃曩迦囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）·离名相假立·一乘如实之道·施度调伏·不祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery, not, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩 滿䭾曩砌娜曩迦囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·施度调伏·等虚空无碍·第一义谛·息灾寂静·清净离诸尘垢·能作成办·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, generosity & self-mastery & space-like boundlessness & ultimate truth, pacifying, making!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩 怛嚩耨佉鉢囉捨麼拏迦囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 128 · 三合 6 · 引 116 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva vidya dhaka ravidha manakara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·发现物·法界总持任持·造作离相·日轮驮·能生自尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, finding, getting, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, the sun, dha, causing pride, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 2 · 引 30 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 13 · 三合 0 · 引 16 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道

verses.meaningZh: 世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），踊跃、忠诚，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: The Blessed One, Bhagavān, eager, devoted, faithful, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·造作离相·圣智通达·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼忻凹·活期、流程！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to joyful, bowed, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨喇怛曩怛 囉夜也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼病人、我身·星宿拘牵·以他去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sick, star, held, tha, with!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨阿弭跢婆也怛 他櫱跢夜
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，水星，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, intelligent, clever, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩 囉也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），彼祈请汝之
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, he + may You your
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼乐趣贪·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·真如实际·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gladden, consideration, selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨摩賀娑他麼鉢囉鉢跢 也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大器物盘子，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Great + a vessel or dish, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼广大、宽博无量·闢自尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to vast, extensive, abundant, profound, settle, pride!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨尾補攞尾麼曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外他人，祈请安住加持尊，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Press out + someone else, O abide steadfastly & bestow grace! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 桑·虚空·此处，日轮、圆满全体
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + hole, sun
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 百彼，笑声、欢喜，嬉一
verses.meaningEn: Hundred + he, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision, pleasure + one
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 捨多娑賀娑 囉底𭋸迦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人星宿，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + star, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉婆嚩婆 悉多母㗚多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席是的，离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧·造作离相，造作离相·离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相，具请执持、总持护念！尊
verses.meaningEn: Feast + yes, conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks, O bearer of hold! bear! sustain!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀麼抳木矩吒 軍拏攞䭾哩抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），向手掌、执持尊手
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, lotus flower (pure, unstained), to hand, palm
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 鉢納麼播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，随一恶趣
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, mostly ) look + evil state
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请寂静息灭、止息灾障（古译「奢摩奴」）
verses.meaningEn: May You pacifying, calming, extinguishing afflictions!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 各个、种种，施度调伏·等虚空无碍·一切诸谛圆满，定居者闢，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Of different kinds, various, manifold, generosity & self-mastery & space-like boundlessness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, settler + settle, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾尾䭾耨佉三麼 吠舍尾瑟吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，最胜无上、郁多摩，祈请不是、就是
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, supreme, highest, may You also not, even , even, nor
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩薩怛嚩 跛哩謨左曩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 乐趣光明，时间
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + light, active, clever, skilled
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 63 · 三合 0 · 引 101 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence (imperative seal)!

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀娑他麼鉢囉 鉢跢

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·三重、三合会！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, triple, threefold!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，向长柄
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, to/for stem
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），不、非、无，一乘如实之道·施度调伏·离名相假立，祈请掌
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! not, non-, supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, may You palm
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩滿䭾曩 砌娜曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，星宿你们，无我大慈三昧·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相，活期、流程
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, star + you, selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩婆嚩叄母訥嚕酢灑拏迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持，息灾寂静·清净离诸尘垢，不祈请掌
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention, pacifying, not + may You palm
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩弭野地鉢 囉捨麼曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·真如实际，句、足迹、法位，妙音闢，损失，祈请掌
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), word, verse-foot, step, abode, sound + settle, disappearance, loss, may You palm
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩吠底𢈔鉢捺 囉嚩尾曩捨曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·真如实际，离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩婆 曵數怛囉拏野怛冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — expansive quiescence!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 112 · 三合 1 · 引 160 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
