verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·以守护掩蔽、度脱从中！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, with/by protect shelter, rescue from!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: ya namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），归命，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 野曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，向星宿、那乞叉多罗，顶
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, to star, asterism, lunar mansion, clear, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，活期彼之
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, current + his
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·汝之、圣尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊，汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, your, thine
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊𤚥阿哩野 嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉荅嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相，高兴·荼·不，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks, be glad + dha + not, great, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 𩕳攞 蹇綻曩麼紇㗚乃野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），六度满行清净·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼韈 㗚多以史夜弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，能使车彼，财
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, waggon + he, treasure
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 山羊此圣女
verses.meaningEn: Drift + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，昂裔胄
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, arise + offspring
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 汝本刹，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，驮之后
verses.meaningEn: You + this, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace (imperative seal), dha + or emphasizing particle
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆嚩沬㗚誐尾戍 䭾劒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 阿罗伽尊
verses.meaningEn: O not the world, the end of the world / in not the world, the end of the world
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世间、世界
verses.meaningEn: World, realm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 遭遇彼，临危、死厄
verses.meaningEn: Encounter + he, dying, death
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），我
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大一样，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Great + like, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·法界总持任持，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Bearing (vocative invocation), Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 垢染闢，垢染、尘垢瑕疵
verses.meaningEn: Stain + settle, stain, impurity, defilement
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，除此之外、此外
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness, except, besides, without
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·摄受法流灌顶），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — consecrating Dharma-stream, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，六度满行清净·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，睡
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, sleep
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，毒害闢，祈请散失走失、隐退
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, poison + settle, may You be lost or missing, vanish, disappear, wane, perish, fly, escape, be gone
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愚痴、无明迷妄，毒害闢，祈请散失走失、隐退
verses.meaningEn: Delusion, ignorance, bewilderment, poison + settle, may You be lost or missing, vanish, disappear, wane, perish, fly, escape, be gone
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 謨賀 尾灑尾曩捨野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 59 · 三合 1 · 引 81 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向乐趣种姓
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + to running or fighting match
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Conquering, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Conquering (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三尊手
verses.meaningEn: Hand again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三垢染、尘垢瑕疵
verses.meaningEn: Stain, impurity, defilement again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三表面地面
verses.meaningEn: Surface of the ground again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切事，嚩逻那，离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: All + actions, a kind of tree, conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼笑声，向妙音汝
verses.meaningEn: He + laughing, sound + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，水星，观照、慈悲垂视尊
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, intelligent, clever, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩沒䭾嚩路枳帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 听弯曲
verses.meaningEn: To listen + crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 各个、一切
verses.meaningEn: Each, every
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自尊
verses.meaningEn: Pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，法界总持任持·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (imperative seal), Dharma-realm retention & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人报刊往外，清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + press out, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, stream forth auspicious ambrosia!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉蘇嚕鉢囉 蘇嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，以唤醒上，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, wake + up, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 熔断下，真如实际·妙行趣入·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Blow + then, immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无愿成、善住，自性善妙愿成
verses.meaningEn: Non-be! become! auspicious self-blessing + be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，熔断种类，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, blow + favourable, primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 32 · 弹舌 0

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冐地薩怛嚩野摩 賀薩怛嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，各个、一切
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), each, every
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼两个九·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to two, nine, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，汝之大地，远离虚妄安立·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, your + earth, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 以上、以内，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Up, above, over, within, besides, moreover, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, freedom from conditioned marks & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三喷香、曼殊
verses.meaningEn: Sweet-smelling, fragrant, lovely, charming, the spring again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 于诸大、摩诃（广大无边）中，部分马车
verses.meaningEn: In great, vast, supreme, a part of a chariot
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大慧
verses.meaningEn: Great wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩 囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·离名相假立，普皆周遍（samanta），演说下，烦恼
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), all-pervading, universal, speaking + then, O passion, sin, depravity
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 悉殿覩三滿多跋捺囉䭾 囉抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）·破暗合集·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, dissolving dense ignorance & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·威神增益圆满），最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，六度满行清净·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — perfected spiritual vigor, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace, perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 器物盘子，一样本刹，离名相假立·造作离相·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: A vessel or dish, te + this, beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩怛 嚩曩麼努劒跛野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，弯曲、超群，他人星宿，六度满行清净·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, crossing, surpassing, overcoming, someone else + star, perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊南滿怛囉 鉢囉婆史擔
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩 路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, O compassion, each, every
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 46 · 三合 2 · 引 62 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，归命，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，祈请掌
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, homage to freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, may You palm

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 29 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!

verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 29 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 猴，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）

verses.meaningZh: 酪面门

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 29 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净，观照堪

verses.meaningZh: 此尊之彼，他不，去之

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，苦富人

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 29 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离名相假立

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 0 · 引 29 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·本性寂静止息，然而、而、实则

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·离名相假立

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 面纱日复一日，去
verses.meaningEn: Veil + day after day, understood, grasped
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva budhabo dhisata vakprasa rasaṃmū nire bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，最上真言离言说·造作离相·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒䭾冒 地薩怛嚩鉢囉娑囉三母涅𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉底曵迦沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，寒鸦桑，妙行趣入·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, trickster + saṃ, awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哩 野室囉嚩迦僧祇毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际，不去，造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness, not + understood, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, offspring, child!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 0 · 引 120 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace

verses.meaningEn: Homage to autumn, also = year, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 117 · 三合 3 · 引 123 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 117 · 三合 3 · 引 123 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，汝之、圣尊之尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, O your, thine / in your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩 怛吠毗藥

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 道德，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩野嚩 路枳帝濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，广大殊胜·施度调伏，器物盘子
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, great, a vessel or dish
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 精神忧苦，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Drive + not-joy, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大·彼·他，无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Great + he + tha, selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀娑他 麼鉢囉鉢多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行流布·离诸诤论无诤，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Practicing (vocative invocation), Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成就、速赐悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Be accomplished! succeed! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: Awake! perceive! behend! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三痕迹尊
verses.meaningEn: O thick hard skin, callosity, scar again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, your, thine
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三掌
verses.meaningEn: Palm again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ）
verses.meaningEn: Scatter rays of blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业大地，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! + earth, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，本性寂静止息·第一义谛·真如实际，持相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, primordial tranquil peace & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), holder of work, activity, attendance
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀跛輸鉢底吠灑䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，因缘空寂大乐，乾陀罗
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), of a Gandharva
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！掌
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! palm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说，百彼，笑声、欢喜，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), hundred + he, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 喇濕弭設多娑賀娑 囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三暖气、炽燃
verses.meaningEn: Heating, burning, tormenting again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 52 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，特

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya amita bhayata thagatayā
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·病人、我身·星宿拘牵·以他去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, sick, star, held, tha, with!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野阿弭跢婆野怛他櫱跢夜
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊
verses.meaningEn: O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·法界总持任持，日轮眉，六度满行清净·真如实际·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & Dharma-realm retention, the sun + brow, perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢 納麼䭾囉尾步史多步薺
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿猕猴，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Star + of a monkey, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 收，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Searched, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无用不，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Worthless + not, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），最上真言离言说·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，一乘如实之道·离一切相无相·支分寂静，支分寂静·造作离相·真如实际，清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme ineffable speech & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs, quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉吠𠯆哩野楞 訖㗚多舍利囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群
verses.meaningEn: Crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请弯曲、超群，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊）
verses.meaningEn: May You crossing, surpassing, overcoming, the Blessed One, Bhagavān
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿特，真如实际·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Star + bull, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜）
verses.meaningEn: Firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·因缘空寂大乐，器物盘子
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, a vessel or dish
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施愿者、满善愿尊，哪些
verses.meaningEn: Boon-granting, wish-bestowing, = who, which
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐地薩怛嚩嚩囉娜
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），古老
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower (pure, unstained), old, ancient
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 78 · 三合 0 · 引 80 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）·面纱相随！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, veil, gone after!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱帝毗 藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·他人·一乘如实之道·造作离相·解脱系缚大力！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, someone else, supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉底曵迦沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·造作离相，会议、遭遇尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, O sticking to, hanging upon, contact with, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哩野室囉嚩迦僧祇毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊）·他人面门·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, someone else, O face, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 每底𭋸野鉢囉穆契毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），菩提彼，勇健宝树宝山，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Bodhi + he, strong + tree or mountain, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 冐地薩怛嚩誐拏嚩𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·请执持、总持护念！！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩日囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，天人、诸天护法，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, god, celestial deity (Deva), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 滿拏攞祢嚩帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 燄麼嚩嚕拏矩 吠囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 六度满行清净·妙行趣入，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & awakened spiritual movement, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 喇怛曩怛囉夜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野 嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），能作成办·因缘空寂大乐，离诸诤论无诤·造作离相·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, making (imperative seal), conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，勇健严，造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, strong, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱跢嚩路枳多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 羂索（慈悲摄缚索），造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Noose, lasso (compassionate binding), freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，无我大慈三昧·法界总持任持·真如实际，女阴

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 才，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk
verses.meaningEn: Excellence, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，真如实际·妙行趣入·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多嚩路枳多櫱婆
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，圣智通达·真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Great, non-dual wisdom awareness & immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，幅度汝即是，此恶者辐条
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, width + Thou art, alas! shame! fie! + spoke of a wheel
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 嚩囉悉地迦囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，射·于此·此边
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, to strike + here + the hither
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，意趣彼岸
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, direction of the will + carrying over
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切苦，为自任，妙行迁变空·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: All + suffering, paramo, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 耨佉鉢囉謨左迦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以迫切往外及！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to pressing out, O and!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）·面纱相随！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, veil, gone after!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·真如实际，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢 囉底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立，度越吧、已往彼岸尊！耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, gone, O One gone beyond! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他 櫱帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，海会众殊胜，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, assembly + O choicest, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐地薩怛嚩 誐拏嚩𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·请执持、总持护念！！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野 嚩日囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva manṇala devata vidīya raje bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，何为，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，尘尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, divinity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, O dyer, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩滿拏攞祢嚩多 尾你也囉薺毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大认为，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + think, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀滿拏攞 鉢納銘
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 66 · 三合 3 · 引 74 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva bodhisa tava namaḥ skṛ ṛte
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，菩提彼，汝之、圣尊之，归命，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化），除此之外、此外

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿謨 伽摩賀鉢囉枳孃嚩婆娑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，颇烦恼，请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, pha + passion, awake! perceive! behend!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三 滿多娑頗囉拏沒𠆙
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人彼，絮叨辐条，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + he, chatter + spoke of a wheel, flow forth and pervade with blessing!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉娑囉鉢囉 娑囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, awake! perceive! behend!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，各个、一切
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks, each, every
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊）
verses.meaningEn: The Blessed One, Bhagavān
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，圣智通达·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), non-dual wisdom awareness & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·圣智通达，殊胜、胜愿、妙好，施度调伏·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀鉢囉枳孃嚩囉 娜播抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·圣智通达
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，持摩尊，离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, O bearer of ma, conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢納 麼䭾哩抳步薺
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）·面纱相随！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, veil, gone after!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，如来佛顶肉髻相
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Tathāgata + Uṣṇīṣa
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱妬 瑟抳灑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，秘密藏护持尊尊，凡彼等诸有情，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, O guardian of the esoteric secret treasury / in guardian of the esoteric secret treasury, those who, whoever (pl.), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿謨伽滿拏攞麌係 曵毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠 毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva kpratiye kabudha riyaśi ravaka saṃgibhyo
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·破有相福德光！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉底曵迦沒䭾 哩野室囉嚩迦僧祇毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立，妙行趣入·真如实际·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底多曩櫱多鉢囉底聿荅半甯毗 藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva tathaga taguhi yaku lahṛ ṛnaiya saṃmaye bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入·真如实际·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·造作离相·离一切相无相·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·一乘如实之道·桑过去·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, saṃ, O made or consisting of, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩怛他櫱跢麌呬野矩 攞紇㗚乃野三麼曵毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼箭两个·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to reed, two, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫舍囉納嚩底素跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），向不动尊威猛降魔心印太
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable + to very
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·造作离相·第一义谛·虚空富人！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth (imperative seal), hole, belonging to one's household!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野每底𭋸 野鉢囉穆契毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，幅度此处，海会众殊胜，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, width, assembly + O choicest, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐 地薩怛嚩哩野誐拏嚩𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼病人、我身·怖畏、灾难惊恐！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sick, fear, peril, danger, dread!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，桑祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ + may You intelligent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢 夜囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）·真如实际·离名相假立·活期、流程！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨喇 怛曩怛囉夜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼钵头摩·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to padmo, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨鉢納謨 瑟抳灑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，祈请请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, may You hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 146 · 三合 3 · 引 137 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），法界总持任持·造作离相，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，本性寂静止息·第一义谛·真如实际

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，大地活跃，过去、阿修罗

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 9 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·造作离相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野地尾迦南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立，妙行趣入·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 能此处，法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，法界总持任持·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: To be able, Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 舍枳野地囉惹阿 地瑟姹曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化）·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼彼船舶！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to he, to boat!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Great (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三多罗尼
verses.meaningEn: Running through or onward, quick, fleet again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·施度调伏，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·破有相福德光，六度满行清净·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence, perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 跢 𭋸鉢納麼尾步史多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，黄金、纯金光明
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), gold, golden
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 收，蓝严
verses.meaningEn: Searched, blue
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，断除憍慢执障·无我大慈三昧·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — primordial non-arising, cutting rigid pride & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，莲华尊
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, O lotus / in lotus
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），羂索·眉·胸尊
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower (pure, unstained), noose + brow
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍·第一义谛，本性寂静止息·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness & ultimate truth, primordial tranquil peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿 謨佉播捨賀悉帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿·此处·星宿，特
verses.meaningEn: Star + walk + star, bull
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席汝即是，法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Feast + Thou art, Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Great, O passion, sin, depravity
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施愿者、满善愿尊尊，彼饮用，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing, he + sucking, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本刹虚空，施愿者、满善愿尊尊
verses.meaningEn: This + hole, O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 17 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0
