verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力，驮·菩提·彼，汝之、圣尊之尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds (imperative seal), dha + Bodhi + he, O your, thine / in your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 櫱嚩沒䭾冐地薩 怛吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼参半此处尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to equally, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，一乘如实之道·造作离相·离一切相无相，桑过去，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks, saṃ + O made or consisting of, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱多麌呬野矩攞三麼曵毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，尘
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, dyer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·造作离相，造作离相·六度满行清净·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿謨伽 尾穆乞义滿拏攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva kpratiye kabudhari yaśira vakasaṃ gibhyo
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·持守摄受·造作离相·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·寒鸦桑·妙行趣入·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), bearing (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, trickster, saṃ, awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉底曵迦沒䭾哩 野室囉嚩迦僧祇毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），推广宝树宝山，赶赴对，一乘如实之道·真如实际·第一义谛，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, extend + tree or mountain, rush + toward, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底 多曩櫱多鉢囉底聿荅半寧毗 藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·裔胄、童子！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, offspring, child!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·佛母！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, mother!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫三𦴭 鉢囉底半曩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼箭两个·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to reed, two, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫舍囉納嚩 底素跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席是的，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Feast + yes, taye
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野每底𭋸野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，多婆罗尊，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤，殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, tavari, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冒地薩怛嚩哩野誐拏 嚩𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·病人、我身·星宿拘牵·以他去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, sick, star, held, tha, with!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野阿弭跢 婆野怛他櫱跢夜
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, may You intelligent, clever
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 囉曷帝 三𦴭三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·弯曲、超群·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, crossing, surpassing, overcoming, supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨喇怛曩怛囉 夜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩路枳帝 濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 125 · 三合 3 · 引 108 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哩野嚩路枳 帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·第一义谛·施度调伏，大彼，真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, great + he, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩 賀鉢納麼賀娑跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三尊手
verses.meaningEn: Hand again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，无住安立·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，祈请君
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, non-abiding equipoise & selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth, may You prince
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀娑他麼鉢囉 鉢跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 活动
verses.meaningEn: Movable
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·本性寂静止息，行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & primordial tranquil peace, O move forth in compassionate activity! / in move forth in compassionate activity! Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三痕迹尊
verses.meaningEn: O thick hard skin, callosity, scar again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，本性寂静止息·法界总持任持，彼汝之
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, primordial tranquil peace & Dharma-realm retention, he + your
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三掌
verses.meaningEn: Palm again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ）
verses.meaningEn: Scatter rays of blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，本性寂静止息·第一义谛·生起不可得·尊胜，持相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, primordial tranquil peace & ultimate truth & transcending birth & victorious, holder of work, activity, attendance
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀跛輸鉢㡳吠灑䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 乾陀罗
verses.meaningEn: Of a Gandharva
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！掌
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! palm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说，百彼，因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), hundred + he, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·真如实际，临危、死厄
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), dying, death
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啼辐条，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨
verses.meaningEn: To weep + spoke of a wheel, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 44 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持，鲁达罗、牯牛
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention, roarer, bellower, neigher, bull, stallion, etc

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·请执持、总持护念！！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩日囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: mahāvi dīya dharindra sagaṇa parivare bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 大闢，施度调伏·一乘如实之道，驮因陀逻，军队亲们、身处，般殊胜，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, dha + Śakra king of the gods, having troops or followers, surrounded by, wisdom + O choicest, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀尾你也 䭾𭌇捺囉娑誐拏跛哩嚩𭋸毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva manṇala vidīya deva te bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道·天人、诸天护法·汝、彼等·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, god, celestial deity (Deva), Thee / they, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩滿拏攞尾你也祢嚩 帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva mūndraman tarapa ṭalaka lapi bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·施度调伏，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，糊涂不安忧苦，解脱自在尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, be confused or disturbed + not-joy, O free from lapa, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩母捺囉滿怛囉鉢 吒攞羯臘閇毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 107 · 三合 2 · 引 111 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva para tiyeka budhari yaśira vakasaṃ gibhyo
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·他人·真如实际·一乘如实之道·造作离相·唤醒踊跃·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·寒鸦桑·妙行趣入·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, someone else, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, wake, eager, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, trickster, saṃ, awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening!

verses.iast: namaḥ sitiri yadhva nugata kprati ṣṭhite bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·真如实际·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多鉢囉底 瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来富人！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, belonging to one's household!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩怛他櫱帝 毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: ariya vajra dharama hāman ṇalade vate bhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 道德，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），驮幸运，因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相·施度调伏，鸣呼尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Noble, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, dha + gladdening, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), vate, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩野嚩日囉䭾囉摩賀滿 拏攞祢嚩帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）·真如实际·一乘如实之道·造作离相·水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, intelligent, clever!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉 底曵迦沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息，妙音张口，妙行趣入·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), sound + gape, awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哩野室囉嚩迦僧 祇毗喻
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立，妙行趣入·真如实际·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道，真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底多曩櫱多鉢囉底聿 荅半寧毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·裔胄、童子！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, offspring, child!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼秋天·鸣呼尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to autumn, also = year, vati!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请落，大理趣，凡彼等诸有情
verses.meaningEn: May You to fall! great + thought, those who, whoever (pl.)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢怛囉野摩賀麼多 曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 121 · 三合 3 · 引 151 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼乐趣经典尊·六度满行清净·妙行趣入·离名相假立·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫悉底哩野特嚩努櫱多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，真如实际·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底瑟耻帝毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, your, thine
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩 怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人彼，忻他，去秘密藏护持尊尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + he, joyful + tha, understood + O guardian of the esoteric secret treasury, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉娑囉怛他櫱多麌呬 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, crossing, surpassing, overcoming
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），噜噜辐条，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, roar + spoke of a wheel, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·请执持、总持护念！！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩日囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 99 · 三合 1 · 引 88 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·离名相假立·造作离相·第一义谛·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩 怛嚩呬多努劒比寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·真如实际·祈请扮！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, may You produced, arranged, prepared, made of , composed or written, placed or fixed on, turn!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩 南每怛囉唧多野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva vyasa namo kṣkṣaṇa karaya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩 弭野娑曩謨乞义拏迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）·离名相假立·一乘如实之道·施度调伏·不祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery, not, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 莫薩嚩滿䭾曩砌娜曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·第一义谛·息灾寂静·清净离诸尘垢·不祈请掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, pacifying, not, may You palm!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩 嚩婆野鉢囉捨麼曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·造作离相·六度满行清净·能作成办·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, making!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 薩嚩弭野地尾穆乞义拏迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvasattva nirṛvaṇa parave śanaka raya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生、普皆有情·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·成员·本性寂静止息·离名相假立·造作离相·活期、流程！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, limb, member, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩薩怛嚩捏㗚嚩拏 鉢囉吠捨曩迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·小壮！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨曩莫冐 地薩怛嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 此等诸尊事业，归命，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化），悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: These + labour, homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, your, thine
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 翳帝釤曩莫塞訖㗚 怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊𤚥麼哩野嚩路枳 帝濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切事，义利彼，法界总持任持·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All + actions, meaning + he, Dharma-realm retention & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩羯磨遏㗚他娑 䭾𩕳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·造作离相，拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & Dharma-realm retention, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — purified faculties
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩弭野地鉢囉穆乞义 抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Uniting (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三春莺
verses.meaningEn: Sili again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三施度调伏·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三净水尊
verses.meaningEn: O water / in water again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 1 · 引 68 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，活期、流程
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者自然
verses.meaningEn: Which + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 闢·凡所…者·自然
verses.meaningEn: Settle + which + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 善见口门尊
verses.meaningEn: O a beautiful mouth / in a beautiful mouth
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 闢善见口门尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩冐鉢捺囉 嚩穆乞义抳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尘无畏
verses.meaningEn: Dust + non-fear
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 死，怖畏、灾难惊恐

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 盗窃无畏

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，风大自在除障种子

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤，怖畏、灾难惊恐

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·造作离相，怖畏、灾难惊恐

verses.meaningZh: 一层是的，法界总持任持·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，真如实际·最上真言离言说

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 僧賀沫地也櫱 妬嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, being in the middle of, contained in, staying among, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 1 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曷悉底沫 地也櫱妬嚩

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Great, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐地薩怛嚩努枳孃 跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三护摩献供·法界总持任持

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提、无上正觉，彼汝之，他人，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, he + your, someone else, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冐地 薩怛嚩鉢囉底半寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左）
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 忧苦，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），六度满行清净·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Not-joy, sorrow, woe, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿羯㗚灑野阿 羯㗚灑野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 12 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）·破暗合集·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, dissolving dense ignorance & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·病人、我身·怖畏、灾难惊恐！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, sick, fear, peril, danger, dread!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨阿哩野阿弭跢 婆野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，以彼此边，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，饮用
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, the hither, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), sucking, drinking

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩路 枳帝濕嚩囉野

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，施度调伏·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust, conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），彼祈请汝之

verses.meaningZh: 道德，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩野嚩路枳帝 濕嚩囉野

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·法界总持任持，意趣

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·支分寂静·等虚空无碍，意趣
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs & space-like boundlessness, direction of the will
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·离名相假立，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性），能作成办·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising, making

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·离名相假立·法界总持任持

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 那罗、天女
verses.meaningEn: Of man, of a goddess, =
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席是的，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Feast + yes, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·破有相福德光，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & blessedness transcending existence, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 係係婆誐挽曩 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请执持驮，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! + dha, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三离一切相无相·妙行趣入

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，呕吐种类，离一切相无相·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks, vomit + favourable, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼尾攬嚩麼尾 攬嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 好好儿、水箱，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），鸿毛弯曲
verses.meaningEn: Well, cistern, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, down + crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大器物盘子，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk
verses.meaningEn: Great + a vessel or dish, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 16 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 40 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·病人、我身·怖畏、灾难惊恐！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, sick, fear, peril, danger, dread!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野阿弭跢婆野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 25 · 三合 0 · 引 40 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，桑祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ + may You intelligent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱跢 夜囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya avalokite īśvara ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，小壮
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, vaya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），般，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, wisdom, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三滿多跛哩 滿拏攞野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，向色相
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, to/for form
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），彼、此尊（阳性主格），法界总持任持·造作离相，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, he, that one, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 乐趣所行尊，自在主、主宰尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + O Bienenschwarm, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀喻儗濕嚩 囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，睡
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), sleep
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相，祈请请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks, may You hold! bear! sustain!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼抳軍拏攞 䭾囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower (pure, unstained), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），祈请方位、流畅
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower (pure, unstained), may You conducting, carrying, bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower (pure, unstained), beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·造作离相，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，真如实际·离名相假立·六度满行清净，真如实际·造作离相·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾訖㗚 多能瑟吒嚧得迦吒野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 殊胜、胜愿、妙好，祈请天人、诸天护法
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent, may You god, celestial deity (Deva)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿特
verses.meaningEn: Star + bull
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 道德，观照、慈悲垂视尊，自在主、主宰尊，造作离相·离一切相无相，离一切相无相·本性寂静止息·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & primordial tranquil peace & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉枳理枳 攞攝𭰖
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三宝山醝
verses.meaningEn: Mountain + tsa again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满，一切诸谛圆满·断除憍慢执障·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & cutting rigid pride & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & awakened conduct beyond flux again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — purified faculties, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·六度满行清净·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & ultimate truth (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，因缘三身总持圣音
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, cut in pieces + sacred Praṇava syllable embodying Trikāya
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，祈请羯磨事业
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, may You action, rite!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 遭受需要麦尊，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Suffer want + O any grain or corn, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 才，最上真言离言说·施度调伏，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Excellence, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾沒䭾鉢 納麼穆欠
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 50 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & blessedness transcending existence, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, juice + very

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），一切、普皆遍满，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, all, every, complete, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在），斗争
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, onset, struggle
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼广大、宽博无量·演说、水深！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to vast, extensive, abundant, profound, speaking, sounding!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愈加踊跃，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + eager, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 领军、作法，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: A man's name, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 流注周遍报刊往外，清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光·造作离相，权利、真正
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! + press out, stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency, right, true, honest, fit, proper
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑囉蘇 囉鼻訖㗚多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 虚空、清净苍穹，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Sky, boundless space, firmament, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 道德，造作离相·本性寂静止息，祈请女阴
verses.meaningEn: Noble, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace, may You vulva!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼虚空、清净苍穹·祈请行境！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sky, boundless space, firmament, may You scope, range!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨誐誐曩遇左囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 全部眉，园认为，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相·最上真言离言说，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Entire + brow, free from lust + think, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑迦攞步 嚩曩滿拏攞嚩娑逸底𭋸
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙洁白
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing + O white
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙莲华、红莲，造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Lotus blossom, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量，三婆婆
verses.meaningEn: Vast, extensive, abundant, profound, Sambhava
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 熔断下，真如实际·妙行趣入·妙行迁变空，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Blow + then, immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement & awakened conduct beyond flux, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 8 · 三合 0 · 引 13 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，嚩啰阇，融通尊
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), free from dust, O to / in to
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·第一义谛，离一切相无相·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢，摧碎鸿毛，驮于我
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust, crushing + down, dha + to me
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉鉢帝𩕳囉 室囉嚩達䛧

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，随一山羊尊，姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, mostly ) look + O drift, beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，咤殊胜，他人，殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, tha + choicest, someone else, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 室𭋸瑟姹嚩囉鉢囉 嚩𭋸
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无会议、遭遇
verses.meaningEn: Non-O sticking to, hanging upon, contact with
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜）
verses.meaningEn: Firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 柔善
verses.meaningEn: Śāntamate
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 消罪业
verses.meaningEn: O eliminate negative karma
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，唤醒日复一日，理趣
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, wake + day after day, O thought, believed, supposed
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席净水，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·圣智通达，波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满）尊
verses.meaningEn: Feast + water, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, O Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond / in Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀鉢囉枳孃播囉弭帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 31 · 三合 2 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三速
verses.meaningEn: Hastening, quick again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 赞叹，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），妙行趣入·妙行迁变空·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Praise, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, awakened spiritual movement & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀曩 誐阿櫱攃多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 水星彼，真如实际·一乘如实之道，离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐·生起不可得·尊胜，无我大慈三昧·施度调伏·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Intelligent + he, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & transcending birth & victorious, selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒䭾薩底曵 寧賀染母你尾閇
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 愈加鸿毛，六度满行清净·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + down, perfection of the six pāramitās & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 大宝树宝山，法界总持任持·第一义谛，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Greatness + tree or mountain, Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 不诸人，妙行迁变空·无住安立
verses.meaningEn: Not + a magian, awakened conduct beyond flux & non-abiding equipoise
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 364 · 三合 5 · 引 738 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 呼请仁者圣众叹词·大·宝树宝山

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来富人！

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，金刚犹如，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Vajra + like, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），最上真言离言说·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），酪
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, giving, bestowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 能生及、与、并，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: Causing and also, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 能生及、与、并，请执持、总持护念！尊，殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊
verses.meaningEn: Causing and also, O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain! O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！尊
verses.meaningEn: O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·威神增益圆满），清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — perfected spiritual vigor, stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·支分寂静·妙行趣入，破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 44 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尖锐、蟒蛇尊

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩吠囉婆夜底跢南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·第一义谛，本性寂静止息·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满，威光彼
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), sharpness + he
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾鉢 始曩悉帝惹娑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空，等虚空无碍·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满，真如实际·无住安立
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened conduct beyond flux, space-like boundlessness & beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 乙㗚𠆙左始 企曩娑怛他
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，破有相福德光·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，造作离相·圣智通达·一乘如实之道，离名相假立·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, blessedness transcending existence & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & supreme vehicle of awakening, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾濕嚩僕鉢囉 枳孃野載嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·施度调伏，垢染·不·及
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery, stain + not + and
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 訖囉䓛忖娜 麼攞曩左
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 黄金、纯金光明，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐，沙字门（六度满行清净（ṣaṭpāramitā）·本不生体性），风大自在除障种子
verses.meaningEn: Gold, golden, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal), perfection of the six pāramitās — primordial non-arising, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦曩迦母寧式乞义 琰
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），几乃是，笑闢，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, how many + be, ridiculous + settle, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 舍 枳野僧賀冩尾哩曵拏
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙（结印词首音），一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光，最上真言离言说·真如实际·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑嚩 悉底婆嚩覩麼麼
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，离名相假立·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，弯曲、超群
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, crossing, surpassing, overcoming
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，怖畏愈加，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, fear + thereto, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 嚩婆喻鉢捺囉吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: Conquering (vocative invocation), O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Conquering (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — purified faculties, conquering (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无胜，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: Unsurpassed, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Conquering (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，摧尊
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, O to conquer / in to conquer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然，摧尊
verses.meaningEn: A certain, O to conquer / in to conquer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，施度调伏·离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, generosity & self-mastery & conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 21 · 弹舌 0
