verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You blow, exhale!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼彼裔胄·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·水星大地·远离虚妄安立·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to he, offspring, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, intelligent, earth, beyond conceptual fabrication & beyond nominal designation!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫颯跢南三𦴭三 沒䭾句置南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨每底哩野 鉢囉穆佉南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，菩提彼，勇健自然
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Bodhi + he, strong + certainly
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩冐地薩 怛嚩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·无我大慈三昧·财！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, treasure!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫鉢囉底曵迦母 䭾南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·裔胄、童子！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, offspring, child!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 三𦴭鉢囉底半曩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼离名相假立·妙行趣入·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·神变善巧应化）·施度调伏·妙行趣入·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — miraculous skillful manifestation, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼报刊往外梵音·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to press out, voice, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 素嚕多半曩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大、摩诃（广大无边）·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, vast, supreme, stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼驱除自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to drive off, certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼陀字门（施度调伏（dāna·园！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, free from lust!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼离名相假立·妙行趣入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）·曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·法界总持任持！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & Dharma-realm retention!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼乐趣胸·妙行趣入·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gladden, womb?, awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼何不·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to what? as whence? wherefore? why? also merely = num, not, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净·古老！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, old, ancient!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼种类鹿科不是！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a kind of deer, also not!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙行趣入·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to awakened spiritual movement & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫污䭾嚩計 舍南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道·法界总持任持·第一义谛·真如实际·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩尾你野地鉢 底南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & generosity & self-mastery, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼八（八正道·施度调伏·本性寂静止息·真如实际·离名相假立·造作离相·六度满行清净·星宿自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to eight, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, star, certainly!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨阿瑟吒尾孕捨底南 諾乞察怛囉喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼曜执、星曜鬼神执障·拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to planet, seizing spirit/graha, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无住安立·真如实际，无能胜、不可摧伏，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, invincible, unconquered, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿他妬阿跛囉尒多 紇㗚乃琰
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·第一义谛，造作离相·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 叄鉢囉嚩乞义野 弭
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，水星星宿，六度满行清净·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, intelligent + star, perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 148 · 三合 6 · 引 143 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 日复一日、之后，无我大慈三昧·施度调伏·真如实际，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·妙行趣入

verses.meaningZh: 桑祈请水星，归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You intelligent, homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 叄沒䭾野曩莫塞訖哩怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入，第一义谛·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), ultimate truth & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 達 磨僧具比滿娜擔
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，鸣呼尊，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, vati, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 舍囉娜嚩底 素旦制嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），施度调伏·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，无我大慈三昧·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉枳孃雉焰 祢尾惹母多𤚥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），种类大麻尊，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O a kind of hemp, great
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉捨𩕳 摩賀具囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），护摩供大，垢染、尘垢瑕疵
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, oblation + great, stain, impurity, defilement
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉護底摩賀 麼攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 215 · 三合 5 · 引 406 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & pacifying conflict & turmoil, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 多水分、潮湿，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Juicy, moist, humid, fresh, new, tasty, pleasant, charming, passionate, enamoured, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三毘萨罗
verses.meaningEn: Plenty, abundance again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·威神增益圆满），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·钩召发起三昧），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — perfected spiritual vigor, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — samādhi invocation, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三大王诗人
verses.meaningEn: Of a king and poet again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·远离虚妄安立·最上真言离言说，妙行迁变空·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond conceptual fabrication & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙音闢，临危、死厄尊
verses.meaningEn: Sound + settle, O dying, death / in dying, death
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，天人、诸天护法，宝山、宝树
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, god, celestial deity (Deva), mountain
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, passion, sin, depravity
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，成功此处，一乘如实之道·支分寂静·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, thrive, supreme vehicle of awakening & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·支分寂静
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），护摩献供·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, offering oblation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），施度调伏·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝，星宿一切此处
verses.meaningEn: Jewel, star + walk
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，手掌、执持尊手
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, hand, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 必然，真如实际·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: A certain, immutable Suchness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，无住安立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, non-abiding equipoise & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），吉祥草
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, grass, the sacred grass used at rel
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·圣智通达，汁液太
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, juice + very
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 29 · 三合 1 · 引 12 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩 賀藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·祈请忿！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You wrath!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉 俱嚕䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，他人，炽盛燃耀、大放光明
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, someone else, blazing, illuminated, flaming
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 捏底野鉢囉 入嚩理多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·第一义谛·真如实际，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），活期、流程
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 你鉢多嚩日囉迦 囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 48 · 三合 2 · 引 54 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，离名相假立·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，断除憍慢执障·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, cutting rigid pride & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沃屹囉能瑟吒嚕得迦 吒婆野

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·祈请忿！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You wrath!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩 日囉俱嚕䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，他人，炽盛燃耀、大放光明
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, someone else, blazing, illuminated, flaming
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 捏底野鉢囉 入嚩理多
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 忿凡彼圣尊，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Wrath + who, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大钺，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·因缘空寂大乐，器物盘子，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Hatchet, axe, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, a vessel or dish, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 跛囉戍播捨賀娑跢 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，真如实际·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 虚空虚空
verses.meaningEn: Hole + hole
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三安住加持
verses.meaningEn: Abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 击破怨魔与无明惑击破怨魔与无明惑
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! + strike down afflictions and mara-forces!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左）
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入，生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement, transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，彼充分，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，祈请充分
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — purified faculties, he + full, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, may You full!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾 娑普吒野尾娑普吒野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，最上真言离言说·破暗合集·离名相假立，调伏之后
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, supreme ineffable speech & dissolving dense ignorance & beyond nominal designation, discipline + or emphasizing particle
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 尾覲曩尾曩野劒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席宝树宝山，离诸诤论无诤·第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Feast + tree or mountain, conflict-free peace & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说·真如实际，祈请长柄、融通
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, may You stem, demin
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 1 · 引 19 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，权利垢染
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), right + stain
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，权利、真正，豪气
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), right, true, honest, fit, proper, heroism
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，真如实际·施度调伏，第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery, ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），真如实际·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 120 · 三合 2 · 引 168 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三刹土
verses.meaningEn: Of a country again and again

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大菩提，彼祈请汝之
verses.meaningEn: Great + Bodhi, he + may You your
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀冐地 薩怛嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，真如实际·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，真如实际·最上真言离言说，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立，离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation, beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·第一义谛·真如实际，持械金刚杵、因达罗尊
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, O armed with the thunderbolt, of Indra
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三刹土
verses.meaningEn: Of a country again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 159 · 三合 0 · 引 217 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，本性寂静止息·无我大慈三昧，滋养增益·破暗合集，第一义谛·法界总持任持，妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·施度调伏，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, primordial tranquil peace & selfless great loving-kindness, nourishing (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & Dharma-realm retention, awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & generosity & self-mastery, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊 上𤚥沫儉補澁喯度喯巘淡麼理琰

verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·损减除灭忧苦），成办作持·清净离诸尘垢

verses.meaningZh: 请护念、摄受守护！

verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·因缘空寂大乐，因缘空寂大乐·法界总持任持，愿刑
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond conceptual fabrication & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & Dharma-realm retention, may it punishment!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿地瑟耻呬賀呬䭾 嚩䭾覩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: nayapara tiṣṭha bhrū milabha nāṃtalo kadhatu
verses.meaningZh: 意趣他人，祈请安住加持，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满），冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·真如实际·离一切相无相，造作离相·法界总持任持·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Direction of the will + someone else, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor, uniting, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness (imperative seal)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩野鉢囉底瑟姹步 弭邏婆難多路迦䭾覩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，最上真言离言说·造作离相·六度满行清净，离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧·本性寂静止息，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，絮叨、耳语

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 吠乞义拏嬌捨理野鉢囉鉢帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请息，第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: May You rest! ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，离名相假立·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, awakened spiritual movement
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩薩怛嚩南捺㗚捨野沫㗚儼
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 水星眉，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·六度满行清净，远离虚妄安立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Intelligent + brow, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒䭾步 弭素鉢囉底瑟耻帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 55 · 三合 0 · 引 36 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), to prince

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧，真如实际·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤，离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 虚空虚空

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向成员，睡，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤

verses.meaningZh: 桑所成，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，第一义谛·一乘如实之道

verses.meaningZh: 祈请陨

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 星宿特，真如实际·第一义谛·施度调伏，一乘如实之道·破有相福德光·离覆障清凉

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆誐嚩底播娜 夜婆鏟覩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 20 · 三合 0 · 引 17 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三自忧苦，离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，摄伏末，烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Own + not-joy again and again, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, hold + end, O passion, sin, depravity

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持认为，多罗尼

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riya ami ṛtakuṇ ṇali
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·真如实际·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤·离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野阿蜜㗚多軍拏理
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 为自任，揭幕、一些
verses.meaningEn: Paramo, cleaving, rending, opening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三滿多 嚩日囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业驮，尘
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! + dha, dyer
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 自性善妙活跃，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·远离寂静周遍），六度满行清净·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious self-blessing + active, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — expansive quiescence, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑 嚩攞娑播㗚灑諾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三趣往、三月，自性善妙住埸
verses.meaningEn: Going to or in again and again, auspicious self-blessing + coming into existence
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 櫱磋櫱磋 娑嚩婆嚩南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 安乐妙善·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Blissful
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三离一切相无相·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·妙行趣入，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，持哪些尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, holder of rel
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），生起不可得·尊胜·妙行迁变空·造作离相，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·真如实际，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, transcending birth & victorious & awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 囉 惹作羯囉韈㗚底底麼曩娑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，往日复一日，速
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, to go + day after day, hastening, quick
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 家，名为、号曰
verses.meaningEn: A servant, by name, called
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦），六度满行清净·第一义谛·法界总持任持，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow, perfection of the six pāramitās & ultimate truth & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，想必·净水·及
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, surely + relating to the feet + and
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼理野祖㗚拏沫伽播你演左
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·离名相假立，认为弯曲，句、足迹、法位
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), think + crossing, word, verse-foot, step, abode
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 131 · 三合 4 · 引 139 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·唤醒自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, wake, certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨喇怛曩 怛囉夜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，汝之、圣尊之尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, O your, thine / in your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩 怛吠毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 道德，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Noble, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩野每底𭋸野 鉢囉穆契毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，真如实际·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 71 · 三合 0 · 引 59 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: May You be lost or missing, vanish, disappear, wane, perish, fly, escape, be gone, selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 暴恶者、恶心障难，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, planet, seizing spirit/graha, primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 訥瑟吒屹囉憾 室左
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三施愿者、满善愿尊
verses.meaningEn: Boon-granting, wish-bestowing again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 桑星宿，最上真言离言说·真如实际·破有相福德光，反胃、病苦
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + star, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, vomiting, sickness, nausea
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），圣智了知·清净离诸尘垢，戒精进
verses.meaningEn: The Blessed One, Bhagavān, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, knowing, as many
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆誐挽嚩日囉 播抳囉枳撚跛野底
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，施度调伏·一乘如实之道·造作离相，圣智通达·第一义谛·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), non-dual wisdom awareness & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀尾 你也枳孃跛野底
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·祈请请执持、总持护念！·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You hold! bear! sustain!!, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉 䭾囉野嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 214 · 三合 1 · 引 161 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请熔断、吐气！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You blow, exhale!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼祈请圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may You Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼器物盘子尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）·一切正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O a vessel or dish / in a vessel or dish, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫颯帝毗藥三𦴭三 沒第毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 彼头，寒鸦菩提，彼汝之，会议、遭遇尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: He, trickster + Bodhi, he + your, O sticking to, hanging upon, contact with, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩室囉嚩迦冐地 薩怛嚩僧祇毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·本不生体性）·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — primordial non-arising, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫室戰 拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀藥乞义 細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·吉祥草本刹·胸严胜伏！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, grass, this, clump, O conquer! victory!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日𠻴矩勢摩 賀囉惹曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·本性寂静止息·造作离相·离一切相无相·凡彼等诸有情！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks, those who, whoever (pl.)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉餉迦攞 曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·行星土曜！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, the planet Saturn!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·祈请余力！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You jerk, wrench, shock!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨 嚩日囉吠誐野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉 難拏野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙行迁变空·造作离相·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼酒席是的·惛沈！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to feast, yes, dulling or hebetating the mind!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·闢祈请揭幕！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, settle, may You cleaving!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉 尾娜囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·揭幕、一些·最上真言离言说·离诸诤论无诤·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, cleaving, rending, opening, supreme ineffable speech & conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉捺囉 尾拏野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it = , also net!, sixty, that, great, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, praise, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·忿尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O wrath / in wrath, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩日囉矩嚕第毗藥
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 179 · 三合 1 · 引 187 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading, universal, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三满陀
verses.meaningEn: May You mota again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，愿成、善住尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, O be! become! / in be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，弯曲、超群，必然，真如实际·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, crossing, surpassing, overcoming, a certain, immutable Suchness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛囉阿鉢囉 底賀帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 7 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·能作成办·本性寂静止息！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, making!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨嚩 日囉餉羯囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 祈请何为
verses.meaningEn: May You divinity
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），不动尊威猛降魔心印严，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，尊胜降伏·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, conquering
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩 賀麼攞野尾你也囉惹野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，宛
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, crooked
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤，调忧苦，向毛
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, tame + not-joy, to of a man
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·施度调伏，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），自在主、主宰尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·造作离相·断除憍慢执障，能作成办·造作离相，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，云彩尊
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride, making (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation, O running, hastening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 餉矩吒羯㗚拏必㗚 野曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，清净离诸尘垢·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 84 · 三合 1 · 引 60 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 天人宝山
verses.meaningEn: God + mountain

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），本性寂静止息·造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 击破怨魔与无明惑击破怨魔与无明惑
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! + strike down afflictions and mara-forces!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，离诸诤论无诤·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, conflict-free peace & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 6 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: apara tihāta malavi riyapa rakṛrama ya
verses.meaningZh: 必然，真如实际·因缘空寂大乐，垢染闢，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: A certain, immutable Suchness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, stain + settle, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿鉢囉 底賀多麼攞味哩野跛囉訖囉麼 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），持守摄受·造作离相，胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, bearing, conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无住安立·真如实际，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 118 · 三合 0 · 引 114 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢底冩

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧）·随一此处·法界总持任持·第一义谛·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation, mostly ) look, Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (reverent offering)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫娑底𭋸 路枳野地鉢跢曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿网罗·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it = , also net!, beyond nominal designation!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大不是了知
verses.meaningEn: Great + not knowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·远离虚妄安立，姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·诸根清净自在）

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 103 · 三合 1 · 引 125 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摩尼宝·星宿此处！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, star, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 室戰拏嚩日囉播拏曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, taye
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀 藥乞义細曩鉢多曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼断除憍慢执障·最上真言离言说·造作离相·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to cutting rigid pride, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席鸿毛，造作离相·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Feast + down, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），祈请海会众、圣众眷属
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, may You assembly, host,retinue!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀藥 乞义誐拏野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 欢喜，自在主、主宰尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: For joy, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，祈请弯曲、超群，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), may You crossing, surpassing, overcoming, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，大地祈请殊胜，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, earth + may You choicest, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩拏 拘嚩囉野吽泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namo bha gavaṃ vajra kuṇṇaliya hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava·特·金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤·离一切相无相·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·顿断魔障、摧破无明！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — primordial non-arising, bull, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace & freedom from conditioned marks, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, shatter obstacles and ignorance!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨婆 誐鍐嚩日囉軍拏理野吽泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），报刊往外·驱除·此处，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, press out + drive off, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 蘇悉地野吽泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊佛母！（呼格）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 断除憍慢执障·最上真言离言说，造作离相·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Cutting rigid pride & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席鸿毛，造作离相·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Feast + down, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Great, cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，导师、指导，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, leader, guide, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒囉憾麼 妳野吽泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，活期、流程，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, current, stream, course, quick motion, haste, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼 抳跋捺囉野吽泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，惛沈，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, dulling or hebetating the mind, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·远离寂静周遍），妙行迁变空·造作离相·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace (araṇa) — expansive quiescence, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，祈请称计粒子，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, may You a measure of grain! Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 吠室囉摩拏野吽 泮
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 45 · 三合 1 · 引 56 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相·他人！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), someone else!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，离诸诤论无诤·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, conflict-free peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 吠室囉摩 拏蘇多冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 酒席贫苦，因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Feast + having no cows, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，闢自尊，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, settle + pride, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，真如实际·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤，大地他人之
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, earth + of someone else
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿他 妬曩拏矩跛囉冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 大秘密藏护持尊尊，离名相假立·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Great + O guardian of the esoteric secret treasury, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀麌呬引 捺囉冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，离名相假立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.iast: mavartta iṣiyā mi avahā nāṃaveśa nāṃpūra vapalaṃ taṃgopanāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，圆满充盈·离名相假立，剪切力严，彼藏
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, fulfilling, shear + enough, him + guarding
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼韈㗚多 以史夜弭阿嚩賀南阿吠捨 南布囉嚩跛囒擔遇跛喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·离名相假立·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 娑婆·蓝·自然
verses.meaningEn: Bear + blue + certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 星宿阿西那
verses.meaningEn: Star + throwing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），生起不可得·尊胜，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, transcending birth & victorious, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），弃捨、还灭
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, leaving, giving up, wanting, ceasing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，病人、我身，清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, sick, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 他人，钻
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, afflicting, injuring, destroying
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·造作离相·祈请他人！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), may You someone else!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·称计粒子报刊往外·真如实际·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, a measure of grain, press out, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨吠室囉摩拏素多野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼闢色相·造作离相·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to settle, form, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 謨尾嚕播乞义野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨·造作离相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — purified faculties, stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨地㗚多囉 瑟吒囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼生起不可得·尊胜·远离虚妄安立·离一切相无相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to transcending birth & victorious & beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 76 · 三合 2 · 引 124 · 弹舌 1

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，曜执、星曜鬼神执障尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, O planet, seizing spirit/graha / in planet, seizing spirit/graha, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，怖畏愈加，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, fear + thereto, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），最上真言离言说·真如实际·一乘如实之道，句鸿毛，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, word + O down, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩 吠底𢈔鉢捺囉吠毗藥

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净，我之（行者所有）之
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās again and again, of my, of me (the practitioner)

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼摧碎本刹·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏·最上真言离言说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to crushing, this, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，债行持妙道
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, debt + O move forth in compassionate activity!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，本性寂静止息·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，胸严度越吧
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, clump + gone
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 普皆周遍（samanta），扇子尊
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading, universal, O fan / in fan
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 酒席忧苦，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，他人，祈请安住加持，然而尊
verses.meaningEn: Feast + not-joy, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, someone else, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! O but / in but
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀迦哩野 鉢囉底瑟姹跛寧
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切义利成就法
verses.meaningEn: All aims and benefits + O accomplishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外他人，圆满充盈·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Press out + someone else, fulfilling (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，风大自在除障种子·不·驮，理趣
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable + not + dha, thought, believed, supposed
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大闢，牯牛父尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + settle, bull + O father
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，敦促愈加，糅合、关于尊
verses.meaningEn: Great (vocative invocation), hasten + thereto, O put together, connected or endowed with, pertaining to
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，仙人报刊往外，一切诸谛圆满·支分寂静·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, Ṛṣi + press out, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩 賀乙㗚史蘇僧屹㗚呬帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，不是马车
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, having no chariot
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·第一义谛，离一切相无相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 15 · 三合 0 · 引 23 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva budhapa ratiye kabu dha

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·他人·一乘如实之道·造作离相·解脱系缚大力！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, someone else, supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩鉢囉底曵迦沒䭾

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎鸿毛，菩提觉知·造作离相，彼汝之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Crushing + down, awakening (vocative invocation), he + O your, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 室囉嚩迦冐地薩怛吠毗藥
