verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: amitabha yatatha gatayā rahate saṃmya saṃbudhaya
verses.meaningZh: 病人星宿，凡所…者尔时，以去，舍离、沙漠，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，桑祈请水星
verses.meaningEn: Sick + star, whatever + now, with/by understood, grasped, leave, desert, abandon, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, saṃ + may You intelligent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿弭跢婆 野怛他櫱跢夜囉曷帝三𦴭 三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩野嚩路 枳帝濕嚩囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，汝之、圣尊之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, your, thine, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Great + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, vast, supreme, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & selfless great loving-kindness, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨摩賀 娑他麼鉢囉鉢跢野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 莫薩嚩遏喇他悉䭾野尾你也 囉枳尼
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 69 · 三合 1 · 引 84 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, meaning, he, alas! shame! fie!, particle!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·他人星宿！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, someone else, of star!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨佩殺尒野麌嚕吠𠯆哩野 鉢囉婆冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，桑水星之
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ + of intelligent
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他櫱怛冩囉曷 沰三𦴭三沒䭾冩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to intelligent, clever!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼熔断、吐气！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to blow, exhale!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namo amita bhayata thagata yāraha tesaṃmya saṃbudhaya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼病人、我身·星宿拘牵·他去·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·桑祈请水星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sick, star, held, tha, understood, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, saṃ, may You intelligent!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨阿弭跢婆野怛他櫱跢 夜囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼道德·观照、慈悲垂视尊·自在主、主宰尊·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩 莫阿哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ a riyama hāsatha mapara pata ya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·笑声他·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·真如实际·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, laughing, tha, selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿 哩野摩賀娑他麼鉢囉鉢跢 野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，祈请汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, may You your, thine!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva aratha sidhaya vidīya dharara jaya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·不是马车·祈请驱除、吓跑·最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道·驮辐条·胜伏、最胜吉祥！！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, having no chariot, may You drive off, scare away, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, dha, spoke of a wheel, conquer! victory!!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩 遏喇他悉䭾野尾你也䭾囉囉 惹野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namo mahāśi riyāye sarva aratha sadhikaye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·一切、普皆遍满·不是马车·彼·此恶者·极微！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to great (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, having no chariot, he, alas! shame! fie!, particle!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨摩賀室哩夜曵薩 嚩遏喇他娑地迦曵
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, perfection of the six pāramitās & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，能使车，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, waggon, war-chariot, also any vehicle of the gods, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎鸿毛，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Crushing + down, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 苦、一切逼恼苦厄，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 配称，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Worthy, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 他人，真如实际·一乘如实之道·造作离相，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 底曵迦沒䭾薩典

verses.meaningZh: 菩提彼，真如实际·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + he, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 72 · 三合 2 · 引 102 · 弹舌 0

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩募薩摩若野曩謨囉怛曩怛囉夜 野曩謨弭跢婆野怛他櫱跢夜 囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野曩莫阿 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野冐 地薩怛嚩野摩賀薩怛嚩野 摩賀迦嚕抳迦野曩謨摩賀娑他 麼鉢囉跛跢野冐地薩怛嚩 野摩賀薩怛嚩野摩賀迦嚕 抳迦野曩謨尾補羅尾麼曩蘇鉢囉 底瑟耻跢僧契野素哩 野捨多娑賀娑囉底𭋹迦 鉢囉婆嚩婆悉多沒㗚多曳 摩賀麼抳穆矩吒軍拏羅䭾哩抳 婆誐嚩帝鉢納麼播拏曳薩嚩路 迦播野舎麼曩野尾尾䭾皤野耨 佉三麼鞞舎尾瑟吒薩嚩薩怛 嚩跛哩謨左曩野怛你也他 唵部囉步嚩摩賀路迦迦囉 拏多摩娑底弭囉鉢吒囉尾曩捨曩 迦囉野囉誐娜吠灑謨賀惹攞 捨麼迦舎娑迦囉乞灑迦薩嚩播 野耨佉訥誐底鉢囉捨麼曩迦囉 野薩嚩怛他𦾨跢娑麼滿䭾曩迦囉 薩嚩薩怛嚩舎跛哩布囉迦薩嚩 薩怛嚩三摩始嚩娑迦囉係係摩賀 𭥗地薩怛嚩嚩囉娜鉢納麼路迦 三步多摩賀迦嚕抳迦惹吒 麼矩吒楞訖哩多始嚕麼抳迦曩迦 囉惹多嚩囉吠女哩野楞 訖哩多捨哩囉弭跢婆尒 曩迦麼攞楞訖哩多鉢囉嚩囉曩囉 曩哩摩賀惹曩捨多娑賀娑囉 鼻攞史多迦野摩賀冐地薩 怛嚩尾䭾麼尾䭾麼尾曩捨野尾曩 捨野摩賀拽怛囉𠮷礼捨迦 嚩吒嚩嚩䭾僧娑囉佐囉 迦鉢囉麼他曩補嚕灑鉢納麼補 嚕灑曩誐補嚕灑娑誐囉尾囉惹尾 囉惹蘇難多蘇難多跛哩勿哩 多娜麼娜麼娑麼娑麼度嚕度嚕鉢囉舎 娑野鉢囉舎娑野祇哩祇 哩唧哩唧哩祖嚕祖嚕母嚕母嚕母庾母庾 悶左悶左度曩度曩尾度曩尾度曩度嚕 度嚕誐野誐野誐䭾野誐䭾野賀娑賀娑 鉢囉賀娑鉢囉賀娑尾尾䭾𠮷礼捨 嚩娑曩麼麼薩嚩薩怛嚩難左賀 囉賀囉僧賀囉僧賀囉度嚕徵度 嚕徵摩賀𭦗拏羅迦囉拏捨多鉢囉 細迦嚩婆娑尾灑曩捨麼迦摩賀 冐地薩怛嚩嚩囉娜娑嚩賀」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩募薩摩若野曩謨囉怛曩怛囉夜
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 野曩謨弭跢婆野怛他櫱跢夜 囉曷帝三𦴭三沒䭾野曩莫阿
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ sarvarabhaye sudhanadasya namaskṛtvā imaṃ āryāvalokiteśvararavaṃ dhavaṃ nīlakaṇṭha
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向一切部分马车，报刊往外施财之，顶礼敬拜已，此（真言，圣观自在菩萨鸿毛，经营、流动，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + to a part of a chariot, press out + of giving money or wealth, having paid homage/salutation, this (accusative), Noble Avalokiteśvara + down, run, flow, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哩野嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野冐 地薩怛嚩野摩賀薩怛嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ hṛdayaṃ āvartayiṣyāmi sarvārthasādhanaṃ śubhaṃ ajeyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhavamārgaviśodhakam
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼心·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一切义利修习·清净吉祥、善妙庄严·山羊此圣女·一切处、到处可见·愿成·圣道·容易净化！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hṛdayaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all aims and benefits, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, drift, this, being everywhere, ubiquitous, be! become!, path, purifying!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀迦嚕抳迦野曩謨摩賀娑他 麼鉢囉跛跢野冐地薩怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 野摩賀薩怛嚩野摩賀迦嚕 抳迦野曩謨尾補羅尾麼曩蘇鉢囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ ālokapate lokātikrānte ehi hare mahābodhisattva sarpa sarpa smara smara mama hṛdayam
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！衍伸种类神明，世间古昔尊，善来降临坛场（翳呬），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，大菩提萨埵，再三蛇，再三忆念本誓，我之（行者所有），心
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spawn + a class of gods, world + O surpassing, come forth, O Blessed One! O Hari / Remover of Suffering! great + Bodhisattva, crawling, creeping again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), hṛdayam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底瑟耻跢僧契野素哩 野捨多娑賀娑囉底𭋹迦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: kuru kuru karma dhuru dhuru vijayate mahāvijayate dhara dhara dhāraṇīrāja cala cala
verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），事，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），最胜尊胜、普胜一切！大最胜尊胜，再三请执持、总持护念！陀罗尼来诣，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, actions, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! great + supreme victory! triumph! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Dhāraṇī + coming from or belonging to goats, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉婆嚩婆悉多沒㗚多曳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: mama vimalamūrte ehy ehi jīva jīva Pañcamukha hāsa hāsa prahasita viṣa viṣaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），离垢坚硬，善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），再三命者，五面门，再三笑声、欢喜，熙，毒害、蛇毒与三毒，箭毒
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), immaculate + O thickened, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! living, alive again and again, five + face, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision again and again, cherful, poison, venom, toxin, viṣaṃ
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀麼抳穆矩吒軍拏羅䭾哩抳 婆誐嚩帝鉢納麼播拏曳薩嚩路
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦播野舎麼曩野尾尾䭾皤野耨 佉三麼鞞舎尾瑟吒薩嚩薩怛
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: hulu hulu malla hulu hulu hare sara sara siri siri suru suru
verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），大勇力士、降魔大力尊，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, mighty champion, fearless hero, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩跛哩謨左曩野怛你也他 唵部囉步嚩摩賀路迦迦囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: bodhiya bodhiya bodhaya bodhaya maitreya nīlakaṇṭha darśanena prahlādaya manaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊），青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），以观照，请令心生清凉大欢喜！自尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakening again and again, awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, by/through false, heretical view, gladden! delight and refresh! pride, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拏多摩娑底弭囉鉢吒囉尾曩捨曩 迦囉野囉誐娜吠灑謨賀惹攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向成就者、已成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 捨麼迦舎娑迦囉乞灑迦薩嚩播 野耨佉訥誐底鉢囉捨麼曩迦囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向大圣，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for a great adept, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 野薩嚩怛他𦾨跢娑麼滿䭾曩迦囉 薩嚩薩怛嚩舎跛哩布囉迦薩嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向魔法机构自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Magic agency + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩怛嚩三摩始嚩娑迦囉係係摩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 𭥗地薩怛嚩嚩囉娜鉢納麼路迦 三步多摩賀迦嚕抳迦惹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向野猪面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Boar + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼矩吒楞訖哩多始嚕麼抳迦曩迦 囉惹多嚩囉吠女哩野楞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向男子嘴子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Man + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 訖哩多捨哩囉弭跢婆尒 曩迦麼攞楞訖哩多鉢囉嚩囉曩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向莲华手，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩哩摩賀惹曩捨多娑賀娑囉 鼻攞史多迦野摩賀冐地薩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 51 · 三合 0 · 引 112 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向法轮战，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Wheel + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ ṭrūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 賀娑多滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 播 娜滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 薩𠕀誐鉢囉 底孕誐滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 怛你野他 ｜ 唵 ｜ 阿曩黎阿曩 ｜ 尾 舎祢尾捨祢 ｜ 吠囉嚩日囉䭾隸 ｜ 滿䭾𩕳滿䭾𩕳 ｜ 嚩日囉播抳

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨囉怛曩 ｜ 怛囉夜野 ｜ 曩 莫阿哩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉野 ｜ 冐地薩怛嚩野 ｜ 摩賀薩怛嚩 野 ｜ 摩賀迦嚕抳迦野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: oṃ sarvarabhaye sudhanadasya namaskṛtvā imaṃ āryāvalokiteśvararavaṃ dhavaṃ nīlakaṇṭha
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向一切部分马车，报刊往外施财之，顶礼敬拜已，此（真言，圣观自在菩萨鸿毛，经营、流动，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + to a part of a chariot, press out + of giving money or wealth, having paid homage/salutation, this (accusative), Noble Avalokiteśvara + down, run, flow, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 ｜ 薩 嚩婆曳數 ｜ 怛囉拏迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: namaḥ hṛdayaṃ āvartayiṣyāmi sarvārthasādhanaṃ śubhaṃ ajeyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhavamārgaviśodhakam
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼心·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一切义利修习·清净吉祥、善妙庄严·山羊此圣女·一切处、到处可见·愿成·圣道·容易净化！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hṛdayaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all aims and benefits, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, drift, this, being everywhere, ubiquitous, be! become!, path, purifying!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛 寫銘 ｜ 曩莫塞訖哩怛嚩 ｜ 伊𤚥 阿哩也 ｜ 嚩路枳帝濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛嚩𩕳攞建姹 ｜ 曩麼𠶹哩 娜野 ｜ 麼韈跢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: oṃ ālokapate lokātikrānte ehi hare mahābodhisattva sarpa sarpa smara smara mama hṛdayam
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！衍伸种类神明，世间古昔尊，善来降临坛场（翳呬），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，大菩提萨埵，再三蛇，再三忆念本誓，我之（行者所有），心
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spawn + a class of gods, world + O surpassing, come forth, O Blessed One! O Hari / Remover of Suffering! great + Bodhisattva, crawling, creeping again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), hṛdayam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊灑弭也 ｜ 薩嚩囉他娑䭾喃 ｜ 輸伴 阿𠰒琰 ｜ 薩嚩部哆喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: kuru kuru karma dhuru dhuru vijayate mahāvijayate dhara dhara dhāraṇīrāja cala cala
verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），事，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），最胜尊胜、普胜一切！大最胜尊胜，再三请执持、总持护念！陀罗尼来诣，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, actions, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! great + supreme victory! triumph! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Dhāraṇī + coming from or belonging to goats, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆 嚩沫𭌇誐 ｜ 尾戍䭾劒 ｜ 怛你也他
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: mama vimalamūrte ehy ehi jīva jīva Pañcamukha hāsa hāsa prahasita viṣa viṣaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），离垢坚硬，善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），再三命者，五面门，再三笑声、欢喜，熙，毒害、蛇毒与三毒，箭毒
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), immaculate + O thickened, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! living, alive again and again, five + face, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision again and again, cherful, poison, venom, toxin, viṣaṃ
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 ｜ 阿路計阿路 迦 ｜ 摩底路迦底 ｜ 訖囒帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 呬呬賀𭋸 ｜ 摩賀冐地薩怛嚩 ｜ 娑麼囉娑麼囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: hulu hulu malla hulu hulu hare sara sara siri siri suru suru
verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），大勇力士、降魔大力尊，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, mighty champion, fearless hero, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 𠶹哩娜野 ｜ 矩嚕矩嚕羯𤚥 ｜ 娑達野娑達野 ｜ 度嚕度嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.iast: bodhiya bodhiya bodhaya bodhaya maitreya nīlakaṇṭha darśanena prahlādaya manaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊），青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），以观照，请令心生清凉大欢喜！自尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakening again and again, awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, by/through false, heretical view, gladden! delight and refresh! pride, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾演底 ｜ 摩賀尾演底 ｜ 䭾囉䭾囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向成就者、已成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 達唎捺𭋸濕嚩 囉 ｜ 左攞左攞 ｜ 尾摩攞阿摩攞 ｜ 敏哩帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向大圣，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for a great adept, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊𨢘曳呬 ｜ 路 枳濕嚩囉 ｜ 囉誐尾灑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向魔法机构自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Magic agency + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾曩捨野 ｜ 你吠灑尾灑 ｜ 尾曩捨野 ｜ 慕賀左囉尾灑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾曩捨野 ｜ 護 嚕護嚕 ｜ 麼攞護嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向野猪面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Boar + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 賀𭋸鉢娜麼 曩婆 ｜ 娑囉娑囉 ｜ 悉哩悉哩 ｜ 素嚕素嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向男子嘴子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Man + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒地也沒地也 ｜ 冐䭾野冐䭾野 ｜ 昧帝𭋸曳
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向莲华手，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 𩕳攞建姹 ｜ 迦麼寫那捺 哩捨喃 ｜ 鉢囉賀攞娜野 ｜ 摩諾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向法轮战，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Wheel + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑嚩賀 ｜ 悉䭾野 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 91 · 弹舌 2

verses.meaningZh: 向法螺·声·在于·带劲，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Conch shell + sound + in + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, cha + eager + son, in Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), said, Mantra, sacred formula

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 圣观自在菩萨，菩提萨埵，甚深、深妙难测，般若波罗蜜多所行，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，照见，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），五（五智，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·离名相假立，彼等（连音式宾格复数）以及空虚，了知、聪明，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）

verses.iast: oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨婆誐嚩帝 ｜ 薩囉嚩怛𡃤路枳也 ｜ 鉢囉底 ｜ 尾始瑟吒野 ｜ 沒䭾野 ｜ 婆誐嚩帝

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, unequalled + suffusion + course + sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑頗囉拏 ｜ 誐帝櫱賀曩 ｜ 誐誐曩 ｜ 娑嚩婆嚩尾 秫弟 ｜ 阿鼻詵散覩𤚥 ｜ 薩囉嚩怛他誐 哆素誐哆

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩囉嚩佐曩 ｜ 阿蜜㗚哆鼻 曬罽 ｜ 摩賀母怛囉 ｜ 滿怛囉鉢帶 ｜ 唵阿賀囉阿賀囉 ｜ 阿𢈔散䭾囉抳 ｜ 戍䭾野戍䭾野

verses.iast: oṃ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṃdhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya gaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命擎尊，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + O supporting, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 誐誐曩娑嚩婆嚩尾 秫弟 ｜ 鄔瑟膩灑 ｜ 尾惹野 ｜ 跛 哩戍弟 ｜ 娑賀娑囉囉濕銘散祖祢 帝 ｜ 薩囉嚩怛他誐哆

verses.iast: uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sahasraraśmisaṃcodite sarvatathāgatāvalokini ṣaṭpāramitāparipūraṇi sarvatathāgatamāte daśabhūmipratiṣṭhite sarvatathāgatahṛdayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite
verses.meaningZh: 佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜·圆满清净，一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，六·波罗蜜多·般·遂尊，萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子，十地踞尊，一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! + O thoroughly pure, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), six + Pāramitā + wisdom + O satisfy, sarvatathāgataṃ + O frame, the Ten Bodhisattva Grounds + O squat, all Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩路枳抳 ｜ 薩囉嚩怛他誐哆麼帝 ｜ 察囉波囉蜜 哆 ｜ 鉢哩布囉抳 ｜ 捺娑布銘 ｜ 鉢 囉帝瑟恥地

verses.iast: oṃ mudre mudre mahāmudre vajrakāyasaṃhatanapariśuddhe sarvakarmāvaraṇaviśuddhe pratinivartaya mama āyurviśuddhe sarvatathāgatasamayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊，金刚身·好好儿编织·不·圆满清净，一切·业障·最极清净，请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！我之（行者所有），寿命最极清净，一切如来·三昧耶·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, vajrakāya + struck together + not + O thoroughly pure, all + karmic obscuration + O completely purified, turn back (evil)! restore! my, of me (the practitioner), life + O completely purified, all Tathagatas + Samaya + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩囉嚩怛他誐哆 ｜ 𠶹哩娜野 ｜ 地瑟姹曩 ｜ 地瑟 恥地 ｜ 唵母底哩母底哩摩賀母 底哩 ｜ 嚩日囉迦野

verses.iast: oṃ muni muni mahāmuni vimuni mahāvimuni mati mati mahāmati mamati sumati tathatābhūtakoṭipariśuddhe visphuṭabuddhiśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼，再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧，我之（行者所有），善心、人情，真如·实际·圆满清净，闢·开·清净尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Muni, silent sage again and again, Great Sage (Mahāmuni), settle + Muni, great + settle + Muni, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom, my, of me (the practitioner), benevolence, favour, Suchness + limit of reality + O thoroughly pure, settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 僧賀跢曩 ｜ 跛哩秫弟 ｜ 薩囉嚩迦哩麼 ｜ 嚩囉 拏尾秫弟 ｜ 鉢囉底𩕳嚩哩哆 ｜ 野 欲尾秫弟 ｜ 唵母𩕳母𩕳摩賀母𩕳

verses.iast: he he jaya jaya vijaya vijaya smara smara sphara sphara sphāraya sphāraya
verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！再三忆念本誓，再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！再三请大放光明遍照十方！

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿誐戍藍 ｜ 阿櫱鉢囉底孕櫱戍藍 ｜ 薩嚩 戍藍 ｜ 阿𤚥薩嚩薩怛嚩喃 ｜ 佐畔 夜呬 ｜ 部多吠跢拏 ｜ 攞迦攞枳𩕳 入嚩攞娜覩嚕 ｜ 迦吒枳致跛固 瑟吒 ｜ 畢致迦嚧跛麼吠 ｜ 薩嚩沫𭌇 賀理誐 ｜ 悉灑娑怛囉薩誐囉尾灑 𢈔櫱
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 除断尊，能作非时横死·般·守护掩蔽·出拏尊
verses.meaningEn: O removing, untimely + wisdom + protect shelter + income + maker of na
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 玉輪麼沫櫱䭾囉 ｜ 玉惹囉麼 囉迦 ｜ 吠喇迦䭾囉 ｜ 阿迦攞弭哩 覩 ｜ 怛𡃤穆迦 ｜ 怛𡃤囉吒迦 勿哩悉唧迦 ｜ 薩嚩婆拏矩攞 ｜ 僧 伽尾野竭囉 ｜ 哩乞灑多哩灑 ｜ 跛 囉𠰒尾帝釤
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩哩吠釤 ｜ 阿𤚥薩囉嚩 薩怛囉喃 ｜ 佐畔夜呬 ｜ 伊莫婆誐嚩 跢 ｜ 怛他誐妬瑟抳灑 ｜ 悉哆多鉢怛囉 ｜ 曩謨鉢囉𠰒多 ｜ 摩賀鉢囉底孕 儗囉 ｜ 嚩左夜摩捺 ｜ 夜嚩訥嚩娜娑𢈔 惹拏 ｜ 阿偏怛隸拏
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ ṭrūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 枲麼滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 尾你也滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 跛囉尾你也 滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 帝祖滿鄧迦嚧弭 ｜ 怛你也 他唵阿拏哩阿拏哩 ｜ 尾娑祢尾娑祢 ｜ 吠囉吠囉 ｜ 嚩日囉䭾囉 ｜ 滿䭾 滿䭾𩕳 ｜ 嚩日囉播抳癹吒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 吽訥 嚕唵癹吒 ｜ 吽訥嚕唵滿䭾癹吒 娑嚩賀伊𤚥婆誐嚩多 ｜ 怛他櫱妬 瑟抳灑 ｜ 悉多跢鉢怛囉拏莫跛囉 𠰒哆 ｜ 摩賀鉢囉底孕儗囉 ｜ 哩乞 灑怛嚩布惹鉢底哩嚩 ｜ 嚩娑底 哩嚩 ｜ 嚩迦哩嚩迦寫野櫱黨嚩 ｜ 迦吒櫱黨嚩 ｜ 拏囉灑底 ｜ 迦寫野嚩 𠰒忘
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩謨囉怛曩怛囉夜野 ｜ 曩莫阿哩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩路枳帝 ｜ 濕嚩囉野 ｜ 冐地薩怛 嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ sarvarabhaye sudhanadasya namaskṛtvā imaṃ āryāvalokiteśvararavaṃ dhavaṃ nīlakaṇṭha
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向一切部分马车，报刊往外施财之，顶礼敬拜已，此（真言，圣观自在菩萨鸿毛，经营、流动，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + to a part of a chariot, press out + of giving money or wealth, having paid homage/salutation, this (accusative), Noble Avalokiteśvara + down, run, flow, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀薩怛嚩野 ｜ 摩賀迦嚕抳 迦野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ hṛdayaṃ āvartayiṣyāmi sarvārthasādhanaṃ śubhaṃ ajeyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhavamārgaviśodhakam
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼心·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·一切义利修习·清净吉祥、善妙庄严·山羊此圣女·一切处、到处可见·愿成·圣道·容易净化！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hṛdayaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all aims and benefits, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, drift, this, being everywhere, ubiquitous, be! become!, path, purifying!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛你也他唵薩嚩婆曳數 ｜ 怛 囉喃 ｜ 迦囉野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛寫銘 ｜ 曩莫塞訖哩 怛嚩 ｜ 伊𤚥阿哩也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ ālokapate lokātikrānte ehi hare mahābodhisattva sarpa sarpa smara smara mama hṛdayam
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！衍伸种类神明，世间古昔尊，善来降临坛场（翳呬），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，大菩提萨埵，再三蛇，再三忆念本誓，我之（行者所有），心
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spawn + a class of gods, world + O surpassing, come forth, O Blessed One! O Hari / Remover of Suffering! great + Bodhisattva, crawling, creeping again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), hṛdayam
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: kuru kuru karma dhuru dhuru vijayate mahāvijayate dhara dhara dhāraṇīrāja cala cala
verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），事，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），最胜尊胜、普胜一切！大最胜尊胜，再三请执持、总持护念！陀罗尼来诣，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, actions, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! great + supreme victory! triumph! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Dhāraṇī + coming from or belonging to goats, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛嚩𩕳攞建姹 ｜ 曩麼𠶹哩 娜野 ｜ 麼嚩哩跢伊灑弭也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: mama vimalamūrte ehy ehi jīva jīva Pañcamukha hāsa hāsa prahasita viṣa viṣaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），离垢坚硬，善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），再三命者，五面门，再三笑声、欢喜，熙，毒害、蛇毒与三毒，箭毒
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), immaculate + O thickened, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! living, alive again and again, five + face, laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision again and again, cherful, poison, venom, toxin, viṣaṃ
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 囉他 ｜ 娑䭾喃輸伴阿𠰒琰 ｜ 薩嚩部哆 喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆嚩沫𭌇誐 ｜ 尾戍䭾劒

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「古者能仁氏之王堪忍也始獲正覺談教法 以度僧伽之眾三寶於是乎現馬埋世霧之 六師薎如霜殞麗義天之五教朗若日懸然 有樂廣之徒慕博知而常說尚略之輩希捷 見以勤行人既二類不同法遂兩端亦異為 樂廣廣開性相曲示於淵玄對尚略略啟呪 名直增於功德其性也實多詮真理少議俗 事其相也權多議俗事少詮真理其呪也密 多從笁語少就支音其名也顯多就支音少 從笁語勃陁住世四十九年年別續演達磨 䟽歧一十二分分各無叅論夫析奧之幽其 閒甚眾議乃拯淪之急唯此為先生死浪由 是乎涸乾圓寂峯以之而峭峻。 今我聦文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝陛 下承祧以立為世而來乘宿敦菩薩之因據 現感皇王之位體佛在之正化闡佛後之遺 風俯控外氓闢三學於三府高提內吒傳六 明於六宮」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

verses.meaningEn: Knowing + suddenly, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, beyond conceptual fabrication — purified faculties, transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness & selfless great loving-kindness, beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), knowing + banyan, beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)

verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), not, non-, beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation, beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — dispelling sorrow, non-dual prajñā gnosis (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness

verses.iast: ṭhilu acipu ṭhilu vilite naṭhilu svāhā

verses.meaningEn: Beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth (imperative seal), beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Hand + this, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), be wonderful + incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, primordial tranquil peace & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust

verses.iast: gīlime luheta haravī ṇagha rasu bhaghana kaline andaka kalika rabhu

verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, conflict-free peace & dissolving dense ignorance, stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), star + slaying, O the present world age / in the present world age, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks, stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence (imperative seal)

verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, beyond + stone, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), press out + O but, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，除此之外、此外，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），再三真如实际·造作离相，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），表面地面尊，造作离相·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: blissful, except, besides, without, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency again and again, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O surface of the ground, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency

verses.tangNoteZh: 丁里反

verses.iast: haḥkara ka indhara jarini kakaka ka paśadya le avati ka
verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·因缘空寂大乐，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），持勇健、威势尊，生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，造作离相，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），不过今日，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），好好儿、水箱尊，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Making, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, holder of strong, mighty, fierce, transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, only + now, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, O well, cistern, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 郝羯喇滯 因達囉 闍利膩 鑠羯㘓滯 鉢設姪囇
verses.tangNoteZh: 丁里反

verses.iast: se kedaku tukutu kakabhī le kabhīle kabhīle kavira mati śirama
verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·钩召发起三昧），造作离相·施度调伏，真如实际·造作离相，造作离相·破有相福德光，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），再三造作离相·破有相福德光·离一切相无相，造作离相·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，慧、正念妙慧，摧碎本刹
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — samādhi invocation, freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness, crushing + this
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿伐底羯 細 計娜矩覩矩覩 脚迦鼻囇 劫鼻囇
verses.tangNoteZh: 丁里反

verses.iast: tinati dhurama tiri pavaka pankale śileśi le satisi teka svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立，牵绊极点本刹，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·最上真言离言说·造作离相，微妙尊手尊，本性寂静止息·离一切相无相，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，真如实际·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), yoke or pole + this, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, be wonderful + O hand, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: tadyathā saṃme visaṃme svāhā sagaka vigaka svāhā vigaḍa vati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：三么多尊，闢三么多尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·造作离相，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·息灭诤怨，鸣呼尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O equality in weight or number / in equality in weight or number, settle + O equality in weight or number, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from karmic agency, supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from karmic agency, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & pacifying conflict & turmoil, vati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.tangNoteZh: 亭耶反 · 蘇活 · 此云 成就我某甲

verses.iast: sa gara saṃbhrūta ya svāhā sakāñda mataya svāhā nilakāñ kaya
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），饮料、毒素，以桑眉及耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·圣智通达，祈请理趣，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！离名相假立·离一切相无相·造作离相，各个、一切
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, devouring, saṃ + brow + and supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness, may You thought, believed, supposed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency, each, every
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 毘揭滯 莎訶 毘揭茶伐底 莎訶娑 揭囉 三步多也莎訶
verses.tangNoteZh: 亭耶反 · 蘇活 · 此云 成就我某甲

verses.iast: svāhā apara kata viṭhaya ya svāhā himapan ta saṃbhrūta ya
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！必然，造作离相·真如实际，大便马，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！雪微妙，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），以桑眉及耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! a certain, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, horse, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! snow + be wonderful, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, saṃ + brow + and supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 塞建陀 摩多也 莎訶 尼攞建佗也 莎訶 阿鉢囉市哆
verses.tangNoteZh: 亭耶反 · 蘇活 · 此云 成就我某甲

verses.iast: svāhā animi la bhatara ya svāhā namo bhaghava tu baraka
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），星宿弯曲，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，破有相福德光·破暗合集·最上真言离言说，然而、而、实则，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, star + crossing, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to blessedness transcending existence & dissolving dense ignorance & supreme ineffable speech, but, indeed, moreover, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency

verses.iast: tadhiya tha aṅghala aṅghala paṃghala paraphaṃ kala bhayami hāmita laṃbhasi
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·本不生体性），再三动着耕，第一义谛·破暗合集·离一切相无相，他人颇，尊手，星宿狱王，不动尊威猛降魔心印趣往，离一切相无相·破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — primordial non-arising, move + plough again and again, ultimate truth & dissolving dense ignorance & freedom from conditioned marks, someone else + pha, hand, star + O holder, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable + going, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: aśa akhaman baridhu me thamante kebaja keyari saṃma bhahāne saṃmanta

verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace, space-like boundlessness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), to me, my, tha + think + to Thee, freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds & transcending birth & victorious, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, star + O leaving, all-pervading, universal

titleZh: 【DB2·悉昙部】《梵字悉曇字母并釋義》五十字门总持（日本 空海 撰）
titleSanskritIast: Siddhaṃ-Mātṛkā-Pañcāśat (T84n2701 / KR6t0412)
titleEnglish: Siddhaṃ Treatise: 梵字悉曇字母并釋義 (T84n2701)
translatorZh: 日本 空海 撰
sutraSourceZh: 大正藏第84册悉昙部《梵字悉曇字母并釋義》(T84n2701)
deityZh: 大日如来 · 悉昙五十字门法界体性
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 空海 撰撰《梵字悉曇字母并釋義》（T84n2701，共 1 卷，3642 字）。核心法义涵盖：悉曇五十字門釋義（阿字本不生）、十八章建立與摩多體文、二合三合連聲法則。原典摘要：梵字悉曇字母并釋義沙門空海撰夫梵字悉曇者印度之文書也西域記云梵天所製五天竺國皆用此字然因地隨人稍有增減語其骨體以此為本劫初之時世無法教梵王下來授以此悉曇章根原四十七言流派餘一萬世人不解元由謂梵王所作若依大毗盧遮那經云此是文字者自然道理之所作也非如來所作亦非梵王諸天之所作若雖有能作者如來不隨喜諸佛如來以佛眼觀察此法然之文…
recitationTipsZh: 悉昙五十字母（摩多十六韵与体文三十四字）是一切如来真言陀罗尼之字门根本，字字皆入不可得空性。

provenance.rawSnippet: 梵字悉曇字母并釋義沙門空海撰夫梵字悉曇者印度之文書也西域記云梵天所製五天竺國皆用此字然因地隨人稍有增減語其骨體以此為本劫初之時世無法教梵王下來授以此悉曇章根原四十七言流派餘一萬世人不解元由謂梵王所作若依大毗盧遮那經云此是文字者自然道理之所作也非如來所作亦非梵王諸天之所作若雖有能作者如來不隨喜諸佛如來以佛眼觀察此法然之文字即如實而説之利益衆生梵王等傳受轉教衆生世人但知彼字相雖日用而未曾解其字義如來説彼實義若隨字相而用之則世間之文字也若解實義則出世間陀羅尼之文字也所謂陀羅尼者梵語也唐翻云總持總者總攝持者任持言於一字中總

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 明覺 撰撰《悉曇要訣》（T84n2706，共 4 卷，13744 字）。核心法义涵盖：梵音反切與和音假名對照、二合三合四合連聲要訣。原典摘要：悉曇要訣辨言悉曇翻為成就悉馱悉地亦翻成就依轉聲法而可解也諸家梵章多就業聲安其標目又具題悉曇阿羅率覩翻成就吉祥字母字體從本以來諸義利成就故顯示異方文字不同此例殊標悉曇嘆其法德而為令之仰信領會其深義乎經曰祕密主我今觀諸佛國土無不見此遍一切處字門諸如來無有不宣説者菩薩住此字門一切事業悉得成就標章因由實在于此矣成就一切文辭章句…

provenance.rawSnippet: 悉曇要訣辨言悉曇翻為成就悉馱悉地亦翻成就依轉聲法而可解也諸家梵章多就業聲安其標目又具題悉曇阿羅率覩翻成就吉祥字母字體從本以來諸義利成就故顯示異方文字不同此例殊標悉曇嘆其法德而為令之仰信領會其深義乎經曰祕密主我今觀諸佛國土無不見此遍一切處字門諸如來無有不宣説者菩薩住此字門一切事業悉得成就標章因由實在于此矣成就一切文辭章句故標為悉曇諸師釋名大底如是此有淺深淺則成就諸顯教及世間多名句文辭深則成就微妙章句大陀羅尼等即是不空自在王家大因陀羅輪微妙章句皆得成就若夫隨緣字門以為其心觀誦如法得止一境則所安布字門成本有金剛字體到此妙

titleEnglish: Siddhaṃ Treatise: 悉曇字記創學鈔 (T84n2710)
translatorZh: 日本 行智 撰
sutraSourceZh: 大正藏第84册悉昙部《悉曇字記創學鈔》(T84n2710)
deityZh: 大日如来 · 悉昙五十字门法界体性
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 行智 撰撰《悉曇字記創學鈔》（T84n2710，共 10 卷，20820 字）。核心法义涵盖：《悉曇字記》逐句詳解、十八章字例全譜。原典摘要：三密鈔悉曇三密鈔序詳夫悉曇梵章之為學也入真言門之閫閾升瑜伽堂之階梯不由閫閾而入門不踐階梯而升堂者未之有也故學金剛乘者要須先肄悉曇凡梵字有字相有字義所言字相者如中國隸楷訓詁竺乾人兒女走卒亦通習之若夫據字義則聲字實相法佛境界不染指真道者雖大人耆宿非所得而窺窬佛言若出法性外別有世間文字者妄心謬見非真言也自字義觀則世間文字即法…
recitationTipsZh: 悉昙五十字母（摩多十六韵与体文三十四字）是一切如来真言陀罗尼之字门根本，字字皆入不可得空性。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 4 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti|| || āryya pacavigaṁtikā prajñāpāramitā nāmadhāraṇī parisamāpta|| ye dharmmā ityādi|| || oṁ namo bhavatyai āryya prajñāpāramitārye|| evaṁ mayā śruta meka sminsamaye bhagavānrājagṛhe viharatisma| gṛddhekūṭyeparvvatemahatā bhikṣusaṁghaśataicanekaircbodhisatvakoṭī niyutaśata sahasraḥ śakra prakṣya lokepāra pramurkhecane kaiśca deva manuṣāyā sura koṭī śata sahasraiḥ pramukhaiśca parivṛttaḥ|| śrīratna gadarbha (dva) siṁhā sena nisugṇaḥ bhagavā dharmma deśayātisma|| ādoca kalyāṇaṁ madhyekalyāṇa paryyavasāne kalyāṇaṁ svarthaṁsuvyajjanaṁ kevalaṁ paripurṇṇapariśuddha parthyavadātaṁ praṣkaca ryya saṁprakāśayatisma| athakhalvāryyā va lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ utthā(stha) pāśanādekāśaimuttarā saṁgaṁkṛtvā dakṣiṇa jānuma。

verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux, not, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, mahāsatvaḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux, a lake + endowed with or, bundle + tsa + god, Human Realm, god, goddess, Garuḍa, golden-winged bird king, stem and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, speaking (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), bearing, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties

verses.tangNoteZh: dhya nti te sarvvā'' vyopāyina bodhi parāṇā bhaviṣyantī anena kāraṇe kula putra saṁkṣipta prajñā pāramite ti| evamukte āryyā va lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavanta me tada-ovaca ta| āścaryya bhagavana paramaścaryya sugataḥ yāvade vaṁ bhagavatā sarvasatva vhitāya sukhāya ca dharmma rthyā yo de śite manda puṇyānāṁca satvānāṁ hitāya sukhāya ce ti|| ika ma voca bhagavāna bodhisatvā mahāsatvaḥ sāca sarvvāvatī parṣatsadeva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandhartvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣitabhyanandānniti|| āryya svalpākṣarā bhagavatī prajñā pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī parisamāptā|| ye dharṇā itya ti ||6|| oṁ namo bhagavatye āryya prajñāpāramitā yai|| evaṁmaya śrutama kāsmina samayaṁ bhagavānnā jagṛhe vidvaratisma|| gṛccakūṭe parvvate mahatā bhikṣū saṁghena sārddha mahatāca bodhisatva saṁghena anaikaiśca śakra vakṣa lokayā

verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此所成，最极听，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），出有坏喫食，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，能觉·助理·矣

verses.iast: gṛccakūṭe parvvate mahatā bhikṣū saṁghena sārddha mahatāca bodhisatva saṁghena anaikaiśca śakra vakṣa lokayā
verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·妙行迁变空·造作离相，时节，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，以圣僧伽、清净海众，俱，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以圣僧伽、清净海众，离名相假立·造作离相·本性寂静止息，帝释天主，最上真言离言说·造作离相·六度满行清净，以世间、世界

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (6): vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 6: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (6): vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu

sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §6

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 6 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu|| jātiviprapraśaṣṭhu nṛpavaramahite ketumahyāṁgṛhītvā buddhatvaṁyaḥ kariṣyatyāmita guṇanidhirnnāga vṛkṣasyamule| aṣṭāvavdāyutānikṣa pitabhagavate bhāviyagramāyu rvvandemaitrayanāthaṁtuṣita puravarāvāskitaṁ taṁmunīndraṁ|| stutvāvi saptabuddhansakalamupagatānsa ptasaptārksa bhāsometrayaṁbāṣumaṁmetuṣita puragataṁbhā vitaṁlokanātha| yatpupyaṁsaṁprasuta tubhagatiphala dadahināmeva sarvvācchitvā saṁlkeśayāśo nmunayaśvavarāniṣṭati saṁprayāntu|| itisugatā vadānasapta buddha muni samāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ sarvabuddha bodhisatvānāṁ mulāmūlahālakā nantā sukṣataḥ sarvvajinā-asimaniṣṭha| varadāmamadhantu abhyudā|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.tangNoteZh: 1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī samāpta|| oṁ namo bhagavate ratneka tu nājāyatamadhāna tāyārhama samyaṁka vjjāya| tayathā oṁ vatte|| 2) mahāvastre ratne saṁbhave svāhā| iti ratne saṁbhavanā dharanī samāpta| oṁ nāmo bhagavate amitāthācā tatha-āgatāyārbhame samyaṁkka buddhāya| 3) tayaṁthā|| oṁ amine' amitobhave amitasiṁddhe amitamini amitagagana kirtīikare sarvāthī siddhe nama savvekarmā kesakasa| 4) kṣayakīra svāhā| iti amitābhasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ namo bhagavate amoghe siśyu tathāgatā mārhamame samyaṁka buddhāya| 5) tayathā|| oṁ siddhatu bhūmiṁddha parama siddhe svāhā| iti amogha siddhī nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ nama dhī majjñā nāthāya| oṁ namo bhagavate| 6) candra vajja kroṭāya| tayathā| bhava| tu, karatu, tiṣṭhatu, vandatu, haratu, amṛteta huṃ, huṃ, ha, phaṭ svāhā|| iti amṛta bhakṣānāma dhāranī samāpta || iti||

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 9 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya|| oṁ namo-arapañacanāyamukatidahanadakṣāyamaṁjuśrīpradātāyacandrakāntimaṇibuddhipradāyākhaṅaga pustakavyagrahastāyamaṁjuvāṇivaraprudāyasarvvasatvānāṁñaca śāntiṁkurūpuṣṭikururakṣākurū oṁ āḥ dhīḥ hūṁ phaṭ-svāhā| iti-arapañacanamaṁjuśrīḥ sādhananāmadhāraṇīsamāptaḥ|| oṁ namaḥ śākyasiṁhāya|| tadyathā| oṁ dhṛtiśrutivijayesvāhā|| namostuhabuddhāya suviśuddhabodhayeviśuddhadharmmāpratibhānubuddhe| saddharmma punyāpagatā nuddhayebhavāgraśunpāpariśuddhabuddhaye|| aho aho buddhamanakṣatejasaṁ aho aho sāgaramerū| aho aho buddhamanantagocaraṁ āṃdunvaṁraṁ puṣa-apamivāti dullabhaṁ|| aho aho kāṇikastathāgataḥ śākyakulatunarendrasūryyāyenedṛśaṁbhāṣita- sutramubhumaṁsarvaṣusatvāmanugrahārtha|| śa-ānteśa-avaraḥ śākyamunistathāgataḥ satvobhumaḥ gāntapurepraviṣṭhaḥ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第11品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 11: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §11
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (11)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 11 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya|| ji āḥ maitreya hūṃ svāhā| iti maitrīya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 23|| ḍenamaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| amogha pāśāyanamaḥ|| evaṁmayā śrutamekasmiṁ samaye bhagavān protarakeparvvate viharatisma|| āryyāva lokiteśvaraspabhavane| aneka śāsagatamāsa campakāśa-okātimukta kanānānāratnavṛkṣa samalaṁkṛtemahatābhikṣū saṁghenasārddha aṣṭādaśabhirbhikṣa sahasrairnavanavati bhiścabodhisatva koṭiniyuteśatasahasraiḥ parivṛttaḥ puraskṛta iśvara maheśvara vraphnta kāyikāṁ deva putrā nādha-ikṛtya dharmmadeśayatisma|| athakhalvāryyāca lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvotchāyāsanādekāṁśa muttarā saṅgakṛtvāda kṣiṇajā majulaṁ pṛthiṣyā pratiṣṭha-āpyayenabhagavāṁsta nāñajalīkṛtvāpraṇya prahasita vadano bhūtvā bhagavanta meta davocata|| astima mebhaṁga。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §12
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (12)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 12 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti|| idamavocad bhagavānāttamanā āryāva lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvastaca bhikṣavastaica bodhisatvā satcaśuddhāvā sakā-īka devapūtrā sadeva mānūṣā saragaruḍa gandharvvaśca lokobha gavatoṣitamabhya nandanniti|| iti āryā smoghapāśanāma hṛdayaṁmahāyāna sūtraṁ nāmadhāraṇāṁ parisamāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrīkhasarpyanāyai| trailokya darpyanātha ekāgracittā cittāya sakala lokavināsana karāya sarvasatvānātrya śānti kurupūṣṭiṁ kururakṣā kurusiddhiṁ kuru-oṁ āḥ hṛṁ hu phaṭ svāhā|| āryā khasarpyanāmadhāraṇī samāpta| oṁ namaḥ trailokanātha|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā oṁsūmūṣṭi chedani nirmmaresū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to glorious (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 三界、三千世界，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，一境心，向心、菩提心、心识，全部、圆满一切，世间·远离·古老，向掌，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，息灾、寂静、安隐，成办作持·造作离相，祈请成办羯磨事业守护

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业悉地，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! + Siddhi, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — dispelling sorrow, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，圣鸿毛，向随一趣往自在主，向菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble + down, mostly ) look + going + to, to/for Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, to/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, to/for Greatly Compassionate One
verses.tangNoteZh: na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti|| idamavocad bhagavānāttamanā āryāva lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvastaca bhikṣavastaica bodhisatvā satcaśuddhāvā sakā-īka devapūtrā sadeva mānūṣā saragaruḍa gandharvvaśca lokobha gavatoṣitamabhya nandanniti|| iti āryā smoghapāśanāma hṛdayaṁmahāyāna sūtraṁ nāmadhāraṇāṁ parisamāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrīkhasarpyanāyai| trailokya darpyanātha ekāgracittā cittāya sakala lokavināsana karāya sarvasatvānātrya śānti kurupūṣṭiṁ kururakṣā kurusiddhiṁ kuru-oṁ āḥ hṛṁ hu phaṭ svāhā|| āryā khasarpyanāmadhāraṇī samāpta| oṁ namaḥ trailokanātha|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā oṁsūmūṣṭi chedani nirmmaresū

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 14 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：verocana vyusarājāpaya tathāgatārhate samyakaṁ buddhāya| tadyathā| nama| sarva tathāgatetatya| samyakaṁ buddhāyatya| namaḥ āryāvajñokī| teśvarāya bodhisatvāya| mahāsatvāya| mahākārūṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ dhara tu dhirītu ṣar-tu bhadrevatu, pracajñetu kusumetu vane| iti bhilici| li vajjālā pranaye svāhā| ārya śrī sabhamra bhujalokeśvarasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ nama, śrī siṁha nādāya| namoratna namāya| namo āryāvalo kiṁteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ akaṭe, vikaṭe, nikaṭe, ikaṭe| kaṭaṁkaṭa kaloka karāṭavīryva| svāhā| āryā siṁhanādalokeśvara nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ namo mokṣa padāya| oṁ nama śrī āryāvajño kineśvarāya, bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| tadyathā| oṁ yajñetu, cilītu, culutu, hayutu m。

verses.iast: oṁ dhara tu dhirītu ṣar-tu bhadrevatu, pracajñetu kusumetu vane
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！请执持、总持护念！然而、而、实则，法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），然而、而、实则，贤愿犹如，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，园
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hold! bear! sustain! but, indeed, moreover, Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, but, indeed, moreover, blessed + may it like, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal), freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), O free from lust

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 15: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (15): tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §15

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 15 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā|| āryya mokṣa prada nāmadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 29|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā| oṁ viśuddhāgreśuddhā kṣi śodhani gagaṇa viśodhanivittī viśodhani-ā valaṇaviśodhani karmmaviraṇa viśodhanihana 2 sarvvā caraṇānipaca 2 patrcanantaryyā padma padmākṣi padma vimale ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ha ha ha ha ha arjja ladare siddhirisvāhā|| paṭhita mātreṇa patrcanapatrcanantarythāṇi karmmāṇi parikṣayaṁcāsyanti|| āryāva lokiteśvarasya siddhinikānāmadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 30|| oṁ namoṣaṅkṣarāya oṁ namo āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākārūṇikāya|| evanmayā śṛta mekasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvastyāṁ viharatisma|| jetavane'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme tatra khalu bhagavānāyuṣmaṁta。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 17 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|。

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Bearing

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·施度调伏，能作成办·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & generosity & self-mastery, making (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Causing to expand or blossom + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 左蕴，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，向胜者、最胜诸佛，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Left + aggregate, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, dark-blue, black, to/for Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Great, practicing, to/for wearing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: To/for Lokeśvara, Sovereign Lord of the World, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Great + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，向成就者自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, accomplished + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命、敬礼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage, salutation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|

verses.meaningZh: 大地·热门·焚净，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Earth + hot + burn, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|

verses.iast: namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·圣、尊贵圣者·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相·菩提萨埵·出·莽娑·长柄·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者·成就者、已成就·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·造作离相·句·苦痛·圆满吉祥成就！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (reverent offering), Bodhisattva, income, flesh, to, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One, accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency, word, pain, hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed!
verses.tangNoteZh: ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|

verses.iast: itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是吉祥，圣观自在菩萨，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），绀青、宝蓝色，颈喉、妙音喉轮，心，并购由事业
verses.meaningEn: Thus + auspiciousness, Noble Avalokiteśvara, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, sapphire-blue, dark azure, throat, neck, hṛdayaṁ, acquisition + from work

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向莲华手
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to lotus flower + to

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 19: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §19
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (19)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 19 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva samāptaḥ|| 35|| oṁ namo lokanāthāya namaste bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāyatāpine| āryyāva lokiteśāya maheśvarāya suśriye||1|| padmaśrī bhuṣitā ya saddharmmavacadāyate namāva śaṁkarāya truvanadṛṣṭika nāyate|| 2|| sarvadā jagadāśvāsavara dāna pradāyaca| śata sahamrahastāya koṭīlakṣekṣaṇāyaca|| 3|| vaḍavā mukha paryyanta śaśidiśāna nāyaca| sarva dharmmānurupāya dharmma priyāṁya suddhiye|| 4|| sarvva satva mahā duḥkha saṁmokṣaṇa karāyaca| matsya dayāmbujūja mṛnāmā śvāsana karāyacaṁ||5|| jñāna rāśṣutta māṁgāya dharmmārtha priyadāyine| ratna śrī bhuṣitāṁtyāya saṅṇa śrī pradāyaca||6|| sarvva naraka bhumīnāṁ saṁśoṣaṇa karāyaca| jñāna śrī saṁprabhāsāya jñāna laṣkī pradāyaca|| sāmaraiḥ sāsurendreśvalokaiḥ saṁpūjitāyaca namaḥ。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 20 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca||17|| trai loke dusatvānī bhīṣaṇa mūrtti dhāriṇe| bhutacetā ekūmbhāṇura kṣoyakṣā dibhī da de|| 18|| nilotyala khunatrāya gambhīcadhīca buddhaye| sarvva dhinā thāya sarvva kle śopāriṇe|| bhūvi vidharmma sambā dhimārgoya citāyaca| mokṣa bhārgā bhiruḍhāya pravaradhamma pitrute|| 20|| prāpta saṁbodhi saccitta sanmārgo pacitāyaca| pretā didurgati kleśa parimokṣaṇa karāyaca||21|| paramoṇu rajo saṁkhya samādhida dhate namaḥ| nama mtrai laukanāthāya bodhisatvāya tesadā|| 22|| mahāsatvāya saddharmma guṇa saṁpaktidāyine| namāmi tejaga chāstā sadāhaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajate||23|| bhajābhisatavaṁbhakkāta tprasadi jagatprabho| kṣanta vyaṁme rādhatvaṁyatmathā prakṛtaṁbhavet||24|| itiśrī madā ryyā va lokiteśvara spajamacā jā muti samāptaḥ|| oṁ na mo loka。

verses.meaningEn: Know + not one and quelling calamity & affliction & stainless purity free from dust, greatness + primordial wisdom, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One

verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās

verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, forward + yes + tha, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & transcending birth & victorious, sudarśanaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Glorious (vocative invocation), calf, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence, god + may You palm

verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties with nirvāṇic visarga release

verses.meaningEn: Great, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, making

verses.meaningEn: No rest or remainder, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās, tremble + cart, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), great + deceitful

verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, auspiciousness + opinion, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 21 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāthāya|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstre va lokite śvarāyate| padmabhṛte maheśāya sū pralhāda karāyaca||1|| padmāsanāya padmaśrī pariṣṭata samūktaye| saṁśubha padmahastāya jagadāśvā sadāyine||2|| pṛthivī carane trāya saṁśuddha patrvacakṣuṣa| jinaratna kirīṭāya cintāmaṇi vibhūṣiṇa||3|| itimaheśvarakṛta stavaḥ|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstreve lokite śvarāyate| maheśāya jagabhartta prāṇadāya mahātmate||1|| pṛthivīvarane trāyaṁ śubhapadmadharāyaca| padmaśrī pariṣṭatāya sūcetana karāyaca||2|| dharmmadharāya nāthāya daśabhūmīśvarāya cāsū nirvṛtti mahāyāna saṁprasthitāya sarvvadā||3|| iti āryyāvalokiteśvarasya umāmaheśvara kṛtmṇati samāptaṁ||3|| oṁ namaḥ samatra bhadrāya|| atha khalū samanta bhadro bodhisatva mmahāsatva etāneva loka dhātu paraṁparona bhilā pyānābhilāpya būddha kṣatrapara。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 22 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca|| || āryyabhadravarīmahāpraṇidhāna ratna rājaṁ samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo lokathāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryyā va lokiteśvarāya|| bodhisatvāyamahā satvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| evaṁmayā śṛta me kasminsamaye bhagavānāryyāvalokiteṇṣaṭasya bhagavate pāṭarake parvvata śikharayarānāratna vṛkṣasahasra samādhi vyakīrṇte jāmvanade suvarṇtukāctrenobhāsa|| nānāratnamaya vimāna bhūmipradeśa viharātisma|| anekaiśvadevanāgayakṣa suragaruḍa kinnara mahoragamatuṣyā koṭi niyūta śata sasamraiḥ sārddha tatrakhalū bhagavānū puraskṛta smaṁskṛtī gurūkṛto mānitaḥ pūjito ardhito apacāyito parivūta dharmma deśayatisma|| ādaukalyānaṁ madhaukalyānaṁ paryyavasāṇakaṁsyā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 23 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti|| || yaḥ kaścidāryāvalokite śvaraspanāmāṣṭotara śatenamtrotrā pahārakuryyotātaspatrca nannataryyāṇikarmmācaraṇāni parikṣayaṁ gacchati|| sarvvamāgulaṁ praviṣṭhobhavanti| sarvva mantrānita spasiddhānita| aneka kalpa koṭhiniyuta satasahasrāṇi durgatinnajārā|| avicīna praviśaṁti| tasyacamaraṇa kālasamaye sutvāvatyāṁloka dhātu dhupa yadyaṁte|| jātojātau āryyāvalokiteśaravirahito bhavanti|| samatrajāpena medhāvī bhavati|| śurāśurayaḥ savaraḥ sarvva śāsta viśārada ā deyavāṣṭo bhavati|| anenamtotrā pahāraṁ kuryyāta dvāṣaṣṭhī gargānadīyālukāsamoyu būddhā bhagavanta pujito bhavanti|| samovipākonā ṣṭi viśe| sarvvajñajina ratnadhātu karaṇukaṁnāma bhagavanta āryyālokiteśvara spa-aṣṭobhāra śatanāma mahāyāna śūtraṁ samāptaṁ||0||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 24 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：kha svāhā|| oṁ kuvaleya svāhā|| oṁ jūṃ jūṃ jūṃ śiva svāhā|| oṁ urddhaṣnuṇe svāhā|| oṁ suryyāya grahādhipataye svāhā|| oṁ candāyārakṣatrādhipataye svāhā|| adhipṛthivyai svāhā|| oṁ asurebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ nāgebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ sarvvayogecittamu pātpādayāmī samudraphalanasamaye haṃ asamācara samīrasāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānathaḥ|| asamanta sarva guṇāsiddhi dāyine|| asamāṁcara samīra sāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānayaḥ|| samanta sarva guṇāsiddhidāyine|| asamāṁcasamavarāgra dharmmiṇaḥ gagaṇe samāpatatānavidyate|| guṇaresareṇū- kanikaṁvyasimiko sphutasatvadhātuvara siddhidāyakaṁ|| vigato prareṣu-asamanta siddhipuśatatāmalokanavega taddhitā praṇidhāna siddhibala nirodhaḥ dharmmatājagatārtha sādhanaparāḥ samattini satatṣvi rocani mahā kṛpātmamānanirodhātmakaruṣācārī kāyarotavajatetrīsokavara siddhidāyakāḥ amitābhateṣu samāpti tamatāḥ sata。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 25 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：|| āryā sarvva dūrgnati pariśo dhanarājyasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyakaṁ būḍacasya kalpaika samāptaḥ|| oṁ namo ratnatracāya|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva buddha bodhisatvebhaḥ|| tadyathā|| oṁ kinira tathāgato dbhabaśānta bala daṁḍattama tathāgato dabhabahūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya gandhavyū hanāmadhāraśāṁ samāptaḥ oṁ namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā|| ḍaṁdhana 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya samādhi rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| oṁ namoca laṁkāya tārāya|| buddhe bhagabadbhe rbhāṣitā nibhāṣiṣante|| tadyathā|| oṁ ṭṭa 2 dhūṭṭa 2 kaṭa 2 amale 2 vimale 2 nima 2 vame 2 kase 2 aṭamaṭṭaka gholathapagho dimera paca 2 vandha 2 ace 2 mace dūtāre dūśovatāre arkkara sarkka 2 vakre 2 dime 2 ṭūṭūṭūṭū|| ḍū ḍū ḍū ḍū|| rū rū rū rū|| phū phū phū phū svāhā|| āryya laṁkābatāra pathi phalanāma dhāraṇīsamā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.iast: āryā sarvva dūrgnati pariśo dhanarājyasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyakaṁ būḍacasya kalpaika samāptaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all, every, complete, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, treasure + of fit to reign, thus + tree or mountain + her, right, proper, spiritual strength freeing bonds & pacifying conflict & turmoil & awakened conduct beyond flux, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, samāptaḥ

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! noble, holy, exalted (Ārya)

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to the wonderful Dharma, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust

verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold!
