meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 30 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā|| āryyā amritā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo ratnatrayāya|| oṁ namo buddhāya mahākāruṇikāya bharaṇikṛtahṛdayāya|| oṁ āḥ sugatavajatṛsyahoḥ svāhā|| āryya sugata nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavate bheṣayavaiḍuryyaprabha rājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyakasaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā oṁ bheṣaye 2 mahābhaiṣaṭta bhaiṣaṭate svāhā|| āryya bhaiṣayta rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryyapara maguravai mahākāruṇikāya śākya manuṣye tathāgatā yārhate samyaksaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ mūne 2 mahāmunaye svāhā|| āryya śākya muni nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ sapta saptīnāṁsamyaksaṁbuddhā koṭīnāṁ||。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 33 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vaja hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ vaja vārāhī mahādevī hūṁ phaṭ|| mūlamantraḥ|| iti mahāsatvara hṛdayaṁ samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namaḥ śrī cakamahāroṣanāya|| śrī matsyakta ravinvāya sarvvasattva pakāriṇi namo vighnoya saṁhāraṁ kāya triyaka muktayaṁkaraṇe deva khaṅāya sarvvanāpāya bhāvayene vāme prajñārga bhāṇyena tarjaṇi śaktapāśe| saptapātāra pārākṣamadhya vāmāya darśine śakravraṣkyaṇupāratvātnamaḥ savyerddha darśine bhūmautaktakṣaṇa tvātrya vineṣṭā vāmajānave| mahāprahāra saṁskārana savyapādāyate namaḥ|| magnaṁyena kṣacca rāva ramidaṁ mahāndhakāro dyaḥ|| prajñāpāya vibhāga bhāskara varai rvyaktaṁ samūdvīpitaṁ kṛtvā candra samādyamādya puruṣaḥ śrī vajasatvasvayaṁ|| soyaṁ tatsūkha sādhanāya jagativyakta prabhātiṣṭhātti|| tatomantragāthāḥ|| viśvāmbhoja dineśa maṇu lagataṁ hūṃ kāra vīyodbhavaṁ dṣṭābhiḥ para pīḍītādharamala dhārāṣṭra haṁsaparāḥ|| urdhyā māsā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 34 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：hā roṣaṇa samādhi hṛdaya samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrī harukāya|| oṁ kroḍhapirgelakeśāya sahamratekṣasyadhara 2 jvāla 2 prajvāla 2 triśūla vyagrahate hara 2 prasara 2 dama 2 gṛntpāpaya 2 sarvva dūṣṭa satvānāṁ nāgānāgarājā nāṁ mūkhaṁ kīlaya 2 śulaṁnośa 2 piṁhanāśaya 2 aśmarāṇāśaya 2 evaṁ sarvva nāśānāṁ nāśaya 2 ekāhikaṁ dayāhikaṁ bhyāhikaṁ cāturthihikaṁ sarvvajvalaṁ sannipātajvalaṁ dūṣṭa jvalaṁ vātikaṁ pittikaṁ śreṣṭikaṁ sannipātikaṁ māsā-ī māsikaṁ sāmvatsarikaṁ evaṁ evaṁ sarva rogāna nāśaya 2 hūṃ śrī akṣotya vajarupamama sarvvasatvā nātrca śānti kūra 2 svāhā|| āryya śrī heru kaspaprasavaroganāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryyavajavārārṣke|| tadyathā|| oṁ namā bhagavati vajavārā hi āryya parājite trailokya mātre mahāvaidye sarvvabhūta yāvaha mahāvaja vajāmane ajite parājite vaśāṁkarane。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

Phaṭ!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 35 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：gaḥ rājaruṣya vrailokya da mahamūdra rośanegrasa 2 hūṃ pha vīcāddhe te hūṃ hā 2 mahāyaśu mahāniyā gauritvaṁ ḍākiṇi lokānāṁ vandani saṁghaḥ pratyaya kālini hūṃ pha|| bhūta trāsani mahāvīra parama siddha vidyai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| valimantraḥ|| oṁ namo vajavārahī|| oṁ sarva ṣṭāna hūṃ phaṭ|| svāhā|| oṁ vajavārāhī āveśaya sarvvadūṣṭān svāhā|| upahṛdaya|| oṁ phū hrīṁ hāṃ|| hṛdayaḥ| oṁ a hriṁ hūṃ hā hūṃ|| ārya mahāmāyā vajavārāhī nāmadhāraṇī samāptā|| 31|| oṁ namaḥ śrīnairātmā mahādevyai|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai neṁ rairātmā dervye vajavirā śiniya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva bhūta bhayāvahe mahāvaje hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namo vajāsana akṣite aparājite vaśvaṁkara netratomani hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ| oṁ namaḥ jayāvijayā jambha nimbha vi mohāni。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 36 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tmā devī phuṃ phuṃ phuṃ phuṃ phuṃ ṭ ṭ ṭ ṭ ṭ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ svā svān hā hā|| oṁ āḥ hūṁ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ | hriṁ hriṁ phaṭ svāhā|||| ityāhi maṁtra phaladāsiddhidāyani vijayo ginī nairotmā guśkeśvarīmantra nāmadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| || oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryyatārāyai|| oṁ tāre ture ture svāhā|| sarvvadṛṣṭānāmaṁ makṛty jahmaya sta mha ya māhya vandhaya didhvaṁsaya hūṃ haṃ phaṭ phaṭ sarva duṣustambha niḥsvāhā|| āryyatārā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namaḥ śrī yogāsvarāya|| takṣyathā|| oṁ hūṃ haḥ svāhā|| oṁ āṃḥ oṁ aṃḥ 'sūṃḥ oṁ kṣaṃḥ oṁ yaṃḥ oṁ hūṃḥ oṁ yyūṃḥ oṁ ṅyuṃḥ oṁ ymuṃḥ oṁ dyuṃḥ oṁ ḍūṃḥ oṁ phaṃḥ oṁ phāṃḥ oṁ phriṃ oṁ haṃ hāṃ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ hrī oṁ ghrī ghraṃḥ oṁ hūṃ hūṃḥ| oṁ grīṃḥ oṁ hūṃ 3 oṁ kuḥ oṁ sunṛvy hūṃ oṁ kṣuṃḥ oṁ kṣaṃ saḥ|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第47品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 47: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §47
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (47)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 47 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ || teca sarvva priduṣṭātmā upasargga sudāraḥ nanejānsidapraśānyente samastāḥ sarvvamonphatāṁā yuścavardvate puṇyaṁ sarvvapāpaurvimocitaṭha || maṇi sarṣapadūrvābhiḥ ratnākṣala saṁvandarneḥ | vajūbhāchīna puṣpaiśca jalabhā yūrjjakāñcanaṁ || ghaṭaṁturajataṁ vāpiśu vivestuṇavāsitaṁ || eka viṁśativā raṁvāvālamaṣṭhāttaraśataṁ || jayaṃdvaja vidāraṇaṁ mantraṁsnādhāyatpārthivaḥ sadā || evaṁpaśyahi dinātne satata sapadayateśubhaṁ || || ita mavocad bhagavāna vajapāṇirbhāṣita matyāntunniti || iti āryyaśrīvajacidāriṇī hṛdaya mūlamaṁtra dhāraṇī samāpta || 84 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyagavaṇāti hṛdayāyai || sumukhaścai vadantaśya kapirogaja karṇukaṁ likhādaṁsalaścaṇikato ghna rājovināyakaḥ || dhamake karṇaṇādhikṣā bhāracandro gajānana śrī vakratuṇḍaḥ kla varṇṇā helambaskaṁndapūrvva。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 48 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ġtaḥ śāntidaḥ śuddhaḥ saṁkaraḥ priyaṁ bāṁdhavaḥ aṣṭamutinnidhīśca jñāna vakṣastapāmayaḥ || aṣṭhādhyāraṁ ṣatrodyaraḥ sarvvaktaḥ śikhīsakaḥ dhudharo bhudharādhī śopatiḥ bhupatiḥ bhudharātmajaḥ || kaṁkāladhārī muṇṇīca nāgayajña pavītavāna | jamtha nāsohe nastaṁbhimāraṇaḥ kṣomavasatthatā || śuddhanī tmābtrahana prakhyādetya muṇuvibhuṣitaḥ | valitukavalitugnotho vālocāla parākramāḥ | sarvvopatta | bhūta niṣavitaḥ kākinacārasyakasyaciṁdevatāraṁ prayatchati || avatāraṁ pratilapyati nacosya bodhicittantarā yā bhaviṣyati || jātau jātau jātismarobhaviṣyati || itamo c gavonātta manāsteca bhikṣavāstaca bādhisatvā mahāsatvāsocana sarvva 1 vitīparṣartīsadeva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāra gagandhardhaśca lokābhagavate bhāṣita sammayanandanviti || aryya gaṇapati hṛdayānāmadhyāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || om namo bhagavatye āryyāṁvaṣṣa vinayāṁye || evam。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 50 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari || tunna 2 vitunna 2 tuna 2 bhūmule svāhā || om piśāci parṇṇaśavari hrīṁ hūṃ phaṭa piśāci svāhā || āryyaparṇṇaśavarī mahāmārī praśamanīnāmadhāraṇī samāpta || 87 || om namo bhagavatye āryya mārīcyai || evaṁ mayā śrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvassyāṁ viharatisma || jetavane'nāthapiṇḍadasthārāme mahātā bhikṣu saṁghena sārdhva mardhva trayodaśa mibhikṣaśataiḥ saṁpakṣalaiśca boddhisatvermahāsatveḥ || tatrakhalu bhagavāna bhikṣa nāmantrayatesma || asmibhikṣa vomārīcīnāma devatā sārsyyācandramasoḥ puratongachati ya || sānadṛśātenagaghate | navadhyatena || namudhyatena || namukhyate | namudhtate || nadaṇḍāte namudyate。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第51品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 51: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §51
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (51)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 51 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：padravetyaḥ svahā || om namo ratnatrayāya || om bhagavatye āryya mārīcī namaḥ | om vanalavarttarivadari 2 carārivarāha mukhi sarvvadūṣṭānāṁ cakṣamukhavaṇdhare svāhā || āryya mārīcī nāmadhāraṇīpari samāpta || 88 || om namo bhagavatye āryya grahamātṛtakāyai || evammayāśrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna ḍakavatyī mahānagaryyāṁ aneka devanāga yakṣa gandarvā asūra garuḍa kinnara mahāragā ditya somāṅgarādi būdhavṛhaspati śukra śaniścarādi rokṣaketu bhiraṣṭhā viṁśati nakṣarādi bhistuyamā nāma mahāvaja samayāla ṅkāravyūhādhiṣṭhāno dhiṣṭhite siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatva śatasahaśraisārdhvaṁ || tadyathā || vaja pāṇinācanāma bodhisatvena satve || vajamatināya nāma bodhisatvaśrenamahāsatvena || vaja vandeṇaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja vegenaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja senenaca nāma bo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·第一义谛，归命敬礼·一切诸谛圆满，能作成办·造作离相，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·造作离相，一切诸谛圆满·离诸诤论无诤·解脱系缚大力，酒席·苦痛·蓝·汝即是，离名相假立·真如实际·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 52: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §52

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 52 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti || idamavocadbhagavānātta manāstecaphiphavaḥ sācasarvāvatī parṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā bhagavato bhāṣita satya nandanniti || āryyagṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇī samāpta || om namoḥ rāhave || evaṁmayā śṛtamekasminsamayebhagavān aḍakavanyāṁ mahānagaryyā aneka devanāga yakṣa gandharvā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā pasmārāditya somāgāra budha bṛhaspati śukra śaniścarā rāhu ketubhiraṣṭāviṁśati bhiśca nakṣatrādi bhistuna māna mahāvajra samayā laṁkādhiṣṭānā dhiṣṭitaṁ siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatvaśata sahastreḥ sārdhva || ramaitreya bodhisatvena mahā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 53 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ntibhavakisma || satvānāṁ viharayantisma || upadravāntisma || keṣāñcidravyapaharāntisma || kaṁpāñcinprāṇama paharantisma || evasarvvasatvānā mupadraṁṇavāhyantisma || tadadaśeyanuṇa bhagavana dharmma paryyāyacesarvasatvānāṁ raktābhavaṁtisma || om rāhavaya ravi śaśihasrāya khaṅagapheṭakāya urdhva pityalakeśāyaddaṣṭākkatā vikṛtānanāya sarvva bhayarananaya || pūrvarogasāntāyanamo namaḥ rādbhūdevatāya || śāṁntibhavantume sarvva dāvatajā pitajā vāgāśoṣmājā sannipātañcana saṁnitā amṛtapiyāya rāhave sarva vighna prasāntayetu || idamavāhacaha gavantaca vājapāṇyāda yamatya nandanniti || āryyānāhavyagraha śānti upadrava nāma dhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || om namaḥ śrī āryyakatavai || evammacā śṛtamekasminsamaye aṅkacatyāṁ deva śanāga yakṣa gandharvvāsura guraḍa kinnara mahoragā apasmārāditya somāṅgāla。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 54 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：māyaprasādhayasarvadṛṣṭānaśodhaya sarvaṣāṁcaṇuracaṇḍinī 2 turu 2 sūma 2 mūñca 2 havā hvayabhecābhavya ugrā ugra gape bhagavati sarvasatvānāñca manārathaṁ paripūraya sarva tathāgata samavedhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā || idamavocadbhagavānāta mahāvaja pāṇīmatyarandanniti || āryyaketugrahaśāṁtapaṇāmadhāraṇī pari samāpta || om nako viprāntakāya || viprāṁtakamahāvīra trailovighnarhatāra cilamipi gaurddhakeśasūmerucaudrāgraivapañcakapāla molitāṁnī 2 varṇṇa śusobhitaṁ gajīgagipare sthaṁpradhtālevriṇirocarnalalāvikṣāśurekṣaṇaṁ || nāgakūṇula bhūṣitaṁnānoratna manīṣālā gṛvyadīvya praktoritaṁ sarvarakṣanasaṁpūktaṁ || ṣāṭabhūjadharaṁ nāyaṁda hina karttidaṁvara mahāmādājāgaraṁ vāmakhatvāgaṁprotraṁcarva jamaṅgara yāśadharaṁ | hastimaṣūdharaṁpāda āriḍādhapādayūgaṁhasticarmāśusobhāva, vyāghracarmākāṭhiddardha || hārārdva hālaropūraṁnāgacarmmaśusobhitaṁ dakṣiṇadigaṣṭārtha sarvvasatvaḍa dhālaraṁgītācāryya jabhāsaktaṁdūḥkhanā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.iast: om būddha būddha suddha suddha vaja vaja padme padme sara sara
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持，再三一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·法界总持任持，再三最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention again and again, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious again and again, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again

verses.meaningEn: Coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour again and again, maina again and again, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil again and again, all + settle + a superhuman female + not, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, severing again and again

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，再三施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，再三施度调伏·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，再三拥护守护·施度调伏，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，一切·曜执·星宿·逼迫
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, protecting again and again, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, all + planet + constellation + violation

verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 55 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：saṁnamaskataṁ || advisidviprasādañcarabhairavāṇāṁnamomṛtevedaśunyaddarbhāśaraṁpoṣakṛṣṇaśumaṁñjaṁladaśakroḍhagaṇemūlakroḍarājaṁ namāmyahaṁ || itidaśakroḍadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyāmahāsāhasrapramardaṇyai || smādamabhedaṁ || siddhasūmidṛsakhearearaścavalemahāvane jāhajaṭilaakhanemakhane laṭekharaṅgaharipiṁgale timigile timiṅgalinirmagale svāhā || sidhontumamamantu padāḥ sarva satvā nāñcaveśracapasyamahārojasyanānnāvalenaiśvaryyādhipate naca svāhā || syādbhedaṁ || akheñnakhevinakhevandhovarāśecapalevūkhevakhane aścinaṁvalebhage bhagandare vaśevaśavarttiṇisvāhā || mūcyantu mamasarvvasatvānāñca sarvagrahetyaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mahārājasyanāmnābalenaiścaryyādhipate na ca svāhā || syāddyabhedaṁ || kha kha kha me khalane khalā me khalali khe khaṭakhe khaṭine kharalikhara khi karāne karaṭa kālakāminividhali | vidhiyo vidheyā śayano samavato śamiśa。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 56 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：śimesvasti 2 śānti 2 samāgrimama saparivārasthañcamiṣaṁ samsṛṣṭayatha hārenirāmiṣāṁyenadagdha yathā sūtraṁ satyaṁkūrvantu tādṛśaṁsthādathedaṁ kalame kalale khalame agnisaṁkrāmanisvāhā || vipaśvibūddhaśaraṇaṁ upaiti śikhiṅca būddha sūgatañca viśvabhuṁ krakrachandabūddha kanakamūniñca kāśyapaṁ viśaradaśākya mūniñca gautama || etāsaptanarottamānāṁ pūṣpaiśvagandhaiścaśarīrapūjāṁ | kāyenateṣā menasāca bhontu prasannacitta śaraṇacaraṇamūpaiti || eteṣubuddheṣūmaharddhikeṣū || yādevatāsanti abhiprasannaḥ | tādevatā attamano udagrārakṣantume adyapradā pramattāḥ || svastyastu mamasarvva satvānāñca svāhā || ityāryya mahāsāhasrapramadardanī nāmamahāyāna sūtraṁ samāptah || om namo bhagavātyai āryya mahāmāyūryya vidyā rājajñe || namaḥ samyakasaṁbūddhabhyaḥ || samyaksabūddha nānpravarapṛthū kṛpāyā jagūḥ saptasaṁkhyānkrūthākrūro ragendrānkṣatavi |。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningZh: 再三本性寂静止息·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，再三息灾、寂静、安隐，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·六度满行清净，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，犹如、如…所说，界线，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道，真如实际·施度调伏·本性寂静止息，笔尊，羯罗蓝，未调伏于我，圣火·易逝·在于·圆满吉祥成就
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation) again and again, peace, pacification, tranquility again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, just as, according to, sūtraṁ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, O reed, O kalala / in kalala, threshing floor + to me, fire + passing + in + hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·第一义谛·本性寂静止息，愈加如是，本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·支分寂静，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·真如实际，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·破有相福德光，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·离覆障清凉，造作离相·离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，迦叶，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·圣智通达，瞿昙
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace, thereto + thus, primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & quiescence of perceptual limbs, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & blessedness transcending existence, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & coolness free of obscuration, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, light-guard, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & non-dual wisdom awareness, descending from Gotama

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 58 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ni | sādhani | vidhani viśodhani | saṁśodhani | saṁkhiraṇi | saṁkiraṇi | saṁcchidani | sādhūtaramāne | taramāne | hanū 2 bandhūmati | hiri 2 khiri 2 khanali | hurū 2 khurū 2 namostu buddhānāṁ bhagavatāṁ svahā || asyā khalu punarāhūlamahāśītavatī vidyāyāṁ | daśottara yadaśatāyām sutregranchiṁ baddhāhastena dhāryya māryā mānāyāṁ kaṇḍena dhāryyamānāyāṁ samantādyo | janaśatasya rakṣākṛto bhavati || īyaṁ khalu yunaḥ mahāśītayatī vidyāyāṁ eka navatyā śaṅ | nadī bālikā samairbbuddhai bhagavat bhirbhāṣitābhāṣiṣyante || āryya mahāśītavatīnāma mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || 4 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyamahāpratisarayai || lokārtha siddhi paramaṁbahū ratnavittā dharmmārthakāmamaśa maṁśravanāyadhīrāḥ | āyāṇḍa yakṣāsūradaityasaṁdyāḥ | pūjāvidhānaniratāgaruḍānendrāḥ | āryyāmimāṁ pratisarāṁsmṛtimā。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 59: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §59

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 59 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om bhava 2 saṁbhara 2 indriyavalaviśodhane hūṃ hūṃ ru ru ca ce svahā | om maṇidharivajrīṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svahā || upahṛdaya vidyā || ārya mahāpratisarāyāḥ prathamaḥ kalpa samāptaḥ || 0 || atra mantrapadāsiddhāḥ samyakkaṁ buddhenabhāṣitāḥ || namo buddhāya | namo dhammāya | namaḥ saṁghāya || namo bhagavate śākya munaye mahākāruṇi | kāyatathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyo bhāvanaināṁ namaskṛtya buddha śāranevaddhaye || alamidānīṁ pravakṣāmi sarva satvānūkampajā || īmāṁ vidyāṁmahātejāṁ mahābalaparākramāṁ || yasyāṁ bhāṣita mātrāyāṁmūnināvajama yāśane || mārāśca mārakāyā racagrahāḥ sa。

verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om bhava 2 saṁbhara 2 indriyavalaviśodhane hūṃ hūṃ ru ru ca ce svahā | om maṇidharivajrīṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svahā || upahṛdaya vidyā || ārya mahāpratisarāyāḥ prathamaḥ kalpa samāptaḥ || 0 || atra mantrapadāsiddhāḥ samyakkaṁ buddhenabhāṣitāḥ || namo buddhāya | namo dhammāya | namaḥ saṁghāya || namo bhagavate śākya munaye mahākāruṇi | kāyatathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyo bhāvanaināṁ namaskṛtya buddha śāranevaddhaye || alamidānīṁ pravakṣāmi sarva satvānūkampajā || īmāṁ vidyāṁmahātejāṁ mahābalaparākramāṁ || yasyāṁ bhāṣita mātrāyāṁmūnināvajama yāśane || mārāśca mārakāyā racagrahāḥ sa

verses.meaningEn: Jerk + course, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatamūrte pravaravigate bhayasamayasvame bhagavati sarvapāpa svasti bhavantu mama sarvasattvānājya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切如来坚硬，最妙离，怖畏·三昧耶·自·于我，世尊佛母！（呼格），一切罪业，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿一切皆得安乐成就，我之（行者所有），一切众生·气息·油脂乳糜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + O thickened, cover + O lost, fear + Samaya + own + to me, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all + evil, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may all be blessed & accomplished! my, of me (the practitioner), all sentient beings + breath + melted or clarified butter, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om muni muni vimuni vimuni dharicali calane vegavati bhayavigate bhayahāriṇi
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，再三闢牟尼，驮·舍离·蜜蜂，短暂裤子尊，具足余力，怖畏离，怖畏具胸严尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Muni, silent sage again and again, settle + Muni again and again, dha + leave + bee, O a waist-cloth used by a nun, O one endowed with jerk, wrench, shock, fear + O lost, fear + O bearer of clump

verses.iast: bodhi bodhi bodhaya bodhaya buddhira cumbini cumbini sarvatathāgata hṛdaya, jaṣṭe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三菩提、无上正觉，再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，再三妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，一切如来，心、心髓、根本心咒，生起不可得·尊胜·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again, awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, awakened, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation) again and again, all Tathagatas, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, transcending birth & victorious & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om munira munivare abhiṣiñca tu māṁ sarva sattvānāñca sarvatathāgatāḥ sarvavidyābhiṣekarmahakavacamudrāmuditaiḥ sarvatathāgatahṛdayādhiṣṭhite vaje svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，牟尼殊胜，请以甘露灌顶加持！然而、而、实则，我，一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，诸一切如来，以诸一切圣智·灌物·酒席·护身甲胄·手印·波牟提陀，一切如来·心·所加持，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, Muni + O choicest, consecrate! anoint with nectar! but, indeed, moreover, me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, all Tathagatas (plural), all knowledge + feast + armor + Mudrā + by, all Tathagatas + heart + O blessed, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Universal + blaze, garland, rosary, necklace, purity, throbbing + Cintāmaṇi, great + position of the hands

verses.meaningEn: Heart, core essence, heart-mantra, conquered, overthrown, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

verses.meaningZh: 于此处、今此，诸真言章句、密咒句义，诸成就者、已成就，一切、普皆遍满，作业诸必然，诸清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this place, sacred mantra phrase (plural), accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) (plural), all, every, complete, action + a certain, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous (plural)

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露殊胜，再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，最妙，最极清净、究竟净除尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! ambrosia + O choicest, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, cover, upper garment, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om amṛtavilokī nigarbhbhasaṁrakṣaṇi ākarṣaṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露现见，拥护守护·离名相假立，阿羯沙尼尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! ambrosia + seeing, protecting (vocative invocation), O Akarsani, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Nourishment + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), heart, core essence, heart-mantra, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, protect, guard and shelter! again and again

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 61 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：āryyamarakṣā mahāmantrānusāriṇī mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || 8 || om namobhagavatyai āryya mahāpratyaṁṅirāyai || eva mmayā śṛtamaikasmitsameya bhagavāna deveṣutrayatti śeṣu viharatisma || sudharmmāyāṁdeva sabhāyāṁmahatā bhikṣū saṁghena sārdhdha pañcamātrai bhikṣaśatraiḥ | mahātāca bodhi satvagaṇena sārddhaḥ smitansamaye samvahulai deveṣu bhagantaparyyuṁ pīśayantisma || tatrakhalu bhagavāna | buddhāsanvahuṇṇā | kośādimānimanupadāniśca rasisma || namobhagavate aparitā guṇa pratibhāna vyuhātīta kalpāya | ta | tathāgatāyā rhate samyaksaṁ buddhāya || namo bhagavate guṇaratna śrī vyūha te jorāśikalpāyatathāgatāyarhate samyasaṁ buddhāya || namobhagavate dharmma。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 62: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (62): nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §62

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 62 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际，礼敬赞叹·造作离相

verses.iast: om hūṃ om hūṃ mama sarvva satvānāñca rakṣāṁ kurū svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！嗡！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，守护、结界护念，成办作持·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! Oṃ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, protection, safeguarding, enacting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.iast: om sarva tathāgatoṣṇīṣa avalikite yurddhite jorāsi
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来佛顶肉髻相，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata + Uṣṇīṣa, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.iast: om jvala jvala prajvala prajvala dhaka dhaka baddha baddha vidhra vidhra chinda chinda bhinda bhinda hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），再三请极炽盛放光、朗照无余！再三法界总持任持·造作离相，再三带子、丁字裤，再三最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, blaze brightly! shine forth intensely! again and again, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again, strap, thong again and again, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust again and again, sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.iast: om sarvva tathāgatoṣṇīṣaśītāta patra om huṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，嗡！金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, Oṃ! vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 彼腿部
verses.meaningEn: That + leg

verses.iast: om anale anale acale acale khasame khasame vīre vīre saumye saumye
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三不动明王、不动摇尊，再三诸人于我，再三勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊，再三寂静温和、慈柔如月尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast again and again, a degraded Kṣatriya + to me again and again, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero again and again, O gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign / in gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign again and again

verses.iast: sarva buddhā nādhiṣṭhile sarva tathāgatoṣlīṣa śītāta patre sarva duṣṭa prabuṣṭhānāṁ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，离名相假立·法界总持任持·六度满行清净，一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，本性寂静止息·真如实际，第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切、普皆遍满，暴恶者、恶心障难，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·解脱系缚大力，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & spiritual strength freeing bonds, Hūṃ!

verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om huṃ māṃ huṃ nāṁ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），我，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra seed syllable Huṃ, me (the practitioner), vajra seed syllable Huṃ, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 65: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 65 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ || caturguṇa ajākṣīre ghṛtamasyaṁ vipācayet || jaiṣa'dhopari kāmātraṁsanaimṛhyabhivāsūdhīḥ | māṣamātraprabhūṁ jītavarṇīṁ prāpnośvanastaraṁ || ṣanmāsaprayogena sākṣādvāgīśvaro bhavet || rutakokila nirghāṣaḥ jāyate bhadhūra svarāḥ | saṁśayāne hūkartyavyāsūcintā bhavaḥ śaktayaḥ || itiśrī sarasvatī nāmadhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || 100 || om namaḥ ścarmmapūṇulīkāyai || om vajaścaṇṭa āḥ om raṇa'paraṇa' saṁpraraṇa' sarvva buddha pracāriṇī prajñāpāramitā nādasvabhāvaḥ sattoṣaṇa karāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || saddharma ṭhārūndhremaṁdha ṇṭhovādana sampanno manuṇadayānyū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Four + virtue, drift + eye + O wind, of this, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux

verses.meaningEn: Thus + auspiciousness, Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, by name + Dhāraṇī, wisdom, samāptaḥ

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，妙行流布·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to practicing (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: om vajaścaṇṭa āḥ om raṇa'paraṇa' saṁpraraṇa' sarvva buddha pracāriṇī prajñāpāramitā nādasvabhāvaḥ sattoṣaṇa karāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·本性寂静止息，语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），嗡！清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·第一义谛，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，具选佛、事关相貌佛母，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），茎干自性，参半理想，向掌，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & primordial tranquil peace, speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace & ultimate truth, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, all, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, goddess possessing meditating on Rāvaṇaʼs own conduct in the way of discipline, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), stalk, equally + satisfying, to/for palm, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 69 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai || om namo dharmmakāya saṁbhoga kāya nirmmāṇakāya || tadyathā || om dānapāramitā śīlapāramitā kṣāntipāramitā viryyapāramitā dhyānapāramitā prajñāpāramitā sarvvadharmmaśūnyatāca bodhi 2 mahābodhaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || itiṣadadhāra mitā nāma hṛdayadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 102 || om namoḥ saptasaptīnāṁtathā gatānāṁ samyakkaṁ buddha koṭī nāṁ || tathayā || om cule cule cunde svāhā || iti cunde bhagavanya dhāraṇī pratidinayaḥ śviddhāra ye vdācayenkikhāpayata || aṣṭotbhara vāraṁjayetaṁ || tasyasarvva pāpaṁrikṣayaṁ yānticatu rvarga phalaṁprāpyateti || āryyacundā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 110 ||。

Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第70品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 70: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §70
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (70)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 70 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti || om namo ratnatrayāya || namo mānibhadrāya mahāyakṣasenā pataye saṁpraskitaṁ || om hili 2 māṇibhadrakili 2 māṇibhadra.śici 2 māṇibhadrakurū 2 māṇibhadra surū 2 māṇibhadra. sarvvasīparipuraya || tadyathā || suratkai suratkī sumenpe suratthe sayiṣpe hi limiliki like lika likā li pūrṇṇu dravatī tiri 2 svāhā || āryyajanha harandrasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 111 || om namaḥ śri ugratārāyaiḥ || prakaṭa vikaṭa draṁṣṭayā ghaula rupādra hā sānariśrara kṛta mālāmaighava rṇṇutikharvva | triguṇāja dhātrīkha ṅaga vinyastaka karakalita kapāla pātuvaḥ ugratāroḥ || dhyāmurttī nama stotraḥ dyārarupo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 71 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：meghavāhi niṭakajāṅli tujaṅme vikaṭakagholū rūpa visphūjjana vijṛmbhane āvāhayāyami sarvva nāgānaṁ sarva buddhādhiṣṭhānena sarvvatryadhva tathāgata satyena travarṣa hajambūdvipe svāhā || namaḥ sarvabuddhebhya | siddhantū mantra pradānime svāhā || āryya mahāmegha nirnnāda vijṛmbhita sūraketū nāma dhāraṇī sarvva buddhabhāṣitaṁ samāptaṁ || 114 || om namo bhagavate śākya munaye || om namo cinye sāgarebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyaḥ || evaṁmayā śrutamekasminsamaye bhagavānnanyo panannadanāgarāja bhavaneviharita sma || śrī maṇīratna garbbha mahāmeghamaṇḍala kūṭāgāre mahatābhikṣū saṁghena sārddhaṁ mahātāca bodhi satvo saṁghena sārddhaṁ mahātā。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 74 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rucitareketunami bodhisattvasya || om namaḥ śrīsuvarṇaprabhā sottamānāma bodhisattvasya || om namaḥ śrīvarṇagandho nāma bodhisattvasya || om namaḥ śrīsadāprarudito nāma bodhisattvasya || om namaḥ śrīdhamagito nāma bodhisattvasya || purāstimenāśrī akṣobhya nāma tathāgatasya || dakṣiṇe śrīratnaketu nāma tathāgataḥ || paścime śrī amitābhanāma tathāgataḥ || uttare dundurbhisvaro nāma tathāgataḥ || suvarṇaprabhā sottama sūtrendrarāje imāni bodhisattvanāmāni ye dhārayanti te bodhitasattvā nityaṁjāti smaro bhaviṣyanti || iti śrīsuvarṇaprabhāsottame sūtrendrarāje sarvabuddhabodhisattvanāma saṁdhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 121 || om namo bhagavatyai ....。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 75 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：viṁśata | yaḥ paṭhetprāyaso dhīmān devyā bhakti samanvite || sāyaṁ vā prātarutchātthāya samare na sarvā bhayaprahā | sarvapāpapraśamanaṁ | sarvadurgatināśanaṁ || abhiṣikto bhavet turṇa saptabhirjinakoṭibhiḥ | āsman mahatvamāsādya saunta bauddhapadaṁ vrajet || viṣaṁ tasya mahādyoraṁsthāvaraṁ vārthajaṁgamaṁ | smaraṇāt parathaṁ jānti khaditaṁ pītameda vā | ugrajvalaviṣanāno paramārtivinauśataṁ || 0 || aṣṭataiṣāṁ caiva satvānāṁ dvisiptābhivarttināṁ || putrakāmo labhet putraṁ dhanakāmo labhet dhanaṁ || sarvāntā mānavāpnoti na vighnai pratihanyase || iti śrīsamyak sambuddhattaḍhaṇaśaṣachaśra ṅaśatraṣatam bhagavatyai āryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṁśati nāma stotraṁ samāptaḥ ||。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第77品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (77): nāṁ

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 77 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāṁ || vārāhakulānāṁ || puṇḍalikakulānāṁ || ghanakakulānāṁ || meghakulānāṁ || jaladakulānāṁ || jīmūlakulānāṁ || sarvvakulānāṁ || elāvarttakulānāṁ || hana 2 śareṇa 2 bandha 2 cāpena || taḍaya 2 utpalena | vibhānnabhayaṁ || dehi 2 parayaṁkāla ime vajadharamavatārayanvarṣanta nāgānvaśikuru 2 phūḥ kulāpaya 2 phū phūḥ || om kulukulle rhīṁ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti kulakullānāma dhāriṇī samāptaḥ || 22 ja || || iti nī dhāraṇī saṁgraha mahāpurāṇe sarvvaśāstraprahitā nāmadhāraṇī paṁcaviśaśatakaṁ samāptaḥ ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼钩召摄受·离一切相无相·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to drawing in (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 44 句）

verses.iast: imāni tathāgatanāmāni satkṛtya dhārayitavyāni vācayitavyāni evaṃ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 一切本刹，如来一切名为，有偿方面、好好儿，放置·极微·一切勇健，语言·极微·一切勇健，如是、如此，彼、此尊（阳性主格），善男子，或、抑或，善女人，或、抑或，什多，福德、胜妙功德，转载·彼·搅拌·戒精进
verses.meaningEn: This (plural), Tathāgata + by name, paying respect, respectfully, put + or interrog + strong, words + or interrog + strong, thus, in this way, he, that one, a good man, or, a good woman, or, numerous, merit, auspicious virtue, forward + he + stir + as many
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 45 句）

verses.meaningZh: 包扎九渊以及大吉祥天女（功德天），以诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）
verses.meaningEn: Wrap + cleft and Śrīmahādevī, Great Goddess of Auspiciousness, by/with Tathāgata, Thus-Come One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 46 句）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ śrīmahādevī anāgate'dhvani śrī[mahā]ratnapratimaṇḍitāyāṃ lokadhātau tatra śrīmaṇiratnasambhavo nāma tathāgato'rhan samyak sambuddhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 当有汝即是，汝、圣尊您，大吉祥天女（功德天），自然·度越吧·以下·劝请，吉祥于大宝庄严中，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，于彼处、其中，吉祥·摩尼宝珠·宝生佛，名为、号曰，如来应供，权利、正确，随着觉者
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, Thou, You, Śrīmahādevī, Great Goddess of Auspiciousness, certainly + gone + below + request, auspiciousness + in Mahāratnapratimaṇḍita, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), there, therein, auspiciousness + Maṇi jewel + Ratnasambhava Buddha, by name, called, Arhat, right, proper, along with
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 47 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，当
verses.meaningEn: She, that and freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 48 句）

verses.iast: tatra ca lokadhātau sa eva tathāgata ālokakaro bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中以及离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），光明羯磨事业，当
verses.meaningEn: There, therein and freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), he, that one, indeed, verily, alone, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, light + action, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 49 句）

verses.iast: te ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre svayaṃprabhā bhaviṣyantyaparimitāyuṣaśca
verses.meaningZh: 向汝、彼等以及菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，佛土，亲自光明，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: To Thee / they and awakening, O Buddha-field, region or, oneself + light, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 50 句）

verses.meaningZh: 由虚空界（无碍周遍）及佛法·圣僧伽·音，妙行流布·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: From space, ether, open sky and Dharma + Saṃgha + sound, practicing (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 51 句）

verses.iast: ye ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre upapatsyante sarve te padmakarkaṭikāsūpapatsyante
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情以及菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，佛土，第一义谛·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，一切、普皆遍满尊，向汝、彼等，能作成办·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.) and awakening, O Buddha-field, region or, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, to Thee / they, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 52 句）

verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，造作离相·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，名为一百八，离垢有形，赞叹、偈子
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, by name + one hundred and eight, immaculate + visible, praise, hymn
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 53 句）

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，无畏观自在菩萨，广大光华，以摩诃室利，一切名为、号曰
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), non-fear + Avalokiteśvara, with great magnificence, with/by Mahādevī, by name, called (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 54 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā sarvatathāgatābhiṣiktā [sarvadevatābhiṣiktā] sarvatathāgatamātā sarvadevatāmātā sarvatathāgataśrīḥ sarvabodhisattvaśrīḥ sarvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaśrīḥ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraśrīḥ mahāsthānagataśrīḥ sarvadevatābhimukhaśrīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切如来灌顶，一切·何为·灌顶，萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子，一切·天神·母，一切如来吉祥，一切·菩提萨埵·吉祥，湖·墙壁·舍罗婆迦·佛驮·吉祥，神父·遍入·大自在天·吉祥，圣地·去·吉祥，一切·何为·现前·吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: all Tathagatas, all + divinity, sarvatathāgataṃ + frame, all + a god, all Tathagatas, all + Bodhisattva, a lake + to be checked or restrained + sravaka + Buddha for himself alone, priest + thousands with names containing prabha + Maheśvara, mahāsthāna + understood, all + divinity + having the face towards
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 55 句）

verses.iast: sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragaśrīḥ sarvavidyādharavajrapāṇivajradharaśrīḥ catuḥpañcalokapālaśrīḥ aṣṭagrahāṣṭāviṃśatinakṣatraśrīḥ om sāvitrī dhātrī mātā caturvedaśrīḥ lakṣmīḥ bhūtamātā
verses.meaningZh: 一切施·犹如·龙族·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗·摩睺罗伽·吉祥，一切·持明仙·金刚手菩萨·金刚总持·吉祥，警觉震动·守护养育·吉祥庄严·妙行迁变空，八·曜执·二十八·星宿·吉祥，嗡！一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·真如实际，母，母，四围陀吉祥，吉祥相，部多鬼神母
verses.meaningEn: One who gives everything + like + Nāga + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara + Mahoraga, all + Vidyādhara + Vajrapāṇi + Vajradhara, stirring, guarding, glorious, eight + planet + twenty-eight + constellation, Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, dhātrī, mātā, the four Vedas, lakṣmīḥ, spirit
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 56 句）

verses.iast: jayā vijayā gaṅgā sarvatīrthā sarvamaṅgalyā vimalanirmalakaraśrīḥ sarvapāpahantrī nirmada[karā] candraśrīḥ sūryaśrīḥ sarvagrahaśrīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 誓耶，尊胜，恒迦河，一切津，一切最极吉祥，离垢·净无垢秽·掌·吉祥，一切·摧灭·肠佛母，不是故辙掌，月轮吉祥，日轮吉祥，一切·曜执·吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Jayā, for victory, Ganges River, all + a ford, all + auspicious, immaculate + utterly spotless + palm, all + destroying sin or the sinful + intestines, not in rut + palm, moon, sun, all + planet
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 57 句）

verses.iast: siṃhavāhinī śatasahasrakoṭipadmavivarasaṃcchannā padmā padmasambhavā padmālayā padmadharā padmāvatī anekaratnāṃśumālā dhanadā śvetā mahāśvetā
verses.meaningZh: 狮子具画儿，百千·俱胝·莲华·维波罗·桑·覆障，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），莲华三婆吠，梵行，莲华请执持，具足秋天勿，多·珍宝·亮·鬘，赃物，洁白、清净白色，大洁白
verses.meaningEn: Lion + possessing carrying, sgl + ten million + lotus flower + opening + saṃ + covered, lotus flower (pure, unstained), lotus flower + giving rise to, of Brahman, lotus flower + hold! bear! sustain! fall + endowed with do not, not one + jewel + cloth + garland, bestowing the prize, the booty, or treasures, white, bright, pure-colored, great + white
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 58 句）

verses.iast: śvetabhujā sarvamaṅgaladhāriṇī sarvapuṇyopacitāṅgī dākṣāyaṇī śatasahasrabhujā śatasahasranayanā śatasahasraśirā vividhavicitramaṇimaulidharā surūpā viśvarūpā yaśā
verses.meaningZh: 洁白臂，执持一切吉祥，一切·福德·积累·肢，火供祀施佛母，百千臂，百因达罗，百千脉，各个·斑驳陆离·摩尼宝珠·头冠首严三尖·请执持，善见，微质怛囒、种种，称
verses.meaningEn: White + arm, all + holder of auspiciousness, all + merit + heaped up + member, descended from or belonging to Dakṣa, sgl + arm, hundred + thousand-eyed, sgl, of different kinds + variegated + Maṇi jewel + head + hold! bear! sustain! handsome-figured, beautiful, many-coloured, multiform, manifold, various, fame
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 59 句）

verses.iast: mahāyaśā saumyā bahujīmūtā pavitrakeśā candrakāntā sūryakāntā śubhā śubhakartrī sarvasattvābhimukhī āryā [kusumaśrīḥ]
verses.meaningZh: 大称，寂静温和、慈柔如月，多花木，过滤发，水晶，水晶，清净吉祥、善妙庄严，清净吉祥拼写，一切众生现前地，圣、尊贵圣者，妙花吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Great + fame, gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign, many + thunder-cloud, instrument for cleansing + hair, beautiful as the moon, the sun-stone, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, auspicious + spell, all sentient beings, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), flower
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 60 句）

verses.iast: kusumeśvarā sarvasumeruparvatarājaśrīḥ sarvanadīsarīcchrīḥ sarvatoyasamudraśrīḥ sarvatīrthābhimukhaśrīḥ sarvauṣadhitṛṇavanaspatidhanadhānyaśrīḥ hiraṇyadā annapānadā [prabhāsvarā ālokakarā pavitrāṅgā]
verses.meaningZh: 妙花自在主，一切·须弥山·山·来诣·吉祥，清净惭愧·一切诸谛圆满，一切·沧溟·大海·吉祥，一切·津·现前·吉祥，吉祥庄严·一切诸谛圆满，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，离名相假立·第一义谛·施度调伏，明显，光明掌，过滤肢
verses.meaningEn: Flower + Īśvara, all + Mount Sumeru + coming from or belonging to goats, modest purity, all + ocean + ocean, all + a ford + having the face towards, glorious, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, prabhāsvarā, light + palm, instrument for cleansing + member
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 61 句）

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatavaśavartinī sarvadevagaṇamukhaśrīḥ yamavaruṇākuberavāsavaśrīḥ dātrī bhoktrī tejā tejovatī vibhūtīḥ samṛddhiḥ vivṛddhiḥ unnatiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切处·尔时·宝树宝山·汝之·具虫子佛母，一切施·犹如·海会众·面门·吉祥，吉祥庄严·一乘如实之道，鎌佛母，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，威光，具足威光尊，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·真如实际，兴盛、成就，肿块、增长，自尊、邪慢
verses.meaningEn: From or on all sides + now + tree or mountain + your + possessing worm, one who gives everything + like + assembly + face, glorious, sickle (feminine), blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, sharpness, tejovatī, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, thriving, success, prosperity, perfection, happiness, wealth, abundance, growth, increase, lengthening, pride, arrogance
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 62 句）

verses.iast: dharmaśrīḥ mādhavāśrayā kusumanilayā anasūyā puruṣakārāśrayā sarvapavitragātrā maṅgalahastā sarvālakṣmīnāśayitrī sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇaśrīḥ sarvapṛthivī[śrīḥ] sarvarājaśrīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 正法吉祥，第二依止，妙花住房，无眼红、牢骚，男子气事迹依止，一切·过滤·腔，吉祥轸，摧灭除遣·一切诸谛圆满，一切·福德·召请·吉祥，一切·大地·吉祥，元龙吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Dharma, vernal + to depend upon, flower + settling down, un-grumbling, displeased, envious, manly deed + to depend upon, all + instrument for cleansing + a limb of the body, auspiciousness + Hasta, destroying obstacles, all + merit + the same as, all + earth, emperor
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 63 句）

verses.iast: sarvavidyādhararājaśrīḥ sarvabhūtayakṣarākṣasapretapiśācakuṃbhāṇḍamahoragaśrīḥ dyutiḥ pramodabhāgyalolā sarvarṣipavitraśrīḥ sarvaśrīḥ bhavajyeṣṭhottamaśrīḥ sarvakinnarasarvasūryottamaśrīḥ niravadyasthānavāsinī [rūpavatī sukhakarī]
verses.meaningZh: 一切·持密咒者·来诣·吉祥，广大殊胜·吉祥庄严·一切诸谛圆满，现，欢喜·那乞叉多罗·风波，吉祥庄严·一切诸谛圆满，一切吉祥，愿成·最长·最上·吉祥，一切·紧那罗·一切·日轮·最上·吉祥，无过·止·具居佛母，具足色、妙色身尊，能作乐尊
verses.meaningEn: All + coming from or belonging to goats, great, glorious, dyutiḥ, joy + relating to Bhaga + moving hither and thither, glorious, all, be! become! + principal + highest, all + Kinnara + all + sun + highest, blameless + point + possessing dwell, endowed with form, matter, sacred body, maker of easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 64 句）

verses.meaningZh: 俱吠滥相亲，法王吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Kubera + desired, Dharmaraja
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 65 句）

verses.iast: om vilokaya tāraya mocaya mama sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ sarvapuṇyasambhārānāmukhīkuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！闢祈请世间，祈请星，请解脱、令离系缚！我之（行者所有），向诸一切苦，成办作持·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! settle + may You world, may You a star! liberate! set free! release! my, of me (the practitioner), all + to all suffering, enacting (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 66 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！成办作持·妙行趣入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! enacting (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 67 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 68 句）

verses.meaningZh: 总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Upholding (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 69 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向四围陀·星宿·曜执·海会众·元·尊身，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: The four Vedas + constellation + planet + assembly + beginning + to embodiment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 70 句）

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 71 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向遍入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 72 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向紧恶，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for of gods, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 73 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向闢如狗面，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Settle, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 74 句）

verses.iast: om ni[gri]grini sarvakāryasādhani sini sini āvāhayāmi devi śrīvaiśravaṇāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，一切·圣·成就法，再三提供尊，嫁夜摩天尊，天女、佛母明妃尊，向吉祥毗沙门天王，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all + noble + O accomplishing, O supply, provision again and again, taking in marriage + O Yama Heaven, O goddess, sacred female deity, auspiciousness + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 75 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向真金·财·驮·他·阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Gold + treasure + dha + other + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 76 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向一切福德阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + merit + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 77 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向吉祥何为阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + divinity + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 78 句）

verses.meaningZh: 摧灭除遣·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Destroying obstacles (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 79 句）

verses.meaningZh: 息灾寂静·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Pacifying (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 80 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 81 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切·何为·现前·广大光华尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + divinity + having the face towards + O with great magnificence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 82 句）

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Making (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 83 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 84 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 85 句）

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 86 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向一切·业行·压镇·远离·行星土曜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + actions + an evil demon + without + to the planet Saturn, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 87 句）

verses.iast: imāni tānyabhayāvalokiteśvaraśriyā mahādevyā nāmāni sarvakilviṣanāśanāni sarvapāpavidhvaṃsanakarāṇi sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇakarāṇi sarvālakṣmīpraśamanakarāṇi sarvaśrīsaubhāgyākarṣaṇakarāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 一切本刹，真如实际·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，以摩诃室利，一切名为、号曰，一切·污秽·一切摧灭，一切·罪业·摧灭·一切掌，一切·福德·召请·一切掌，息灾寂静·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，吉祥庄严·钩召摄受·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: This (plural), immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, with/by Mahādevī, by name, called (plural), all + filth + destroying, all + evil + ruining + palm, all + merit + the same as + palm, pacifying, making (vocative invocation), glorious, drawing in, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 88 句）

verses.iast: yaḥ kaścidvārayiṣyati imāni tathāgatanāmāni kalyamutthāya śucinā sarvabuddhānāṃ puṣpadhūpaṃ dattvā śriyai mahādevyai
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…者，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，一切本刹，如来一切名为，精神·摄伏·立起，以清净，一切没驮南，花烧香，齿已，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，向摩诃室利
verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), this (plural), Tathāgata + by name, drive + hold, by flaming, beaming, all + buddhānām, flower + to burn incense, dattvā, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), to Mahādevī
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 89 句）

verses.iast: candanadhūpaṃ dattvā vācayitavyāni sarvaśriyamadhigamiṣyati sarvasukhasaumanasyalābhī bhaviṣyati sarvadevatāśca rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti sarvakāryasiddhistasya bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 檀香烧香，齿已，语言·极微·一切勇健，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，当，一切诸何为及守护，能作成办·造作离相，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，当
verses.meaningEn: Best of its kind + to burn incense, dattvā, words + or interrog + strong, going toward (vocative invocation), blissful, will be, all + divinity and guard, protection, and defense, making (vocative invocation), perfected, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 90 句）

provenance.rawSnippet: āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī om namo bhagavatyai āryavajravidāraṇāyai | evaṃ mayā śrutamekasmin samaye bhagavān vajreṣu viharati sma |sarvaśarīraṃ vajramayamadhiṣṭhāya vajrapāṇiśca buddhānubhāvena vajrasamādhiṃ samāpannaḥ | tato vajrapāṇiḥ [sarva] buddhānubh

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Bowing (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā - om truṭa truṭa troṭaya troṭaya sfuṭa sfuṭa sfoṭaya sfoṭaya
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三一切诸谛圆满·断除憍慢执障，再三一切诸谛圆满·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & cutting rigid pride again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: ghurṇa ghurṇa ghurṇāpaya ghurṇāpaya sarvasattvānāṃ vibodhaya vibodhaya sambodhaya sambodhaya bhrama bhrama
verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！再三随着请开晓觉悟，再三头旋
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, of all all sentient beings, fully awaken and enlighten! again and again, along with + awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, spring again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: saṃbhrāmaya saṃbhrāmaya sarvabhūtāni kuṭa kuṭa saṃkuṭaya saṃkuṭaya sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa ghaṭa saṃdhāṭaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请遊，一切一切处、到处可见，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障，再三桑祈请庵，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You to tour! again and again, being everywhere, ubiquitous, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride again and again, saṃ + may You cottage! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: saṃghāṭaya sarvavidyā vajra vajra sphoṭaya vajra vajra kaṭa vajra vajra maṭa
verses.meaningZh: 祈请僧伽吒，一切圣智，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: May You assembly! all knowledge, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: vajra vajra matha vajra vajra aṭṭahāsanīlavajrasuvajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），向大声笑声·绀青·金刚·勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, loud laughter + sapphire-blue + Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 9 句）

verses.iast: om he fullu nirufullu nigṛhṇa kullu mili cullu kuru kullu vajravijayāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），离一切相无相，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，离名相假立·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，造作离相·离一切相无相，契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），造作离相·离一切相无相，向金刚最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), intimate union with the deity samādhi, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), accomplish & enact this sacred work! freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 11 句）

verses.iast: om kaṭa kaṭa maṭa maṭa raṭa raṭa moṭana pramoṭanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，摧碎，向转载摧碎，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! straw mat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, crushing, breaking, strangling, forward + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: om cara nicara hara hara sara sara māraya vajravidāraṇāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），在于行持妙道，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，向金刚裂解，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! move forth in compassionate activity! in + move forth in compassionate activity! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: om chinda chinda bhinda bhinda mahākilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），向大金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, great + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 14 句）

verses.iast: om bandha bandha krodha krodha vajrakilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三忿，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, wrath again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），向威猛金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, fierce + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！向金刚总持、执金刚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三巡，向金刚风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! a watch a period of about hours again and again, Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 19 句）

verses.iast: om matisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra aihivajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！慧·坚硬·金刚，闻·坚硬·金刚，对·坚硬·金刚，大金刚，无碍金刚，不空，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence + hard + Vajra, hearing + hard + Vajra, toward + hard + Vajra, great + Vajra, unobstructed + Vajra, Amoghavajra, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, śīghraṃ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: om dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru sarvavajrakulamāvartāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），向一切·金刚·大地·不过·绕，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, all + Vajra + earth + only + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 某甲，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: A certain person, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，普遍诸金刚之
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to universal + of Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 23 句）

verses.iast: sarvabalamāvartaya mahābale kaṭabale tatale acale maṇḍalamaye ativajra mahābale vegaraṇa ajite jvala
verses.meaningZh: 一切·跋蓝·祈请绕，大力威神、大势力尊尊，席力，彼严，不动明王、不动摇尊，曼荼罗极微，太金刚，大力威神、大势力尊尊，余力烦恼，无胜尊，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: All + may You circumambulate! O of great power and might / in of great power and might, straw mat + O power, That, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, particle, very + Vajra, O of great power and might / in of great power and might, jerk + passion, O unsurpassed, blaze forth with wisdom radiance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: jvala tiṭi tiṭi ti ṅgale daha daha tejovati tili tili bandha
verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），支分寂静·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），具足威光尊，再三芝麻尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, tejovati, O the sesamum plant or seed again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），大力威神、大势力尊尊，向金刚面天焰光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O of great power and might / in of great power and might, Vajrāṅkuśa + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 26 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向圣入无分别法门经
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble + to Ru Wu Fenbie Famen Jing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！无分别，无分别性交尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! avikalpe, O entering
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 诸诸法之，自性最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Of all things, own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 无着尊，无相门尊，漫无目的、解脱自在尊
verses.meaningEn: O Asanga / in Asanga, O having no cause, motive, or design, O aimless, not bent on anything
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 寂静、调柔安稳尊，寂静、赊多尊，一切·分别·离·虚空·随着·地狱道·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, O tranquillized, quiet, calm, indifferent, all + thought + lost + sky + along with + of a hell + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 法界性交尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Dharmadhātu + O entering, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 8 句）
