verses.iast: namo bhagavate dhvajāgra rājāya tathāgatāya arhate samyak sambuddhāya tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，顶部计都、规格，向王，向如来（乘如实道来成正觉），向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，权利、正确，向随着佛陀，即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, top of a banner, to/for king, to/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to the Arhat, Worthy One, right, proper, along with + to, Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: jaya jaya vijaya vijaya jayavāhini-sam gari prabhañjani prabhañjani sarva śatruṇām jambhaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），饮料、毒素尊，再三风息、暴雨尊，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! again and again, conquering (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O devouring, O wind, storm again and again, all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, crush! quell jaws of hostility!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.iast: jambhaya stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya bhagavati jayavāhini mātha mātha pra-mātha pra-mātha
verses.meaningZh: 请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！世尊佛母！（呼格），尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，再三消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭
verses.meaningEn: Crush! quell jaws of hostility! immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! conquering (vocative invocation), destruction, annihilation again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: grasa grasa hasa hasa huṃ huṃ lambodari trinetre caturmukhe caturvaktre catur
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，再三笑声，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），腹垂尊，三眼目，神明尊，四面目，四
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, laughter, mirth again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, O having a large belly, three + O eye, O four faces, four + O meters, four
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: daṃṣṭre catur bhuje asi musala khaḍga triśūla vajra dhāraṇīrakṣa rakṣa mām
verses.meaningZh: 牙尊，四，臂、千臂庄严尊，汝即是（当体即是），碓，智慧宝剑（断烦恼剑），三戟叉（破三毒戟），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），陀罗尼眼目，拥护、守护，我（宾格：守护
verses.meaningEn: O large tooth, tusk, fang / in large tooth, tusk, fang, four, O arm, hand / in arm, hand, Thou art, pestle, mace, club, bell-clapper, sword (wisdom-blade), trident, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Dhāraṇī + eye, protect, guard and shelter! me
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: bhagavati hana hana daha daha paca paca mātha mātha pramātha pramātha huṃ huṃ phaṭphaṭbhañja bhañja sarva śatrūṇām
verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三消灭，再三姦妇女、压倒性，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），顿断魔障·顿断魔障·摧碎破除一切魔障，摧碎破除一切魔障，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, destruction, annihilation again and again, tearing, rape , overwhelming, destruction again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter and break all obstacles! shatter and break all obstacles! all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: dhvajāgra keyure tisṭhat tisṭhat triṭa ulkā dhāraṇi trailokyanātha vidhvaṃśaya para sainya
verses.meaningZh: 顶部计都、规格，造作离相·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，再三真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·远离虚妄安立，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，炬，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，三界依，服务天神祈请笛，他人，多
verses.meaningEn: Top of a banner, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond conceptual fabrication again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride, meteor, firebrand, flame, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, the Three Worlds + refuge, serve a god + may You tradition, someone else, relating to an army
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa māṃ cala cala cili cili culu culu kala kala
verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三尊手
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, hand again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: kili kili kulu kulu muncaṭṭa hāsaya vidhvaṃśaya parasainya bhramaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三造作离相·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行迁变空，祈请笑声、欢喜，服务天神祈请笛，他人多，祈请头旋
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux, may You laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision! serve a god + may You tradition, someone else + relating to an army, may You spring
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.iast: buddha satyena dharma satyena saṃgha satyena satya vādināṃ satyena buddha satyāmatikrama
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀、觉者，以谛、真实不虚语，正法、诸法实相，以谛、真实不虚语，圣僧伽、清净海众，以谛、真实不虚语，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，以谛、真实不虚语，佛陀、觉者，参半·趣往·趣往以上
verses.meaningEn: Buddha, the Awakened One, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, by/through truth, reality, veracity, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Buddha, the Awakened One, equally + going + going over
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 10 句）

verses.iast: dharma satyāṃ atikrama saṃgha satyāṃ atikrama satya vādinaṃ satyamatikrama
verses.meaningZh: 正法、诸法实相，谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，圣僧伽、清净海众，谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，参半·摄伏·趣往以上
verses.meaningEn: Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, equally + hold + going over
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 11 句）

verses.iast: lambodare kuṭṭa kuṭṭa kuṭṭya kuṭṭya rudra mānaya biṣṇu mānaya candra sūrya
verses.meaningZh: 腹垂尊，再三摧碎，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，紧恶，祈请慢，解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，祈请慢，月轮、清凉满月，日轮、太阳光明
verses.meaningEn: O having a large belly, sqashing, stamping, crushing, hammering again and again, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, of gods, may You opinion, conception, spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), may You opinion, conception, moon, lunar disc, sun, solar orb
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: mānaya trailokya adhipatya mānaya sarva devo mānaya sarva yakṣa rākṣasa gandharva
verses.meaningZh: 祈请慢，三界、三千世界，自在主那个，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，天，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），罗刹（暴恶鬼神），乾闼婆（香音神）
verses.meaningEn: May You opinion, conception, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), lord + that, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, devo, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Rākṣasa, fierce spirit/demon, Gandharva, celestial musician
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: kinnara mahoraga mānaya vidhvamsaya mama sarva śatru vaḥ rangha rangha ranghāpaya
verses.meaningZh: 紧那罗（歌神），摩睺罗伽（大蟒神），祈请慢，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，怨敌、仇害违缘，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，再三喜滋滋想必，喜滋滋祈请令想必
verses.meaningEn: Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, Mahoraga, great serpent spirit, may You opinion, conception, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, my, of me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, be pleased + surely again and again, be pleased + cause to surely
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 14 句）

verses.iast: ranghāpaya jvala jvala puṣpa mālini liḍhi liḍhi triṭa triṭa bhṛkuti mukhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 喜滋滋祈请令想必，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），花，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，再三离一切相无相·法鼓觉悟，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，毘倶胝尊，面门、尊颜、法门入口
verses.meaningEn: Be pleased + cause to surely, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, flower, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & awakening Dharma-drum resonance (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, O Bhrkuti, face, mouth, gateway/door
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: parasainya kurucchedana karaṇha ha hi hi hu hu he he riṇi
verses.meaningZh: 他人多，祈请成办羯磨事业除断，能作成办·造作离相，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三诚然、因为、实乃，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + relating to an army, accomplish & enact this sacred work! + removing, making, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, for, indeed, surely again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，母尊，愿悉胜伏、最胜吉祥！宝幢、胜幡尊
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, māte, may they conquer! victory!! O victory banner, standard / in victory banner, standard
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 17 句）

verses.iast: buddhāvalokite rakṣa rakṣa mama bhagavatāvalokite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀观照，再三拥护、守护，我之（行者所有），才·鸣呼·观照，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + O beheld, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), excellence + O beheld, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 功德、殊胜妙德，王，神明男人尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, king, O of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage / in of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 日阿罗歌花，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Arka flowers, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: sarva graha nakṣatra dā me karaṇa svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，星宿（二十八宿），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，于我、为我，时间，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha, constellation, lunar mansion, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, to me, my, active, clever, skilled, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗卢遮那佛（大日遍照如来）·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vairocana, Illuminator Buddha, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切过去末现在时·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）·一切正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gone away, future, present, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利）
verses.meaningEn: Steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜）
verses.meaningEn: Firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 伊吒尊，最上真言离言说·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Iṭṭe, supreme ineffable speech & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊
verses.meaningEn: O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三场景往外、一品离港尊
verses.meaningEn: O setting out again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 妙花尊，妙花殊胜
verses.meaningEn: O flower, flower + O choicest
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），诡谲尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi, O boon-companion, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，尾真言
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, root + Mantra
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，犹如、如…所说，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, just as, according to, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 16 句）

verses.iast: ime tile cile bhile khile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 怎么，芝麻尊，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，破有相福德光·离一切相无相，硬度尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ime, O the sesamum plant or seed, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), O hardness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以七诵念
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, seven + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵出摩诃萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, income, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā ṭuru ṭuru hā hā hā hā svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，归命敬礼·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — perfected spiritual vigor, bowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #15《Ekādaśamukham》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生·怖畏·疗·掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, fear, heal, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ferrying across, making (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切圣智容器去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, receptacle, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切圣智·不是规定·去·尊身·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, no rule, understood, to embodiment, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大明咒在位非得·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Mahāvidyā, reign, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: om tarula tarula vi[ta]rula vi[ta]rula sarvaviṣaghātaka jvalitavisphuliṅgāṭṭahāsa kesarāṭopapravṛddhavega vajrakhuranirghātaka calitavasudhātala niḥsvasitahasitamārutotkṣiptadharaṇīdhara
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，再三最上真言离言说·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切·毒害·凶手，炽盛燃耀·闢·触发智火·大声笑声，花鬘·自尊·增·余力，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，动地表，持守摄受·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks again and again, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + poison + slayer, blazing + settle + spark of fire + loud laughter, also filament + puffing up + grown up + jerk, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, moving to and fro + the surface of the earth, bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 9 句）

verses.iast: parabhṛtagaṇasamūhavikṣobhaṇakara paravidyāsaṃbhakṣaṇakara sarvagrāhotsādanakara paramaśāntikarasarvagrahapraśamanakara budhya budhya dhāva dhāva ca bhagavā hayagrīva
verses.meaningZh: 能生他人·雇·海会众·积修·一动拏，能生愈加·无明·桑·星宿一刹那，能生一切四种水兽净身，能生最胜·扇底羯啰·一切·曜执疗，再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！再三濯以及出有坏，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊）
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + hire + assembly + heap + violent motion + causing na, beyond + ignorance + saṃ + star + causing birth under favorable conditions, all + belief + causing putting off, supreme + peace and prosperity + all + planet + causing heal, awake! perceive! behend! again and again, wash again and again and bhagavā, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三请啖食净尽一切毒害魔障！他人·瞒·宝生如来宝部灌顶种子字
verses.meaningEn: Consume! devour obstacles! again and again, someone else + maṃ + Ratnasaṃbhava jewel-family seed syllable Trāṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 11 句）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa kṣamasva kṣamasva sa mayābhihitāṃ mantrām
verses.meaningZh: 再三拥护、守护，再三堪自，彼、此尊（阳性主格），过去啓，程式
verses.meaningEn: Protect, guard and shelter! again and again, enduring + own again and again, he, that one, made or consisting of + spoken, formula
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 悉地、妙成就，于我、为我，施度调伏·本性寂静止息，再三最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, to me, my, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: ghorapiśāca sarvagraheṣvapratihato mama varavajradaṃṣṭra kiṃ cirāpayasi
verses.meaningZh: 威怖毗舍遮，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，我之（行者所有），殊胜金刚牙，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Formidable + Piśāca, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, my, of me (the practitioner), choicest + Vajradaṃṣṭra, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 14 句）

verses.iast: idaṃ duṣṭagrahaṃ duṣṭasattvaṃ duṣṭapiśācaṃ vā dhuna [dhuna vidhuna] vidhuna kampa kampa matha matha pramatha pramatha
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，暴恶者曜执，暴恶者心力，暴恶者毗舍遮，或、抑或，再三护摩献供·法界总持任持，再三搏动不，再三疟疾，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三那罗
verses.meaningEn: This, here, wicked + planet, wicked, wicked + Piśāca, or, offering oblation again and again, throb + not again and again, trembling, shaking, earthquake again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, tormentor again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: tathāgatājñāṃ pālaya buddhadharmasaṃghānujñātaṃ me karma śīghraṃ kuru kuru mā vilamba
verses.meaningZh: 如来命令，请护念、摄受守护！佛法·圣僧伽·受权，于我、为我，事，快，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + command, protect!watch over! cherish! Dharma + Saṃgha + allowed, to me, my, actions, śīghraṃ, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, do not, let not, hanging down
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 16 句）

verses.iast: hayagrī[vā]ya phaṭ vajrakhurāya phaṭ vajradaṃṣṭrāya phaṭ vajradaṃṣṭrotkaṭabhayabhairavāya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 向马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚蹄，泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚牙，泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚牙·极了广大·怖畏·怖畏，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, Phaṭ! Vajra + to, Phaṭ! to/for Vajradaṃṣṭra, Phaṭ! Vajradaṃṣṭra + exceedingly great + fear + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向愈加·无明·桑·星宿·一刹那，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + ignorance + saṃ + star + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向钵啰么怛啰摧灭，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: To, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (reverent offering), Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 20 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向一切毒害凶手，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All + poison + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (reverent offering), Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向海心，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vaḍavāmukhāya, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 23 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切·曜执·毗舍遮，于我、为我，因为祈请慢
verses.meaningEn: All + planet + Piśāca, to me, my, on account of + may You opinion
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: yāvanto mama [ye kecit] ahitaiṣiṇastān sarvān vaḍavāmukhena nikṛntaya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 乃至末，我之（行者所有），凡彼等诸有情，任何众生、凡有诸类，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·六度满行清净，一切、普皆遍满，以海心，祈请切断、断除，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: How + end, my, of me (the practitioner), those who, whoever (pl.), any, some (plural), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, all, every, complete, vaḍavāmukhena, may You cut off, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 26 句）

verses.iast: sidhyantu mama maṃtrapadā hayagrīvo bhagavān ājñā[pa]yati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，命令·净水·戒精进，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May all mantra-padas succeed! my, of me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, command + water + as many, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 27 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向归命如来，香·光明·广大光华尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage + to, smell + light + O with great magnificence
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大神父音！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, priest, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 此等，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），施度调伏·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: They, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 由我（具格：如是我闻），住，于明咒、真言明妃、圣智明中，成就，得
verses.meaningEn: By me, asyāṃ, in Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, siddhiḥ, filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三鸿毛是的尊
verses.meaningEn: Down + O yes again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，嗡！殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent, Oṃ! O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: parikuñja naṭa naṭa puskara vahaja lukha
verses.meaningZh: 般灌木，再三作舞，能作成办·第一义谛，御山羊，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍
verses.meaningEn: Wisdom + bush, a dancer or mime again and again, making, to transport + drift, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & selfless great loving-kindness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 誉殊胜
verses.meaningEn: Renown + choicest
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，面门、尊颜、法门入口尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O face, mouth, gateway/door / in face, mouth, gateway/door, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān tasmin samaye māramaṇḍalavidhvaṃsanaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpede
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，于彼处、于彼时，向平，魔·曼荼罗·摧灭，名为、号曰，三摩地、正定等持，平·净水·此处尊
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, in that, therein, to equal, Māra + Maṇḍala + ruining, by name, called, Samādhi, meditative absorption, equal + water
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 借由彼因缘，一切、普皆遍满，玻璃·器械·一雨，天妙·青莲华·莲华·固目答·白莲华，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，滋养增益·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: By which, whereby, all, every, complete, a precious stone + striking + rain, divine + blue lotus + lotus flower + the flower of the white water-lily + white lotus, great, nourishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）及声，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu and sound, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: yaduta [dharmaśabdaṃ buddhaśa]bdaṃ saṃghaśabdaṃ pāramitāśabdam abhijñāśabdaṃ bodhimaṇḍopasaṃkramaṇaśabdaṃ yāvatsopā[dānanirupādānaśabdā] nadhyatiṣṭhat
verses.meaningZh: 亦即、心路，正法声，佛陀声，截至军队年度，波罗蜜多声，六通声，菩提藏·演出弩蘖帝·声，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·真如实际，离名相假立·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Namely, to wit, Dharma + sound, Buddha + sound, by troops + year, Pāramitā + sound, six supernatural powers + sound, platform + act of approaching + sound, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，尘·一样·号啕·阿野婆，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, the same + cry, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，造作离相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·妙行趣入，一切、普皆遍满，七（七佛，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace & awakened spiritual movement, all, every, complete, seven, great
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 18 句）

verses.iast: anava loka]nataḥ mūrdhnā bhagavān yāvad brahmalokaṃ kāyena vaśaṃ vartayāmāsa
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说，世间、世界，由不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，梵世，以身、佛身法身，因为、截至所以，幅度·以彼·月
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech, world, realm, from not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, Brahma World, by/through body, kāya (sacred dimension), on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, width + moon
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 19 句）

verses.iast: ekaikasmācca lakṣaṇādbhagavatastādṛśī prabhā niścacāra yayā prabhayā tri[sāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātū]dāreṇābhāsena sphuṭo'bhūt
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·造作离相·六度满行清净，光明、清净毫光，离名相假立·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，一乘如实之道，以光明、清净毫光，广大殊胜·真如实际，开曾有
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, light, radiance, splendor, aura, beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, supreme vehicle of awakening, with/by light, radiance, splendor, aura, great (by spiritual power), suffused
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: ye cāsyāṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasrayāṃ lokadhātau devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnara-mahoragapretapiśāca-kumābhāṇḍa [manuṣyāmanuṣyā] nairayikā vā tairyagyonikā vā yāmalaukikā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，广大殊胜·真如实际，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，光明照耀·宝树宝山·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗，摩睺罗伽·饿鬼·毗舍遮，大地·勿·椀，人非人，地狱道，或、抑或，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，或、抑或，趣往特殊
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, great, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), shining + tree or mountain + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara, Mahoraga + Preta + Piśāca, earth + do not + bowl, person + a non-human, of hell, or, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, or, going + not common in the world
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 21 句）

verses.iast: vā te sarve bhagavantamadrākṣuḥ bahūni ca devanāgayakṣamanuṣyāmanuṣyaśatasahasrāṇi gaganasthāḥ puṣpairavākiran [pra]dakṣiṇaṃ cakruḥ
verses.meaningZh: 或、抑或，向汝、彼等，一切、普皆遍满尊，若衍底·本刹·经营·喷嚏，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立以及光明照耀·宝树宝山·坚持下去·非人·非人·一切百千，虚空诸依止处，滋养增益·第一义谛，右遶，妙行迁变空·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Or, to Thee / they, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, victorious passed beyond + this + run + sneeze, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) and shining + tree or mountain + press on + a non-human + a non-human + sgl, sky + standing, nourishing, moving to the right, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, bowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 23 句）

verses.iast: bahūni nairayikā tairyagyonikā yāmalaukikākṣobhyakoṭīśatasahasrāṇi smṛtiṃ pratilebhire
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立，地狱道，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，趣往·特殊·阿閦如来·魔爪·一切百千，正念、忆持不忘，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), of hell, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, going + not common in the world + Akṣobhya + the curved end of the bow + sgl, mindfulness, recollection, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: pūrvāvaropitakuśalamūlamanusmṛtya namo buddhāya iti kṛtvā tebhyo'pāyebhyaścyavitvā deveṣūpapannaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 本·种善根·那罗·忆持·那个，归命，向佛陀、觉者，如是（结句印定），既作已、行持已，真如实际·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，神圣宝箭揭帝降临
verses.meaningEn: Former + man + remember + that, homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, thus, so it is stated, having done, having performed, immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, a divine arrow + having gone or come to
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 25 句）

verses.iast: tataśca mārasainyā dvāviṃśatimāraputraśatasahasrāṇi sapārṣadyāni bhagavata evaṃrūpaṃ prātihāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavato'ntike atīva prasādaṃ pratilabdhvā yena bhagavāṃstenopajagmatuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 由伊人、本刹及魔多，二十二·魔·子·一切百千，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，才鸣呼，如是，瑞，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，世尊·以此·于，很，淳，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，借由彼因缘，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: From stem of he, she, it, Māra + relating to an army, twenty-two + Māra + son + sgl, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), excellence, evaṃrūpaṃ, a miracle, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, Bhagavān + hence + near to, very, pure, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, by which, whereby, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 26 句）

verses.iast: upetya taiḥ sārdhaṃ pañcabhirmārakanyāśatairbhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya añjalīn pragṛhya ābhirgāthabhiradhibhāṣante sma
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·真如实际·一乘如实之道，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·大自在威德统摄·涅槃除障点证入），俱，第一义谛·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，第一义谛·施度调伏，礼敬赞叹·本性寂静止息，圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，转载可见，宣说演畅·破有相福德光，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — sovereign spiritual mastery with nirvāṇic visarga release, together, ultimate truth & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), venerating, non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks, forward + to be seized or taken, speaking (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 27 句）

titleZh: 【DB3·DSBC专书】《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》(Book #18)

titleEnglish: DSBC Sanskrit Canon Book #18: Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī

sutraSourceZh: DSBC Dhāraṇī Collection (Book #18)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC) 陀罗尼专目第 #18 号梵本《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（录入校勘：Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)）。

provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 尼泊尔 DSBC 独立陀罗尼梵文经卷 (#18)。
provenance.rawSnippet: nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ evaṃ mayā śrutamekasminsamaye bhagavān svarṇaśṛṅge parvatāgre vaiśravaṇasya gṛhe viharati sma| tatra devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragavidyādharāpsaraḥprabh

verses.iast: tena nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇatvaṃ mahāmāyāvijayavāhinīṃ nāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 借由彼力、以是因缘，那罗延，妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，广大殊胜·尊胜降伏·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，陀罗尼一切真言章句
verses.meaningEn: By that truth, thereby, through that power, Narayana, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, great, conquering, by name, called, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra phrase
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：归命敬礼·离名相假立，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: bowing, all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向诸一切手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: All + Mudrā + to all sacred mantra phrase
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: om māye mahāmāye mahāmāyādhāraṇi iyaṃ sā mahāmāyāmantreṇa mahāmāyārūpeṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！花样尊，神明尊，广大泡影陀罗尼，此圣女、此陀罗尼，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），以广大泡影真言，以广大泡影色
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O trick, wile / in trick, wile, O very deceitful or illusory, the Great Illusion + O Dhāraṇī, this (feminine), she, that, the Great Illusion + by, the Great Illusion + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: bhrama bhrama sattvānāñca ye virūdhakaṃ cintayanti sarvaduṣṭasattvāstān bhrāmaya bhrāmaya mohaya mohaya mūrcchāpaya mūrcchāpaya māraya māraya vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三头旋，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，凡彼等诸有情，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，认为诸尊此处，一切·暴恶者·有情·故乡，再三遊，再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！再三无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！
verses.meaningEn: Spring again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, those who, whoever (pl.), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, think + they walk, all + wicked + sentient being + home, may You to tour! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: mara mara mahāmāye alalalale mahāmāyājālasahasramukhi sahasraśire sahasramuje jvalitanetre sarvatathāgatahṛdayagarbhe asidhanuparaśupāśatomarakanayaśaktinṛmuṇḍihaste mudgaracakrahaste
verses.meaningZh: 再三临危、死厄，神明尊，严·体育·严，广大泡影·网·打败·眼泪尊颜尊，截至成千饮料，千胸尊，炽盛燃耀眼目，一切如来·心·藏，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持·离名相假立，锤·颤动·无手尊
verses.meaningEn: Dying, death again and again, O very deceitful or illusory, sport, the Great Illusion + net + overpower + O having tears in the face, by thousands + O drink, sahasramuje, blazing + O eye, all Tathagatas + heart + O womb, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), hammer + tremble + O handless
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: ehyehi bhagavati sarvatathāgatasatyena devarṣigaṇasatyena mahāmāyāvijayavāhinī smara smara sarvatathāgatajñānarūpeṇa gaccha gaccha sarvāvaraṇakṣayaṅkari
verses.meaningZh: 祈请速疾降临道场（翳呬翳呬），世尊佛母！（呼格），以一切如来谛，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，广大泡影·最胜尊胜·具画儿，再三忆念本誓，以一切如来圣智色，再三去吧、趣向菩提！能作成办·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Come, come swiftly to this sanctuary! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all Tathagatas + by, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (by spiritual power), the Great Illusion + supreme victory! triumph! + possessing carrying, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all Tathagatas + primordial wisdom + by, go! proceed! again and again, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: parasainyavidrāviṇi mohaya mohaya mama sarvasattvānāñca sarvaduṣṭān
verses.meaningZh: 他人·多·解·具叫声，再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切暴恶者
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + relating to an army + understanding + O bearer of roaring, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all + wicked
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃśca yakṣabhayopadravebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，向诸坚持下去无畏灾横，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, press on + non-fear + to all calamity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！僵仆出，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 23 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! conquering (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 24 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 26 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！花样·此边·慧眼·汝即是·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! trick + the hither + eye + Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 30 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 31 句）

verses.iast: om rū rū hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ he he jaye māyā bhagavati mahāmāyāvijayavāhinī gṛhāṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，幻化、如幻妙力，世尊佛母！（呼格），广大泡影·最胜尊胜·具画儿，妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! illusion, magical display (Māyā), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! the Great Illusion + supreme victory! triumph! + possessing carrying, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 32 句）

verses.iast: śīghramāvilambasva mama sarvasattvānāṃca sarvakāryaṃ kuru kuru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 快·勿·搭拉·自，我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切果，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Quick + do not + hanging down + own, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 33 句）

verses.meaningZh: 兽主徒，静·即时·渊博，世间过去，归命愿得成就，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Śivaḥ, then + to be seized, world, homage + may it be so, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 34 句）

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·法界总持任持，正法、诸法实相，谛、真实不虚语，归命愿得成就，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Bearing (imperative seal), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, truth, reality, veracity, homage + may it be so, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 35 句）

provenance.rawSnippet: ṣaṇmukhī-dhāraṇī oṃ namo buddhāya|| evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śuddhāvāsopari-gaganatala-pratiṣṭhite sapta-ratna pravibha kta-vicitra-ratna-vyūhe mahā-maṇḍalamāḍe viharati sma|| asaṃ-khyeyena bodhi sa[t]tva-gaṇena sār(d)dhaṃ|| tatra khalu bhagavā

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śuddhāvāsopari-gaganatala-pratiṣṭhite sapta-ratna pravibha kta-vicitra-ratna-vyūhe mahā-maṇḍalamāḍe viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，净居天般，穹苍，踞尊，七（七佛，珍宝、摩尼宝，坡度宝山家庭，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），斑驳陆离、微质怛囒，珍宝、摩尼宝，庄严尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），周廊尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, suddhavasa + wisdom, celestial vault, firmament, O squat / in squat, seven, jewel, precious gem, treasure, slope of a mountain + household, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, variegated, many-coloured, jewel, precious gem, treasure, O mass, heap, great, vast, supreme, O a circular hall, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 乃是、存在，以观照此处，菩提、无上正觉，有情、众生、勇猛心，以海会众、圣众眷属，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Be, exist, happen, become, see, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, sentient being, living creature, courage, by/through assembly, host,retinue, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tatra khalu bhagavān bodhisa[t]tvān āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，诚然、确实，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: udgṛhṇīdhavaṃ yūyaṃ kulaputrā imāṃ ṣaṇmukhī-nāma-dhāraṇīṃ sarva-jagad-dhitārthaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，一乘如实之道，善男子，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，总持任持·法界总持任持，一切、普皆遍满，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·施度调伏，救度超脱·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, supreme vehicle of awakening, a good man, this (feminine accusative), perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, by name, called, upholding, all, every, complete, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery, ferrying across
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，犹如此圣女
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, just as + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸吉祥·一切·佛陀·菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to auspiciousness + all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，清净、纯洁无染尊，嚩啰阇尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O free from dust, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼正法、诸法实相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ namo maitreyapramukhānāṃ sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghānām
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼诸七（七佛·正等正觉诸俱胝·弥勒菩萨诸上首·一切·佛陀·诸菩提萨埵·彼·舍罗婆迦·诸圣僧伽！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to seven, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, of ten million, Maitreya, of all foremost, all, Buddha, of all Bodhisattva, he, sravaka, of all Saṃgha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世间、世界尊·诸应供、阿罗汉（破烦恼贼）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O world, realm / in world, realm, Arhat, Worthy One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·诸入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, entered!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼斯陀含是的！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Sakrdagamin, yes!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼自然·宝树宝山·急躁！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to certainly, tree or mountain, impetuous!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世间、世界尊·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O world, realm / in world, realm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼权利诸入！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼施度调伏·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust!

verses.meaningZh: 归命诸般舟
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the thus-gone ones of the three times. Oṁ , O you who are best in splendor, O you who have been uttered, culu culu ! Hold firm, hold firm! O holder of the relics of all the thus-gone ones, O lotus matrix, best among victories, unmoving one! Remember! O thus-gone one, setting in motion the wheel of the doctrine! O you who adorn with ornaments the adamantine seat of enlightenment! O you who are blessed by all the thus-gone ones! Arouse, arouse toward enlightenment, enlightenment! Thoroughly arouse, arouse toward the buddha, the buddha! Shake, shake! All obscurations must shake! O you in whom all evil has disappeared, huru huru ! O you in whom all grief has disappeared! O quintessence of all the thus-gone ones, O wielder of the adamantine thunderbolt, engender, engender, O secret of all the thus-gone ones, O seal of the dhāraṇī, O knowing one, O well-knowing one, O you who are blessed by all the thus-gone ones, O matrix of relics, svāhā ! O you who are blessed by the pledge, svāhā ! O quintessence of all the thus-gone ones, O seal of relics, svāhā ! O well-constructed stūpa blessed by the thus-gone one, hūṁ hūṁ svāhā ! Oṁ , O seal of the relics of all the thus-gone ones’ uṣṇīṣas, O you who are blessed by the ornament of the dimension of reality of all the thus-gone ones, huru huru , hūṁ hūṁ svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading traiyadhvikānāṃ , as in the Compendium of Incantations section of the Degé edition. The version in the Tantra section is somewhat illegible here, so although it seems to read dhī , it may be that dhvi was intended.

verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + O well grounded or situated, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, conquer! victory! + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! become a thunderbolt or diamond + O desirous, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetuṃ teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因生，因，彼等一切之，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + excelling, cause, of them, their, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud 'bum, na), folio 42.a (in par phud printings), folio 59.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་པར་འབྱུང་བའི་སྙིང་པོ།

verses.iast: teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼等一切之以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是论者，大沙门
verses.meaningEn: Of them, their and who, whichever, suppression, thus + vādī, great

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三弯曲、超群，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三忆念本誓，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸饿鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + of all Preta, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

Oṃ goddess Mārīcī, protect me on the path. Protect me from the wrong path. Protect me from perils related to people. Protect me from perils related to kings. Protect me from perils related to elephants. Protect me from perils related to robbers. Protect me from perils related to nāgas. Protect me from perils related to lions. Protect me from perils related to tigers. Protect me from perils related to fire. Protect me from perils related to water. Protect me from perils related to serpents. Protect me from perils related to poison. Protect me from all adversaries and enemies. Protect me when there is conflict and calm and when there is disorder and order. Protect me from lions. Protect me from tigers. Protect me from nāgas. Protect me from serpents, svāhā . Protect me from all perils and from all manner of harm, infectious disease, and conflict. Protect me!

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ padākramasi parākramasi udayamasi nairamasi arkamasi markamasi urmamasi vanamasi gulmamasi cīvaramasi mahācīvaramasi antardhānamasi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！秋天·案·汝即是，愈加·案·汝即是，净水·摄伏·汝即是，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，园汝即是，妙行趣入·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，灭汝即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! fall + hold fast + Thou art, beyond + hold fast + Thou art, water + hold + Thou art, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Thou art, awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), great (vocative invocation), Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S pa dA kra ma si , which is supported by Skt. padākramasi . Toh 564 and 988 read pa tā kra ma si .

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā oṃ ālo tālo kālo sacchalo sattvamudrati rakṣa rakṣa māṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，即说咒曰：嗡！衍伸、刻毒实物，七多罗树，时，奸滑，有情阶位双手，祈请再三拥护、守护于我
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! spawn, venomous matter, tālo, kālo, deceitful, sentient being + position of the hands, evermore protect, guard and shelter me
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following Dhiḥ 42 sattvamudrati . Toh 564 and 988 read sa ma pa mU ra d+hi Ti , S reads sa ma pa mUr+d+ha , and N E 1480/9 omits. The reading in Dhiḥ 42 ,

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ vattāli vadāli varāli varāhamukhī sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha bandha mukhaṃ jaṃbhaya staṃbhaya mohaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），面，生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光，请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, mukhaṃ, transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, bewilder hostile forces! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following N E 1480/9 and Dhiḥ 42 varāhamukhī . Toh 564 and 988 read bA rA ha mu khi , and S reads ba rA ha mu khi .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 157.a–158.b · 藏文名：འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṃ varāli vadāli vattāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ praduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！殊胜小溪，演说小溪，不过逮捕七多罗树，野猪面门，一切诸暴恶者，诸败坏、糟糕之，眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! choicest + small ditch, speaking + small ditch, only apprehend + O palm-tree, boar + O face, all + of all wicked, of all corrupt, bad, wicked, libidinous, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . Toh 564 and 988 read bA rA ha mu khi , Dhiḥ 42 reads varāhamukhī , and N E 1480/9 omits.

verses.iast: namaḥ samantabuddhānām apratihataśāsanānāṃ oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā!
verses.meaningZh: 归命普遍没驮南，无碍诸传，嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal + buddhānām, unobstructed + of all chastising, Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This word is omitted in Mañjukīrti.

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，清净、纯洁无染尊，嚩啰阇尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O free from dust, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This line, which is unique to Toh 590, appears in transliterated Sanskrit in the Tibetan translation and so has been left as such here. This line can be

verses.iast: oṁ ṛṣigaṇapraśaste sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṁ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！仙人·海会众·善祥尊，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi + assembly + O cut, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Degé version reads prasādhanakarī ( pra sA d+ha na ka rI ), which has been emended here, as in the prose passage above, to prasādanakarī based on CL 1326 ,

verses.meaningZh: 令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）

verses.meaningEn: O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended to the vocative following CL 1326 , KT 728 , and RAS H 77 . The Tibetan transliterations read vajrapāṇi .

verses.meaningZh: 再三诸人于我
verses.meaningEn: A degraded Kṣatriya + to me again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended to the vocative following CL 1326 , KT 728 , and RAS H 77 . The Tibetan transliterations read vajrapāṇi .

verses.meaningZh: 再三勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended to the vocative following CL 1326 , KT 728 , and RAS H 77 . The Tibetan transliterations read vajrapāṇi .

verses.meaningZh: 再三怨
verses.meaningEn: Enmity again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三寂静温和、慈柔如月尊
verses.meaningEn: O gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign / in gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended to the vocative following CL 1326 , KT 728 , and RAS H 77 . The Tibetan transliterations read vajrapāṇi .

verses.iast: sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre sarvaduṣṭacittān hūṁ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，一切具瞋心，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, all, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended to the vocative following CL 1326 , KT 728 , and RAS H 77 . The Tibetan transliterations read vajrapāṇi .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 243.b–248.a · 藏文名：གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空，自性最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Unequalled + suffusion + course + O sky, own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.iast: āhara āhara mama āyuḥsandhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命·赢得·陀罗尼，再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + win + O Dhāraṇī, purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶尊胜佛母圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣavijayā + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 六·波罗蜜多·般·遂尊
verses.meaningEn: Six + Pāramitā + wisdom + O satisfy
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子，十地踞尊
verses.meaningEn: Sarvatathāgataṃ + O frame, the Ten Bodhisattva Grounds + O squat
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚身·好好儿编织·不·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Vajrakāya + struck together + not + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·业障·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: All + karmic obscuration + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！我之（行者所有），寿命最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Turn back (evil)! restore! my, of me (the practitioner), life + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·三昧耶·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + Samaya + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Muni, silent sage again and again, Great Sage (Mahāmuni)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼
verses.meaningEn: Settle + Muni again and again, great + settle + Muni
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧，我之（行者所有），善心、人情
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom, my, of me (the practitioner), benevolence, favour
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 真如·实际·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Suchness + limit of reality + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 闢·开·清净尊
verses.meaningEn: Settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓，再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! again and again, pervade! radiate forth everywhere! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请大放光明遍照十方！
verses.meaningEn: Cause to radiate and expand universally! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净、纯洁无染尊
verses.meaningEn: O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三佛陀、觉者尊
verses.meaningEn: O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊，勇健金刚杵尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, great + O Vajra, O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚藏尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajragarbhe
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏藏
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! + O womb
