verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三佛陀、觉者尊，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三初升、洪水，祈请忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour again and again, remember Your primordial vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: smara krīḍaya krīḍaya māraya māraya mārdhaya mārdhaya ghāṭaya ghāṭaya sarvavighnān kuru kuru
verses.meaningZh: 祈请忆念本誓，再三戏剧、体育，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，再三无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，再三破暗合集·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，一切障碍，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! may You playing, sporting again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, all + obstacle, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: mama kāryāṃ cchindha cchindha sarvaduṣṭān kṣāpaya kṣāpaya śānte śānte dānte dānte dāmaya
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），果，再三斩断结缚·妙行迁变空，一切暴恶者，再三令刍，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，再三低调、佛口婆心尊，祈请施物
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), to be done, severing again and again, all + wicked, cause to kṣ! again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless again and again, may You gift
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: drutam ādarśaya ātmanaṃ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca sarvagrahānakṣatravidhvaṃsaṃ nivartaya bhagavati mahāmāye prasādaya sarvaduṣṭaṃ śodhaya sarvapāpaṃ caṇḍe caṇḍe turu turu caṇḍeni caṇḍeni muyu muyu mucu mucu vaha vaha ugre ugrata me pūraya me manoratham paripūraya sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 经营、迅速，祈请镜子，我，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及一切·曜执·气息·田园·秋天，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，世尊佛母！（呼格），神明尊，祈请淳，一切暴恶者，请净除、涤荡清净！一切罪业，再三威猛、暴烈除障尊，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，再三无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，再三无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，再三最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，威猛、大势力尊，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，于我、为我，祈请充分、充分称计，于我、为我，希望、贪欲，祈请成就，一切如来所加持，向平，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Run, fled, may You looking-glass, mirror, self, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and all + planet + breath + field + fall, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O very deceitful or illusory, may You pure! all + wicked, purify! cleanse! all + evil, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, O mighty, fierce, formidable / in mighty, fierce, formidable, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, to me, my, may You full, to me, my, wish, desire, fancy, may You filling up, all Tathagatas + O blessed, to equal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三揭幕、一些，再三闢揭幕，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，再三濯，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三柱，再三齿相、獠牙，再三愚痴、无明迷妄，再三请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！再三施度调伏·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，放置·驮·他，悉地、妙成就，于我、为我，乐趣喜
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! straw mat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, settle + cleaving again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, wash again and again, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, post, column, prop, support again and again, tooth, tusk, the jaws, mouth again and again, delusion, ignorance, bewilderment again and again, give! grant! bestow! again and again, generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, put + dha + other, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, to me, my, pleasure + close by

verses.iast: oṃ śrīmahākāla gaṇaguti svāhā namaḥ śrīmahākāla gaṇe gutiśāya namo yoginaṇīna tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥大黑天护法，妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，吉祥大黑天护法，海会众、圣众眷属尊，妙行趣入·真如实际·本性寂静止息，归命，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立，即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness + Mahākāla, awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to auspiciousness + Mahākāla, O assembly, host,retinue / in assembly, host,retinue, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace (reverent offering), homage to supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, Thus goes the mantra:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，造作离相·真如实际，造作离相·真如实际·离名相假立，积累、浓厚尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O piled up, heaped up, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṁ namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñāna-suviniścita-tejorājāya tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tadyathā | oṁ puṇye puṇye mahāpuṇye
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，无量寿智决定王如来圣智，报刊往外决定，向威光王，向如来（乘如实道来成正觉），向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，向正等正觉、正遍知；即说咒曰：嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三福德、胜妙功德尊，大福尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Aparimitāyus + primordial wisdom, press out + determined to, to, to/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to the Arhat, Worthy One, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O merit, auspicious virtue / in merit, auspicious virtue again and again, O very auspicious or fortunate
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 211.b–216.a · 藏文名：ཚེ་དང་ཡེ་ཤེས་དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པའི་མདོ།

verses.meaningZh: 无量寿智决定王如来福德，圣智、无漏真智
verses.meaningEn: Aparimitāyus + merit, primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 211.b–216.a · 藏文名：ཚེ་དང་ཡེ་ཤེས་དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པའི་མདོ།

verses.meaningZh: 无限量福德，无限量福德，圣智、无漏真智
verses.meaningEn: Unmeasured + O merit, unmeasured + merit, primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 211.b–216.a · 藏文名：ཚེ་དང་ཡེ་ཤེས་དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པའི་མདོ།

verses.iast: saṃbhāropacite | oṁ sarva-saṃskāra-pariśuddha-dharmate gagana-samudgate svabhāva-viśuddhe mahānaya-parivāre svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 资粮积累尊；嗡！一切、普皆遍满，行（诸行造作），圆满清净、周遍无垢，正法、诸法实相，虚空、清净苍穹，器箧，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊，祈请大，眷属尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Something accumulated + O heaped up Oṃ! all, every, complete, volitional formations, conditioned phenomena, thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, sky, boundless space, firmament, tip, point, own-being, intrinsic nature, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, mahānaya, O accessory, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 211.b–216.a · 藏文名：ཚེ་དང་ཡེ་ཤེས་དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པའི་མདོ།

verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!

verses.iast: oṃ kaṅkani kaṅkani rocani rocani troṭani troṭani trāsani trāsani pratihana pratihana sarvakarmaparamparāṇi me svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三那罗在于，再三光明照耀、光净尊，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三怛啰尊，再三对击破怨魔与无明惑，一切·事·管保·一切他人，于我、为我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! heron + in again and again, O shining, bright, beautiful again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, O trasana again and again, toward + strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all + actions + assuredly + someone else, to me, my, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud, tsha), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三开
verses.meaningEn: Suffused again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！
verses.meaningEn: Shatter! split open! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切一切众生、普皆有情
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三理解、聪慧
verses.meaningEn: May You understanding, intelligence! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三头旋
verses.meaningEn: Spring again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三敬行
verses.meaningEn: May You confusion, agitation, haste, hurry again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切一切处、到处可见，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Being everywhere, ubiquitous, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请庵
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You cottage! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请瓶
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You jar again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切圣智，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: All knowledge, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大声笑声绀青，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Loud laughter + sapphire-blue, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for having a strong thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），妙果圆成·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·妙果圆成
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & fruition of enlightenment (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Enacting (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向金刚最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 杵尊，向杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O a pointed piece of wood, to/for a pointed piece of wood, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三席
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎，向转载摧碎，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Crushing, breaking, strangling, forward + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 行持妙道·在于·行持妙道
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! + in + move forth in compassionate activity!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Great (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忿
verses.meaningEn: Wrath again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，向杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), to/for a pointed piece of wood, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚杵尊，向杵
verses.meaningEn: O thunderbolt, to/for a pointed piece of wood
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！向金刚总持、执金刚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三巡
verses.meaningEn: A watch a period of about hours again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向金刚风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 慧坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 闻坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hearing + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 对坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Toward + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大金刚
verses.meaningEn: Great + Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无碍、无能障碍，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 善来降临坛场（翳呬），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Come forth, O Blessed One! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Śīghraṁ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.iast: dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru sarvavajrakulamāvartāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），向一切·金刚·大地·不过·绕，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, all + Vajra + earth + only + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 某甲，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: A certain person, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍诸金刚！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, of all Vajra!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切跋蓝，祈请绕
verses.meaningEn: All, may You circumambulate!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 席力
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat + O power
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 彼严
verses.meaningEn: That
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 不动明王、不动摇尊
verses.meaningEn: O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 曼荼罗出
verses.meaningEn: O income
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 太金刚
verses.meaningEn: Very + Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 余力烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Jerk + passion
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无胜尊
verses.meaningEn: O unsurpassed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — purified faculties, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 黄白色尊
verses.meaningEn: O a man's name, of an author on Chandas or metrics, of gods demons
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 具足威光尊
verses.meaningEn: Tejovati
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三芝麻尊
verses.meaningEn: O the sesamum plant or seed again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṁ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三护摩献供·法界总持任持，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Offering oblation again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三方位，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: May You holding, bearing! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三惨酷，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hard, rough, harsh, cruel, severe again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṁ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚忿
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + Vajra + to
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三安住加持
verses.meaningEn: Abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 甘露、不死妙法尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṁ mañjubhara mañjughoṣa hana hana hana daha daha paca paca vece vece
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！玅方位，妙音文殊菩萨，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beautiful + bearing, Mañjughoṣa, Gentle-Voiced Mañjuśrī, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: bhita bhita iphuta iphuta herate sottani namaḥ sottani pripiśale tang pritahasa prabhinata
verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·真如实际，再三火供净施·妙果圆成，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，归命，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness again and again, sacred offering again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: jaya hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ herate sottani hūṁ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 胜伏、最胜吉祥！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ vāgīśvari muṁ mañjughoṣa hana vatisidhoharini svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！尊主语言尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），妙音文殊菩萨，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），最上真言离言说·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a master of language, selfless great loving-kindness — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Mañjughoṣa, Gentle-Voiced Mañjuśrī, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三掌，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三方位、战斗，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三请执持、总持护念！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! palm again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! bearing, carrying again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waṃ), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：སྡོང་པོ་རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ prajñe prajñe prajñe avalokiradhati mani susiddhi ārya jvala nāma mañjuye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三聪明、英明尊，鸿毛·随一·努力利养，自尊尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，圣、尊贵圣者，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），名为、号曰，无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing again and again, down + mostly ) look + strive to gain, O pride, O well-accomplished, supremely perfected, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), blaze forth with wisdom radiance! by name, called, selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waṃ), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：སྡོང་པོ་རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！因缘空寂大乐·造作离相，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！不、非、无，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！风大自在除障种子，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·禅定三昧总持），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·禅定三昧总持），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — dispelling sorrow, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! not, non-, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — deep samādhi retention, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — deep samādhi retention, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — perfected spiritual vigor, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 归命才鸣呼，一切、普皆遍满，法界总持任持·一乘如实之道，暴恶者不，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to excellence, all, every, complete, Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), wicked + not, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waṃ), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：སྡོང་པོ་རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：离一切相无相·真如实际，闢七多罗树，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，太他，破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，离名相假立·息灭诤怨，最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐·等虚空无碍，幻化乐，阿难，生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, settle + palm-tree, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust, very + tha, blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation & pacifying conflict & turmoil, supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & space-like boundlessness, illusion + easy, servant, transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: dhāraṇi dhāraṇi uddhāraṇi sampratiṣṭhite vijaya varna satyapratijñāsaradā jñānavati utpadani vināmani abhiśecani abhivyāhāra
verses.meaningZh: 再三陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，总持任持·施度调伏，随着踞尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！幅度不，忠诚约定·床坐·齿相，具足圣智、无漏真智尊，迸粮尊，闢形变尊，破有相福德光·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，融通常恒
verses.meaningEn: O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell again and again, upholding (vocative invocation), along with + O squat, supreme victory! triumph! width + not, faithful to a promise + seat + scratching, O one endowed with primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna), burst forth + O provisions, settle + O bending, blessedness transcending existence & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), to + eternal from the standpoint of common experience
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: śubhavati jīmatu ehi kumabālan vaha hara kleśāna dhuna pāvama śodhaya mārgan nirāhikadharmātā
verses.meaningZh: 具足清净吉祥、善妙庄严尊，生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，善来降临坛场（翳呬），造作离相·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，请摄取、遣除苦厄！烦恼气息，护摩献供·法界总持任持，饮用守护本刹，请净除、涤荡清净！无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，持守摄受·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), come forth, O Blessed One! freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, carry away (suffering)! remove! affliction + breath, offering oblation, drinking or protecting + this, purify! cleanse! selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: śuddhāloka vitimirarājasa dukkha śamana sarva buddha avalokana adhiṣṭhite prajñā jñānabhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 真实世间，闢·眩·来诣·彼，施度调伏·造作离相·等虚空无碍，寂静息灭、止息灾障（古译「奢摩奴」），一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，观不，所加持、安住摄持尊，般若、超越妙慧，圣智星宿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: World, settle + obscuring of vision + coming from or belonging to goats + he, generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency & space-like boundlessness, pacifying, calming, extinguishing afflictions, all, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, viewing + not, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Prajñā, transcendent wisdom, primordial wisdom + O star, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: mahājñāna avabhāsāni śrītejolakṣmi vṛṣṭivikrama vajra siṁhatane paramavirāja nirmalaguṇa ketusūryaprabhe vimalāṇgayaṣṭi bhara bhara
verses.meaningZh: 乐趣权威，一切普光明照、遍照瑞光，吉祥·威光·吉祥相，一雨超，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），狮子裔胄，最胜光明照耀，净无垢秽功德，光明幢日光尊，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，再三方位、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + authority, splendor, universal illumination (plural), auspiciousness + O mark, rain + surpass, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, lion + O offspring, supreme + shining, utterly spotless + virtue, banner + O bright as the sun, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), bearing, carrying again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: sambhara sambhara dudumbu hana hana mahāprabhe vibhūta mahā maho andhakāre prajñāgraśuddhe paripūrṇṇamaitri
verses.meaningZh: 再三参婆啰，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），大光尊，离，大、摩诃（广大无边），威力、光耀，暗尊，聪明·尊·清净，圆满慈心尊
verses.meaningEn: Bestower again and again, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (imperative seal), strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, O exceedingly brilliant / in exceedingly brilliant, variously, great, vast, supreme, greatness, might, lustre, splendour, abundance, plenty, feast, festival, joy, pleasur, O dark, intelligent + first + O pure, filled or covered with + O loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: maitri viraṇaskandha maitrāmabuddhare jala jala jala jala jalam buddhare bodhyaṅgakusume daśabale caturveśvaradhe
verses.meaningZh: 慈心（与乐大慈）尊，闢·烦恼·蕴，觉悟正觉·无我大慈三昧，再三净水，净水，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，觉支妙花尊，十力尊，四·定居者·幅度·下尊
verses.meaningEn: O loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), settle + passion + aggregate, awakened (vocative invocation), water again and again, water, awakened (vocative invocation), aid to enlightenment + O flower, O possessing the ten bala, four + settler + width + O then
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: aṣṭādaśa apanigabuddhadharme śubhamadi puṇyarāśi śukladharmasamanvite gambhāre virajase vimale viśiṣaprāpte nirāsrapadharme sarvalokajyaiṣṭha jeṣṭhaparapravare
verses.meaningZh: 十八，觉悟正觉·持守摄受·第一义谛，清净吉祥曼殊，福德群体，白·正法·辅以，往包袱，闢不明不白，毘磨利，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·六度满行清净，在于·噜噜·絮叨·非法尊，世界月份夏天，孟夏·他人·最妙尊
verses.meaningEn: Eighteenth, awakened, bearing (vocative invocation), auspicious + O gladdening, merit + group, white + Dharma + O accompanied by, to go + O burden, settle + O obscure, pure, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), in + roar + chatter + O unrighteousness, the universe + a month in summer, someone else + O cover
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: anuttare asaṇge dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhura śāntamahe śāntavege cara cara
verses.meaningZh: 无上、无与伦比尊，一切诸谛圆满·离诸诤论无诤·妙行趣入，再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），坚固任持总持法印（度噜），勤爱，寂静欢喜，寂静余力，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: O unsurpassed, supreme, peerless / in unsurpassed, supreme, peerless, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & conflict-free peace & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! burden, peaceful + for joy, peaceful + O jerk, move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: cara cara ciri ciri curu curu paramabuddhānumate mahāprajñāpāramite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），最胜·佛陀·便利，摩诃般若波罗蜜尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, supreme + Buddha + O allowed, O Great Perfection of Wisdom / in Great Perfection of Wisdom, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this

verses.iast: sara sara siri siri suru suru nāgā nāgā java java jivi jivi juvu juvu
verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三龙族、大龙王，再三速，再三生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，再三生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity again and again, hastening, quick again and again, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation) again and again, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sara sara means “move, move!” Here, and all the way up to and including the paragraph at , only the first pair of the Sanskrit words is translatable. The

verses.iast: cara cara ciri ciri curu curu
verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Cara cara means “Act, act!”

verses.iast: vara vara viri viri vuru vuru
verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Vara vara means “Surround, surround!”

verses.iast: bhara bhara bhiri bhiri bhuru bhuru
verses.meaningZh: 再三方位、战斗，再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢

verses.iast: pramadate vijṛmbha utpatate utpatata utmatate jaḥ samvijṛmbha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 高胜数字，拉筋，迸，真如实际·第一义谛，真如实际·无我大慈三昧，金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，随着拉筋，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: A high number, stretching, burst forth, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), along with + stretching, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Y, J, K, N, C, H pra ma da te ; D pra ma ta te .

verses.iast: tadyathā | samudravate maruvate napini napini gauraveṣa deniṣadeni ivijasoha jabhiibheda saṅskarābhra svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：大海鸣呼尊，绝边广川鸣呼尊，再三离名相假立·第一义谛，洁白相，施度调伏·离名相假立·六度满行清净，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光·施度调伏，能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Ocean, god, beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth (vocative invocation) again and again, white + work, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery, making, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 67 (mdo sde, ’a), folios 90.a–209.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ཚུལ་ནམ་མཁའི་མདོག་གིས་འདུལ་བའི་བཟོད་པ།

verses.iast: tadyathā | janami bhāva subhāva subhāva subhāvo bhavavo bravovavakha gavākha gava vibhajayabhyo svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：归命敬礼·生起不可得·尊胜，物，再三报刊往外物，报刊往外物，汝人情，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·等虚空无碍，特，向诸微婆奢哪些，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Bowing (vocative invocation), becoming, being, press out + becoming again and again, press out, you + favour, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & space-like boundlessness, bull, to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 67 (mdo sde, ’a), folios 90.a–209.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ཚུལ་ནམ་མཁའི་མདོག་གིས་འདུལ་བའི་བཟོད་པ།

verses.iast: vedini vedini vedini paṇḍini paṇḍini paṇḍini trijñani trijñani trijñani upadāni upadāni upadāni
verses.meaningZh: 再三依持在于，再三第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，再三三·了知·在于，再三圣供在于
verses.meaningEn: The sacrificial bed or altar + in again and again, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again, three + knowing + in again and again, offering + in again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Y, K kānte ; D kānti . This transliteration follows the variant in the Yongle and Peking Kangyurs.

verses.meaningZh: 再三不脂肪，再三无我大慈三昧·生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·支分寂静，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三请执持、总持护念！尊
verses.meaningEn: Not + O fat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) again and again, stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & quiescence of perceptual limbs, great, O hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Y, K kānte ; D kānti . This transliteration follows the variant in the Yongle and Peking Kangyurs.

verses.iast: dhaṣṭe pradhaṣṭe urukānte gambhiri avartani vartanim eva avartani iha nivartani kānte sarvakānte
verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，设相亲尊，往无畏威神震伏魔怨，人情裔胄，途径、道路，唯、正是、决定，人情裔胄，于此、今于此处，一样、退还尊，相亲尊，一切一极
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), spacious + O desired, to go + fearless spiritual majesty, favour + O offspring, the felloe or the track of a wheel, indeed, verily, alone, favour + O offspring, here, in this world/place, O the same, O desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, all + O ultimate
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Y, K kānte ; D kānti . This transliteration follows the variant in the Yongle and Peking Kangyurs.

verses.iast: hṛdayakānte viraje varaje varaviraje skandhavame ayatanarahe bhatusare darvaphalgu dharmarājer prekṣite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 心相亲尊，嚩啰阇尊，幅度山羊尊，幅度羊毛尘尊，蕴反胃，此处·推广·配称尊，破有相福德光·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，勺子无用，正法线条，模样、达利瑟致尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Heart + O desired, O free from dust, width + O drift, width, aggregate + O vomiting, walk + extend + O worthy, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), ladle + worthless, Dharma + of streak, O look, view, glance / in look, view, glance, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Y, K kānte ; D kānti . This transliteration follows the variant in the Yongle and Peking Kangyurs.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三耕

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入！

verses.iast: oṃ paca paca pācaya pācaya sarvabhūtānām | chindaya kīlaya paravidyānāṃ svāhā

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, of all being everywhere, ubiquitous May You sever every fetter and hostile spell!! pin down with the vajra-stake! beyond + of all ignorant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

All, every, complete, of planet, seizing spirit/graha, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: tadyathā akhe makhe samantamukhe sautiyukte nirukte prabhe samayoge citavivarte ame khame madane
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：等虚空无碍，欢乐、三摩耶欢喜尊，普门尊，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道，那罗尊，光明、星星尊，随着不具尊，积累沿革尊，本刹尊，虚空于我，泡沫自然
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: space-like boundlessness (vocative invocation), O gay, jocund, O Universal Gate / in Universal Gate, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), O explained, O light, along with + O separation, piled up + O  evolution, O this / in this, hole + to me, bubble + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

verses.iast: vivarte samantaguṇe satyārame yukte prayukte hili mili masale ānale came aciṭi aciṭi
verses.meaningZh: 沿革尊，普遍功德，谛·此边·于我，具，相应，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相，离名相假立·离一切相无相，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，再三妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: O (period of) evolution, universal + O virtue, truth + the hither + to me, O yoked, harnessed, set to work, appointed, instituted, occupied with,, O yoked, used, employed, acted, proceeded , lent, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

verses.iast: coce arahe bahudche māyugrahe hemavati jyotivati dharmaciti cyutapaṅke avikṣepe radhikṣa me skandhavibhakte
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空，配称尊，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏，护符曜执，具足金尊，具足打败正勤尊，正法积累，没泥尊，无心乱，清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持·造作离相，于我、为我，部派浑然
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), O worthy / in worthy, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), charm + O planet, hemavati, overpower + O one endowed with effort, Dharma + O piled up, gone away + O mud, non-O a putting off, excuse, stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, to me, my, ramification + O undivided
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

Homage to all the tathāgatas, the fulfillers of all wishes! You whose faces are completely motionless, naṭṭa , naṭṭa ! Moṭṭa , moṭṭa ! Saṭṭa , saṭṭa ! Tuṭṭa , tuṭṭa ! Remain, remain! Enter, enter! Āḥ , great crazed youth, dhūṇa , dhūṇa ! Tiṇa , tiṇa ! Eat, eat! Kill the obstacle makers, kill! Devour the rogues, devour! Accomplish everything, accomplish! Kiri , kiri ! Great Vajra of Poison , phaṭ ! Hūṁ , hūṁ , hūṁ , you with a threefold, ruddy curl between your eyebrows, hūṁ , hūṁ , hūṁ ! Acala, ceṭa ! Phaṭ ! Injure, injure, hūṁ , hūṁ ! Asamantikā, trāṭ ! verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵，归命，六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·一切诸谛圆满，归命，广收富人，向诸佛陀俱胝，即说咒曰：嗡！再三莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），一切诸龙族，无边诸部族之，和修吉诸部族之，木匠诸部族之，法螺·婆罗·诸部族之，诸人诸部族之，莲华诸部族之，大红莲华诸部族之，良好部族诸部族之，野猪诸部族之，白莲华诸部族之，想必诸无种之，云诸部族之，云彩诸部族之，云彩诸部族之，花木诸部族之，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，春诸部族之，一样诸部族之，固目答诸部族之，造作离相·因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，胜香诸部族之，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），以箭，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），以宝弓，再三抃掌尊手，以青莲华（优钵罗花），诸惊疑、怖畏之，无畏，请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！转载·惛沈·时，犹如、如同，净水方位，祈请入，年，彼等（宾格复数），龙族、大龙王，成办作持·最上真言离言说，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），再三令部族（佛，再三颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），嗡！作明佛母（咕噜咕列怀爱母）尊，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva, homage to perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (reverent offering), homage to joined + belonging to one's household, Buddha + to, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara again and again, all + of all Nāga, boundless + of all buddha-family, Vasuki + of all buddha-family, cutter + of all buddha-family, conch shell + warden + of all buddha-family, of a serpent-demon + of all buddha-family, lotus flower + of all buddha-family, Mahapadma + of all buddha-family, of good family + of all buddha-family, boar + of all buddha-family, white lotus + of all buddha-family, surely + of all the ichneumon, cloud + of all buddha-family, a cloud + of all buddha-family, cloud + of all buddha-family, thunder-cloud + of all buddha-family, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, spring + of all buddha-family, the same + of all buddha-family, the flower of the white water-lily + of all buddha-family, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks, sweet-scented + of all buddha-family, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, by/through reed, arrow, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, by/through bow, may You cymbal again and again, by/through blue lotus (Utpala), of all frightened, terrified, afraid of, non-fear, give! grant! bestow! forward + dulling or hebetating the mind + black, like, just as, water + holding, may You descent, appearance, varṣaṃ, them, those, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, enacting (imperative seal), accomplish & enact this sacred work! fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, cause to buddha-family, lineage! again and again, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Oṃ! O Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess / in Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Phaṭ!

verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ āḥ hūṁ phaṭ hrīḥ haḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ hī kaṃ hūṁ kīla kīla mahānādākārālavikarālakṣīgṛhaḥ daha daha paca paca siddhidākāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），吽（金刚心印）！再三杵，广大殊胜·能作成办·无我大慈三昧，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），施予成就非身，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — deep samādhi retention, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Hūṃ! a pointed piece of wood again and again, great, making, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, giving success + no-body, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ daṃṣṭrotkaṭabhair avāya saṃ saṃ saṃ ru ru ru ru hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！牙·极了广大·吠，向鸿毛、随一，再三娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! large tooth + exceedingly great + vai, to/for down, off, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ yama jagatakṣobhaya kṣobhaya tāla patāla khāhi khāhi gṛhṇa bali grahāḥ grahāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！狱王，动人·车轴·怖畏，祈请躁动、情感，七多罗树，落衍伸，再三请吞啖、纳受（火供，妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，施食，再三诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! holder, bridle or driver, moving + fear, may You shaking, agitation, emotion! palm-tree, to fall + spawn, devour! consume all calamities! again and again, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），向大怖畏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, great + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ maṁ maṁ raṁ hūṁ hūṁ maṃ rakṣa pālāya hūṁ vajra phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），拥护、守护，向婆罗，吽（金刚心印）！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, protect, guard and shelter! to/for warden, Hūṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ dharaṇī dhara dhara hūṁ hūṁ [insert name] rakṣā kuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！簷，再三请执持、总持护念！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，守护、结界护念，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! support, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, protection, safeguarding, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit amuka , sometimes rendered in Tibetan as che ge mo , is a term marking the point at which one should insert the name of the intended beneficiary

verses.iast: oṁ hrāṃ hrāṃ yaṃ maṃ karāla virālākṣa vaṃ karāla mahāyogeśvara sarvadāyaka svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），风大自在除障种子，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），揭幕广阔、大口，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，揭幕广阔、大口，广大，一切施哪些，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, projecting , opening wide, gaping, ugly, terrible, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, projecting , opening wide, gaping, ugly, terrible, great lord of devotion, one who gives everything + = who, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ śrīṃ kṣīṃ gṛhṇa baliṃ hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，施食，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: madyamāṁsapuṣpadhūparaktatalapātale aṣṭanāgadevayakṣarākṣasa gṛhna idaṃ baliṃ hā hā hā hūṁ khāhi khāhi kha
verses.meaningZh: 滋养增益·无我大慈三昧，八·龙族·天人·坚持下去·解脱自在，执着不，此、此法门，施食，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！再三请吞啖、纳受（火供，佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Nourishing (vocative invocation), eight + Nāga + god + press on + free from Rākṣasas, grasping + not, this, here, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence again and again, Hūṃ! devour! consume all calamities! again and again, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: kha hūṁ jaḥ pheṃ pheṃ haṃ haṃ mahāḍadharahāsa garjja garjja kṛṣṇavarṇī ehe
verses.meaningZh: 佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，再三颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持），再三不动明王因业清净虚空种子，广大殊胜·持守摄受·无我大慈三昧，再三噜噜、音声，深青黑显色，此间尊
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising, Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable again and again, great, bearing, roar, noise, thunder again and again, dark-blue + color, O here / in here
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三莲华妙幻自在种子字（清净摄受），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! lotus-māyā seed syllable Hrīṃ again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ mahākāla hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大黑天护法（摩诃迦罗），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mahākāla, Great Black Dharmapāla, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乐趣·阿难·自在主，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gladden + servant + Īśvara, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ kṣīṃ śrīṃ ho kṣaḥ [insert name] māṁsamāraya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），呼请垂听叹词，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，我祈请时候，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, Ho! O Blessed One! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, me + may You half-year, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads de ba da t+taM , and the Sanskrit reads devadatta . Like the phrase amuka (Tib. che ge mo ), the name devadatta functions in as a placeholder

verses.iast: oṁ kṣīṃ he caṇḍeśvarī hūṁ śrī svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），威猛自在主，吽（金刚心印）！吉祥、圣德威光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, fierce + Īśvara, Hūṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following K and Y tsan De shwa rI and Skt. caṇḍeśvarī . D reads tsaM ha De shwa rI . S reads tsa De shwa rI .

verses.iast: oṁ lāṃ kaṃ kulikeśvarī he pheṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），良好部族自在主，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, of good family + Īśvara, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following Skt. lāṃ kaṃ . D reads lA ke . S reads lA kaM .

verses.iast: oṁ māṃ maheśvarī hūṁ śrī heṃ pheṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！我，大自在天佛母，吽（金刚心印）！吉祥、圣德威光，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! me (the practitioner), Maheśvara, Great Sovereign Lord (feminine), Hūṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ kili vikarāla śrīḥ kṣīṃ kṣīṃ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），闢揭幕广阔，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·涅槃除障点证入），再三乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, settle + projecting, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention with nirvāṇic visarga release, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ caṁ carcaya carcaya hūṁ hrīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三损害、伤残人员，吽（金刚心印）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, may You injure again and again, Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ camuṇḍe daha daha paca paca idaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṁ pheṃ heṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），此、此法门，施食，再三妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，吽（金刚心印）！颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, this, here, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, Hūṃ! fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ hrī hāḥ hūṁ śrī phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！吉祥、圣德威光，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ hūṁ kṣiṃ śrīṃ oṁ ghaṃ [insert name] hi māraya māraya hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），嗡！伽字门（破暗合集（ghana）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，诚然、因为、实乃，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, Oṃ! dissolving dense ignorance (ghana) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, for, indeed, surely, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ kṣiṃ ha hāṁ [insert name] ucchaṭaya hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，不动尊威猛降魔心印，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，高显超胜·妙行迁变空，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, exalting, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ muḥ hāṁ sarvapaśūn staṁbhāya mohāya hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），不动尊威猛降魔心印，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光，向愚痴、无明迷妄，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence (reverent offering), to/for delusion, ignorance, bewilderment, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following RAS H 47 and BnF S 84 sarvapaśūn . D reads sarba pA shu na . This transliteration follows the readings in RAS H 47 and BnF S 84 , which preserve the

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大末，吽（金刚心印）！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! end, Hūṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ mukhaṃ stambhaya [insert name] vaṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！面，请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! mukhaṃ, immobilize! halt hostile forces! beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ hrīḥ maṁ raṁ camuṇḍa haḥ śrī hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吉祥、圣德威光，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ mahilala bhilala bhilala ha hoḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三破有相福德光·离一切相无相，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from conditioned marks again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！伽字门（破暗合集（ghana）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dissolving dense ignorance (ghana) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ haḥ kaha kaha malinimukhe prasādhaya prasādhaya mahākāla buddhajñāṃ prahitosi māraya māraya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三造作离相·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，再三转载请成办，大黑天护法（摩诃迦罗），佛陀觉知，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，再三魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), forward + accomplish! fulfill! perfect! again and again, Mahākāla, Great Black Dharmapāla, Buddha + know, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: kāraya kāraya sarvaduṣṭāṃ praduṣṭān gṛhṇa gṛhṇa mara mara kha kha khāhi khāhi
verses.meaningZh: 再三偈子赞叹、敬礼，一切暴恶者，败坏、糟糕，再三妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，再三临危、死厄，再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），再三请吞啖、纳受（火供
verses.meaningEn: May You hymn of praise again and again, all + wicked, corrupt, bad, wicked, libidinous, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, dying, death again and again, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, devour! consume all calamities! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: śīghraṃ daha daha paca paca hūre hūre maṃ raṃ hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 快，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Śīghraṃ, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: idaṃ baliṃ graha graha śrī svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，施食，再三曜执、星曜鬼神执障，吉祥、圣德威光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: This, here, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, planet, seizing spirit/graha again and again, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ camuṇḍe hana hana daha daha hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṁ hūṁ māṁ maṃ māraya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！我，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One
