verses.meaningZh: 嗡！偈子赞叹·衍伸·巨大·自在主，再三因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），大·形骸·耕，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），不动明王因业清净虚空种子，吽（金刚心印）！向乐趣阿难自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hymn of praise + spawn + exceeding the usual measure + Īśvara, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, great + skeleton + plough, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, Hūṃ! gladden + servant + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大黑天护法（摩诃迦罗），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mahākāla, Great Black Dharmapāla, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！舍在于，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！作昏尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！施度调伏·离名相假立·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! in, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：N and S read mucili .

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā he buddhamātari sarvapāpanāśani garja garja bhañja bhañja marda marda gambhari gambhari hasa hasa dama dama matha matha vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya sarvaśatrūn taramati vimale pūraya pūraya pratijñāna sarvabuddhaparyupasiti bhagavati gana gana jahi jahi vimasani kramaṇi dhavani ramaṇi mātaṅgi ge svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），佛陀·勿·船舶，一切·罪业·摧灭，再三噜噜、音声，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三调伏摧碾一切恶障（末娜），再三甚深法海渊广难测，再三笑声，再三柔善，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，星宿相貌，毘磨利，再三充分、充分称计，协定、约定，一切·佛陀·愈加·阻碍·阿夷尊，世尊佛母！（呼格），再三妙行趣入·离名相假立，再三弃捨尊，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，措施、踥蹀尊，驮劝请，丈夫、小老婆尊，下贱种，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·钩召发起三昧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, Buddha + do not + boat, all + evil + O destroying, roar, noise, thunder again and again, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, subdue and pulverize all evil forces! again and again, profound ocean-like Dharma depth again and again, laughter, mirth again and again, or house, home again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, star + appearance, pure, may You full again and again, agreement, promise, statement, assertion, all + Buddha + beyond + only pf + O dark-coloured, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation again and again, O abandoning, giving up again and again, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O step, dha + request, O = — lover, husband, O elephant, greatest or best of, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā amari amari taṭa bhañja bhañja jha jha mici mici sphoṭaya sphoṭaya matha matha durdāntadamaka svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三仙人、天神尊，坡度、海滨，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三酇字门（除灭灾患（jhamara）·本不生体性），再三无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），师子·调·忧苦，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, O immortal again and again, slope, declivity, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, quelling calamity & affliction — primordial non-arising again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, badly tamed or hard to tame + tame + not-joy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyā sarvathā he he kinade sarvatathāgatabhaneke bhodhiṃ dada trāṭa trāṭa hūṁ phaṭ hūṁ phaṭ garja garja paramati vihurike svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，一切·面门·富人，诸相本，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），造作离相·离名相假立·施度调伏，一切如来·宣说·一，破有相福德光·法界总持任持，施予，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！再三噜噜、音声，最胜、第一、无上，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + face + belonging to one's household, in all ways, by all means, at all, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas + speak + O one, blessedness transcending existence & Dharma-realm retention, giving, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! Phaṭ! roar, noise, thunder again and again, supreme, highest, ultimate, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This follows Toh 497. Toh 499 reads hUM hUM phaT phaT .

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā bhagavati prajñāpāramite a sarvapāpakṣayaṅkari jñānārcisparaṇi bhañja bhañja matha matha dama dama ānaya ānaya sara sara māraya māraya sarvabuddhajanetrīyai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，世尊佛母！（呼格），般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸）尊，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，圣智了知·生起不可得·尊胜，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三柔善，再三离名相假立·一乘如实之道，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三魔、天魔烦恼障，觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā) / in Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, making (vocative invocation), knowing (vocative invocation), shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, or house, home again and again, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, awakened (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā garja garja matha matha dama dama bhañja bhañja dundubhi sarvanirghoṣe hana hana vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya moṭaya moṭaya daha daha vipulanirmalanirjāte āhara āhara gaccha gaccha sarvabuddhaparyupasatim mā vilamba svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三噜噜、音声，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三柔善，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，大鼓，一切责任，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！再三满陀，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），广大·净无垢秽·揭帝，再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！再三去吧、趣向菩提！觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, roar, noise, thunder again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, or house, home again and again, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, drum, all + O blame, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again, may You mota again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, vast + utterly spotless + O gone or come forth or out, bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, go! proceed! again and again, awakened, do not, let not, hanging down, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā oṁ bhagavati sarvatathāgatajanika pūraya pratijñāna taṭa taṭa marda marda āhara āhara hūṁ hūṁ jati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，嗡！世尊佛母！（呼格），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，祈请充分、充分称计，协定、约定，再三坡度、海滨，再三调伏摧碾一切恶障（末娜），再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, Oṃ! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, may You full, agreement, promise, statement, assertion, slope, declivity again and again, subdue and pulverize all evil forces! again and again, bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā hūṁ hrī sarvabuddhamātiri bhañja bhañja matha matha damani damani gargāri gargāri hrī svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，吽（金刚心印）！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三要胁、调御士马匹尊，再三雷音震吼破除诸障，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, Hūṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, awakened (vocative invocation), shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, O taming, controlling, chastising again and again, thundering roar dispelling hindrances again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā trāṭa trāṭa muhu muhu sarvapāpaviśodhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三突然、赶快，一切·罪业·闢·理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, suddenly, at once again and again, all + evil + settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā dhaka dhaka moṭa moṭa daha daha sarvatathāgatajñānanirjāte svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三法界总持任持·造作离相，再三满陀，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切如来·圣智·揭帝，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again, mota again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all Tathagatas + primordial wisdom + O gone or come forth or out, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā ha ha mihu mihu dama dama khāhi khāhi dhuna dhuna mici mici durdāntadamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐，再三柔善，再三请吞啖、纳受（火供，再三护摩献供·法界总持任持，再三无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，师子要胁，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal) again and again, or house, home again and again, devour! consume all calamities! again and again, offering oblation again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, badly tamed or hard to tame + O taming, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā mici mici garja garja sphoṭaya sphoṭaya matha matha dama dama svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切如来，向诸一切面门，诸相本，再三无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，再三噜噜、音声，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三柔善，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to all all Tathagatas, all + to all face, in all ways, by all means, at all, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, roar, noise, thunder again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, or house, home again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！绀青金刚，急躁宝树宝山，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sapphire-blue + Vajra, irritable + tree or mountain, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! emptiness + primordial wisdom + Vajra + own-being + son, I, the awakened self

verses.meaningEn: Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sapphire-blue + garment + hold! bear! sustain! + Vajrapāṇi, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṃ āḥkāro mukhaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ādyantapanna tathā oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，面，诸诸法之，起讫·微妙·不，如是、亦复如是，嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, mukhaṃ, of all things, beginning and end + be wonderful + not, thus, in that same way, Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毗沙门天王（多闻天王），彼眷属，三摩惹，金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，吽（金刚心印）！金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子，嗡！嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！毗沙门天王（多闻天王），请钩召、慈悲摄引善法！吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, he + accessory, assembly, Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable, Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, attract! summon! draw near! Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṃ amṛtakuṇḍalī hana hana hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露军荼利，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! amṛtakuṇḍalī, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṃ nīlāmbaradharavajrapāṇi ājñāpayati imaṃ baligṛhnantu Samayarakṣantu Mama sarvasiddhiṃ me prayacchantu mama karmāmogha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！绀青·天衣·请执持·金刚手菩萨，命令·净水·戒精进，此（真言，解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，三昧耶愿诸尊普皆守护！我之（行者所有），一切悉地，于我、为我，乐趣愿悉喜，我之（行者所有），事不空，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sapphire-blue + garment + hold! bear! sustain! + Vajrapāṇi, command + water + as many, this (accusative), spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), Samaya + may they all protect! my, of me (the practitioner), all + Siddhi, to me, my, pleasure + may they close by, my, of me (the practitioner), actions + unfailing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！毗沙门天王即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa + thus, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向瞻巴拉财神（宝藏神），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Jambhala, Wealth-Bestowing Deity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！圆满充盈·第一义谛，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! fulfilling (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Manibhadra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Kubera, the chief of the spirits of darkness, afterwards the god of riches, the regen, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毗沙门天王（多闻天王），灯，吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, light, lamp, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, O smell, odour, fragrance, fragrant substance, perfume, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, O offering of eatables to a deity / in offering of eatables to a deity, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṃ vaiśravaṇaya chegemo māraya phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！祈请毗沙门天王（多闻天王），离覆障清凉·妙行趣入·无我大慈三昧，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! may You Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King! coolness free of obscuration & awakened spiritual movement & selfless great loving-kindness, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向毗沙门天王（多闻天王），财增益，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），凡彼等诸有情，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, treasure + nourishment, accomplish & enact this sacred work! those who, whoever (pl.), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毗沙门天王出，息灾、寂静、安隐，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa + O income, peace, pacification, tranquility, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！毗沙门天王（多闻天王），清净离诸尘垢·无住安立·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, stainless purity free from dust & non-abiding equipoise & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṃ vajrapāṇi nīlāmbaradhara vajrasphoṭa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），绀青持天衣尊，金刚请摧裂，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, sapphire-blue + holder of garment, Vajra + burst asunder! shatter obstacles! Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立！向如来（乘如实道来成正觉）；向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，向正等正觉、正遍知；即说咒曰：再三珍宝、摩尼宝尊，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)! To/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One To the Arhat, Worthy One, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha Thus goes the mantra: O jewel, precious gem, treasure / in jewel, precious gem, treasure again and again, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Oṁ , ra ra ! Do remember! O perfect teacher possessing the form of a divine youth! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，真如实际·离覆障清凉·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·钩召发起三昧），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，放光勇健，一乘如实之道·无住安立，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising again and again, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, immutable Suchness & coolness free of obscuration & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — samādhi invocation, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, shine + O strong, supreme vehicle of awakening & non-abiding equipoise, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt.: namaḥ sarvatathāgatānām acintyāpratihataśāsanānāṃ oṁ ra ra smara | apratihataśāsana kumārarūpadhāriṇa hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，时色，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），大空无碍法界虚空种子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, black + form, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！离名相假立·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！以诸了知、聪明，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! by/with knowing, versed in, conversant or familiar with, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！施愿者、满善愿尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! boon-granting, wish-bestowing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！聪慧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！迅疾、踊跃尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！闢具世间，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! settle + possessing world, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！吉祥、圣德威光
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , Jayā , svāhā ! Vijayā , svāhā ! Ajitā, svāhā ! Aparājitā, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！誓耶，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无能胜佛母，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Jayā, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! for victory, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! unsurpassed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Aparājitā, the Unconquerable Goddess, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , you disfigured graha! Huṁ phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一乘如实之道，施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement, planet, seizing spirit/graha, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ kālumelu kālumelu stambhaya śilāvarṣaṃ tuṣāravarṣaṃ ca lucca i lucca i svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！玻璃年，牸牛年以及高显超胜·离一切相无相，悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，高显超胜·离一切相无相，悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again, immobilize! halt hostile forces! a precious stone, cold and exalting, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, exalting, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ garuḍa haṃsa he he cala cala svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！迦楼罗（金翅鸟王），鹅，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Garuḍa, golden-winged bird king, goose, also applied to the swan, flamingo and like water-fowl, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ he he tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha dhāraya dhāraya nirundhaya nirundhaya devadattam ūrṇāmaṇe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三安住加持，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三方位，再三离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，天授，白毫称计粒子尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, may You holding, bearing! again and again, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention again and again, characterized by conduct like  D.  and  U, urna + O a measure of grain, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ nihi nicule abhayaṃkari elu velu śila pa ḍa i jahaṃ pelu āgāsapantharate ha attaṃdhari khili mo ḍi them bhi jakāre jā hi ṭhakāre hi ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐，宝树诗人尊，淫媒罪安全性尊，翳啰，薛罗，耳根，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性），悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，弃捨，媲罗，妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，持守摄受·真如实际，硬度尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·诸根清净自在），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·钩召发起三昧），婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，生起不可得·尊胜·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，诚然、因为、实乃，妙音半字尊，诚然、因为、实乃，再三姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), O of a tree a poet / in of a tree a poet, O procuring safety, elu, bamboo, an ear of corn left on the field the gleaning of it, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, abandoning, giving up, pelu, awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, bearing (vocative invocation), O hardness, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, pacifying conflict & turmoil — purified faculties, selfless great loving-kindness — samādhi invocation, blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — purified faculties, transcending birth & victorious & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — expansive quiescence, for, indeed, surely, O the sound or letter / in the sound or letter, for, indeed, surely, beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṁ ambāsimbāka pyāsu jom mo phe ḍa i du pyāsu
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！母·那罗·忧苦，于诸膨胀、溢出中，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧），荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性），悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，于诸膨胀、溢出中
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! mother + of a man + not-joy, in swell, overflow, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation, pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — dispelling sorrow, in swell, overflow

verses.iast: Oṁ , Ambāsimbāka, pyāsu jom mo phe ḍa i du pyāsu !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！母·那罗·忧苦，于诸膨胀、溢出中，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧），荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性），悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，于诸膨胀、溢出中
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! mother + of a man + not-joy, in swell, overflow, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation, pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — dispelling sorrow, in swell, overflow

verses.iast: eṣotthito hulu hulu jvālājihve hulu hulu yatraivotthito hulu hulu tatraiva pratigacchatu hulu hulu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 急促事关已起，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），光焰舌尊，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），凡于何处·犹如·已起，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），于彼处犹如，对愿去吧，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Rushing on, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, blaze + O tongue, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, where + like, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, there + like, toward + may it go! proceed!! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ padme padmākṣi padmasubhage phura phura phura
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，莲华睛，莲华幸运，再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), lotus flower + eye, lotus flower + O lucky, fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ mocani mocaya mokṣaṇi mokṣaya jīvaṃvarade svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！解放尊，请解脱、令离系缚！自由化尊，祈请解脱、自在离缚，长寿护命·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O delivering from, hurling, liberate! set free! release! O freeing, delivering, may You liberation, emancipation! vitalizing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , Mocanī, release! O Mokṣaṇī, set free! O Jīvaṃvaradā, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！解放佛母，清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，自由化佛母，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），清净离诸尘垢，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，长寿护命·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! delivering from, hurling, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, freeing, delivering, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, vitalizing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ harimarkaṭanāmasahasrabāhur devadattaṃ bandhanād mocaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！哈利·猴·名为·千武器，天授，结界系缚·解脱系缚大力，请解脱、令离系缚！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! fallow + ape + by name + having a thousand arms, characterized by conduct like  D.  and  U, binding obstacles, liberate! set free! release! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ tāraṇi tāraya mocani mocaya mokṣaṇi mokṣaya jīvaṃvarade svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！弯曲、超群尊，祈请星，解放尊，请解脱、令离系缚！自由化尊，祈请解脱、自在离缚，长寿护命·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O carrying over, rescuing, may You a star! O delivering from, hurling, liberate! set free! release! O freeing, delivering, may You liberation, emancipation! vitalizing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , Tāraṇī, liberate! Mocanī, release! Mokṣaṇī, set free! Jivaṃvaradā, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！弯曲、超群佛母，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，解放佛母，清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，自由化佛母，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），清净离诸尘垢，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carrying over, rescuing, freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), delivering from, hurling, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), freeing, delivering, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ tāre tu tāre ture mokṣaya jīvaṃvarade svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！星尊，然而、而、实则，星尊，迅疾、踊跃尊，祈请解脱、自在离缚，长寿护命·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a star / in a star, but, indeed, moreover, O a star / in a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, may You liberation, emancipation! vitalizing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , Tārā, powerful Tārā, please liberate! O Jivaṃvaradā, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！圣救度佛母（度母），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，圣救度佛母（度母），第一义谛·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Tārā, Savioress Goddess, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, Tārā, Savioress Goddess, ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: eraṇḍasya vane kāko gaṅgātīram upasthitaḥ | pibatu dūtaḥ pānīyaṃ viśalyā bhavatu gurviṇī
verses.meaningZh: 伊兰树之，园，老鸭，恒迦河堤岸，临；愿饮用，使卒，饮用、饮料，不是点子、解脱自在，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，大肚子、孕妇
verses.meaningEn: Of the castor-oil plant, O free from lust, kāko, Ganges River, to overlook May it drinking! dūtaḥ, drinkable, having no point, may it be, let there be! pregnant, a pregnant woman
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无死，活·对治·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! non-O to die, live + opposite, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无死佛母，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），活末佛母
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! non-to die (feminine), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, live + end
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！尊足短暂裤子尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! foot + O a waist-cloth used by a nun, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！尊足短暂裤子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! foot + a waist-cloth used by a nun, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毗舍遮（啖精气鬼）佛母，叶衣佛母（除疫山林母）尊，一切·灾横·摧灭，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Piśāca, flesh/energy-eating spirit (feminine), O Parṇaśabarī, Leaf-Clad Healing Goddess, all + calamity + O destroying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Oṁ , demoness Parṇaśabarī! Remover of all misfortunes, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，叶衣佛母（除疫山林母），清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, Parṇaśabarī, Leaf-Clad Healing Goddess, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ adya tṛtīyā amukasya cakṣuḥ stambhaya ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！今日，第三，某甲之，目，请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! now, the third, of a certain person, eye, immobilize! halt hostile forces! beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！威猛·大·激愤，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! fierce + great + angry, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！威猛·大·激愤，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! fierce + great + angry, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṁ kāśe syanda kuśe syanda syanda tvaṃ śūnyaveśmani mama tvaṃ tathā syanda yathā syandasi vajriṇaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！种类草本尊，做出、结果，吉祥草，再三做出、结果，汝、圣尊您，空·房·在于，我之（行者所有），汝、圣尊您，如是、亦复如是，做出、结果，犹如、如…所说，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a kind of grass / in a kind of grass, issue, outcome, result, O grass, the sacred grass used at rel, issue, outcome, result again and again, Thou, You, empty + in, my, of me (the practitioner), Thou, You, thus, in that same way, issue, outcome, result, just as, according to, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！圣智光明，三·珍宝·笛·擎尊，世尊佛母！（呼格），无畏，施物尊，无畏，施度调伏·真如实际，于我、为我，菩提心·金刚·请周遍护持，以普现，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! primordial wisdom + O light, three + jewel + tradition + O supporting, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! non-fear, O gift, non-fear, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), to me, my, aspiration to enlightenment + Vajra + completely protect and sustain! samantāvabhāsena, strike down afflictions and mara-forces!

verses.iast: hana sarvasattvasaṃtānapatitaṃ kleśān ucchedaya varalakṣaṇālaṃkṛtaśarīre bodhisattvaśiśūn paripālaya buddhān ādeśaya devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragān vaśe sthāpaya

verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! all sentient beings + saṃ + thread, affliction, mental defilement, may You cutting off! width + without characteristic mark + adornment + O body, awakening, completely protect and sustain! Buddha, the Awakened One, may You account, information, prophecy, shining + tree or mountain + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara + Mahoraga, O on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, cause to standing, living, being in, occupied with, devoted to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 892 reads triratnapaṃśasaṃdhāraṇi .

verses.meaningZh: 无畏，施予，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Non-fear, giving, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: tadyathā | pūrṇamanorathe doho doho yāvat sūryāvabhāsatā yāvad candre daudante tāvād rakṣamān daṇḍaparihāraṃ kuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：富楼那希望，再三也他，乃至，日轮境界，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，月轮、清凉满月尊，施度调伏·离名相假立·真如实际，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，守护本刹，金刚杖回答，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Purna + O wish, milking again and again, how, sun + state of, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, O moon, lunar disc / in moon, lunar disc, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, protect + this, staff + watchful care, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556: pūrṇamnorathe duhu duhu duhu yāvat candra daudatte dāvād arakṣamān daṇạparihāram kuru svāhā . The Chinese transliterations in YJ and BG are very close

verses.iast: tadyathā | uttoli ciriciri uttorā torāṇāṃ śānto śānto uttoli hulu hulu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：真如实际·离一切相无相，久远常恒护持不退久远常恒护持不退，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，再三静，真如实际·离一切相无相，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness + enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, śānto again and again, immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | uttoli ciriciri uttorā toranaṃ śānto śānto attoli hulu hulu svāhā .

verses.iast: tadyathā | daṇṭhike paṇṭhike karaṭhā kauraṭhi keyūre dantele svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：施度调伏·离诸诤论无诤·远离虚妄安立，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·远离虚妄安立，能作成办·造作离相，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·远离虚妄安立，璎珞尊，牙大地，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Generosity & self-mastery & conflict-free peace & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), making, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, tooth + O = + speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | daṇṭhike vaṇṭhike karaṭhī kauraṭhi kaiyūre tantili svāhā .

verses.iast: tadyathā | śiri śiri dima dimani dhari dharini śiri śiriṇi viśalā viśālā vaśa vaśani bandhniye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三头尊，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，请执持、总持护念！尊，持守摄受·法界总持任持，头尊，具头尊，闢隙弃罗，广博、广大清净，因为、截至所以，受支配尊，结界系缚·解脱系缚大力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.iast: tadyathā | hari hariṇi ciri ciriṇi karimāṇi saṃkarimāṇi sāma vāsani jambhani stambhani mohani svayaṃbhūkke svāhā

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Fallow, yellowish, greenish, O bearer of carry away (suffering)! remove! enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness, O bearer of lasting a long time, action + this, saṃ + action + this, dark, O impression, result, O crushing, destroying, O laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | hari hariṇi ciri ciriṇi karimāṇi saṅkarimāṇi sambāsani jambhani stambhani mohani svamūkke svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三最上真言离言说·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，具临危、死厄尊，再三罪垢、魔掌，闢驮，一同么，再三离一切相无相，再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），真如实际·离一切相无相·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, O bearer of dying, death, sin, depravity again and again, settle + dha, O come! go to! well! often repeated or / in come! go to! well! often repeated or, freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | vitori vitori mariṇi kali kali vidho hanati lulu lulu culu culu toluva toluva śaśa śaccha variśa svasti sarva satvānāṃ siddhyantu mama

verses.iast: tolūva śaśa śaccha pariśa svasti sarva satvānāṃ siddhyantu mama mantrapādāni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离一切相无相·最上真言离言说，兔，本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，一切、普皆遍满，诸有情、众生、勇猛心之，愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，我之（行者所有），真言一切尊足，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech, hare, primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, all, every, complete, of all sentient being, living creature, courage, may the mantra words be fully accomplished! my, of me (the practitioner), Mantra + foot, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | vitori vitori mariṇi kali kali vidho hanati lulu lulu culu culu toluva toluva śaśa śaccha variśa svasti sarva satvānāṃ siddhyantu mama

verses.meaningEn: Abandoning, giving up, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), abandoning, giving up again and again, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation) again and again, ambrosia + O teacher, much + O a kind of hemp, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & spiritual strength freeing bonds, O part, proportion, measure, sort, kind

verses.iast: heke vinda vileni amṛluteki vaijuyu vaijuyu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·造作离相，发现物、优胜，闢卫护归依，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·真如实际，再三最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), finding, winning, settle + O refuge, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | jaha jaharu jaha jaha jaharu vailuke amṛteghaṇe puruśaṇe vairutike varubatte vidhi hike vinda vilini amṛlutike bhaijuyu bhaijuyu svāhā .

verses.iast: tadyathā | sari śari śiriṇi mite mite kari kari heru heru curu curu bandhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）尊，箭尊，具头尊，再三有限、干脆尊，再三大象尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O flow forth and pervade with blessing! O reed, arrow, śiriṇi, O measured, defined, limited again and again, O an elephant again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In Toh 556 the dhāraṇī is the same: tadyathā | sari śari śiriṇi mitemite kari kari heru heru curu curu bandhani svāhā .

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), buddha-family + do not + O blessed, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to fall + Thou art, śiri again and again, awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, of all all sentient beings, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | haricaṇḍalike kulamābhate toraśipata patasi śiri śiri gaśiri gaviśiri svasti sarvasatvānāṃ svāhā .

verses.iast: siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣani mukte vimukte amale vimale damale māṅgale hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe
verses.meaningZh: 成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，解脱在于，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，调严，无我大慈三昧·支分寂静·妙行趣入，金胎神尊，宝藏尊
verses.meaningEn: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, liberation + in, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, tame, selfless great loving-kindness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels

verses.iast: samantabhadre sarvārtha sādhani manase mahāmanase adbhute atyadbhute araje viraje acyute amṛte araje
verses.meaningZh: 普贤菩萨（遍吉）尊，一切义利、一切所求善愿，成就法、能成办尊，那罗、天女尊，大那罗，希尊，多数微妙尊，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，嚩啰阇尊，坚固尊，甘露、不死妙法尊，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: O Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva / in Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva, all aims and benefits, O accomplishing, means of attainment (Sādhana), O of man, of a goddess, = / in of man, of a goddess, =, great + O of man, O extraordinary, O most wonderful / in most wonderful, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), O free from dust, O unshaken, firm, imperishable, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣani mukte vimukte amale vimale damale māṅgale hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe samantabhadre sarvārtha sādhana

verses.iast: viraje prahme prahma svarepūraṇi pūraṇi manorathe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嚩啰阇尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，圆满充盈·一切诸谛圆满，遂尊，希望、贪欲尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O free from dust, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, fulfilling (vocative invocation), O satisfy, O wish, desire, fancy / in wish, desire, fancy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 556 has tadyathā | siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣani mukte vimukte amale vimale damale māṅgale hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe samantabhadre sarvārtha sādhana

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya | tadyathā | kuṭi kuṭini imirito koṣaṇi imiriṇi irī svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！即说咒曰：庵，庵在于，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)! Thus goes the mantra: Cottage, cottage + in, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 19.a–151.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·大王！

verses.iast: rara rara kuno kuno khuno khuno ruṇo ruṇo saba saba kara kara

verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust again and again, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation again and again, offering oblation again and again, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds again and again, palm again and again

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.iast: namo vaiśravaṇāya mahādhanadāya caṇḍeśvarāya ākarṣa aparājita caṇḍeśvara paramakāruṇika sarvasatvāhitacintā [say your name] mama dhanavardho parameśvara svayaṃ ākarṣaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向毗沙门天王（多闻天王），向大施财，向威猛自在主，抽，无能胜、不可摧伏，威猛自在主，最胜具悲心者，一切众生·穿上·思，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，归命、敬礼尊，我之（行者所有），财杯子，童子大王，亲自、自然本具，请钩召、慈悲摄引善法！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, great + to, fierce + to, to draw out, invincible, unconquered, fierce + Īśvara, supreme + compassionate, all sentient beings + put on + thought, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, my, of me (the practitioner), treasure + cup, a rich or noble lord, a prince or king, oneself, spontaneously, attract! summon! draw near! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 向希望般充分，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼种类小鸟、男人·佛陀、觉者！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·俱吠滥·大王·太王！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼吉祥、圣德威光·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三报刊往外清净，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），摩尼宝珠黄金

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Degé version of Toh 556. The Degé of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，无我大慈三昧·造作离相·真如实际，向湖饮料，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，口彩，毗沙门天王（多闻天王），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，再三善来降临坛场（翳呬），勿搭拉，再三索索、滴溜溜，再三他人之，施予饶益·施度调伏，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·造作离相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, a lake + to, of all all sentient beings, well-wishing, Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), come forth, O Blessed One! again and again, do not + hanging down, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again, of someone else again and again, granting (vocative invocation), my, of me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Degé version of Toh 556. The Degé of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningEn: False + of wish, darśanaṃ, my, of me (the practitioner), pride, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Degé version of Toh 556. The Degé of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.meaningEn: Win + O Dhāraṇī, upholding (vocative invocation), press out + O fixed, press out + by name, O well grounded or situated / in well grounded or situated, supreme victory! triumph! + power, equally + that + claim, press out + height, primordial wisdom + toward + O as, favour + bed or course of a river, consecrate! anoint with nectar! + in, to + eternal from the standpoint of common experience, O one endowed with auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, press out + before + clinging to, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened spiritual movement, to + speaking, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三边框，持守摄受·离名相假立，离名相假立·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，世间、世界，世间在于，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，再三把手眼目

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·真如实际，那罗，离名相假立·造作离相·真如实际，回犯尊，冤家尊，清净、纯洁无染尊，除此之外，毘磨利，光净尊，离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，洁白、清净白色尊

verses.iast: simi simi sumu sumu caṇḍa caṇḍa cara cara, sara sara kara kara
verses.meaningZh: 再三一切、一切处尊，再三一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，再三威猛、暴烈除障，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三掌

verses.iast: kili kili kuru kuru muru muru curu curu sandhāya ātmanām nitatyan antardhātu
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），赢得一层，我自然，在于·彼·假定今日，裏界
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, win + layer, self + certainly, in + That + suppose now, interior + realm

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命向极微妙音自然，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + sound + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Degé of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 向施财，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for giving money or wealth, munificent, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 向希望般充分，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Wish + wisdom + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Degé of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼种类小鸟、男人·佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a kind of bird, Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·俱吠滥·大王·太王！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, king of the Yakṣas, of Kubera, great king, very, to!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼吉祥、圣德威光·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三报刊往外清净，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），摩尼宝珠黄金，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, press out + pure again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, Maṇi jewel + gold, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, adornment, a lake + to, of all all sentient beings, well-wishing, Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), come forth, O Blessed One! again and again, do not + hanging down, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 再三他人之，施予饶益·施度调伏，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·造作离相·离名相假立

verses.meaningEn: Covering, protection or protector (plural), spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, do not + tooth + this, immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) again and again, Gauri, bearing (vocative invocation), O a Candala or outcast, O elephant, greatest or best of, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), bowing, bearing (vocative invocation), stain + in, granting (vocative invocation), wheel + down + inactive, superiority + eager, savari, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O flower, O having beautiful flowers / in having beautiful flowers, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), noble + O cut, peace, pacification, tranquility, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, praise + to Thee, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, and Choné versions of Toh 555 and Toh 556. The Degé of Toh 556 has āryapuśaste .

verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), O a man's name, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), uniting (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，离好好儿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“It is thus: O one who has gone well, who has departed, who has departure! svāhā .” The Bhagji edition has sugate vigate vigatāvati svāhā . The Nobel edition

verses.meaningZh: 息尊，危尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O rest / in rest, O perilous / in perilous, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Blissful (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向大海三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 向部派仙人，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ramification + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向无能胜精进，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向雪山三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 冥合融摄·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Uniting (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·婆罗门！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, O brahmanhood, brahmanic condition / in brahmanhood, brahmanic condition!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.iast: namaḥ sarasvatyai devyai sidhyantu mantrapadā daṃ brahma anumanyatu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向妙音天女（辩才天），向天女、佛母明妃，愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，真言章句、密咒句义，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，神父，日复一日愿持心，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，恶鬼尊，久尊，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，鸿毛速，因缘空寂大乐·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入·本性寂静止息，胡椒尊，法会大众，第十，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，弯曲、超群，感觉辐条，妙行迁变空·第一义谛·真如实际，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，胡椒尊，相投，世尊尊，随一刻薄，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍，无碍、无能障碍尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，佛陀、觉者尊，再三恶鬼，摩诃室利，对·执着·不·不·竹子
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, O of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa / in of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa, O lasting a long time / in lasting a long time, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), down + hastening, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), O the pepper shrub, assembly, the tenth, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), crossing, surpassing, overcoming, perceive + spoke of a wheel, awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O the pepper shrub, O leader, guide, O supreme one of the world / in supreme one of the world, mostly ) look + O unkind, perfected (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness, O unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded / in unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, of a demon again and again, Mahādevī, toward + grasping + not + not + bamboo
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan .

verses.iast: tadyathā | mahāprabhavā hili hili mili mili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：大光或，再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Exceedingly brilliant + or, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Lithang and Choné versions have mahāprabhava .

verses.meaningZh: 乌鸦尊，璎珞尊，具足璎珞尊，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: O an elephant's temple or cheek, O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, O one endowed with a bracelet worn on the upper arm, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Bhagji edition has kadārake yuvati . The Nobel edition has karaṭe keyūre keyūrabati .

verses.iast: tadyathā | hili hili hili mili hili mili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the Yongle version, hili hili is absent. The Kangxi has hasa hasa .

verses.iast: syād yathedam pratipūrṇavare samantavedanagate mahākāryapratiprāpaṇe sattvārtha samatānuprapūre ayānadharmitāmahābhogine mahāmaitre upasaṃhihe saṃgṛhīte samarthānupālane svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，充分殊胜，普遍·吠陀·宝山，大·果·对·领军向着，有情义利，萨麻丹理想尊，持守摄受·广大殊胜·一乘如实之道，大慈爱，愈加·一层·于此，向桑在家人汝，功能·日复一日·守护尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, full + O choicest, universal + Vedas + mountain, great + to be done + toward + O leading towards, sentient being + meaning, to + O fulfilling, bearing, great (vocative invocation), great + O friendly, thereto + layer + O here, saṃ + become a house or habitation + to Thee, ability + day after day + O keeping, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: cili cili curu curu kuru kuru kuṭu kuṭu toṭu toṭu vaha vaha variṣe variṣe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，再三最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 151.b–273.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

verses.iast: tadyathā | añcani kyalikṣani śiśidhari haha hihi kuruvare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：圣智通达·妙行迁变空·离名相假立，造作离相·一乘如实之道·离一切相无相，持守摄受·本性寂静止息，因缘空寂大乐，因缘空寂大乐，祈请成办羯磨事业殊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), bearing (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), accomplish & enact this sacred work! + O choicest, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 151.b–273.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

verses.iast: tadyathā | śiri śiri vāśakati tati kuṭṭi pūta pūderi pūderi tiṭe pati kukuṭi kapacili svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三头尊，叫声多少，如此众多，系缚尊，第一义谛·真如实际，再三第一义谛·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·断除憍慢执障，君，大地庵，种类神明积集一切白净善法功德，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Śiri again and again, roaring + how many? some, so many, O reviling?, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), prince, earth + cottage, a class of gods + gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
