verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼神父！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to priest!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼因陀逻！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Śakra king of the gods!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，诸大王之
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, of all great king
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.iast: hili hili mili mili gauri mahāgauri gandhari mahāgandhari drimiḍi mahādrimiḍi daṇḍakhukhunti haha
verses.meaningZh: 再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），娇吠哩尊，大娇吠哩尊，持守摄受·妙行趣入，广大殊胜·持守摄受·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，护摩献供·施度调伏，因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, O Gauri, great + O Gauri, bearing (vocative invocation), great, bearing (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), great (vocative invocation), offering oblation (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.iast: haha hihi hihi huhu huhu halodhame gudhame caca caca cici cici cucu
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐，再三因缘空寂大乐，再三乾陀罗，耕·驮·于我，妙行趣入·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，再三妙行迁变空，再三妙行迁变空，妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation) again and again, of a Gandharva again and again, dha + to me, awakened spiritual movement & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.iast: cucu caṇḍeśvara śikhara śikhara atiṣṭhāhe bhagavān saṃvidjñāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空，威猛自在主，再三山尖，超群呼唤圣尊叹词，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，向分别事识了知，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal), fierce + Īśvara, peaked again and again, surpassing + O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, consciousness + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 555. The Degé version of Toh 556 has atiṣṭhahe .

verses.iast: tadyathā | sukṛte kṛtakamalanīlajinakarate haṃkarāte indrajali śakaddre vaśaddre avartakasike nakutra kukavilakavimalamati śīlamati sandhidhudhumamavati śiśiri satyasthite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：好事、功德尊，所作·妙莲华·绀青·胜者·掌，不动明王因业清净虚空种子·掌·架子，因陀逻净水尊，本性寂静止息·造作离相·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，不何处，造作离相·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，戒律，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·法界总持任持，冬尽尊，谛立尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O a good deed, virtue, merit, done + lotus blossom + sapphire-blue + Victor + palm, Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable + palm + O frame, Śakra king of the gods + O water, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), not + where? whither? on what account? for what purpose? With indef, freedom from karmic agency & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), śīlamati, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), O the cool or dewy season, hoar, frost, dew, truth + O standing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to Toh 557 and the Sanskrit. The Kangxi version of Toh 557 has sukrite . Toh 555 and 556 have sute kṛte . The Yongle, Kangxi, and Narthang versions

verses.iast: syād yathedaṃ arake nayane hile mile gile khikhile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，领军、作法尊，因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，妙行趣入·离一切相无相，等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), O a man's name, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), uniting (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit is transliterated as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ): “It should be thus.”

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，离好好儿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), lost + O well, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–62.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 息尊，危尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O rest / in rest, O perilous / in perilous, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Blissful (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向大海三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ocean + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向部派仙人，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ramification + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向无能胜精进，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 向雪山三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 冥合融摄·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Uniting (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·婆罗门！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, O brahmanhood, brahmanic condition / in brahmanhood, brahmanic condition!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙音天女（辩才天）·天女、佛母明妃！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, goddess, sacred female deity!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.iast: sidhyantu mantrapadā daṃ brahma anumanyatu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，真言章句、密咒句义，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，神父，日复一日愿持心，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May all mantra-padas succeed! sacred mantra phrase, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, priest, day after day + may it thinking one's self-, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.meaningZh: 恶鬼尊，久尊
verses.meaningEn: O of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa / in of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa, O lasting a long time / in lasting a long time
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，鸿毛速
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), down + hastening
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.iast: pigalavati maguśe marici samati daśamati agrimagri tara citara capati cicirī śirimiri marici
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入·本性寂静止息，胡椒尊，法会大众，第十，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，弯曲、超群，感觉辐条，妙行迁变空·第一义谛·真如实际，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，胡椒尊
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), O the pepper shrub, assembly, the tenth, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), crossing, surpassing, overcoming, perceive + spoke of a wheel, awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O the pepper shrub
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.iast: praṇaye lokajyeṣṭhe lokapriye siddhiprite vimamukhiśucikharī apratihate apratehata buddhe namuci namuci mahādevī pratigṛhnanamaskaraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 相投，世尊尊，随一刻薄，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍，无碍、无能障碍尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，佛陀、觉者尊，再三恶鬼，摩诃室利，对·执着·不·不·竹子
verses.meaningEn: O leader, guide, O supreme one of the world / in supreme one of the world, mostly ) look + O unkind, perfected (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness, O unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded / in unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, of a demon again and again, Mahādevī, toward + grasping + not + not + bamboo
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan transliterates this phrase as syād yathedan (for syād yathedaṃ ).

verses.iast: tadyathā | mahāprabhavā hili hili mili mili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：大光或，再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Exceedingly brilliant + or, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Lithang and and Choné versions have mahāprabhava .

verses.iast: karaṭe keyūre keyūravati hili mili hili mili hili hili
verses.meaningZh: 乌鸦尊，璎珞尊，具足璎珞尊，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: O an elephant's temple or cheek, O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, O one endowed with a bracelet worn on the upper arm, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Bhagji edition has kadārake yuvati . The Nobel edition has karaṭe keyūre keyūrabati .

verses.iast: tadyathā | hili hili hili mili, hili mili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the Yongle version, hili hili is absent. The Kangxi has hasa hasa .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–62.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam pratipūrṇavare samantavedanagate mahākāryapratiprāpaṇe sattvārthasamatānuprapūre ayāna dharmatā mahābhogine mahāmaitre upasaṃhihe saṃgṛhīte samarthānupālane
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，充分殊胜，普遍·吠陀·宝山，大·果·对·领军向着，有情·义利·萨麻丹·理想尊，即是不，实相，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，大慈爱，愈加·一层·于此，向桑在家人汝，功能·日复一日·守护尊
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, full + O choicest, universal + Vedas + mountain, great + to be done + toward + O leading towards, sentient being + meaning + to + O fulfilling, thus + not, true appearance, great (vocative invocation), great + O friendly, thereto + layer + O here, saṃ + become a house or habitation + to Thee, ability + day after day + O keeping
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Sanskrit and Kangxi.

verses.iast: ye dharmahetuprabhavā hetun teśān tathāgato hy avadat eśāñ ca yo nirodhā evaṃ vādī mahāśramanaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法·因·生，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·离名相假立，真如实际·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际，本性寂静止息·圣智通达以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是、如此，论者，乐趣·精庐·我等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma + cause + excelling, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & non-dual wisdom awareness and who, whichever, suppression, thus, in this way, vādī, gladden + hermitage + us, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–62.a · 藏文名：གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་མདོ།

May my mantra syllables be fulfilled! May the name, power, sovereignty, and might of the great king Vaiśravaṇa bring me well-being! Svāhā !

Through the name, power, sovereignty, and might of the great king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, may I be free of all grahas and misfortunes! Svāhā !
syād yathedam khakhakhami khalane khalami kharāli kharali karakhe kaśani karaṭe kāli kāmini vivale vidheyaśayanisamavate śama śamini svāhā
Through the name, power, sovereignty, and might of the great king Virūḍhaka, may all grahas and misfortunes be pacified for me! Svāhā !
syād yathedam krakami kragamaṇi kragase krugraśe krakra śami kruśrumi kruśrume krukka krukluma kruge agale nagale samagale kuhume gume alake kaluke kalamale galale kalaṭake irimire dhire arugavati svāhā |
Through the name, power, sovereignty, and might of the great king Virūpākṣa, may I have well-being!
syād yathedam asaṅge khaṅgavate balavate balanirghoṣe śūre śūravatve vajrasme vajragame vajradhare stambhe jambhe dṛḍhasāre viraje vighośe varāgraprāpte araṇe araṇe dharmmayukte diśi vighuṣṭe svāhā |
May the name, power, sovereignty, and might of the Thus-Gone One bring me well-being! Svāhā !
syād yathedam khaṅge khaṅge khaṅga garbhe vicakṣaṇe cakra rājane candre capale pātāle bhīmavadavati kharāgre bhṛikuṭimukhe kuṭilakarāgre ekākṣi vargavati sāraṅgavati mārgavati gargavate citravati citrakānti
May I have well-being in the north!
syād yathedam dhāraṇi dhāraṇi pradhvaṃsani bhañjani prabhañjani vidhamaṇi kiṃpuruṣe śakale sārethe sāravati śūladhare śūladhāriṇi śuddhacaraṇe ghoṣavati śārāgre śānte
May I have well-being in the east! Svāha !

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，再三造作离相·等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，虚空小鸟尊，生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说，速度严，请摄取从中，具请摄取、遣除苦厄！尊，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，息灾、寂静、安隐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！浣尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载浣尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！歌手尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载·蹩脚·在于，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切·压镇·所作·毘陀罗鬼·除断尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, hole + O a bird, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), quickness, carry away ! remove! + from, O bearer of carry away (suffering)! remove! primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), peace, pacification, tranquility, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O causing to wash, having washed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + O causing to wash, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O belonging or peculiar to the Gandharvas, or a marriage without any ceremony, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + lame + in, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + an evil demon + done + zombie + O removing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam harigiśinakili ehere amare aṇḍare paṇḍare kaṭake keyūre hase hase hase khase khase khase kharaṅge marugahaṇe svāhā mumukṣa svāhā hile svāhā mile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，此间风息尊，仙人、天神尊，离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，腕环尊，璎珞尊，再三笑声尊，再三诸人尊，虚空颜料尊，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无我大慈三昧·造作离相·六度满行清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), here + O wind, O immortal, conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O ring / in ring, O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, O laughter, mirth / in laughter, mirth again and again, O a degraded Kṣatriya again and again, hole + O colour, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! uniting (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam amṛte agrapuṣpe bahuphale nivāriṇi sarvārthasādhani aparājite varaṭe dharaṇi guhyāvarte gautame guptamati jambhani svāhā prajambhani svāha balaprabhañjani svāhā jaye svāhā vijaye svāhā jaye vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，甘露、不死妙法尊，尊花尊，多果尊，在于具人群，一切义利成就法，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，种类胡蜂、胡蜂尊，大地，密绕尊，瞿昙，维持暗，令愚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载令愚尊，自如是宣说，力风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, first + O flower, many + O direct effect, in + O bearer of crowd, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, O a kind of wasp, the earth, hidden or covered + O circumambulate, O descending from Gotama, keep + dark, O crushing, destroying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + O crushing, own + spoke, power + O wind, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedaṃ bodhi bodhi mahābodhi bodhanumate phalini bahuphale śikṣa śikṣa sāravate sāgali durāsade dūrāgame śūraprāpte śūravate bhage bhagavate bhāgini nivāriṇi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，再三菩提、无上正觉，大菩提，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，方位水果尊，多果尊，再三本性寂静止息·造作离相·六度满行清净，坚硬因素尊，有罪罪行蜜蜂，难敬，远传，勇得尊，勇鸣呼尊，才尊，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·离名相假立，在于具人群，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again, great + Bodhi, awakening (vocative invocation), O bearing fruit, many + O direct effect, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās again and again, O solid element, guilty of a crime + bee, O difficult to be approached or met, unaccessible, impracticable, unheard of / in difficult to be approached or met, unaccessible, impracticable, unheard of, distant + O traditional, bold + O filled with astonishment and wonder, bold, O excellence / in excellence, to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), in + O bearer of crowd, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam akrame vikrame bhūtaghoṣe bhūtaṃgame dahani dhadhare dharavare dadhini nikhume khukhume khakha khakha sāraṃgame candre capale halime hale hāriṇi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，需要次第尊，超尊，部多鬼神音尊，昂·彼·趣往，炽燃、摧灭尊，驮请执持，驮阿婆罗尊，酪在于，埋难迥遮，经过·经过·于我，再三虚空虚空，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，月轮、清凉满月尊，嚣尊，因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，耕，具胸严尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, O want of order, O surpass / in surpass, spirit + O sound, arise + him + O going to or in, O burning, consuming, destroying, dha + O hold! bear! sustain! dha + O lower, giving + in, bury + O flax, of course + of course + to me, hole + hole again and again, going toward (vocative invocation), O moon, lunar disc / in moon, lunar disc, O inconsiderate / in inconsiderate, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O plough / in plough, O bearer of clump, mass, thicket, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam khakhame khakha khakha khukhume śime śime śihume śime śime svasti svasti svasti svasti mama śānte sārāgre
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，虚空·虚空·于我，再三虚空虚空，经过·经过·于我，再三正勤尊，本性寂静止息·因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，再三正勤尊，再三吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，我之（行者所有），寂静、调柔安稳尊，心坚从中
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, hole + hole + to me, hole + hole again and again, of course + of course + to me, O endeavour, effort / in endeavour, effort again and again, primordial tranquil peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O endeavour, effort / in endeavour, effort again and again, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, maina + from
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam kalake kalale balani karuḍa ālāye agne saṃkrāmane svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，精神忧苦尊，羯罗蓝，力在于，能作成办·造作离相，衍伸出，妙行趣入·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, drive + O not-joy, O kalala / in kalala, power + in, making, spawn + O income, awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: Ciri ciri viri viri dhiri dhiri vigatāvaraṇe viśodhane vividhāvaraṇavināśani muri muri muci muci muli muli cili cili kili kili mili mili kamale vimale jaye vijaye vijayāvahe jayavati viśeṣavati
verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），离障蔽，闢理由，能灭除闢服务天神障蔽，再三清净解脱、无碍妙音！再三舍，再三无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙莲华、红莲尊，毘磨利，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，最胜尊胜·鸿毛·呼唤圣尊叹词，具足胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，具足异尊
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, lost + O obscuration, settle + O also means of purification, settle + serve a god + O destroyer of obscuration, pure release, unobstructed grace! again and again, muci again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, O lotus blossom / in lotus blossom, pure, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! supreme victory! triumph! + down + O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, O one endowed with conquer! victory! O one endowed with distinction, difference, special property, peculiarity
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Oṁ dhuru dhuru svāhā turu turu svāhā muru muru svāhā hana hana sarvaśatrūn svāhā daha daha sarvaduṣṭānāṃ svāhā paca paca sarvapratyarthikapratyamitrānāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切诸暴恶者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），一切·回犯·诸冤家之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all + of all wicked, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, all + enemy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Tadyathā oṁ amṛte amṛtavare vare vare pravare viśuddhe hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！甘露、不死妙法尊，甘露殊胜，再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，最妙尊，最极清净、究竟净除尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, ambrosia + O choicest, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Oṁ amṛtavilokini garbhe saṃrakṣaṇi ākarṣaṇi hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无我大慈三昧·真如实际·最上真言离言说，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，守护从中尊，阿羯沙尼尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, O guarding, protecting from, O Akarsani, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Oṁ vimale vipule jayavare jayavāhini amṛte viraje hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毘磨利，广大、宽博无量尊，胜伏殊胜，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，甘露、不死妙法尊，嚩啰阇尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! pure, O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound, conquer! victory! + O choicest, conquering (vocative invocation), O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, O free from dust, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Oṁ bhara bhara sambhara sambhara indriyabalaviśodhani ruru cale hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三方位、战斗，再三参婆啰，根·力·闢·理由，大悲流注、光明赫奕！震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bearing, carrying again and again, bestower again and again, an organ + power + settle + O also means of purification, radiate compassionate light! O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Oṁ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Tadyathā oṁ giri giri giriṇi giriṇi girivati guṇavati ākāśavati ākāśaviśuddhe sarvapāpavigate ākāśe gaganatale ākāśavicāriṇi jvalitaśikhare maṇimauktikakhacitamaulidhare sukeśe suvaktre sunetre suvarṇe suvarṇagauri atīte anutpanne anāgate pratyutpanne namaḥ sarveṣāṃ buddhānāṃ jvalitatejaṣāṃ buddhe subuddhe bhagavati surakṣaṇi sukṣeme suprabhe sudame sudānte vare varte bhagavati bhadravati bhadre subhadre vimale jayabhadre pracaṇḍe caṇḍe pracaṇḍe pracaṇḍe vajracaṇḍe mahācaṇḍe mahācaṇḍe ghori gāndhāri ghauri cauri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi varcasi pukkasi sumati śāvari śāvari śaṅkari dramiḍi drāmiḍi raudriṇi sarvagrahavidāriṅi arthasādhani hana hana sarvaśatrūṇāṃ daha daha sarvaduṣṭān pretapiśācaḍākinīnāṃ manuṣyāmanuṣyāṇāṃ ca paca paca hrīdayaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护，再三具歌咏、歌手尊，具足宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护尊，具足功德、殊胜妙德尊，具足虚空界（无碍周遍）尊，虚空界最极清净，一切·罪业·离，虚空界（无碍周遍）尊，穹苍尊，虚空界具伺尊，炽盛燃耀山尖，摩尼宝珠·企求解脱·宝嵌·头冠首严三尖·请执持，报刊往外发尊，报刊往外面目，妙眼尊，真金、妙金色尊，真金娇吠哩尊，过去尊，离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，末尊，现在时，归命，湖相，没驮南，炽燃放光·生起不可得·尊胜，佛陀、觉者尊，报刊往外佛陀，世尊佛母！（呼格），报刊往外卫尊，良好安全性尊，好看、英俊尊，报刊往外柔善尊，报刊往外低调，殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，向幅度汝，世尊佛母！（呼格），具足贤尊，贤尊，善哉、善见尊，毘磨利，胜伏贤尊，转载威猛，威猛、暴烈除障尊，再三转载威猛，金刚威猛，再三大威猛，威怖、猛厉降魔尊，诸人，破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢，贼盗尊，下贱种，下贱种，光明、显色尊，屠家尊，善心、人情，再三本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，作乐尊，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，具黑心，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，义利成就法，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切暴恶者，饿鬼·毗舍遮·诸荼吉尼之，人诸非人之以及再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），愧划分
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! steadfast sacred mountain peak again and again, O bearer of singing, singer again and again, O one endowed with steadfast sacred mountain peak, O one endowed with virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, O one endowed with space, ether, open sky, space + O completely purified, all + evil + O lost, O space, ether, open sky / in space, ether, open sky, O celestial vault, firmament / in celestial vault, firmament, space + O bearer of proceeding, blazing + O peaked, Maṇi jewel + desirous of emancipation + glittering + head + O hold! bear! sustain! press out + O hair, press out + O meters, O marvelous eye / in marvelous eye, O gold, golden-colored / in gold, golden-colored, gold + O Gauri, O gone away, passed, dead, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O future / in future, O present, homage to a lake + work, buddhānām, blazing, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, press out + O Buddha, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! press out + O guard, O good security, time of peace / in good security, time of peace, O good-looking, handsome, beautiful / in good-looking, handsome, beautiful, press out + O or house, press out + O tamed, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent, width + to Thee, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! verses.iast: oṃ padākramasi parākramasi udayamasi pudamasi nairamasi antardhānamasi
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！秋天·案·汝即是，愈加·案·汝即是，净水·摄伏·汝即是，第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，灭汝即是
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! fall + hold fast + Thou art, beyond + hold fast + Thou art, water + hold + Thou art, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Thou art
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following the reading in N E 1480/9 . D and S read pa tA kra ma si .

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya oṃ ālo kālo tālo sacchalo saṁmurti rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvabhayeṣu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，嗡！衍伸、刻毒实物，时，七多罗树，奸滑，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，于诸一切怖畏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Oṃ! spawn, venomous matter, kālo, tālo, deceitful, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all + among, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux, spiritual strength freeing bonds & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, O homage, salutation / in homage, salutation, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），灭汝即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S aM tardA na ma si , which is supported by N E 1480/9 anta [ r ] dhānamasi . D reads An+d+hardA na ma si .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），灭，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, covering, hiding, disappearance, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.iast: oṃ ehy ehi mahābhūtadevagaṇa ṛṣidvijasattama gṛhītvā āhuti āhāra asmin sannihito bhava oṃ agnaye triphatri svāhā āviśa āviśa mahāśriye havyakavyavāhanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），四大·天人·海会众，仙人梵行，在家人已，圣供、护摩供，楼阁，于此之中，赢得潜在，愿成、善住，嗡！向圣火、智火（火大），三·颇·三，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，大广大光华尊，向护摩供婆喝那，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! the four great seeds + god + assembly, Ṛṣi + a Brahman, having become a house or habitation, offering, oblation, tower, in this, win + laid, be! become! Oṃ! to fire, sacred flame (Agni), three + pha + three, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace again and again, great + O with great magnificence, sgl + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ga Na . D reads ga na , and N E 1480/9 reads gana .

verses.iast: oṃ mārīcyai vattāli vadāli varāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切诸暴恶者，眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all + of all wicked, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.iast: oṃ vaṃ yaṃ raṃ vaṃ maṃ mā me paśyantu sattvā antardhānamasi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，风大自在除障种子，火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），勿、莫令，于我、为我，愿悉了知、聪明，器物盘子已，灭汝即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, do not, let not, to me, my, may they looking, knowing, intelligent! having a vessel or dish, Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following N E 1480/9 mā me paśyantu satvā , meaning “may beings not see me.” The reading in the Tibetan witnesses appears to be a corruption of this phrase—D

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！最上真言离言说·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D and S bi pa ri ma si . N E 1480/9 reads cīramasi [?]. Though this transliteration follows the reading in D and S, this is the only time that the

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.iast: oṃ vattāli vadāli varāli varāhamukhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.iast: oṃ vattāli vadāli varāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānām cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandhami svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，眼面，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），结界系缚·解脱系缚大力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! binding obstacles (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S va rA ha mu khi and N E 1480/9 varāhamukhi . D reads bA rA hA mu khi .

verses.iast: oṃ vattāli vadāli varāli varāhāmukhi sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ stambhaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪般舟，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O before oneʼs face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, immobilize! halt hostile forces! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . D reads bA rA hA mu khi , and N E 1480/9 reads valāhamukhi [ sic for varāhamukhi ].

verses.iast: oṃ vattāli vadāli varāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭām me vaśam ānaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切暴恶者，于我、为我，因为、截至所以，离名相假立·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all + wicked, to me, my, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . D reads bA rA hA mu khi , and N E 1480/9 reads varāhamuṣi [ sic for varāhamukhi ].

verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·大自在威德统摄）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — sovereign spiritual mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 165.b–186.a · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་གྱི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར་གྱི་ཆོ་ག

verses.iast: oṃ mārīcyai ehy ehi antasannihito bhava
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），末·赢得·潜在，愿成、善住
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! end + win + laid, be! become!

verses.iast: tadyathā—oṃ munidharme saṃgrahadharme anugrahadharme vimuktidharme sadānugrahadharme vaiśravaṇaparivartitadharme sarvakāryapariprāpaṇadharme śamatānuparivartitadharme svāhā!
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！牟尼正法，摄正法，摄益正法，微目吃底正法，水果·摄益·正法，持守摄受·最上真言离言说，一切·圣·般·领军向着·正法，息灾寂静·持守摄受·本性寂静止息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Muni + O Dharma, samgraha + O Dharma, to benefit + O Dharma, liberation + O Dharma, fruit + to benefit + O Dharma, bearing (vocative invocation), all + noble + wisdom + leading towards + O Dharma, pacifying, bearing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Tatakaragupta has sunidharme .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！聪明、英明尊，闻·正念·最胜尊胜，分别·陀罗尼·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing, hearing + mindfulness + O supreme victory! triumph! thought + Dhāraṇī, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Tatakaragupta’s version adds mahādharme .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！般若波罗蜜多力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Perfection of Wisdom + power, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

O intelligent, wise, knowing, mahāprajñe, intelligent + O splendor, intelligent + O beheld, all things + dark + O fan, O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, may all mantra-padas succeed me, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! omniscient + breath + O holding

verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O loving her calf, as subst, extended + O hand, my, of me (the practitioner), easy, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection again and again, Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, trembling, shaking, earthquake again and again, warden

verses.meaningZh: 婆罗，再三请执持、总持护念！再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三噜噜、音声，再三唯愿降临赴会！世尊佛母！（呼格），勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料
verses.meaningEn: Warden, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, roar, noise, thunder again and again, come hither! approach! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! do not, let not, hanging down

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! generosity + to controller, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·大·希·诸佛子！

verses.meaningZh: 圆满充盈·本性寂静止息，向风息，戒律，于我、为我

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *mahākānādamakānāṃ .

verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! a perfectly enlightened one, a Buddha, bhagavan, of Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, name + not + juice + very
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *mahākānādamakānāṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·不可思·牯牛成了！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以弄伤彼尊·一切多！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来！嗡！毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，再三禅那、静虑禅定尊，禅那惜者，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas! Oṃ! pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O meditative concentration (Dhyāna) / in meditative concentration (Dhyāna) again and again, meditative concentration + O dear, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This dhāraṇī translates as, “Homage to all the tathāgatas. oṃ . Stainless. Spotless. Concentration. Concentration. Beloved concentration. hūṃ phaṭ . ”

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·无限量权威行境！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, unmeasured, authority, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·智到彼岸！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, jñānapāramitā!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，圣智、无漏真智
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），闢海会众
verses.meaningEn: To me, my, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, settle + assembly
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.meaningZh: 如来（乘如实道来成正觉）之，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），随念本昔弘誓大愿
verses.meaningEn: Of Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, recall Your ancient compassionate vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.iast: hi hi hi hi jñā jñā jñā jñā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 再三诚然、因为、实乃，再三若字门（般若无分别圣智（jñāna）·远离寂静周遍），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: For, indeed, surely again and again, non-dual prajñā gnosis (jñāna) — expansive quiescence again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan reads *vigāna .

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), lotus flower + O god, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)

O cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! / in cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! O shatter and break all obstacles! / in shatter and break all obstacles! verses.iast: hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！阿夷·智慧猛火·阿罗歌花·光明·开·花开·大白伞盖尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dark-coloured + sacred fire + arka flowers + light + suffused + O White Parasol
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D, F, and S read, in transliteration,

verses.iast: oṁ jvala jvala khāda khāda hana hana dara dara vidara vidara chinda
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），再三请啖食净尽一切毒害魔障！再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三揭幕、一些，再三闢揭幕，断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, consume! devour obstacles! again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, settle + cleaving again and again, sever every fetter and hostile spell!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D, F, and S read, in transliteration,

verses.iast: chinda bhinda bhinda bandha bandha hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Vajra + by, all + wicked + obstacle, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! sutraSourceZh: 德格版甘珠尔 (TOH592 / TOH986)《གདུགས་དཀར་གཞན་གྱིས་མི་ཐུབ་པ།》(gdugs dkar gzhan gyis mi thub pa)
deityZh: Sitātapatrāparājitā · གདུགས་དཀར་གཞན་གྱིས་མི་ཐུབ་པ།
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH592 / TOH986，部类：Gzungs-dus，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre aparājitānāmadhāraṇī；藏文经题：གདུགས་དཀར་གཞན་གྱིས་མི་ཐུབ་པ། (gdugs dkar gzhan gyis mi thub pa)；英文经题：The Invincible Sitātapatrā (1)。共提取校勘级梵文真言 107 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向仙人海会众善祥，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi + assembly + to, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṁ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, praised by the host of ṛṣis, hūṁ drūṁ ! Crusher, hūṁ drūṁ !

verses.meaningZh: 能作令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Maker of crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṁ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, praised by the host of ṛṣis, hūṁ drūṁ ! Crusher, hūṁ drūṁ !

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.iast: oṁ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, ambrosia + O origin, ambrosia + O Sambhava, ambrosia + O bold, ambrosia + gone, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), ambrosia + life + O giving, sky + renown + O palm, all + affliction + exhaustion, O deed / in deed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṁ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三清净、纯洁无染尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三佛陀、觉者尊

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊

verses.meaningZh: 勇健金刚杵尊
verses.meaningEn: O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚藏尊

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏藏

verses.meaningZh: 金刚·焰光·藏
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + light + O womb

verses.meaningZh: 金刚氏族
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O origin

verses.meaningZh: 金刚三婆吠尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O giving rise to

verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.iast: vajram bhavatu me śarīraṃ sarvasatvānāñ ca kāyapariśuddhir bhavatu
verses.meaningZh: 金刚，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，于我、为我，躯，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及身净，愿成就、愿悉吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Vajram, may it be, let there be! to me, my, śarīraṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and body, may it be, let there be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，恒常、一切时，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: To me, my, always, evermore, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及我，愿诸如来慈悲安慰授记！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and me (the practitioner), may they comfort and encourage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成就妙悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Be accomplished! manifest siddhi! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！
verses.meaningEn: Fully awaken and enlighten! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Liberate! set free! release! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly liberate and emancipate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍、周遍十方，再三请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Universal, all-encompassing, liberate! set free! release! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍·光芒·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Universal + ray of light + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 以诸大手印真言章句，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Mahāmudrā + by, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas’ Sanskrit edition.

verses.iast: oṁ traiyadhve sarvatathāgatahṛdayagarbhe jvala dharmadhātugarbhe saṃhāraṇa āyuḥ saṃśodhaya pāpaṃ sarvatathāgatasamantoṣṇīṣavimale viśuddhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，一切如来·心·藏，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），法界藏，一层深度，寿命、无量寿，桑请净除，罪业、恶不善业，一切如来·普遍·佛顶肉髻相·毘磨利，最极清净、究竟净除尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas + heart + O womb, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! Dharmadhātu + O womb, layer + depth, life-force, longevity, saṃ + purify! cleanse! evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, all Tathagatas + universal + Uṣṇīṣa + pure, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emending the dative saṃśodhāya to the verbal imperative saṃśodhaya . This emendation is made in the subsequent formulas without further notation.

verses.iast: oṁ traiyadhve sarvatathāgatahṛdayagarbhe jvala dharmadhātugarbhe saṃhāraṇa āyuḥ saṃśodhaya pāpaṃ sarvatathāgatasamantoṣṇīṣavimale viśuddhe mahāvirajera gambhīrasi dharmadhātugarbhe vivisāra a a laṁ svāhā

verses.iast: tadyathā sūkṣme sūkṣme śānte śānte nirākule yaśo tejo sarvabuddhe adhiṣṭhāna adhiṣṭhite anumide svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三微细尊，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，明白、赊多尊，美称，威光，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic / in fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, O not over-filled, yaśo, tejo, all + O Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚契经，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + discourse, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ vajrakīli kīli kīlaya sarvaduṣṭam hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚杵尊，杵尊，请以金刚橛钉伏魔障！一切暴恶者，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O thunderbolt, O a pointed piece of wood, pin down with the vajra-stake! all + wicked, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ amṛte hana hana hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露、不死妙法尊，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ vajra khana khana hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三空心、坑洞，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, digging again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 金刚锤，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + hammer, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露、不死妙法尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），祈请摧碎、摧灭，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā sūkṣme sūkṣme śānte śānte dānte dānte nirākule yaśo yaśovati tejo śuddhe viśuddhe sarvatathāgata adhiṣṭhāna adhiṣṭhite ā namaḥ te hite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，即说咒曰：再三微细尊，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，再三低调、佛口婆心尊，明白、赊多尊，美称，具足美称，威光，清净、纯洁无染尊，最极清净、究竟净除尊，一切如来，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，归命，向汝、彼等，利尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Thus goes the mantra: O fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic / in fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless again and again, O not over-filled, yaśo, yaśovati, tejo, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, all Tathagatas, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, homage to to Thee / they, O put, placed, laid, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），一乘如实之道·六度满行清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme vehicle of awakening & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！宝生如来宝部灌顶种子字，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! Ratnasaṃbhava jewel-family seed syllable Trāṃ, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！金刚藏尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajragarbhe, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，嚩啰阇尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), O free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ vajramudgara ākoṭaya ākoṭaya hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚锤，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + hammer, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持守摄受·法界总持任持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！法界藏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bearing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Dharmadhātu + O womb, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向量，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to authority, evidence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ dharmadhātusvabhāva viśuddhe dharma te svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！法界自性，最极清净、究竟净除尊，正法、诸法实相，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharmadhātu + own-being, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！依止处、坚固，塔，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! standing firmly or having handsome feet, O relic-mound, tope, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向金刚莲华平，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + lotus flower + to equal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，月轮曼荼罗，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, moon + Maṇḍala, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚界，以上祈请安住加持，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! kongōkai, up + abide steadfastly & bestow grace! Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！供养礼赞·一切诸谛圆满，花尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! worshipping, O flower, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露、不死妙法尊，功德，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, worth, price, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, passion + Dharma, change or loss of colour + free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious, forward + abandoning, O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! equal, hole + equal, the same + equal, Mount Meru + equal, great + Bodhisattva, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：H and N read āva -.

verses.iast: oṃ vajrakrodha hayagrīva hūṁ hulu hulu hūṁ vaṃ

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + wrath, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, Hūṃ! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！大悲流注、光明赫奕！闢祈请安住加持，刑流水，大悲流注、光明赫奕！清净离诸尘垢，闢祈请安住加持，刑流水，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! radiate compassionate light! settle + abide steadfastly & bestow grace! punishment + O spring, radiate compassionate light! stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), settle + abide steadfastly & bestow grace! punishment + O spring, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·无量寿智决定王如来圣智·报刊往外决定·威光王·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·正等正觉、正遍知！即说咒曰：嗡！一切、普皆遍满，行（诸行造作），圆满清净、周遍无垢，正法、诸法实相，虚空、清净苍穹，器箧，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊，祈请大，眷属尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Aparimitāyus, primordial wisdom, press out, determined to, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha! verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：优势严，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，一切诸谛圆满·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，演说尊，揭帝、三婆吠尊，那罗尊，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，炽燃光明·品·在于，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，甘露、不死妙法尊，寿命藏
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: superiority, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), O elucidation / in elucidation, O gone or come forth or out, O explained, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), blaze forth with wisdom radiance! + cutting + in, blissful (vocative invocation), O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, life + womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Degé Toh 676, Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, Choné, and Stok Palace read bha ; Degé Toh 850 reads ba .

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，甘露、不死妙法尊，成办悉地·一乘如实之道，缺心眼、矬陋，虚空界演说尊，虚空界揭帝，造作离相·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，造作离相·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，虚空界加持，具足乐尊，法界总持任持·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，色演说尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, accomplishing (vocative invocation), senseless, stupid, ignorant, space + O elucidation, space + O gone or come forth or out, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), space + O spiritual blessing, O one endowed with easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), form + O elucidation

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya namo bhagavate amitabhāya tathāgatāya arhate saṃyaksambuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·病人星宿·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·桑·肝脏·随着·佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, sick, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, saṃ, the liver, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading is attested in Toh 851 as well as the Yongle, Narthang, and Lhasa (Zhol) editions of the Kangyur. Toh 679 reads gaganakīrtikari .

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ amite amitodbhave amitasaṃbhave amitavikrānte amitagamini gaganakīrtikare sarvakleśakṣayaṃkare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！病人、我身尊，病人氏族，病人三婆婆尊，病人勇健，趣入通行·无我大慈三昧，虚空·誉·掌尊，一切·烦恼·一样尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O sick, sick + O origin, sick + O Sambhava, sick + O bold, going toward (vocative invocation), sky + renown + O palm, all + affliction + O the same, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华手，酒席不空羂索，请成办、令速成就！三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），心，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），吽（金刚心印）！

verses.iast: Oṁ , O lotus holder who grants unfailing victory! Curu curu , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，离一切相无相·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相·施度调伏，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），离名相假立·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — consecrating Dharma-stream, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ amogha prāvaraṇa muru muri divyakaśikaṃ sambhavatu tara tara svāhā .

verses.iast: oṁ amogha vastrāṇy utkṣipāmi bodhini padme svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，真如实际·造作离相·六度满行清净，菩提在于，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṁ , amogha clothes! I cast off clothes within the lotus that brings awakening, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ amogha vastrāṇy utkṣipāmi bodhini padme svāhā .

verses.iast: Oṁ , amogha lotus seat of nectar, raining down! Curu curu , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，离一切相无相·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，离名相假立·妙行迁变空·真如实际，清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立·妙行趣入，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·摄受法流灌顶），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! unfailing, infallible, never in vain, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — consecrating Dharma-stream, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ amṛtāmoghapadmāsane varṣaṇi curu curu svāhā .

verses.iast: Oṁ , amogha protection! Take effect, do!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，长柄、融通尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! unfailing, infallible, never in vain, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, O stem, demin, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ amogha rakṣiṇi kuru kuru svāhā .

verses.iast: Oṁ , amogha samaya! Remain within the great lotus, hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，无住安立·离名相假立，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·钩召发起三昧），妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，离一切相无相·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! unfailing, infallible, never in vain, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, non-abiding equipoise & beyond nominal designation, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — samādhi invocation, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ amogha samaya mahāpadme tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūṃ .

verses.iast: oṁ sarvvatra amoghavati tiṣṭha rakṣatu hūṁ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切处、普皆周遍，具足不空、决定成就无虚尊，祈请安住加持，愿慈悲守护！吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṁ , you who never fail in any way! Remain and protect, hūṁ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ sarvvatra amoghavati tiṣṭha rakṣatu hūṁ .

verses.iast: oṁ trailokya padmāmoghakramiṇi mili mili svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！三界、三千世界，莲华·不空·具次第尊，再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṁ , you who overstep the three worlds with amogha lotus steps! Mili mili , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ trailokya padmāmoghakramiṇi mili mili svāhā .

verses.iast: oṁ padme mahāpadme sara sara samantena pariveṣṭayāmoghapāśena huru huru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，大红莲华尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），以普遍、周遍十方，以般·绕过·此处·不空羂索，再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṁ , unfold within the lotus, the great lotus! Surround everything with the unfailing noose! Huru huru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṁ padme mahāpadme sara sara samantena pariveṣṭayāmoghapāśena huru huru svāhā .
