verses.iast: namo ratna trayāya | nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahasattvāya mahākāruṇikāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·乐趣非情·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold! Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, gladden, to, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 163.b–164.b · 藏文名：སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ akaṭe vikaṭe nikaṭe kaṭaṃkaṭe karoṭe karokaṃṭe vīryai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，比邻、边儿尊，造作离相·断除憍慢执障，杯子、盆地尊，能作成办·造作离相，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O near, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O cup, basin, making (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），师子吼，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, lion’s roar, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），悉昙「āṃ」韵字门：远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），大空无碍法界虚空种子，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'āṃ': expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ balīn bhuñja jiva puśpe dhūpe hūṁ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·离名相假立，破有相福德光·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，第一义谛·本性寂静止息，烧香尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, blessedness transcending existence & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), O to burn incense / in to burn incense, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 一切甘露，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: All + O ambrosia, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ vatali mahāvatali hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ jaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕蜜蜂，酒席·鸿毛·表面地面尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + bee, feast + down + O surface of the ground, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ bhakṣa bhakṣa samaya tiṣṭha jaṃ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三食，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），祈请安住加持，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! alms again and again, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！燋，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to heat, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Making, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ varuṇa āgacchaya āgacchaya mahānāga gisati sarve bhuraḥ phuḥ phuḥ phuḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！水神，再三唯愿降临赴会！善良，妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，一切、普皆遍满尊，抖瑟、猪头，再三颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! the All-encompasser, of a god, may You come hither! approach!! again and again, great serpent or elephant, awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, quiver, jerk, struggle, stir, flash, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ bhagavati śrutismṛtisamavati saramati siddhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！世尊佛母！（呼格），具足闻正念平尊，彼喜，悉地、妙成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! hearing + mindfulness + O one endowed with equal, he + a pleasant abode, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！师子吼，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! lion’s roar, Hūṃ! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·施度调伏，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 再三焰光，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Light, flame again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），障碍·一极·断除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), obstacle + ultimate + cut, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ agnaye ativya abhisamayaviśa mahāśriye havyakavyam ahanīya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向圣火、智火（火大），真如实际·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，大广大光华尊，护摩供，因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to fire, sacred flame (Agni), immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, great + O with great magnificence, sgl, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ bhavaka agnaye śāntiṃ kuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！星宿寒鸦，向圣火、智火（火大），息灾、寂静、安隐，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! star + trickster, to fire, sacred flame (Agni), peace, pacification, tranquility, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṁ hrīḥ siṃhanāda vajracakravartalokika bruṁ bruṁ bruṁ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），师子吼，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, lion’s roar, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: oṁ akaṭe vikaṭe nikaṭe kaṭaṃkaṭe karoṭe citijvalakaroṭa vīrye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，比邻、边儿尊，造作离相·断除憍慢执障，杯子、盆地尊，炽燃放光·能作成办·妙行迁变空，精进、勇猛无畏力尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O near, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O cup, basin, blazing, making, O heroic energy, diligence / in heroic energy, diligence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.iast: oṁ aḥ hrīḥ siṃhanāda hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！涅槃除遣点种子字（远离烦恼生死），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），师子吼，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! nirvāṇa-visarga seed syllable Aḥ, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, lion’s roar, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namo ratna trayāya | namo hayagrīvāya | namo lokesvarāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！归命顶礼马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊）！归命顶礼离一切相无相·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold! Homage to Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja! Homage to freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṁ hrīḥ kulu yulu nīlakaṇṭha hulu hulu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha māraya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），造作离相·离一切相无相，一乘如实之道·离一切相无相，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三安住加持，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: māraya hā hā hā hā vajrakrodha hayagrīva hṛḥ hūṁ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，金刚忿，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: May You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence again and again, Vajra + wrath, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: ā hrīḥ hri paṁ taṁ naṁ
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），彼（宾格），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, him, that, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: hrīḥ nāga lele nāga dumva lele nāga phut phut hale hale hāla hāla sphuṭa sphuṭa nāga bright flickering svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），龙族、大龙王，离一切相无相，龙族、大龙王，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，离一切相无相，龙族、大龙王，再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·损减除灭忧苦），再三耕，再三大王诗人，再三开，龙族、大龙王，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），离一切相无相·妙行迁变空·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — dispelling sorrow again and again, O plough / in plough again and again, of a king and poet again and again, suffused again and again, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, freedom from conditioned marks & awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Unlike the rest of the mantra, this phrase is in Tibetan rather than transliterated Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在·涅槃除障点证入），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），嗡！吽（金刚心印）！大空无碍法界虚空种子
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties with nirvāṇic visarga release, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Oṃ! Hūṃ! boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 头尊，冬尽尊，闢头尊
verses.meaningEn: Śire, O the cool or dewy season, hoar, frost, dew, settle
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: vīrāyai gauri gāndhāri drāmiṭe mātaṅgi pukkasi kaṣṭaya māṃ
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，娇吠哩尊，诸人，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，下贱种，屠家尊，祈请糟糕、恶障于我
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), O Gauri, of a people, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O elephant, greatest or best of, O a mixed caste, may You bad, evil, painful, rough, constrained, affected, unnatural me
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 下贱种，火供净施·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: O a Candala or outcast, sacred offering (imperative seal), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 再三驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), uniting (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，慈柔方面尊
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, O of gentle aspect
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），月轮罐子

verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 向轻·慢·假定今日·汝，圣·右·臂
verses.meaningEn: Light + opinion + suppose now + to Thee, noble + right + O arm
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 诸一切圣智之，庄严具、穿戴尊

verses.meaningEn: Of all all knowledge, O Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

namaḥ sarva-tathāgatānāṃ tadyathā oṁ namaḥ sūkasaṃ namaḥ tārāyai tāramātā.
namas tāre ture vīre kṣana-dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe. trailokya-nātha-vaktrābja-vikasat-keśarodbhave.
namaḥ śata-śarac-candra-saṃpūrṇa-paṭalānane tārā-sahasra-nikara-prahasat-kiraṇojjvale.
namaḥ kanaka-nīlābja-pāṇi-padma-vibhūṣite dāna-vīrya-tapaḥ-śānti-titikṣā-dhyāna-gocare.
namas tathāgatoṣṇīṣa-vijayānanta-cāriṇi aśeṣa-pāramitā-prāpta-jina-putra-niṣevite.
namas tuttāra-hūṁ-kāra-pūritāśā-dig-antare sapta-loka-kramākrānti niḥśeṣākarṣaṇakṣame.
namaḥ śakrānala-brahma-marud-viśveśvarārcite bhūta-vetāla-gandharva-gaṇa-yakṣa-puras-kṛte.
namas traḍ iti phaṭ-kāra-para-yantra-pramardini pratyālīḍha-pada-nyāse śikhi-jvālākulekṣane.
namas ture mahā-ghore māra-vīra-vināśane bhṛkuṭī-kṛta-vaktrābja-sarva-śatru-niṣūdani.
namas tri-ratna-mudrāṅka-hṛdyāṅguli-vibhūṣite bhūṣitāśeṣa-dik-cakra-nikara-svakarākule.
namaḥ pramuditāṭopa-mukuṭā-kṣipta-mālini hasat-prahasa-tuttāre māra-loka-vaśaṅkari.
namaḥ samanta-bhūpāla-paṭalākarṣaṇa-kṣame calad-bhṛkuṭi-hūṁ-kāra-sarvāpada-vimocani.
namaḥ śikhaṇḍa-khaṇḍeṇdu-mukuṭābharaṇojjvale amitābha-jaṭābhāra-bhāsure kiraṇa-dhruve.
namaḥ kalpānta-hutabhug-jvālā-mālāntara-sthite ālīḍha-muditā-bandha-ripu-cakra-vināśani.
namaḥ kara-talāghāta-caraṇāhata-bhūtale bhṛkuṭī-kṛta-hūṁ-kāra-sapta-pātāla-bhedini.
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śānta-nirvāṇa-gocare svāhā-praṇava-saṃyukte mahā-pātaka-nāśani.
namaḥ pramuditābandha-ripu-gātra-prabhedini daśākṣara-pada-nyāse vidyā-hūṁ-kāra-dīpite.
namas ture padāghāta-hūṁ-kārākāra-bījite meru-mandara-kailāsa-bhuvana-traya-cālini.
namaḥ sura-sarākāra-hariṇāṅka-kara-sthite tāra-dvir-ukta-phaṭ-kāra aśeṣa-viṣa-nāśani.
namaḥ sura-gaṇādhyakṣa-sura-kinnara-sevite ābandha-muditā-bhoga-kali-duḥsvapna-nāśani.
namaś candrārka-sampūrṇa-nayana-dyuti-bhāsure hara-dvir-ukta-tuttāre viṣama-jvara-nāśani.
namas tri-tattva-vinyāsa-śiva-śakti-samanvite graha-vetāla-yakṣaugha-nāśani pravare ture.
mantra-mūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namas-kāraika-viṃśakam yaḥ paṭhet prayato dhīmān devyām bhakti-samanvitaḥ.
sāyaṃ vā prātar utthāya smaret sarvābhaya-pradam sarva-pāpa-praśamanaṃ sarva-durgati-nāśanam.
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jina-koṭibhiḥ asmin mahattvam āsādya so ’nte bauddha-padaṃ vrajet.
viṣaṃ tasya mahā-ghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ cātha jaṅgamam smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditam pītam eva vā.
graha-jvara-viṣārtānām paramārti-vināśanam anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvis-tri-saptābhivartanam.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! own-being + pure, all things, own-being + pure, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！菩提心，祈请出世，我、吾身
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! aspiration to enlightenment, may You to appear in this world! I, myself
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），烧香，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to burn incense, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），花，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, flower, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），光明、智慧明照，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, light, illumination, clear vision, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），香，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, smell, odour, fragrance, fragrant substance, perfume, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），天食，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, offering of eatables to a deity, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），声，供，云，大海、生死海，遍，向平，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, sound, to make an offering, cloud, ocean, boundless sea, suffusion, pervasion, to equal, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva-tathāgatānāṃ tadyathā oṁ namaḥ sūkasaṃ namaḥ tārāyai tāramātā
verses.meaningZh: 归命一切、普皆遍满，诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）之，即说咒曰：嗡！归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，归命，救度超脱·真如实际，星母
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, of all Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, homage to ferrying across (vocative invocation), a star
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：It is unclear what the correct Sanskrit for the Tibetan transliteration sūkasam might have been.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼星尊·迅疾、踊跃尊·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊·造作离相·六度满行清净·离名相假立·明·一样模样·三界、三千世界·依·最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·众华氏族！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O a star / in a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation, splendour, beauty, majesty, like, O look, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), refuge, aid, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, pollen, O origin!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading kṣana-dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe for kṣanair dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe , as the former rendering appears below and is supported by the published Sanskrit editions.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼百·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·月轮、清凉满月·充分、欲滴·分次第口门·圣救度佛母（度母）·千、千手千眼·积修、一堆·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·作紊炽盛！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hundred, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, moon, lunar disc, full, replete, filled or richly furnished with, cover, O mouth, Tārā, Savioress Goddess, thousand, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, a pig, O flaming!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼黄金、纯金光明·青莲·手掌、执持尊手·莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）·光华、光彩尊·布施、法施檀那·精进、勇猛无畏力·暖气、炽燃·息灾、寂静、安隐·耐力、忍辱·禅那、静虑禅定·行境尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold, golden, blue lotus, hand, palm, lotus flower (pure, unstained), O magnificence, splendor, ornate condition, generosity, giving, gift, heroic energy, diligence, heating, burning, tormenting, peace, pacification, tranquility, endurance, patience, meditative concentration (Dhyāna), O scope, range!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼如来佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜无边·具监狱尊·周遍、圆满全体·波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满）·得·胜者、最胜诸佛·子·得近尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Tathāgata, Uṣṇīṣa, supreme victory! triumph!, boundless, O bearer of prison, no rest or remainder, Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond, filled with astonishment and wonder, Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), son, child, the young of an animal, O inhabited, frequented, tenanted, occupied, approached, enjoyed / in inhabited, frequented, tenanted, occupied, approached, enjoyed!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·真如实际·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·圆满充盈·第一义谛·誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在）·之间·七（七佛·世间、世界·踏步初升·不是剩余·召请·堪尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ferrying across, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, fulfilling, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, between, seven, world, realm, stride, ascending, having no remainder, the same as, O enduring!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼帝释天主智慧猛火·神父·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·遍一切·自在主·宝嵌·部多鬼神、一切生类、真实·起尸·乾闼婆（香音神）·海会众、圣众眷属·药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）·阵地、转载·所作、已成办尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to powerful, sacred fire, priest, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, all-pervading, Īśvara, O beset, spirit, living being, true/existent, a kind of goblins or vampires, Gandharva, celestial musician, assembly, host,retinue, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, in front, forward, before, O done, made, accomplished / in done, made, accomplished!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: namas traḍ iti phaṭ-kāra-para-yantra-pramardini pratyālīḍha-pada-nyāse śikhi-jvālākulekṣane
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性）·如是（结句印定）·顿断魔障、摧破无明·偈子赞叹、敬礼·他人·机·调伏碾碎·第一义谛·展左·句、足迹、法位·门限尊·孔雀尊·光焰·部族·模样·自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, thus, so it is stated, shatter obstacles and ignorance!, hymn of praise, someone else, apparatus, subduing (vocative invocation), left foot forward, right drawn back, word, verse-foot, step, abode, O threshold, door-sill, O Sikhin, blaze, buddha-family, look, O certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迅疾、踊跃尊·大、摩诃（广大无边）·威怖、猛厉降魔尊·魔、天魔烦恼障·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊·闢摧灭·颦眉观音母（忿怒除障度母）·所作、已成办·最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际·一切、普皆遍满·怨敌、仇害违缘·杀手、驱逐舰尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, great, vast, supreme, O formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring / in formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, settle, O destroying, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, done, made, accomplished, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, O killer, destroyer!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼三·珍宝、摩尼宝·密闭·心友指甲·光华、光彩尊·繁忙来讲·趣往·周遍·迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在）·法轮、金轮、脉轮·积修、一堆·自我糊涂！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, jewel, precious gem, treasure, stamped, sealed, marked with, being in the heart, finger or toe, O magnificence, splendor, ornate condition, be busy for, going, no rest or remainder, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, self, O confounded!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼欢喜自尊·顶严·打击、染污·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·转载笑声·救度超脱·真如实际·魔、天魔烦恼障·世间、世界·踊跃·弯子·踊跃！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to glad, puffing up, diadem, crown, thrown, tossed, hit, afflicted, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, forward, laughter, ferrying across (vocative invocation), Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, world, realm, be eager, bend, eager!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍、周遍十方·大王衍伸·分次第召请·堪尊·警觉震动·妙行迁变空·忿怒·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·一切无轨·自由化从中、弃捨尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, all-encompassing, earth-protector, spawn, cover, the same as, O enduring / in enduring, stirring, contraction of the eyebrows, a frown, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, all, trackless, O unharnessing, loosening, freeing from!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·顶严·璎络·炽盛·阿弥陀佛（无量光如来）·生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障·破有相福德光·光净天神·作紊·是么尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace, space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (imperative seal), diadem, ornament, O flaming, Amitābha, Buddha of Infinite Light, transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride & blessedness transcending existence, be bright, O god, a pig, O steady, firm, constant, certain, safe!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼究竟劫波·火供净施·因缘空寂大乐·光焰、智慧炽盛火焰·花鬘内部·立尊·展右·喜·结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）·奸滑、奸诈·法轮、金轮、脉轮·闢摧灭！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the end of a Kalpa, destruction of the world, sacred offering, blaze, flame, radiant fire, garland, interior, O standing, abiding, remaining, not tasted, joy, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, deceitful, treacherous, wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, settle, O destroying!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼掌·表面地面嫌恨·杂罗南弄伤·地表尊·颦眉观音母（忿怒除障度母）·所作、已成办·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·七（七佛·降低世间、住地·破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to palm, surface of the ground, malicious feeling, residence, beaten, O the surface of the earth / in the surface of the earth, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, done, made, accomplished, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, seven, lower world, abode of serpents or demons, also a hell, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śānta-nirvāṇa-gocare svāhā-praṇava-saṃyukte mahā-pātaka-nāśani
verses.meaningZh: 归命寂静，融通，寂静、调柔安稳尊，寂静、调柔安稳，涅槃、圆寂不生灭，行境尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！神圣，桑具，大、摩诃（广大无边），罪行、罪垢，摧灭、除断尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, to, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, peaceful, calm, tranquil, Nirvāṇa, ultimate peace/extinction of suffering, O scope, range, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! the sacred syllable Om, saṃ + O yoked, great, vast, supreme, causing to fall, O destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼极喜地结界系缚邪魔外障·奸滑、奸诈·腔·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光·边缘天衣看到·句、足迹、法位·门限尊·明咒、真言明妃、圣智明·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·烈火趣往！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, deceitful, treacherous, a limb of the body, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), fringe of a garment, a saw, word, verse-foot, step, abode, O threshold, door-sill, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, ), O going!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迅疾、踊跃尊·秋天嫌恨·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·监狱偈子赞叹·解脱系缚大力·生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际·须弥山王（妙高山）·神圣宝山、宝树乐园·崑崙山·世间、法界刹土·三重、三合会·妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, fall, malicious feeling, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, prison, hymn of praise, spiritual strength freeing bonds & transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Mount Meru, cosmic axis mountain, a sacred mountain, a tree in paradise, men, a mountain, the seat of Śiva and Kubera, world, realm of beings, triple, threefold, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼天神、天女·湖相·山羊钩子·掌·立尊·星·啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在）·曰·顿断魔障、摧破无明·偈子赞叹、敬礼·周遍、圆满全体·毒害、蛇毒与三毒·摧灭、除断尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to god, goddess, a lake, disposition, fallow, hook, palm, O standing, abiding, remaining, a star, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, said, shatter obstacles and ignorance!, hymn of praise, no rest or remainder, poison, venom, toxin, O destroying, removing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼天神、天女·海会众眼目·天神、天女·紧那罗（歌神）·住宿截至趣往·束缚缠缚·喜·蛇盘身·罪垢、魔掌·恶梦、不祥梦境·摧灭、除断尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to god, goddess, assembly, eye-witness or superintendent, god, goddess, Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, stay by, O going, tie or bond, joy, winding, curve, coil, sin, depravity, bad dream, nightmare, evil omen, O destroying, removing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，月轮阿罗歌花，随着富楼那，领军、作法，明，光净天神，请摄取、遣除苦厄！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），曰，救度超脱·真如实际，危，瘟疫，摧灭、除断尊
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, moon + arka flowers, along with + Purna, a man's name, splendour, beauty, majesty, be bright + O god, carry away (suffering)! remove! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, said, ferrying across (vocative invocation), perilous, fever, pain, grief, sorrow, O destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼三·真性·布局、次第·寂静·威·辅以、充分魔怔尊·曜执、星曜鬼神执障·起尸·坚持下去洪水·摧灭、除断尊·最妙尊·迅疾、踊跃尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, the state of being that, the true state or real nature, putting down or on placing, distributing, arrangement, order, disposition, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, ability, power, capacity of, O accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of / in accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of, planet, seizing spirit/graha, a kind of goblins or vampires, press on, a flood, O destroying, removing, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: mantra-mūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namas-kāraika-viṃśakam yaḥ paṭhet prayato dhīmān devyām bhakti-samanvitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），尾，此、此法门，赞叹、偈子，归命，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，二十，凡彼…者，第一义谛·远离虚妄安立·真如实际，深远，成就觉慧，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，物流、瓜分，辅以、充分魔怔
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, to (the neighborhood of), this, here, praise, hymn, homage to freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, accompanied or increased by twenty, whoever, he who, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness, stretched or held out, far-reaching, dhīmān, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: sāyaṃ vā prātar utthāya smaret sarvābhaya-pradam sarva-pāpa-praśamanaṃ sarva-durgati-nāśanam
verses.meaningZh: 晚，或、抑或，及早、初日分，立起，忆念本誓·一切诸谛圆满，一切无畏，施予，一切、普皆遍满，罪业、恶不善业，疗，一切、普皆遍满，恶趣，摧灭、除断
verses.meaningEn: Evening, or, early, in the morning, to-morrow, utthāya, recalling, all + non-fear, giving, uttering, causing, all, every, complete, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, heal, all, every, complete, evil destiny, destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jina-koṭibhiḥ asmin mahattvam āsādya so ’nte bauddha-padaṃ vrajet
verses.meaningZh: 灌顶，当得成就、若成，迅疾、疾速，萨钵多融通，胜者、最胜诸佛，以诸俱胝（千万，于此之中，酒席汝，倚，彼、彼尊（连音式），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），佛驮，言，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Abhiṣikto, may be, would become, quick, swift, seven + to, Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), with ten million, myriad (koṭi), in this, feast + Thou, to be got or obtained, he, that one, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, of (a) Buddha, padaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: viṣaṃ tasya mahā-ghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ cātha jaṅgamam smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditam pītam eva vā
verses.meaningZh: 箭毒，彼之、其（属格），大、摩诃（广大无边），威怖、猛厉降魔，住，妙行迁变空·无住安立，行，从记忆、传统，转载惛沈，揭帝、步调尊，嚼，黄，唯、正是、决定，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Viṣaṃ, his, of that, great, vast, supreme, formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, standing, immovable, firm, lasting, constant, awakened conduct beyond flux & non-abiding equipoise, going, moving, living, from remembrance, memory, tradition, forward + dulling or hebetating the mind, O gone, passed,, chew, pītam, indeed, verily, alone, or
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: graha-jvara-viṣārtānām paramārti-vināśanam anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvis-tri-saptābhivartanam
verses.meaningZh: 曜执、星曜鬼神执障，瘟疫，搅拌诸辛苦之，最胜意外，闢摧灭，他轴，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），诸有情、众生、勇猛心之，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），三，七·融通·轰隆
verses.meaningEn: Planet, seizing spirit/graha, fever, pain, grief, sorrow, stir + of all fallen into, supreme + mishap, settle + destroying, other + the pole of a carriage, and indeed, likewise, of all sentient being, living creature, courage, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — purified faculties, three, seven + to + causing to move or live

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！星尊，救度超脱·真如实际，迅疾、踊跃尊，一切暴恶者，败坏、糟糕，我之（行者所有），所作、已成办尊，请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！祈请结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to noble + down + with, man, husband, hero, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero (plural), spiritual blessing + O blessed, my, of me (the practitioner), all + karmic obscuration, own-being + O pure, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, purify! cleanse! thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)! Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tadyathā | jvare mahājvare dukhe muktisusampanne mahāsampanne sampatti mahāsampatti kase mahākase kacchajvaramuktesi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：瘟疫尊，广大尊，忧患、悲惨尊，解脱·报刊往外·成就尊，大成就尊，荣，大荣，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，造作离相·妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O fever, pain, grief, sorrow / in fever, pain, grief, sorrow, O great fever or affliction / in great fever or affliction, O misery, liberation + press out + O to bring to perfection, great + O to bring to perfection, prosperity, great + prosperity, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), great (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tadyathā | cili cili mili mili rakṣa rakṣa māṃ āryāvalokiteśvara svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），祈请再三拥护、守护于我，圣观自在菩萨，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, Noble Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tadyathā | kili kili cili cili nigile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），离名相假立·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tadyathā | sare sare visare visare saranāśani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）尊，再三毘萨罗尊，流注周遍摧灭，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O flow forth and pervade with blessing! / in flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, O plenty, abundance / in plenty, abundance again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! + O destroying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodisattvāya mahāsattvāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)! Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (reverent offering), Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tadyathā | nisire nisire kalanimire kalaricirī vacile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三在于脉尊，造作离相·离一切相无相·离名相假立，精神·踊跃·久佛母，告诉大地，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: In + O vein again and again, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), drive + eager + lasting a long time, say + O = + speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝气息！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels, breath!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya vajrapāṇidhyam oṁ oṁ krāraprabhave bhagavati buddhe pratibuddhe śuddhe śāntikiri hana hana mama pāpam
verses.meaningZh: 归命向圣观自在菩萨，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，嗡！造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊佛母！（呼格），佛陀、觉者尊，惺忪、开明尊，清净、纯洁无染尊，息灾舒散光明，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），我之（行者所有），罪业、恶不善业
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, O awakened, awake, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, peace + scatter rays of blessing! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: daha daha mama pāpadaṃ paca paca mama pāpakaṃ | oṁ oḍe grasa grasa riteḍe riteḍe śāntīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），我之（行者所有），罪业调，再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），我之（行者所有），糟糕、恶障；嗡！那罗尊，再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，再三流畅瘖尊，本性寂静止息·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), evil + tame, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), bad, evil Oṃ! O of a man / in of a man, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, flowing + O deaf again and again, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! become a thunderbolt or diamond + dawn, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — consecrating Dharma-stream again and again, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), toward + this + O deficient, O black, forward + O black, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, great + O fierce, toward + O fierce, dog, dispelling delusion, forward + delusion, great + mota, forward + mota

verses.meaningZh: 摧灭、除断尊，转载·摧灭·控制器，一切春天、跳跃，转载一切春天，离名相假立·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，第一义谛·离名相假立·远离虚妄安立，一切忿，对一切忿，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三闢击破怨魔与无明惑
verses.meaningEn: O destroying, removing, forward + destroying + controller, spring, jump, forward + spring, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), wrath (plural), toward + wrath, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, settle + strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningZh: 一切·暴恶者·败坏，请除灭、遣散灾厄！一切施予安全性尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All + wicked + corrupt, dispel! destroy! all + O giving safety, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningEn: All + of all Nāga, ultimate truth & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux

verses.meaningEn: Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, protect, guard and shelter! generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满！

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切圣智容器去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, receptacle, to!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, no rule, understood, to embodiment, Greatly Compassionate One!

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān deveṣu trāyastriṃśeṣu viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，神圣宝箭，于诸忉利天中，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, a divine arrow, among/in Trayastrimsa Heaven, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: sudharmāyāṃ devasabhāyāṃ mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā ca bodhisattvasaṃghena bhikṣuśataiḥ śakreṇa ca devatānāmindreṇa sārdham

verses.meaningEn: In justice, righteousness, devasabhāyāṃ, great, beggar + by, great and Bodhisattva + by, beggar + by, by/through powerful, mighty, strong and a god + name + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 5 句）

verses.iast: tatra khalu bhagavān prajñapta evāsane niṣadya uṣṇīṣamavalokitaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，诚然、确实，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，摆，如此古老尊，离名相假立·六度满行清净·施度调伏，六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，三摩地、正定等持，时候造偈句，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, arranged, so + O old, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & generosity & self-mastery, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, by name, called, Samādhi, meditative absorption, half-year + way, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: samanantarasamāpannasya bhagavata uṣṇīṣamadhyādimāni mantrapadāni niścaranti sma
verses.meaningZh: 弹指成就之，才鸣呼，佛顶肉髻相·中·一切第一，一切真言秘密章句，晚上诸尊行持妙道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Immediately adjoining + of attained, excellence, Uṣṇīṣa + neutral + first, sacred mantra words and phrases, night + they move forth in compassionate activity! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 7 句）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，清净、纯洁无染尊，嚩啰阇尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼正法、诸法实相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, Noble Avalokiteśvara, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvo, not one + Vidyādhara + the curved end of the bow + tied on + by, parivṛto, by which, whereby, star + bull, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth

verses.iast: ñ1.3 upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā {kṛtvā

verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, having done, having performed

verses.meaningEn: Spirit + by, Piśāca + by, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, by/with owl, by/with a worm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息以及以诸人非人，以诸有情、众生、勇猛心
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace and person + by, by/with sentient being, living creature, courage
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 8 句）

verses.iast: athāyuṣmān rāhulo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau
verses.meaningZh: 即时汝等，罗怙罗，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Then + you [plural], rāhulo, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: śirasābhivanditvā bhagavantaṃ tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ purato rudann aśrūṇi pravartayati sma
verses.meaningZh: 礼敬赞叹·本性寂静止息，若衍底，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），阵地、之前，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离名相假立，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, in front, before , in presence of, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān jānann eva rāhulam āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，唯、正是、决定，罗喉罗，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation, indeed, verily, alone, Rahula, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: kiṃ tvaṃ rāhula mama purataḥ sthitvā aśrūṇi pravartayasi
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），汝、圣尊您，罗喉罗，我之（行者所有），由城邑，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Thou, You, Rahula, my, of me (the practitioner), from city, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·无住安立·最上真言离言说，向威光色，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！

verses.meaningZh: 向归命汝，向风·色·即是·有形·无色，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，向勇猛大士无色，向尘色，向遍入
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), hero + to, to, to thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu

verses.meaningZh: 向一样广大，向圣智色，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: The same + to, primordial wisdom + to, to Thee / they, reverent homage!

verses.meaningZh: 向聪明·演出饮用·我·无色，向密色，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Intelligent + act of drinking + self + to, hidden or covered + to, to Thee / they, reverent homage!

verses.meaningZh: 守护养育·施度调伏，向微质怛囒、种种，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！

verses.meaningZh: 目·设·善巧方便，向耳根、船舵，向鼻色，生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Eye + spacious + skillful means, to/for ear , rudder, nose + to, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ādibuddhadvādaśakastotram (DSBC Stotra)》(T01n802u)（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向身色，向吉祥自性无色，那罗、天女尊，至心归命礼！

verses.meaningEn: Press out + O hair, O a beautiful dress / in a beautiful dress, press out + O meters, O marvelous eye / in marvelous eye, gold + O white, O gone away, passed, dead, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O future / in future, O present
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 7 句）

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ jvalitaujasāṃ buddhe subuddhe bhagavati surakṣaṇi akṣaya sukṣaya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切没驮南·炽燃放光·生起不可得·尊胜·佛陀、觉者尊·报刊往外佛陀·世尊佛母！（呼格）·报刊往外卫尊·无尽·报刊往外尽！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, buddhānām, blazing, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, press out, O Buddha, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!, press out, O guard, imperishable, press out, exhaustion!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 8 句）

verses.iast: sūkṣme suprabhe sudame sudānte suvrate varade pravare bhagavati bhadravati subhadravati
verses.meaningZh: 微细尊，好看、英俊尊，报刊往外柔善尊，报刊往外低调，裁定好好儿、虔信尊，施愿者、满善愿尊尊，最妙尊，世尊佛母！（呼格），具足贤尊，具足善哉、善见尊
verses.meaningEn: O fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic / in fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic, O good-looking, handsome, beautiful / in good-looking, handsome, beautiful, press out + O or house, press out + O tamed, O ruling well, O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O one endowed with blessed, O one endowed with excellent, beautiful, auspicious, fortunate
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: bhadre subhadre vimale jayabhadre caṇḍi pracaṇḍi caṇḍe vajracaṇḍe mahācaṇḍe gauri
verses.meaningZh: 贤尊，善哉、善见尊，毘磨利，胜伏贤尊，威猛、暴烈除障尊，转载威猛，威猛、暴烈除障尊，金刚威猛，大威猛，娇吠哩尊
verses.meaningEn: O blessed, O excellent, beautiful, auspicious, fortunate, pure, conquer! victory! + O blessed, O fierce, ardent, wrathful, forward + O fierce, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, Vajra + O fierce, great + O fierce, O Gauri
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi vaccasi sumati pukkasi sumukhi śabari śāvari śaṃkari dramaṇḍi
verses.meaningZh: 诸人，下贱种，下贱种，真言宣演·最上真言离言说，善心、人情，屠家尊，善见口门尊，山行，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，作乐，经营那么卵尊
verses.meaningEn: Of a people, O a Candala or outcast, O elephant, greatest or best of, uttering (vocative invocation), benevolence, favour, O a mixed caste, O a beautiful mouth, O of a people, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), O causing welfare or happiness, run about + O egg
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: drāmaṇḍi raudriṇi sarvārthasādhani paramārthasādhani hana hana sarvaśatrūn daha daha
verses.meaningZh: 经营妙，具黑心，一切义利成就法，第一义谛成就法，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Run + O cream, O bearer of relating to Rudra or the Rudras, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, ultimate truth + O accomplishing, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 具足大冷尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + endowed with sail

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊佛母顶礼·广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 2 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 3 句）

verses.iast: śītavane mahāśmaśāne iṅghikāyatanapratyuddeśe tatrāyuṣmān rāhulo 'tīva viheṭhyate
verses.meaningZh: 尸陀林尊，大恐毘林尊，支分寂静·破暗合集·造作离相，彼具寿，罗怙罗，很，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: O sitavana, great + O smasana, quiescence of perceptual limbs & dissolving dense ignorance & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), That, rāhulo, very, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: devagrahair nāgagrahair yakṣagrahai rākṣagrahair marutagrahair asuragrahair kinnaragrahair
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·妙行趣入，离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，坚持下去·尊·呼格极微，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·六度满行清净，天神·尊·呼格极微，气息·尊·呼格极微，造作离相·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, press on + first + vocative particle, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, god + first + vocative particle, vital spirit + first + vocative particle, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 5 句）

verses.iast: garuḍagrahair gandharvagrahair mahoragagrahair manuṣyagrahair amanuṣyagrahair pretagrahair
verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，持守摄受·妙行趣入，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil, bearing, great, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: bhūtagrahair piśācagrahair kumbhāṇḍagrahair dvīpibhiḥ kākair ulūkaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarīsṛpair
verses.meaningZh: 也许·尊·呼格极微，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·第一义谛，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，以诸鸱枭，以诸蚓，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Perhaps + first + vocative particle, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, by/with owl, by/with a worm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息以及以诸人非人，以诸有情、众生、勇猛心
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace and person + by, by/with sentient being, living creature, courage
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 8 句）

verses.iast: athāyuṣmān rāhulo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ purato rudann aśrūṇi pravartayati sma
verses.meaningZh: 即时汝等，罗怙罗，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，若衍底，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），阵地、之前，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离名相假立，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Then + you [plural], rāhulo, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, in front, before , in presence of, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān jānann eva rāhulam āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，唯、正是、决定，罗喉罗，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation, indeed, verily, alone, Rahula, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: kiṃ tvaṃ rāhula mama prataḥ sthitvā aśrūṇi pravartayasi
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），汝、圣尊您，罗喉罗，我之（行者所有），由转载、向前，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Thou, You, Rahula, my, of me (the practitioner), from forward, onward, forth, away, fore, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: evam ukte āyuṣmān rāhulo bhagavantam etad avocat
verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），曰尊，具寿，罗怙罗，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, O said / in said, āyuṣmān, rāhulo, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahāśītavatīvidyārājñī》(T02msitvatu)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，救度超脱·造作离相，因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，彼（宾格），最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Whatever, that which, ferrying across, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), him, that, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Niṣpannayogāvalī (Abhayākaragupta)》(T02abhnispu)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: tair etac caritādbhutāni nijadhīdhāmāni dhāvantu vaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄），真如实际·妙行迁变空，运作一切希，先天·分别·一切碪，愿悉濯，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery, immutable Suchness & awakened conduct beyond flux, operation + extraordinary, inborn + thought + dhāṃ, may they wash! supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Niṣpannayogāvalī (Abhayākaragupta)》(T02abhnispu)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 于诸金刚·打桨·甲板·趣往·曼荼罗，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·远离寂静周遍），最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，微妙尊足，以诸高胜、最上崇高（古译「郁遮」）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + row + deck + going + among, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — expansive quiescence, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, pleasant + foot, by/with high, lofty, exalted

verses.iast: tadañcitais tadvacanirmitaughair amogham agryāṃ śriyam ādadhātu
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·圣智通达，真言宣演·真如实际，不空、决定成就无虚，上首、第一，清癯摄伏，施予饶益·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & non-dual wisdom awareness, uttering, unfailing, infallible, never in vain, foremost, first, best, lean + hold, granting (imperative seal)

verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，诚然、因为、实乃，无我大慈三昧·施度调伏·法界总持任持，报刊往外·若习若修若·三摩地，大极聪明，才鸣呼
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, for, indeed, surely, selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, press out + brought into being + of Samādhi, of intelligent, excellence
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Niṣpannayogāvalī (Abhayākaragupta)》(T02abhnispu)（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切·相·殊胜·具足，光明遍满·一切诸谛圆满，画儿一起作者
verses.meaningEn: All + disposition + choicest, radiating, drawing together

verses.meaningZh: 除灭灾患·真如实际，圣智熟透，相应，熟透，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Quelling calamity & affliction & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), primordial wisdom + come forth, yogo, come forth, arisen, descended or derived from, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Niṣpannayogāvalī (Abhayākaragupta)》(T02abhnispu)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼善见·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！即说咒曰：嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三弯曲、超群，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三忆念本誓，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸饿鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！此，放置·愉快·浮肿·一连，饼，七（七佛，人群、海众，般一样，左·手·勇健·弹指·三重，齿已，向诸湖剪切力此等诸尊，远离尊，所尊，施予；如是、如此以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光；第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，生事，施予饶益·施度调伏，我、真我自性，世界·界·天衣·勇健，诸饿鬼、薜荔多之，楼阁，如是（结句印定）；破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，任务；如是、如此，一切诸饿鬼，水稻·斗斛·饼，别主，施度调伏·真如实际，成办、生起、安住；如是、如此，成办作持·造作离相，不、非、无，弱，成办、生起、安住，不、非、无，流浪者、贫苦，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，亦、虽、乃至，然而、而、实则，再三生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，大力，颜容殊妙，众所乐见，富，广大规模，成办、生起、安住，长寿，无病佛母，疾，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，三耶三佛，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际；妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际以及乐·鸿毛·那个，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，愈加造偈句；如是（结句印定），善见，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Homage to handsome-figured, beautiful, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha! Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + of all Preta, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Anayā, put + delightful + dropsy + connected, bhaktaṃ, seven, crowd, multitude, wisdom + the same, left + hand + strong + snap of the fingers + triple, dattvā, a lake + shear + to, O detached / in detached, O place / in place, give Thus, in this way and speaking Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, avatāraprekṣiṇo, granting, I, the awakened self, the universe + realm + garment + strong, of all Preta, hungry ghost/departed spirit, tower, thus, so it is stated Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, to be made or done Thus, in this way, all + of all Preta, grain + valley, pratyekaṃ, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, becomes, arises, is Thus, in this way, enacting, not, non-, weak, becomes, arises, is, not, non-, vagrant, strolling, poor, needy, beggar, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, even, also, but, indeed, moreover, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) again and again, mahābalaḥ, prāsādiko, = + to be shown, to be made to appear, āḍhyo, of great extent, becomes, arises, is, long-lived, free from disease, healthy, speedy, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) Awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness and easy + down + that, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention, thereto + way Thus, so it is stated, handsome-figured, beautiful, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva | skandhadhātvāyatanādyanantaroktakāyavivekas tatra devatāvinyāsaś ca sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇam sthūlayogatvāt | vāgvivekas tu yogijñānam atisūkṣmaṃ mahāyānikānām aviṣayaḥ | vajrayānikānām apy utpattikramacāriṇām agocaraḥ sūkṣmayogatvāt | tasmād yatnataḥ śṛṇv ahaṃ te vistareṇa vyākhyātantrānusāreṇa vāgvajrasamādhiṃ pratibodhayāmi

tatra prāṇo hṛdistho 'kṣobhyas tathāgataḥ | apāno gudastho ratnasambhavas tathāgataḥ | udānaḥ kaṇṭhastho 'mitābhas tathāgataḥ | samāno nābhistho 'moghasiddhis tathāgataḥ | vyānaḥ sarvasandhistho vairocanas tathāgata iti | udvāho rūpam | vivāhaḥ śabdaḥ | saṃvāho gandhaḥ | pravāho rasaḥ | nirvāhaḥ sparśaś cêti

vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva mantratattvaṃ nāma tattvasaṅgrahādau mūlatantre côttaratantre ca kevalaṃ mantramātram udīritaṃ mantroddhāro na pradarśitaḥ | vyākhyātantre tu mantroddhāro mantrasaṅketo mantrārtho mantratattvaṃ ca bhagavatā sadbhāvena vivṛtam | ato vyākhyātantram anadhigatā bāhyamantraparāyaṇā na prajānanti | tasmād yatnataḥ śṛṇu vyākhyātantrā nusāreṇa mantratattvaṃ te pratibodhayāmi

adhunā 'kṣaratrayasya vyāpāro nirdiśyate | tatra tāvat trisaṃyogād devatāmūrtiṃ niṣpādayati | sa eva praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa deham aharniśaṃ dhārayati | sa evâlikālibhiḥ saha dvayendriyasamāpattikāle 'dhomukho bhūtvā guhyanāsikācchidrāc chukrarūpeṇa vinirgatya sattvadhātūn utpādayati | sa eva prāṇāyāmena saha punar ūrdhvaṃ gatvā indriyadvāraṃ prabodhya saṃvṛtighrāṇa- dvārād vāmadakṣiṇādikrameṇa nirgatyânābhogena vajrajāpaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakarmāvaraṇaṃ viśodhayati | sa evâhorātrakrameṇa japasaṅkhyām upalakṣya vāruṇādimaṇḍalodaye sitādivarṇam āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa evâkṣararūpeṇa parikalpito nâbhiṣpanditajihvāgrêtyādivāgjāpalakṣaṇena jāpaṃ kṛtvā bāhyavarṇādikriyām āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa eva tryakṣaraśodhanabodhanajvalanakrameṇâhāraṃ viśodhya nirāmayaṃ karoti | evaṃ kaḍevarāvasthāyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paryante 'nāhate praviśya punar api prākṛtadeham āśritya tathaîva sarvaṃ karoti

tatra guhyakādhipate 'sti kāmadhātvīśvarasya madayantikā nāma vidyā | tayā sarvān kāmāvacarān devaputrān madena mūrcchayati | vividhavicitraramaṇīyāṃś ca pradeśān darśayati | vividhavicitraparibhogāṃś câbhinirmāya paranirmitavaśavartibhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte
tadyathâsti maheśvarasya devaputrasya manojavā nāma vidyā | tayā trisāhasramahāsāhasre lokadhātau sarvakāryaṃ karoti | sarvopabhogaparibhogāṃś câbhinirmāya śuddhāvāsakāyikebhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte

ebhir nidarśanapadair mantraprabhāvo 'bhiśraddhātavya iti | sa ca mantraprabhāvo hi na mantrato niṣkrāmati | na sattveṣu praviśati | na prayoktṛta upalabhyate | atha ca kulaputra mantrādhiṣṭhānadharmatā sambhavaṃ nâtikrāmati | kālatrayātītatvāt | sarvathâcintyapratītyasamutpādābhinivartitatvāc ca

verses.iast: kāyaviveke sthitvā ālikālidvāreṇa vāgviveke 'vatarati | yadā vajrajāpakrameṇa prāṇāyāmam adhigato bhavati tadā vāgvajra- samādhau pratiṣṭhito bhavati | vāgviveke sthitvā prakṛtyābhāsakrameṇa cittaviveke 'vatarati | yadā prakṛtyābhāsaṃ vāyuvāhanaprabhedaṃ yathābhūtaṃ śikṣate tadā cittavajrasamādhisamāpanno bhavati | cittasya yathābhūtaparijñāne sthitvā dvādaśamāyādṛṣṭāntena saṃvṛtisatye 'vatarati | yadā māyopamasamādhisamāpanno bhavati tadā sarvabuddhābhiṣekaṃ pratilabhate | māyopamasamādhau sthitvâṣṭādaśamahāśūnyatānukrameṇa paramārthasatye 'vatarati | yadā piṇḍagrahānubhedasamādhinā bhūtakoṭiṃ praviśati tadā sarvakleśaviśuddho bhavati | yadā jñānakrameṇa vyutthāya prakṛtiprabhāsvaraṃ satyadvayādvaidhīkāreṇâtmānam abhisambudhyati tadā niṣpannakramasamādhau śikṣito bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 身明知尊，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，离一切相无相·造作离相·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·造作离相，好好儿、水箱；何时、若是，以金刚诵念次第，调息，以上去，成办、生起、安住，彼时，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·生起不可得·尊胜，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·法界总持任持，踞，成办、生起、安住；最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·造作离相，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，以转载·作害·光明·需要次第，心明知尊，好好儿、水箱；何时、若是，转载·作害·光明，风·婆喝那·万，如实，试图、受取，彼时，心·金刚三昧经·成就，成办、生起、安住；心、菩提心、心识之，犹如·部多鬼神·想蕴，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，以十二幻化譬喻，俗谛力，好好儿、水箱；何时、若是，花样·郁多摩·三摩地·成就，成办、生起、安住，彼时，一切·佛陀·灌顶，对获；无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，息灾寂静·一切诸谛圆满，真谛，好好儿、水箱；何时、若是，以丸·曜执·日复一日·异生性·三摩地，实际、真如本际，转载入，彼时，一切·烦恼·最极清净，成办、生起、安住；何时、若是，以圣智次第，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·真如实际，自然本性光净，禅智观照·归命敬礼·一切诸谛圆满，得证正觉，彼时，离名相假立·六度满行清净·第一义谛，试图从此，成办、生起、安住
