nanu prayojanaviśeṣārthitaiva puṃsaḥ prayojanaviśeṣasaṃśayotpattihetuḥ prāgvidyata eva | tathāhi prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣāparigatamanasaḥ prathamataramevaṃ bhavatyeva, kimidamasmadadhi gataprayojanena saprayojanam ? āhosvidanyena ? kiṃ vā niṣprayojanamiti; tatsādhaka bādhakapramāṇābhāve tasya nyāyaprāptatvāt | prayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaśāstrāntaropala bdheśca | ato bhavatyeva prāgapi prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśaya iti vyarthaḥ prayojanavākyo panyāsaḥ | naitadasti | yadyapi prayojanaviśeṣārthitāpi saṃśayaviśeṣaheturbhavati | ta thāpi na sā sarveṣāṃ saṃmukhībhavati | avyutpannapuruṣārthānāṃ mūḍhadhiyāṃ keṣāṃcidasaṃmu khībhāvāt | tathāhi—mokṣaḥ paramapuruṣārthatayā siddhaḥ, atha ca santi kecidavyu tpannā ye tamapi paramapuruṣārthaṃ puruṣārthatayā na jānanti | prāgye na taṃ prārthayiṣyante te | na vā saṃmukhībhūtā prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣā prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasandehotpattihetu ryuktā, kāraṇasattādhīnatvātkāryāṇām | yadi nāma sā keṣāṃcidapi saṃmukhībhavati, tathāpyasau sādhanāntaraparityāgena pratiniyatasādhanopādānahetoḥ saṃśayaviśeṣasya heturna bhavati; sarvatra sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena tasyāstaddhetutvena nyāyaprāptatvāt | na cai tāvanmātreṇa pravṛttiryuktā | sarvatra pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca śakyaṃ kenacitsarvatra pravartti tumityataḥ phalaviśeṣārthino'pi pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahanibandhanābhāvādudāsīran | tasmātpratiniyatasādhanaparigrahahetuprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśayotpādanāyātyantaparokṣārtha viṣayāgamapraṇayanavat phalaviśeṣārthinā pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahāyābhidhānīyameva prayo janavākyam | tathā hi tenāsyaiva śāstrasyārthaviśeṣa upadarśyate nānyasya | ato'nena pratiniyatasādhanasādhyaphalaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ saṃśayo janyate | sa ca śrotā kadācinma māyamarthaviśeṣo niṣpatsyata iti prayojanavākyopajanitāt prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayādatya ntaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamopajanitādiva saṃśayātpravarttetāpītyataḥ prayojanavākyopanyāsaḥ
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā'tyantaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamapraṇayanamapi vyarthaṃ syāt; prāgapyāgamapraṇayanāddānādiṣu phalaviśeṣārthināṃ sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena ta tsaṃśayasya vidyamānatvāt | kiṃ tvasāvavyutpannasvargādiphalānāṃ naivotpadyate | tatkāra ṇabhūtāyāḥ phalaviśeṣārthitāyā asaṃmukhībhāvāt | yeṣāṃ copajāyate teṣāmapi sarva tropalādibhakṣaṇe'pi pravṛttihetutayā sādhāraṇatvādupalādibhakṣaṇaparihāreṇa (na) prati niyatadānādiparigrahaheturbhavatīti matvā tadarthamāgamapraṇetṛbhirāgamaḥ praṇīyate tadvatprayo janavākyamapi śāstrakārairityacodyametat | na cāpi jijñāsitaprayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaṃ śāstrāntaramupalabdham, yena tadupalabdhibalādabhimataprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ sandeho bha vet | na hyabhimataprayojanaviśeṣasādhane śāstrāntare sambhavati kaścitprekṣāvān paraṃ śā strāntaramārabhate | prekṣāvattvahāniprasaṅgāt | ato na śāstrāntaropalabdhirapi vivakṣi taprayojanaviśeṣasandehaheturbhavati | tasmācchrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaḥ prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti sthitam
yastu manyate na śrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaṃ prayojanādikathanam, tataḥ saṃśayotpatteḥ; saṃ śayena tu prekṣāvataḥ pravṛttyasambhavāt | kiṃtu yatprayojanarahitamanarthakaṃ vā tannārabdha vyam, yathā kākadantaparīkṣonmattādivākyam; prayojanarahitaṃ cedaṃ śāstramato na śrotuṃ karttuṃ vā prārabdhavyamityevaṃ vyāpakānupalabdhyā yaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate tasya hetorasiddhatodbhā vanārthamādau prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti | tadasamyagiva lakṣyate | saṃśayenāpi pravṛtteḥ prasādhitatvāt | asiddhatodbhāvanasya ca vaiyarthyāt | evaṃ hi tadarthavadbhavet | yadi tasya parasyāto vākyātpravṛttirbhavet | yāvatodbhāvitāyāmapyanena vākyenāsiddha tāyāṃ nāto vākyātprekṣāvato yathoktavyāpakāttatvaniścayaḥ samutpadyate yenāsau prava rttito bhavet | pūrvavadvākyasyāsyāpramāṇatvāt | saṃśayena ca prekṣāpūrvakāriṇo bhavanma tena pravṛttyasambhavāt | ato viphalamevāsiddhatodbhāvanam | nāpi kaścitprekṣāvānavi ditaśāstraśarīro'kasmādvyāpakābhāvaṃ niścityānena pratyavatiṣṭhate | nāpi tatpratyavasthā nāt svayaṃ viditaśāstraprayojano'pi śāstrakṛnnārabheta kartuṃ śrotā vā prekṣāpūrvakārī nirnibandhanādvākyānnivarttate yena tayoḥ pravṛttyarthamasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ syāt | athāpi syādyo'prekṣāpūrvakārī so'nibandhanamakasmādapi yathoktavyāpakābhāvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | paraiśca grāhayedapi, atastaṃ pratyasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ kriyata ityetadapyayuktam

verses.meaningEn: Whose, of whom, by which, whereby, together with, anyone, someone, pratibandho, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) Not, non-, he, that one, by that truth, thereby, through that power, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence That, thus, just as, according to, Himalayan Mountains, by/through of a mountain Not, non-, hard + self + certainly, together with, anyone, someone, collection, live + of wind, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, pervading + not to be grasped or conceived, leader, guide, asiddho, hetuḥ From rel, collection, star + te, the identity of nature with, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, or, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness Not, non- and the identity of nature with, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace Primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, with constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation + beginning + form, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence That + perverse + may it be so + mind, come to + from stem Beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), that + occurrence, with constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation + may it be so + pride, body, physical frame, sacred relics, burst forth + that + from bond, freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — dispelling sorrow

verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, indeed, verily, certainly, Brahman and so on, authority + scope + prison He, that one, for, indeed, surely, kind + bond + mark, family name + mark, activity + adequacy + superior, or, may be, would become Not, non-, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, produced by that + very + do not + hymn of praise, distinction + not divine, upholding (vocative invocation) Making, from false, heretical view Primordial tranquil peace & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), he + like + thereto + to be found or met with Not, non-, indeed, verily, certainly, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks, like, just as, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), of a different kind + to, thought + appearance + of different character or nature, may You wise, learned, clever! stone + fear + within Immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, making (by spiritual power), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, connected, coherent, sensible, pratyakṣaṃ, pramāṇaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Pramāṇavārttikālaṅkārabhāṣya (sa-Latn) · pramanavarttikalankarabhasya_1（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: paropadeśaprāmāṇyaṃ pratyakṣārthe na yuktimat | upadeśo hi lokānāmanyathāpi pravarttate
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，现量义利，不、非、无，一乘如实之道·造作离相·真如实际；优婆提舍，诚然、因为、实乃，世间·无名·因为经过，转载转
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, seeing before the eyes + O meaning, not, non-, supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness Upadeśo, for, indeed, surely, world + nameless + because of course, forward
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Pramāṇavārttikālaṅkārabhāṣya (sa-Latn) · pramanavarttikalankarabhasya_2（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: yadi khalu bāhmaṇatvādijātiḥ pratyakṣeṇekṣyate | paropadeśasya vyarthatā | nahi pratyakṣārthe paropadeśo garīyān | tathā cenna paropadeśataḥ sandehaḥ syāt | ataeva pratyakṣaṃ sahāyamapekṣate
verses.meaningZh: 设使，诚然、确实，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际；他人论议，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢；的确不是、才不，现量义利，他人优婆提舍，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道；如是、亦复如是，妙行迁变空·离名相假立，他人由论议，赢得身，愿得成就、当如是；真如实际·最上真言离言说，现量，一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: If, when, indeed, verily, certainly, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) Someone else + of instruction, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust Indeed not, by no means, not at all, seeing before the eyes + O meaning, someone else, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening Thus, in that same way, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation, someone else + from instruction, win, may it be so Immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, pratyakṣaṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，亦、虽、乃至，以自在主妙语、尊主语言，谛、真实不虚语，以开始即是，复次、再三，复次、再三，后后上，本性寂静止息·支分寂静·造作离相，彼、真如彼岸，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），以比量，团体，以稳定性膨胀开始即是，圆满充盈·破有相福德光，矛盾、抗议，第一义谛·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），不、非、无，观想即是，实物事实汝，明了觉识·真如实际，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·破有相福德光，如是（结句印定）；彼、如是真实，无着彼；如是、亦复如是，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），此尊、此法，向团体毒害，比量·已·观想·由力，有形·团体·缘，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），团体之，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），迸喫食，真如实际·无住安立·破有相福德光，唯、正是、决定，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Which, what, that which, even, also, by lord of speech, master of language, of gods, of Bṛhaspati, also a man's name, truth, reality, veracity, by beginning thus, again, furthermore, again, furthermore, uttarottaram, primordial tranquil peace & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency, That (ultimate reality), selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, by/through inference, beast for draught, team, distinctness + swell + by beginning thus, fulfilling (vocative invocation), contradiction, disagreement, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, not, non-, this is his + thus, matter of fact + Thou, discerning, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & blessedness transcending existence, thus, so it is stated That, thus, Asanga + him Thus, in that same way, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, this one, beast for draught + to poison, inference + former + this is his + from power, visible + beast for draught, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, of beast for draught, team, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, burst forth + food, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & blessedness transcending existence, indeed, verily, alone, or

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavāñ śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane ’nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，那罗凝聚，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），祇树林尊，离名相假立·无住安立·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, of a man + coagulate, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O the grove called Jeta / in the grove called Jeta, beyond nominal designation & non-abiding equipoise & ultimate truth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: atha khalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光，大药叉军主，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence, mahāyakṣasenāpatir, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，从依止处、活生生
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating (vocative invocation), from standing, living, being in, occupied with, devoted to
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: ekānte sthito māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir bhagavantam etad avocat
verses.meaningZh: 一面，立，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光，大药叉军主，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕
verses.meaningEn: One side, standing, abiding, remaining, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence, mahāyakṣasenāpatir, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: idaṃ bhadanta mama hṛdayaṃ yaḥ kaścid bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vopāsako vopāsikā
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，大德，我之（行者所有），心，凡彼…者，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，比丘，或、抑或，比丘尼，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: This, here, venerable, reverend person, my, of me (the practitioner), hṛdayaṃ, whoever, he who, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, bhikṣur, or, nun, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: vā triṣkṛtvā divase vācayiṣyati tasyāhaṃ satatānubaddho bhaviṣyāmi

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·真如实际！

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, great + lean + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, beautiful + lean + hold, Noble Avalokiteśvara and Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: yaḥ khalu punar mañjuśrīr mahāśriyo devatāyā nāmadvādaśakaṃ jñāsyati

verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, Mañjuśrī, Gentle Glory Bodhisattva, great + lean + who, divinity + thus, by name + two + fringe, knowing + mouth

verses.iast: bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā
verses.meaningZh: 比丘，或、抑或，比丘尼，或、抑或，近事男，或、抑或，近事女，或、抑或

verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 圣·大·吉祥·名为·陀罗尼，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + auspiciousness + by name + Dhāraṇī, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ jaye jaye mahājaye jayavāhini jayottari kala kala mala mala cala
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，向乐趣种姓，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，胜伏愈加，再三尊手，再三垢染、尘垢瑕疵，震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! again and again, gladden + to running or fighting match, conquering (vocative invocation), conquer! victory! + further, hand again and again, stain, impurity, defilement again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: cala hulu hulu chiṇi chiṇi sarvakarmāvaraṇāni mama bhagavati sahasrāvarte sarvabuddhāvalokite cakṣuḥśrotaghrāṇajihvākāyamanovijñānaviśodhani
verses.meaningZh: 震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三具车尊，一切一切业障，我之（行者所有），世尊佛母！（呼格），千绕母尊，一切·佛陀·观照，明了觉识·净治清净·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, O bearer of cha again and again, all + karmic obscuration, my, of me (the practitioner), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! sahasrāvarte, all + Buddha + O beheld, discerning, purifying (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ suru suru prasuru prasuru bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara hara hara smara smara oṃ sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三忆念本誓，嗡！一切·佛陀·所加持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, Oṃ! all + Buddha + O blessed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切·佛陀·观照，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + Buddha + O beheld, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！法界藏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharmadhātu + O womb, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！无物·自性·正法·鸿毛·带劲，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! not being + own-being + Dharma + down + O causing to expand or blossom, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 此尊母之（连音省尾式），以陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），此尊、此法，仪轨
verses.meaningEn: Of her, of this deity, with/by Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, this one, upacāraḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 细轨·千·集，业障（宿世恶业障蔽），以一·人群·在高处·流畅，销，行
verses.meaningEn: Style + thousand + collected, karmic obscuration/obstacle, one + crowd + aloft + by, to dissolve, exists, carries on
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 佛陀·千·鸿毛·绞痛·彼，善根，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + thousand + down + pain in the bowels + him, virtuous roots, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 以换世，妙行迁变空·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，百千，对获
verses.meaningEn: Jātiparivartena, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, sgl, toward + to take
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 死时尊以及佛陀千，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: To die + O black and Buddha, looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: pratidinaṃ sahasrāvartaṃ kurvann ekaviṃśatidivasena bodhisattvasaṃkhyāṃ gacchati
verses.meaningZh: 日益、日常，威势绕，成办作持·造作离相，以二十一日，菩提萨埵僧祇，行
verses.meaningEn: Day by day, daily, powerful + circumambulate, enacting, twenty-one + by, Bodhisattva + reckoning up, exists, carries on
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 于诸圆满清净、周遍无垢中，佛土·宝箭·愈加·造偈句
verses.meaningEn: Among/in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, Buddha-field + arrow + thereto + way
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，日之，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, of heaven or day, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 犹如一切所愿，一切梦，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: Just as + wished, sleep, dream (plural), looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 真金·显色·如来，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: Gold + color + Tathāgata, looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 无限量利益，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，向不过假定今日汝
verses.meaningEn: Unmeasured + benefit, awakening, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), only + suppose now + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 永不断，事关，任务
verses.meaningEn: Satatasamitaṃ, concentrates the mind on, reflects, to be made or done
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 圣·千绕母·名为·陀罗尼，用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Noble + by name + Dhāraṇī, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼善见·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to handsome-figured, beautiful, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ suru suru prasuru prasuru tara tara bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara smara smara saṃtarpaya saṃtarpaya sarvapretānāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三弯曲、超群，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三忆念本誓，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸饿鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + of all Preta, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: anayā dhāraṇyodakasahitaṃ bhaktaṃ sapta vārān parijapya vāmahastenācchaṭātrayaṃ dattvā sarvapretebhyo vivikte pradeśe dātavyam
verses.meaningZh: 此，放置·愉快·浮肿·一连，饼，七（七佛，人群、海众，般一样，左·手·勇健·弹指·三重，齿已，向诸湖剪切力此等诸尊，远离尊，所尊，施予
verses.meaningEn: Anayā, put + delightful + dropsy + connected, bhaktaṃ, seven, crowd, multitude, wisdom + the same, left + hand + strong + snap of the fingers + triple, dattvā, a lake + shear + to, O detached / in detached, O place / in place, give
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way and speaking
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: apasarantv avatāraprekṣiṇo dadāmy ahaṃ sarvalokadhātuvāsināṃ pretānām āhāram iti
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，生事，施予饶益·施度调伏，我、真我自性，世界·界·天衣·勇健，诸饿鬼、薜荔多之，楼阁，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, avatāraprekṣiṇo, granting, I, the awakened self, the universe + realm + garment + strong, of all Preta, hungry ghost/departed spirit, tower, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，任务
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, to be made or done
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: evaṃ sarvapretānāṃ taṇḍuladroṇabhaktaṃ pratyekaṃ dattaṃ bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，一切诸饿鬼，水稻·斗斛·饼，别主，施度调伏·真如实际，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, all + of all Preta, grain + valley, pratyekaṃ, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: evaṃ kurvan na durbalo bhavati na daridro bhavaty api tu jātau
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，成办作持·造作离相，不、非、无，弱，成办、生起、安住，不、非、无，流浪者、贫苦，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，亦、虽、乃至，然而、而、实则，生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, enacting, not, non-, weak, becomes, arises, is, not, non-, vagrant, strolling, poor, needy, beggar, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, even, also, but, indeed, moreover, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: jātau mahābalaḥ prāsādiko darśanīya āḍhyo mahābhogo bhavati dīrghāyur arogī kṣipraṃ cānuttarāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，大力，颜容殊妙，众所乐见，富，广大规模，成办、生起、安住，长寿，无病佛母，疾，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), mahābalaḥ, prāsādiko, = + to be shown, to be made to appear, āḍhyo, of great extent, becomes, arises, is, long-lived, free from disease, healthy, speedy, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 三耶三佛，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际以及乐·鸿毛·那个，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，愈加造偈句
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness and easy + down + that, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention, thereto + way
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），善见，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, handsome-figured, beautiful, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

O one endowed with power, strength, spiritual force, O one endowed with jerk, wrench, shock, plenty, abundance again and again, they plenty, abundance, nourishing, upholding (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: Just as, according to, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, elsewhere + O black, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, filled with astonishment and wonder, they be! become! thus, in that same way, write, writer, scribe, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace

verses.meaningEn: If, when, pure, cleansed, bright, impure, or, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & beyond nominal designation, great

verses.meaningEn: Broken + back + straw + back of the neck, immutable Suchness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency

verses.meaningEn: By/through bad, evil, painful, rough, constrained, affected, unnatural, likhi, him, that, śāstraṃ, like a son, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust

verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & space-like boundlessness, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, nourishing, press out + naked, fruition of enlightenment & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1326 (839 Nepāla Saṃvat (1719 CE)) 外交转写（第 44 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，向五乐趣出，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，老苦
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, making, five + gladden + to, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, decrepitude, old age

verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), cause, underlying and determining factor
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1326 (839 Nepāla Saṃvat (1719 CE)) 外交转写（第 46 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，火供净施·离一切相无相，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, sacred offering, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1326 (839 Nepāla Saṃvat (1719 CE)) 外交转写（第 47 句）

verses.meaningZh: 福利、大乐，愿一切皆得安乐成就，一切施，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入
verses.meaningEn: Welfare, bliss, may all be blessed & accomplished! one who gives everything, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1326 (839 Nepāla Saṃvat (1719 CE)) 外交转写（第 48 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te śca bhikṣavaḥ bodhisattvamahāsattvā,, sā ca sarvvāvatīparṣa,, sadevamānuṣāśuragaruḍagandharvvaś ca loko bhagavato,, bhāṣitaḥm abhyanandan iti
verses.meaningZh: 此、此妙法，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向汝、彼等，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），希望鸿毛，菩提萨埵摩诃萨埵，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满以及世间、世界，以世尊此，宣说演畅·破有相福德光，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, to Thee / they, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, wish for + down, Bodhisattva + Mahāsattva, she, that and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, bearing and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, speaking, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 36 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·曜执·母，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·远离寂静周遍），名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Noble + planet + mother, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 37 句）

verses.iast: ye dharmmā hetu,,prabhāvā,, hetu teṣāṃ tathāgato,, [ -1- ] hy avadat teṣāṃñ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādi (!) mahāśramanaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因，威，因，彼等一切之，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际，真如实际·六度满行清净·圣智通达以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是论者，乐趣·精庐·我等
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, cause, of them, their, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & non-dual wisdom awareness and who, whichever, suppression, thus + O vādī, gladden + hermitage + us
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 38 句）

verses.iast: śreyo stu samvat eka,, netra,, durggā, māsa, māghaśuddhi 1 saṃpūrṇṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 妙，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·损减除灭忧苦），随着不过逮捕，一、唯一不二，眼目、清净慧眼，难近母，月，季冬贞洁，充分、欲滴
verses.meaningEn: Śreyo, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — dispelling sorrow, along with + only apprehend, one, single, non-dual, eye, guiding vision, Durga, moon , month, relating to the constellation Maghā + purification, full, replete, filled or richly furnished with
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 39 句）

verses.iast: dānapati jajomān , bhadra-pūli-mahānagala-śrīvajācāryya,-rājamuṇiyā hlya (!) sakṣatrasacodāvarasa,-atidharmma-citta utpattijayā jo,thamanaśvārddhārthanimitina [ dayakā jātayājalaśubhaṃ ḥ
verses.meaningZh: 施主，战士救度者，贤，第一义谛·离一切相无相，大·不·喉轮，吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），彼·田园·若是·施予·无味，太正法，心、菩提心、心识，三摩耶誓耶，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，他·自尊·膨胀·放置·他·在于·称计·不，施度调伏·一乘如实之道·造作离相，清净吉祥·生起不可得·尊胜，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入
verses.meaningEn: A very liberal man, warrior + protector, blessed, ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), great + not + throat, glorious, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, he + field + if + giving + tasteless, very + Dharma, mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, occurrence + Jayā, transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, tha + pride + swell + put + tha + in + measure + not, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, auspicious, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 40 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严，吉祥，愿一切皆得安乐成就，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, maṅgalaṃ, may all be blessed & accomplished! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1315 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 41 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān mahāvajramerusikharakūṭāgāre viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, great (vocative invocation), lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大·金刚三昧经·地·依止处，大·金刚·细轨·茂盛树·随着·严尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + Vajrasamādhi + ground + O basis, great + Vajra + style + tree + along with + O adornment
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，第一，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Great, first or primary rule, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·大随求佛母·即是，大明咒不是了知，守护·法事·劫，明咒·驮·好吃·出，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + Mahāpratisarā + thus, Mahāvidyā + not knowing, protection + arrangement, Vidyā + dha + palatable + income, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·大·因达罗·转载·具调伏摧碾一切恶障佛母，名为、号曰，大·不·界线，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + consisting of 1000 + forward + possessing subdue and pulverize all evil forces! by name, called, great + not, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: [ ārya ] mahāmāyūrī vidyārājñī [ a ] yamu pacāravidhi samāpta
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，孔雀明王，明妃，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，成熟善根·此边·法事，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), Peahen Queen, wise consort, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! + the hither + way, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 具足圣大冷尊，名为、号曰，明咒不是了知，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + endowed with sail, by name, called, Vidyā + not knowing, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.iast: jānīha bhūtāti samāgatāni sthitāni bhūmav (!) athavāntarīkṣe
verses.meaningZh: 婆利耶于此，部多鬼神太，随着一切来，一切立，破有相福德光·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，尔时·吐·现见
verses.meaningEn: Wife + here, spirit + very, along with + to come, standing, abiding, remaining, blessedness transcending existence & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, now + to vomit + O looking
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: kurvantu maitrī satataṃ prajāsu divā ca rātrau ca carantu dharmam
verses.meaningZh: 愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！慈心（与乐大慈），不已、从来，于诸裔胄、孩子们中，截至日子以及清净离诸尘垢·真如实际以及愿悉行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），正法、诸法实相
verses.meaningEn: May they all perform/grant! loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), continual, in bringing forth, by day and stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) and may they move forth in compassionate activity!! Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: iti tatra buddhānubhāvena devatānubhāvena mahāti iti [ ryyu ] paśānteti
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），于彼处、其中，以佛陀体面，以何为体面，酒席太，如是（结句印定），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·损减除灭忧苦），不过·一极·瘟疫
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, there, therein, Buddha + by, divinity + by, feast + very, thus, so it is stated, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — dispelling sorrow, only + ultimate + plague
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

verses.iast: āryaśrimahāpratiśarā, mahāsāhasrapramardinī, mahāmāyurī, mahāśitavatī, mahāmantrānusāranī etāni paṃ [ -1- ] mahārakṣāsutrāṇi samāpta
verses.meaningZh: 圣·清癯·大·对·箭，大·因达罗·转载·具调伏摧碾一切恶障佛母，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，具足乐趣充填，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一切长柄、本刹，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），大·守护·一切迫切往外，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + lean + great + toward + reed, great + consisting of 1000 + forward + possessing subdue and pulverize all evil forces! great, gladden + endowed with eaten, great, stem, sgl, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, great + protection + pressing out, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 13 句）

verses.iast: ye dharmā hetuprabhāvā hetu (!) teṣān tathāgata hy a [ -2- ]
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因威，因，真如实际·六度满行清净·离名相假立，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + might, cause, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 14 句）

verses.iast: teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃ vādī mahāśramaṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 彼等一切之以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是、如此，论者，大沙弥
verses.meaningEn: Of them, their and who, whichever, suppression, thus, in this way, vādī, great + ascetic
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 随着不过逮捕

verses.meaningZh: 彼·不已·慈父·战士·战士·星宿·星宿·星宿·星宿

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asama-samanta-avabhāsa-spharaṇa-gati-gagana-svabhāva-viśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！无等、无比伦，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，遍，趣向、六趣、妙行，虚空、清净苍穹，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, unequalled, peerless, matchless, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, suffusion, pervasion, course, path, realm of rebirth, sky, boundless space, firmament, own-being, intrinsic nature, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，善逝、好去（妙往涅槃），殊胜、胜愿、妙好，言，甘露、不死妙法，破有相福德光·六度满行清净·造作离相，大手印、大法契印，真言、密咒（护心密语），以诸句、足迹、法位
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), Sugata, Well-Gone Blissful One, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, word, ambrosia, nectar of immortality, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & freedom from karmic agency, Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, Mantra, sacred formula, by/with word, verse-foot, step, abode
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ āhara āhara mama āyuḥ-saṃdhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya gagana-svabhāva-viśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命、无量寿，擎尊，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！虚空、清净苍穹，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force, longevity, O supporting, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, sky, boundless space, firmament, own-being, intrinsic nature, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: uṣṇīṣavijaya-pariśuddhe sahasra-raśmi-saṃcodite sarvatathāgata-avalokini ṣaṭ-pāramitā-paripūraṇi sarvatathāgata-māte daśa-bhūmi-pratiṣṭhite sarvatathāgata-hṛdaya-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite
verses.meaningZh: 佛顶肉髻相最胜尊胜，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，千、千手千眼，光芒、百千光明聚，一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，一切如来，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，六（六度，波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满），般遂尊，一切如来，母尊，十（十方，地、菩萨十地，踞尊，一切如来，心、心髓、根本心咒，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, thousand, ray of light, beam, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), six, Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond, wisdom + O satisfy, all Tathagatas, māte, ten, ground, stage (bodhisattva bhūmi), O squat / in squat, all Tathagatas, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mudre mudre mahāmudre vajra-kāya-saṃhatana-pariśuddhe sarvakarmāvaraṇa-viśuddhe pratinivartaya mama āyur-viśuddhe sarvatathāgata-samaya-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite oṃ muni
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），身、佛身法身，好好儿编织不，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，一切业障，最极清净、究竟净除尊，请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！我之（行者所有），寿命（连音式），最极清净、究竟净除尊，一切如来，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，嗡！牟尼、寂默圣者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, body, kāya (sacred dimension), struck together + not, O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, all + karmic obscuration, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, turn back (evil)! restore! my, of me (the practitioner), life, longevity, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, all Tathagatas, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Oṃ! Muni, silent sage
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: muni mahāmuni vimuni mahāvimuni mati mati mahāmati mamati sumati tathatā-bhūtakoṭi-pariśuddhe visphuṭa-buddhi-śuddhe he
verses.meaningZh: 牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼，再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧，我之（行者所有），善心、人情，真如、如实法性，实际、真如本际，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，闢开，觉慧、明觉，清净、纯洁无染尊，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: Muni, silent sage, Great Sage (Mahāmuni), settle + Muni, great + settle + Muni, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom, my, of me (the practitioner), benevolence, favour, Suchness, ultimate reality (Tathatā), limit of reality, ultimate truth (Bhūtakoṭi), O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, settle + suffused, awakened intellect, comprehension, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.iast: he jaya jaya vijaya vijaya smara smara sphara sphara sphāraya sphāraya sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite
verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！再三忆念本誓，再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！再三请大放光明遍照十方！一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, conquer! victory! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, pervade! radiate forth everywhere! again and again, cause to radiate and expand universally! again and again, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.iast: śuddhe śuddhe buddhe buddhe vajre vajre mahāvajre suvajre vajragarbhe jaya-garbhe vijaya-garbhe vajra-jvālā-garbhe
verses.meaningZh: 再三清净、纯洁无染尊，再三佛陀、觉者尊，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊，勇健金刚杵尊，金刚藏尊，胜伏、最胜吉祥！藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），光焰、智慧炽盛火焰，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊
verses.meaningEn: O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright again and again, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, great + O Vajra, O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt, vajragarbhe, conquer! victory! O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, supreme victory! triumph! O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, blaze, flame, radiant fire, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: vajrodbhave vajrasaṃbhave vajre vajriṇi vajram bhavatu mama śarīraṃ sarvasattvānāṃ ca kāya-pariśuddhiś ca
verses.meaningZh: 金刚氏族，金刚三婆婆尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，金刚，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有），躯，诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及身、佛身法身，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O origin, Vajra + O Sambhava, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, vajram, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner), śarīraṃ, of all all sentient beings and body, kāya (sacred dimension), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: bhavatu me sadā sarvagati-pariśuddhiś ca sarvatathāgatāś ca māṃ samāśvāsayantu
verses.meaningZh: 愿成就、愿悉吉祥，于我、为我，恒常、一切时，趣往一切处、圆通，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及我，愿诸如来慈悲安慰授记！
verses.meaningEn: May it be, let there be! to me, my, always, evermore, going everywhere, all-pervading, omnipresent, universal, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and me (the practitioner), may they comfort and encourage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.iast: oṃ siddhya siddhya buddhya buddhya bodhaya bodhaya vibodhaya vibodhaya mocaya mocaya vimocaya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请成就妙悉地！再三请觉察、慈悲垂念！再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！再三请解脱、令离系缚！请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! be accomplished! manifest siddhi! again and again, awake! know! perceive! again and again, awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, fully awaken and enlighten! again and again, liberate! set free! release! again and again, thoroughly liberate and emancipate!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

verses.iast: vimocaya śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya samantān mocaya samanta-raśmi-pariśuddhe sarvatathāgata-hṛdaya-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite mudre mudre mahāmudre
verses.meaningZh: 请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄！再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！普遍、周遍十方，请解脱、令离系缚！普遍、周遍十方，光芒、百千光明聚，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，一切如来，心、心髓、根本心咒，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly liberate and emancipate! purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, universal, all-encompassing, liberate! set free! release! universal, all-encompassing, ray of light, beam, O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, all Tathagatas, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大手印、大法契印，真言、密咒（护心密语），以诸句、足迹、法位，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, Mantra, sacred formula, by/with word, verse-foot, step, abode, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥泡沫，圣佛顶尊胜佛母，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness + bubble, noble + Uṣṇīṣavijayā, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 15 句）

verses.iast: ṃjñ ] ke mahāvanavare ghosirālāme mahatā mahābhikṣusaghena sārdhaṃ pa ñcamātrair bhikṣuśataiḥ sabahu
verses.meaningZh: 若字门（般若无分别圣智（jñāna）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），酒席·鸿毛·那婆罗尊，吞食·众多·是的尊，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以大比丘平等，俱，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），圣智通达·妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，以诸比丘百，彼多
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual prajñā gnosis (jñāna) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, feast + down, devour + having many or strong veins + O yes, great, great + beggar + by, together, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness, beggar + by, he + many
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.iast: laiś ca mahāśrā vakair asaṃkhyayaś (!) ca bodhisatvair mmahāsatvaiḥ sarvabuddhasamanvāgataiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·大自在威德统摄）以及大沸腾，最上真言离言说·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道以及菩提·参半·极微，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以诸一切佛陀成就
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — sovereign spiritual mastery and great + ) roast, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening and Bodhi + equally + particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, great, all + Buddha + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: Incipit, section: tena khalu punaḥ samayena kośāṃbyā (!) mahānagaryāṃ sucandro nāma gṛhapatiḥ prativasati sma
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行迁变空·第一义谛，一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·真如实际，借由彼力、以是因缘，诚然、确实，复次、再三，以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），造作离相·本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，妙月，名为、号曰，理家，对髁骨，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, by that truth, thereby, through that power, indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, by/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & spiritual strength freeing bonds, great, sucandro, by name, called, householder, toward + donʼt stop ! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.iast: idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā āyuṣmān ānandas te ca bhikṣavas te ca bodhisatvā
verses.meaningZh: 此、此妙法，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，愉悦、伊人，具寿，离名相假立·施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满，向汝、彼等以及希望人情，向汝、彼等以及菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, glad at heart, delighted, āyuṣmān, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to Thee / they and wish for + favour, to Thee / they and Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.iast: mahāsattvā sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuraga ndharvaloko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti
verses.meaningZh: 摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·气息·宝树宝山，持守摄受·离名相假立，以世尊此，妙语、语言，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + vital spirit + tree or mountain, bearing, Bhagavān + hence, spoken, told, uttered, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·吉祥·财源佛母，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入
verses.meaningEn: Noble + auspiciousness + Vasudhārā, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: ye dharmmā hetuprabhāvā hetu teṣān tathāgato hy avadat teṣāñ ca yo nirodha evaṃvā dī mahāśramanaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因威，因，真如实际·六度满行清净·离名相假立，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际，真如实际·六度满行清净·圣智通达以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是或，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，乐趣·精庐·我等
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + might, cause, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & non-dual wisdom awareness and who, whichever, suppression, thus + or, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — deep samādhi retention, gladden + hermitage + us
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 驮都正法
verses.meaningEn: Realm + Dharma
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

verses.iast: yaṃ 'pravaramahāyānayāyinaḥ paramopāśaka (!) śrīphataśālagṛhādhivāśinajaka nājabhārobhāryāputrapautrādi [ ḥ ] sagaraparivārasya yad atra
verses.meaningZh: 风大自在除障种子，广大殊胜·第一义谛，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息，离名相假立·生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，气象眷属之，凡所…者，于此处、今此
verses.meaningEn: Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, great, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, glorious, beyond nominal designation & transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, the atmosphere + of accessory, which, what, that which, here, in this place
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 13 句）

verses.iast: puṇyaṃ tad bhavatv ācāryopādhyā yamātāpitṛpurvaṅgamaṅ kṛtvā sakalasatvarāśe r anuttarajñānaphalam avāpnuyād iti
verses.meaningZh: 福德、胜妙功德，彼、如是真实，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，以阿遮利耶更代，趣入通行·一乘如实之道，既作已、行持已，全部·迅疾·望尊，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），无上·圣智·果，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Merit, auspicious virtue, that, thus, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, teacher + with, going toward, having done, having performed, entire + hastening + O hope, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, unsurpassed + primordial wisdom + direct effect, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 14 句）

verses.iast: samvat 676 jeṣṭamāśe kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthyāyāṃ tithau bṛhaspativārasare
verses.meaningZh: 随着不过逮捕，生起不可得·尊胜·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，下半月尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·无住安立，木星·人群·流注周遍
verses.meaningEn: Along with + only apprehend, transcending birth & victorious & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O second half of the month / in second half of the month, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise (imperative seal), of a god + crowd + O flow forth and pervade with blessing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大王·大自在·童子大王·最胜·尊神，吉祥·吉祥·胜伏·恒常·寂静·大勇力士·天人，最胜尊胜油脂乳糜尊
verses.meaningEn: Great king + supreme ruler + a rich or noble lord + supreme + lord, auspiciousness + auspiciousness + conquer! victory! + always + kind + mighty champion + of god, supreme victory! triumph! + O melted or clarified butter
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, may it be so, let it be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 17 句）

oṃ namo bhagavatyai ārya-prajñāpāramitāyai | evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ||
tasmāj jñātavyam — prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro 'nuttaramantro 'samasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt ||
tadyathā — oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā | oṃ dhīḥ śruti-smṛti-vijaye svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，圣智了知·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), knowing (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），灵鸟顶山尊，时节，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以比丘圣僧伽，俱
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O Vulture Peak / in Vulture Peak, parvate, great, beggar + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyam — prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro 'nuttaramantro 'samasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，觉知勇健，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），贡高大方颤动，大明咒真言，无上真言，无等等真言，一切·苦·疗，谛、真实不虚语，从不虚
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, know + strong, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), high-minded + tremble, Mahāvidyā + Mantra, unsurpassed + Mantra, without a peer + Mantra, all + suffering + heal, truth, reality, veracity, from not false
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！文殊般若心印（甚深智慧总持），闻，正念、忆持不忘，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mañjuśrī wisdom seed syllable (prajñā), hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news, tidings, utterance or prescription, mindfulness, recollection, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，摩诃室利此处尊，吉祥相，孵化尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Mahādevī, mark, sign, O increasing, augmenting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，宝藏尊，一切义利成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

oṃ mayūrakrānte svāhā | oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! merit, auspicious virtue again and again, very auspicious or fortunate, unmeasured + merit, unmeasured + merit + primordial wisdom + something accumulated + O heaped up

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + volitional formations + thoroughly pure + Dharma, sky + tip, own-being + O completely purified, walk + O accessory, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

oṃ namo bhagavatyai ārya-suvarṇaprabhāsottamāyai sūtrendrarājāyai | tadyathā — oṃ śrī-mahādevīye lakṣmī-saṃvardhani svāhā ||
tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，摩诃室利此处尊，吉祥相，孵化尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Mahādevī, mark, sign, O increasing, augmenting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，宝藏尊，一切义利成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1395 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1395 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1395 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1395 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

oṃ namo bhagavatyai ārya-śrī-vasudhārāyai | namo ratnatrayāya | namo bhagavate vajradhara-sāgara-nirghoṣāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya ||
tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale ||
oṃ śrī-vasudhārā-ratna-nidhāna-kṣetre svāhā | oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā | oṃ śrī-vasumukhi svāhā | oṃ vasudhe svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
