verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to seven + crowd, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, to all a god

verses.meaningZh: 财源佛母（持世丰饶母）
verses.meaningEn: Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 金刚裂解
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + tearing or breaking asunder
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 誐那鉢底心
verses.meaningEn: Ganapati + heart
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶尊胜佛母
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣavijayā, Victorious Crown Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 叶衣菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Parnasavari Bodhisatttva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母）
verses.meaningEn: Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 曜执摩怛理迦
verses.meaningEn: Planet + matrix
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨，向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi, mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ truṭa truṭa troṭaya troṭaya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya ghūrṇa
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三开，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, suffused again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: ghūrṇa ghūrṇāpaya ghūrṇāpaya sarvasattvāni bodhaya saṃbodhaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 索索、滴溜溜，再三令索索、滴溜溜，一切一切众生、普皆有情，请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！祈请理解、聪慧，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling, cause to moving to and fro, trembling, whirling! again and again, all sentient beings (plural), awaken! enlighten! illuminate! may You understanding, intelligence! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1701.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.2196.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.2196.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.2196.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.2196.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向无量寿智决定王如来·圣智·报刊往外·决定·威光·王，如来·出·堪敬尊，向正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Aparimitāyus + primordial wisdom + press out + determined to + to, Tathāgata + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.153 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ puṇya puṇya mahāpuṇya aparimitapuṇya aparimitapuṇyajñānasaṃbhāropacite
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三福德、胜妙功德，大福，无限量福德，无限量·福德·圣智·资粮·积累尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! merit, auspicious virtue again and again, very auspicious or fortunate, unmeasured + merit, unmeasured + merit + primordial wisdom + something accumulated + O heaped up
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.153 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvasaṃskārapariśuddhadharmate gaganasamudgate svabhāvaviśuddhe mahānayaparivāre svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切·行·圆满清净·正法，虚空器箧，自性最极清净，大·此处·眷属尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

oṃ mahāśītavati sarva-upadrava-praśamani svāhā | oṃ mahāmantrānusāriṇi sarvapāpa-viśodhani svāhā || iti śrī-pañcarakṣā-mahāvidyārājñī-dhāraṇī samāptā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1812.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure

oṃ mayūrakrānte svāhā | oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §3】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：(7)如是我聞。一時佛在王舍大城靈鷲山中。與(8)大比丘衆滿百千人。菩薩摩訶薩七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰觀世音菩薩。文殊師利菩薩。彌(10)勒菩薩等。以爲上首。皆得三昧總持。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：’di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan ’das rgyal po’i khab na bya rgod phung po’i ri la | dge slong gi dge ’dun chen po dang | byang chub sems dpa’i dge ’dun chen po dang thabs cig (145a1) tu bzhugs te | de’i tshe bcom ldan ’das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba’i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge ’dzin la mos par zhugs so ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: Thus have I heard at one time. The Lord dwelled at Rājagṛha, on the Vulture Peak, together with a large gathering of both monks and Bodhisattvas. At that time the Lord, after he had taught the discourse on dharma called «deep splendour», had entered into concentration.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (7)如是我聞。一時佛在王舍大城靈鷲山中。與(8)大比丘衆滿百千人。菩薩摩訶薩七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰觀世音菩薩。文殊師利菩薩。彌(10)勒菩薩等。以爲上首。皆得三昧總持。
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (16 本)：San long: Vaidya (1961) 98 - · San long: Conze (1967) 148 - · Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19 · Chi: Prajñā 般若 et al. (790CE) T.253 849b24 - 850a2

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §4】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：(10)觀世音菩薩。行深般若波羅蜜時。照見五陰(11)空。度一切苦厄。 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：’dï lta ’phags pa kun tu spyan ras gzigs gyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa’ shes rab | (3) gyï pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad spyod pa’ï tshe || lta phung de dag ngo bo nyid gyïs stong par mthong ngo ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Avalokiteśwara (The Devatā of the Sūtra). When the Prajnā Pāramitā has been fully practised, then clearly behold that the five skandhas are all empty, vain, and unreal. So it is we escape the possibility of sorrow or obstruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (10)觀世音菩薩。行深般若波羅蜜時。照見五陰(11)空。度一切苦厄。
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (16 本)：San short: Vaidya (1961) · San short: Conze (1967) 148 - · San long: Vaidya (1961) 98 - · San long: Conze (1967) 148 -

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: Thereupon the Venerable Śāriputra, through the Buddha’s might, said to the holy Lord Avalokita, the Bodhisattva, the great being:

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：世尊。我欲於此會中。説(15)諸菩薩普遍智藏般若波羅蜜多心。唯願世(16)尊聽我所説。爲諸菩薩宣祕法要。爾時世尊(17)以妙梵音。告觀自在菩薩摩訶薩言。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：rigs kyi bu’am | rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par ’dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya | de skad ces smras pa dang | byang chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang (4) phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti’i bu la ’di skad ces smras so ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: «How should a son or daughter of good family train themselves if they want to course in the course of this deep perfection of wisdom?» The holy Lord Avalokita, the Bodhisattva, the great being, then said to the Venerable Śāriputra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 世尊。我欲於此會中。説(15)諸菩薩普遍智藏般若波羅蜜多心。唯願世(16)尊聽我所説。爲諸菩薩宣祕法要。爾時世尊(17)以妙梵音。告觀自在菩薩摩訶薩言。
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (16 本)：San long: Vaidya (1961) 98 - · San long: Conze (1967) 148 - · Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19 · Chi: Prajñā 般若 et al. (790CE) T.253 849b24 - 850a2

verses.iast: iha śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā, śūnyataiva rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：善哉善(18)哉具大悲者。聽汝所説。與諸衆生作大光明。(19)於是觀自在菩薩摩訶薩蒙佛聽許。佛所護(20)念。入於慧光三昧正受。入此定已。以三昧力(21)行深般若波羅蜜多時。照見五蘊自性皆空。(22)彼了知五蘊自性皆空。從彼三昧安詳而起。(23)即告慧命舍利弗言。 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：de ni sha ri ’ï
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 142 -: II. Here, O Sariputra,
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 善哉善(18)哉具大悲者。聽汝所説。與諸衆生作大光明。(19)於是觀自在菩薩摩訶薩蒙佛聽許。佛所護(20)念。入於慧光三昧正受。入此定已。以三昧力(21)行深般若波羅蜜多時。照見五蘊自性皆空。(22)彼了知五蘊自性皆空。從彼三昧安詳而起。(23)即告慧命舍利弗言。

verses.iast: ihaṃ śāriputra sarvadharmāḥ śūnyatālakṣaṇā anutpannā aniruddhā amalā na vimalā nonā na paripūrṇāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：舍利弗是諸法空相。不生不滅。不垢不(16)淨。不増不減。是空法。非過去非未來非現在。 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：’dï ni sha rï ’i bo chos tham cad stong pa nyïd gyi mtshan ma ste || myï skyes myi ’gog || myi tsangs (6) myï brtsog || myï ’phel myi ’bri |
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Śāriputra. All these things around us (ye dhammā) being thus stript or devoid of qualities (lakshaṅa [sic]), there can be no longer birth or death, defilement or purity, addition or destruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 舍利弗是諸法空相。不生不滅。不垢不(16)淨。不増不減。是空法。非過去非未來非現在。

verses.iast: na vidyā nāvidyā na vidyākṣayo nāvidyākṣayo yāvanna jarāmaraṇaṃ na jarāmaraṇakṣayo na duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgā na jñānaṃ na prāptitvam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §10】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：(19)無無明亦無無明盡。乃至無老死無老死盡。(20)無苦集滅道。無智亦無得。以無所得故。 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：rig pa yang myed | ma rig pa yang myed | rig pa zad pa yang myed | ma rig pa zad pa yang myed | rga shes shi ba yang myed | rga shing shi ba yang (9)zad pa yang myed || sdug bsngal ba dang | ’dus pa dang ’gog pa dang || lam yang myed | shes pa yang myed | thob pa yang myed | ma thob pa yang myed | par
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: So there will be no such thing as ignorance (avdiyā), nor yet freedom from ignorance, and therefore these can be none of its consequences (viz., the twelve nidānas. Colebrooke p.255); and therefore no such thing as decay or death (jarā or maraṅa), nor yet freedom from decay and death. So neither can there be a method (or way) for destroying the concourse of sorrows. No such thing as wisdom, and no such thing as attaining (happiness or rest), as there will not be ought that can be attained.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (19)無無明亦無無明盡。乃至無老死無老死盡。(20)無苦集滅道。無智亦無得。以無所得故。

verses.iast: bodhisattvasya(ś ca?) prajñāpāramitām āśritya viharati cittāvaraṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §11】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：菩薩(21)依般若波羅蜜故。心無罣礙。 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：byang chub (10)sems dpa’ shes rab gyï pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas ne | spyod pas sems spyod pa yang myed sems myï spyod pa yang myed | de ltar myed pa la gnas | (11)na logs pa la shin tu ’das te || thub pa ni mya ngan las ’das pa’o ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: The Bodhisatwa resting on this Prajnā Pāramitā, no sorrow of obstruction can then affect his heart, for there will be no (28) such thing as sorrow of obstruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 菩薩(21)依般若波羅蜜故。心無罣礙。
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (16 本)：San short: Vaidya (1961) · San short: Conze (1967) 148 - · San long: Vaidya (1961) 98 - · Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyaḥ prajñāpāramitāmahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro ’nuttaramantro ’samasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：故知般若波羅蜜是大明呪。無上明呪。(25)無等等明呪。能除一切苦眞實不虚故説般 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：(13)de bas nas shes rab gyi pha rol phyin pa chen po ’i sngag || bla na myed pa’i sngag mnyam ba dang myï mnyam ba’ï sngags | sdug sngal thams cad | (14)rab tu zhi ba’i sngags | bden te myï brdzun pas na |
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Therefore know that this Prajnā Pāramitā is the the Great Spiritual Dhāraṇī,–it is the Great Light-giving Dhāraṇī. This is the unsurpassed Dhāraṇī. This is the unequalled Dhāraṇī, able to destroy all sorrows. True and real, (i.e., full of meaning), not vain (i.e., unmeaning).
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 故知般若波羅蜜是大明呪。無上明呪。(25)無等等明呪。能除一切苦眞實不虚故説般

verses.iast: atha khalu bhagavān tasmāt samādher vyutthāya āryāvalokiteśvarasya bodhisattvasya sādhukāram adāt - sādhu sādhu kulaputra

(790CE) T.253 849b24 - 850a2：即時世尊從(24)廣大甚深三摩地起。讃觀自在菩薩摩訶薩(25)言。善哉善哉。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：de nas bcom ldan ’das ting nge ’dzin de las bzhengs te | byang chub (6) sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas | legs so legs so ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: Thereupon the Lord emerged from that concentration, and he applauded the holy Lord Avalokita, the Bodhisattva, the great being: «Well said, well said,
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 即時世尊從(24)廣大甚深三摩地起。讃觀自在菩薩摩訶薩(25)言。善哉善哉。

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：(29)摩訶般若波羅蜜大明呪經 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang | lo tstsha ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing | zhu chen gyi lo tstsha ba dge blo dang nam mkha’ la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab pa || ||
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (16 本)：Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29 · Chi: Xuanzang 玄奘 (649CE) T.251 848c4 - 848c23 · Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19 · Chi: Prajñā 般若 et al. (790CE) T.253 849b24 - 850a2

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 即說呪曰：揭諦揭諦 波羅揭諦 波羅僧揭諦 菩提薩婆訶。般若波羅蜜多心經。

Tārānamaskāraikaviṃśatistotra
namas tārāyai
namastāre ture vīre kṣaṇadyutinibhekṣaṇe | trailokyanāthavaktrābja- vikasatkamalodbhave
namaḥ śataśaraccandra- saṃpūrṇapaṭalānane | tārāsahasranikara- prahasatkiraṇojjvale
namaḥ kanakanīlābja- pāṇipadmavibhūṣite | dānavīryatapaḥśānti- titikṣādhyānagocare
namas tathāgatoṣṇīṣa- vijayānantacāriṇi | 'śeṣapāramitāprāpta- jinaputraniṣevite
namas tutrārehuṃkāra- pūritāśādigantare | saptalokakramākrānti niśeṣākarṣaṇakṣame
namaḥ śakrānalabrahma- marudviśveśvarārcite | bhūtavetālagandharva- gaṇayakṣapuraskṛte
namas traḍ iti phaṭkāra- parayantrapramardini | pratyālīḍhapadanyāse śikhijvālākulojjvale
namas ture mahāghore mālavīravināśini | bhṛkuṭīkṛtavaktrābja- sarvaśatruniṣūdini
namas triratnamudrāṅka- hṛdyāṅgulivibhūṣite | bhūṣitāśeṣadikcakra- nikarasvakarākule
namaḥ pramuditāśeṣa- muktākṣīraprasāriṇi | hasatprahasattutāre māralokavaśaṃkari
namaḥ samantabhūpāla- paṭalākarṣaṇakṣame | caladbhṛkuṭihūṃkāra- sarvāpadavimocini
namaḥ śikhaṇḍakhaṇḍendu- mukuṭābharaṇojjvale | amitābhajaṭābhāra- bhāsvārakiraṇadhruve
namaḥ kalpāntahutabhug- jvālāmālāntarasthite | ālīḍhamuditābaddha- ripucakravināśini
namaḥ karatalāghāta- caraṇāhatabhūtale | bhṛkuṭīkṛtahuṃkāra- saptapātālabhedini
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
namaḥ pramuditābaddha- ripugātraprabhedini | daśākṣarapadanyāsa- vidyāhuṃkāradīpite
namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
namaḥ surasarākāra- hariṇāṅkakarasthite | tāradviruktaphaṭkāra aśeṣaviṣanāśini
namaḥ suragaṇayakṣa- kiṃnarasevite | ābaddhamuditābhoga- kaliduḥsvapnanāśini
namaś candrārkasampūrṇa- nayanadyutibhāsvare | haradviruktatuttāre- viṣamajvaranāśini
namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam

verses.diplomaticOriginal: rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||

verses.iast: namastāre ture vīre kṣaṇadyutinibhekṣaṇe | trailokyanāthavaktrābja- vikasatkamalodbhave
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §3】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮救度速勇母 目如剎那電光照 三世界尊蓮華面 從妙華中現端嚴 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo | | spyan ni skad cig glog daṅ 'dra ma | | 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes źal gyi | | ge sar phye ba las ni byuṅ ma | |(1)
verses.meaningEn: Homage + O a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, birth under favorable conditions + splendour + like + O look Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, of a man + equally + lotus blossom + O origin
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮救度速勇母 目如剎那電光照 三世界尊蓮華面 從妙華中現端嚴
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo | | spyan ni skad cig glog daṅ 'dra ma | | 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes źal gyi | | ge sar phye ba las ni byuṅ ma | |(1)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §4】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮百秋朗月母 普遍圓滿無垢面 如千星宿俱時聚 殊勝威光超於彼 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun du | | gaṅ ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i źal ma | | skar ma stoṅ phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis | | rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma | |(2)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, full, cover, O mouth! Tārā + thousand + heap, blazing (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮百秋朗月母 普遍圓滿無垢面 如千星宿俱時聚 殊勝威光超於彼
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun du | | gaṅ ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i źal ma | | skar ma stoṅ phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis | | rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma | |(2)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §5】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮紫磨金色母 妙蓮華手勝莊嚴 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性無境 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal gser sṅo chu nas skyes kyi | | pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma | | sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub źi ba | | bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul ñid ma | |(3)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold, blue lotus, a lotus hand, O magnificence! Generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), endurance + meditative concentration + O scope
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮紫磨金色母 妙蓮華手勝莊嚴 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性無境
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal gser sṅo chu nas skyes kyi | | pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma | | sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub źi ba | | bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul ñid ma | |(3)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮如來頂髻母 最勝能滿無邊行 得到彼岸盡無餘 勝勢佛子極所愛 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal de bźin gśegs pa'i gtsug tor | | mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma | | ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i | | rgyal ba'i sras kyis śin tu bsten ma | |(4)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Tathāgata, Uṣṇīṣa, supreme victory! triumph!, boundless, O bearer of prison! No rest or remainder + Pāramitā + filled with astonishment and wonder, son of a Buddha + O inhabited
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮如來頂髻母 最勝能滿無邊行 得到彼岸盡無餘 勝勢佛子極所愛
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal de bźin gśegs pa'i gtsug tor | | mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma | | ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i | | rgyal ba'i sras kyis śin tu bsten ma | |(4)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮怛囉吽字母 聲愛方所滿虛空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召攝無餘 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūṃ yi ge | | 'dod daṅ phyogs daṅ nam mkha' gaṅ ma | | 'jig rten bdun po źabs kyis mnan te | | lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma | |(5)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, fulfilling (vocative invocation)! Seven + world + stride + ascending, in + offspring + the same as + O enduring
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮怛囉吽字母 聲愛方所滿虛空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召攝無餘
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūṃ yi ge | | 'dod daṅ phyogs daṅ nam mkha' gaṅ ma | | 'jig rten bdun po źabs kyis mnan te | | lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma | |(5)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §8】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮釋梵火天母 風神自在眾俱集 部多起屍尋香等 諸藥叉眾作稱歎 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshaṅs pa | | rluṅ lha sna tshogs dbaṅ phyug mchod ma | | 'byuṅ po ro laṅs dri za rnams daṅ | | gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma | |(6)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to powerful, sacred fire, priest, god, two, swell, Īśvara, O beset! Spirit + a kind of goblins or vampires + Gandharva, assembly + Yakṣa + O placed before
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮釋梵火天母 風神自在眾俱集 部多起屍尋香等 諸藥叉眾作稱歎
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshaṅs pa | | rluṅ lha sna tshogs dbaṅ phyug mchod ma | | 'byuṅ po ro laṅs dri za rnams daṅ | | gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma | |(6)

verses.iast: namas traḍ iti phaṭkāra- parayantrapramardini | pratyālīḍhapadanyāse śikhijvālākulojjvale
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮特囉胝發母 於他加行極摧壞 展左踡右作足踏 頂髻熾盛極明耀 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal traṭ ces bya daṅ phaṭ kyis | | pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma | | g.yas bskum g.yon brkyaṅ źabs kyis mnan te | | me 'bar 'khrugs pa śin tu 'bar ma | |(7)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, thus, so it is stated, shatter obstacles and ignorance!, hymn of praise, someone else, suppose now, become perplexed or ashamed, this, O day! Left foot forward + O putting down the feet, blazing (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮特囉胝發母 於他加行極摧壞 展左踡右作足踏 頂髻熾盛極明耀
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal traṭ ces bya daṅ phaṭ kyis | | pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma | | g.yas bskum g.yon brkyaṅ źabs kyis mnan te | | me 'bar 'khrugs pa śin tu 'bar ma | |(7)

verses.iast: namas ture mahāghore mālavīravināśini | bhṛkuṭīkṛtavaktrābja- sarvaśatruniṣūdini
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §10】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於蓮華面作顰眉 摧壞一切冤家眾 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo | | bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma | | chu skyes źal ni khro gñer ldan mdzad | | dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma | |(8)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O most horrible / in most horrible, garland, heroic, without, O aged! Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於蓮華面作顰眉 摧壞一切冤家眾
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo | | bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma | | chu skyes źal ni khro gñer ldan mdzad | | dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma | |(8)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §11】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮三寶嚴印母 手指當心威嚴相 嚴飾方輪盡無餘 自身熾盛光聚種 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i | | sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma | | ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i | | raṅ gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma | |(9)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, jewel, stamped, being in the heart, finger or toe, O magnificence! Be busy for + going + no rest or remainder + circuit of the quarters of the compass, heap + self + O confounded
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮三寶嚴印母 手指當心威嚴相 嚴飾方輪盡無餘 自身熾盛光聚種
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i | | sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma | | ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i | | raṅ gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma | |(9)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮威德歡悅母 寶冠珠鬘眾光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作攝伏 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i | | dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreṅ ba spel ma | | bźad pa rab bźad tu ttā ra yis | | bdud daṅ 'jig rten dbaṅ du mdzad ma | |(10)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to remaining, pearl, milk, O bearer of stretching! Ferrying across (vocative invocation), Māra + mostly ) look + down + O causing welfare or happiness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮威德歡悅母 寶冠珠鬘眾光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作攝伏
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i | | dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreṅ ba spel ma | | bźad pa rab bźad tu ttā ra yis | | bdud daṅ 'jig rten dbaṅ du mdzad ma | |(10)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §13】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮守護眾地母 亦能鉤召諸神眾 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal sa gźi skyoṅ ba'i tshogs rnams | | thams cad 'gugs par nus ma ñid ma | | khro gñer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis | | phoṅs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma | |(11)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, earth-protector, spawn, cover, the same as, O enduring! Stirring, liberating (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮守護眾地母 亦能鉤召諸神眾 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal sa gźi skyoṅ ba'i tshogs rnams | | thams cad 'gugs par nus ma ñid ma | | khro gñer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis | | phoṅs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma | |(11)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮頂冠月相母 冠中現勝妙嚴光 阿彌陀佛髻中現 常放眾妙寶光明 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan | | brgyan pa thams cad śin tu 'bar ma | | ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las | | rtag par śin tu 'od ni mdzad ma | |(12)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), diadem, ornament, O flaming! Selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, be bright + sound + a pig + O steady
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮頂冠月相母 冠中現勝妙嚴光 阿彌陀佛髻中現 常放眾妙寶光明
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan | | brgyan pa thams cad śin tu 'bar ma | | ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las | | rtag par śin tu 'od ni mdzad ma | |(12)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §15】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮如盡劫火母 安住熾盛頂髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧滅壞惡冤輪 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phreṅ ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyaṅ g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpuṅ ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sacred offering, blaze, garland, O being within! To expound + bound, deceitful + wheel + without + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮如盡劫火母 安住熾盛頂髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧滅壞惡冤輪
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phreṅ ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyaṅ g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpuṅ ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §16】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal sa gźi'i ṅos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun ciṅ źabs kyis brduṅ ma | | khro gñer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the palm of the hand, malicious feeling, residence, beaten, O the surface of the earth! Bhṛkuṭī + done + the sound hum, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal sa gźi'i ṅos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun ciṅ źabs kyis brduṅ ma | | khro gñer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)

verses.iast: namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §17】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮安隱柔善母 涅槃寂滅最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消滅大災禍 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma źi ma | | mya ṅan 'das źi spyod yul ñid ma | | svā hā oṃ daṅ yaṅ dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ñid ma | |(15)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, to, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, peaceful, Nirvāṇa, O scope! Hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed + the sacred syllable Om + saṃ + O yoked, long flight + be glad + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮安隱柔善母 涅槃寂滅最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消滅大災禍
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma źi ma | | mya ṅan 'das źi spyod yul ñid ma | | svā hā oṃ daṅ yaṅ dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ñid ma | |(15)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮普遍極喜母 諸怨支體令脫離 十字呪句妙嚴布 明呪吽聲常朗耀 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i ṅag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hūṃ las sgron ma ñid ma | |(16)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to strap, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation)! Fringe of a garment + a saw + putting down the feet, Vidyā + the sound hum + ) + O going
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮普遍極喜母 諸怨支體令脫離 十字呪句妙嚴布 明呪吽聲常朗耀
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i ṅag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hūṃ las sgron ma ñid ma | |(16)

verses.iast: namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §19】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, foot, O slaying, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)! Mount Meru + cream + the hither + of a mountain, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | tā ra gñis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to well-flavoured, disposition, fallow, hook, palm, O standing! A star + twice said + shatter obstacles and ignorance! + hymn of praise, no rest or remainder + stir + certainly + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §21】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha daṅ mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod daṅ rmi lam ṅan pa sel ma | |(19)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sgl, Yakṣa, a class of mythical beings, stay by, O going! Bound + joy + winding, destroying obstacles (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal ñi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gñis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gñis brjod tu ttā ra yis | | śin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, moon + arka flowers + along with + Purna, a man's name + splendour + be bright + O vowel Ferrying across (vocative invocation), perilous + be hot or feverish + certainly + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病

verses.iast: namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal de ñid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | źi ba'i mthu daṅ yaṅ dag ldan ma | | gdon daṅ ro laṅs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog ñid ma | |(21)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, father, pain, threshold, kind, ability, O accompanied by! Planet + a kind of goblins or vampires + Yakṣa + heat, destroying obstacles (vocative invocation), O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍

verses.iast: mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】Chi: T.1108A：若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)
verses.meaningEn: Mantra + to, this, here, praise, hymn, bowing Whoever, he who, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness, believing in, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, distribution + accompanied by
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)

verses.iast: sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §25】Chi: T.1108A：每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：srod daṅ tho raṅs laṅs par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu źi ba | | ṅan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa ñid do | (23)
verses.meaningEn: Evening, or, early, recalling, all + giving safety All + evil + heal, all + evil destiny + destroying
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: srod daṅ tho raṅs laṅs par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu źi ba | | ṅan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa ñid do | (23)

verses.iast: abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §26】Chi: T.1108A：此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌頂 現世富貴壽延安 當來趣向諸佛位 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis | | myur du dbaṅ ni bskur bar 'gyur la | | 'di las che ba ñid ni 'thob ciṅ | | saṅs rgyas go 'phaṅ mthar thug der 'gro | |(24)
verses.meaningEn: Abhiṣikto, may be, would become, quick, swift, seven + to, Victor + with ten million In this, feast + Thou, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, he, that one, within, of  Buddha, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌頂 現世富貴壽延安 當來趣向諸佛位
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis | | myur du dbaṅ ni bskur bar 'gyur la | | 'di las che ba ñid ni 'thob ciṅ | | saṅs rgyas go 'phaṅ mthar thug der 'gro | |(24)

verses.iast: viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §27】Chi: T.1108A：有時誤服諸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念聖尊真實力 諸惡毒藥盡消滅 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：de yi dug ni drag po chen po | | brtan gnas pa'am gźan yaṅ 'gro ba | | zos pa daṅ ni 'thuṅs pa ñid kyaṅ | | dran pas rab tu sel ba ñid thob | |(25)
verses.meaningEn: Viṣaṃ, his, of that, most horrible, standing, immovable, firm, lasting, constant, supreme ineffable speech & non-abiding equipoise, going, moving, living From remembrance, memory, tradition, forward + dulling or hebetating the mind, O gone, passed,, chew, pītam, indeed, verily, alone, or
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 有時誤服諸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念聖尊真實力 諸惡毒藥盡消滅
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §28】Chi: T.1108A：或見他人遭鬼魅 或發熱病受諸苦 若轉此讚二三七 彼諸苦惱悉蠲除 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：gdon daṅ rims daṅ dug gis gzir ba'i | | sdug bsṅal tshogs ni rnam par spoṅ ste | | sems can gźan pa rnams la yaṅ ṅo | | gñis gsum bdun du mṅon par brjod na | |(26)
verses.meaningEn: Planet + fever + stir + of mishap, supreme + very poisonous + of all loss Other + the pole of a carriage, and indeed, likewise, of all sentient being, living creature, courage, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 或見他人遭鬼魅 或發熱病受諸苦 若轉此讚二三七 彼諸苦惱悉蠲除
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: gdon daṅ rims daṅ dug gis gzir ba'i | | sdug bsṅal tshogs ni rnam par spoṅ ste | | sems can gźan pa rnams la yaṅ ṅo | | gñis gsum bdun du mṅon par brjod na | |(26)

verses.iast: putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §29】Chi: T.1108A：欲乞男女得男女 求財寶位獲富饒 善能圓滿隨意願 一切障礙不能侵 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur źiṅ | | nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams ñid thob | | 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te | | bgegs rnams med ciṅ so sor 'joms 'gyur | |
verses.meaningEn: Little son + yes, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, son, child, the young of an animal, slaying + wish, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery, dhanam All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), not, non-, by/with obstacle, impediment, obstructing spirit, toward
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 欲乞男女得男女 求財寶位獲富饒 善能圓滿隨意願 一切障礙不能侵
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur źiṅ | | nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams ñid thob | | 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te | | bgegs rnams med ciṅ so sor 'joms 'gyur | |

verses.iast: iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §30】Chi: T.1108A：根本十字真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄(入) 多 哩 都 哩 莎(引) 訶(引)。救度八難真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄 多 哩 都 哩 薩 哩嚩(二合) 琶 耶 那(引) 舍 儞 薩 哩嚩(二合) 覩(入) 枯(入) 多(引) 哩 禰 莎(引) 訶(引) | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa'i saṅs rgyas kyis bstod pa gsuṅs pa rdzogs so || ||
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness + Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha + Vairocana + spoken, Bhagavān + hastening + Arya-Tara + with, bowing, Buddha + spoken, finished, perfect
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 根本十字真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄(入) 多 哩 都 哩 莎(引) 訶(引)。救度八難真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄 多 哩 都 哩 薩 哩嚩(二合) 琶 耶 那(引) 舍 儞 薩 哩嚩(二合) 覩(入) 枯(入) 多(引) 哩 禰 莎(引) 訶(引)

1v1)(... evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin sa)maye bhagavān rājagṛhe virahati sma
tatra khalu bhagavā(3)(n anekaśatasahasrayā parṣadā parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto) dharmaṃ deśayati sma | yad uta dharmāṇāṃ nirvikalpatām ārabhya
atha tasyām eva parṣady avikalpaprabhāso nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ
bhagavāṃs teṣām etad avocat
tasya tāni kramaśo vikalpanimittāni parivarjayataḥ
tasya tāni pari(2)(varjayataḥ tadanyāni tattvanirūpaṇavikalpani)mittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
tasya tāny api parivarjayato ’parāṇi prāptinirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
evaṃ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni sarvākāravikalpanimittāny amanasikārataḥ parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena
kena kāraṇena kulaputrā avikalpadhātur avikalpa ity ucyate
katarat tad avikalpaṃ
tad yathā kulaputrā ekaghanasāramayasya pāṣāṇaparvatasyādhastān mahānānāratnaparipūrṇanidhiḥ syād ( | ) bhāsurāṇāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ mahācintāmaṇiratnānāṃ | yad uta rūpyaratnasya vā | suvarṇaratnasya vā | (3)(aśmagarbhanānāratnasya vā
tathā hi kulaputrā iyam upamā kṛ)tā yāvad evāsyārthasya vijñaptaye
kathaṃ punaḥ kulaputrā bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni yathānirdiṣṭāni vikalpanimittāni vyupaparī(3r1)(kṣamāṇo ’vikalpadhātuṃ praviśati
iha kulaputrāḥ bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvākārajñatānirūpaṇavikalpanimitta āmukhībhūta evaṃ vyupaparīkṣate
asya kulaputrā dharmaparyāyasya udgrahaṇalekhanavācanād bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ nanv eva gaṅgānadīvālukopamātmabhāvaparityāgasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalokādhātuparipūrṇaratnadānasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalpkadhātuparipūrṇatathāgatabiṃbakārāpaṇapuṇyaskandhasyeti
atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ ime gāthe abhāṣata
idam avocad bahgavān āttamanā avikalpaprabhāsaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti

verses.iast: idam avocad bahgavān āttamanā avikalpaprabhāsaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】Dun Ch 1r1 - 1r133：爾時世尊，說此經已，無分別照明菩薩摩訶薩，(133)及諸大會，聞佛所說，皆大歡喜，信受奉行。 | 藏本 (Kj D 1a1-1b2 - 6a7-6b1)：bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces ba' stsal nas | byaṅ chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par mi rtog snaṅ ba daṅ | thams cad daṅ ldan (7) pa'i 'khor de daṅ | lha daṅ | mi daṅ | lha ma yin daṅ | dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi raṅs te | bcom ldan 'das kyis gsuṅs pa la mṅon par bstod do ||
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened spiritual movement, glad at heart, delighted, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks and bodhisattvo, mahāsattvaḥ, she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + vital spirit + without smell + be eager and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, spoken, told, uttered, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 爾時世尊，說此經已，無分別照明菩薩摩訶薩，(133)及諸大會，聞佛所說，皆大歡喜，信受奉行。

verses.meaningEn: eng: Ānanda, in the eastern quarter there is lightning called ‘Radiant’ (‘od rather than ‘ong?). In the southern quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Hundred moments/Languages. In the western quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Fading light’. In the northern quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Lord of the stream’.

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】梵本义译：即说咒曰：嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！ | 藏本 (tib Kg gzuṅs ’du e 273b4 - 275a7-276a1)：tadya thā | ha te bi ha te | ni ha te | pra tyarthi ke | pra tya mi tre | śuddhe | mukte | bi ma le | pra bhā sva re | aṇḍā re | (5) paṇḍa re | śve te | paṇḍa ra bā si ni | ha ri ka ra di | piṅga lākṣi danti mu khi | dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las bdag la srungs shig srungs shig | 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzi brjid kyis bdag dus ma yin par (6) 'chi ba thams cad mthong bar ma gyur cig svā hā |
verses.meaningEn: eng: Tadyathā | hate bihate nihate pratyarthike pratyamitre | śuddhe mukte bimale prabhāsvare aṇḍāre paṇḍare śvete paṇḍarabāsini | hari kara di | pi Drāviḍa mantragalālṣi dantimukhi | Protect us from from all untimely death! verses.iast: 4 oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya | namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāya
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】T. 449 404c13-401a26 - 401b20-24：(401a04)藥師如來本願功德經序 (401a05)藥師如來本願經者，致福消災之要法也；曼殊以慈悲之力請說尊號，如來以利物之心盛陳功業；十二大願彰因行之弘遠，七寶莊嚴顯果德之純淨；憶念稱名則眾苦咸脫，祈請供養則諸願皆滿；至於病士求救應死更生，王者攘災轉禍為福；信是消百怪之神符，除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世，鹿野寺沙門慧簡已曾譯出在世流行，但以梵宋不融、文辭雜糅，致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披葉典，思遇此經驗其紕謬；開皇十七年初獲一本，猶恐脫誤未敢即翻，至大業十一年復得二本，更相讎比方為揩定，遂與三藏法師達磨笈多，并大隋翻經沙門法行明則、長順海馭等，於東都洛水南上林園翻經舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失，故一言出口必三覆乃書，傳度幽旨差無大過；其年十二月八日翻勘方了，仍為一卷。(401a21)所願此經深義人人共解，彼佛名號處處遍聞，十二夜叉念佛恩而護國，七千眷屬承經力以利民，帝祚遐永，群生安樂，式貽來世序云爾。 佛說藥師如來本願經 (401a26)新翻藥師經，大業十二年十二月八日，沙門慧矩等六人，於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定，諸讀誦者願莫更疑，得罪不輕。 | 藏本 (Kj D 274a2 - 274b2-4)：(2)saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for omniscient Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Bhaiṣajyaguru, lapis lazuli, light, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
