233,1)21: dhāraṇīparivartaḥ
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat kiyad bhagavan sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā puṇyaṃ prasavet, ya imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayet, kāyagataṃ vā pustakagataṃ vā kṛtvā?
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyāṃ bhagavantam etad avocat
anye manye mane mamane citte carite same samitā viśānte mukte muktatame same aviṣame samasame jaye kṣaye akṣaye akṣiṇe śānte samite dhāraṇi ālokabhāṣe pratyavekṣaṇi nidhiru abhyantaraniviṣṭe abhyantarapāriśuddhimutkule araḍe paraḍe sukāṅkṣi asamasame buddhavilokite dharmaparīkṣite saṃghanirghoṣaṇi nirghoṇi bhayābhayaviśodhani mantre mantrākṣayate rute rutakauśalye akṣaye akṣayavanatāye vakkule valoḍra amanyanatāye svāhā
imāni bhagavan mantradhāraṇīpadāni dvāṣaṣṭibhir gaṅgānadīvālikāsamair buddhair bhagavadbhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu bhagavān bhaiṣajyarājāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu bhaiṣajyarāja, sattvānām arthaḥ kṛtaḥ
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantam etad avocat
234,1) atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyām imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma
jvale mahājvale ukke tukke mukke aḍe aḍāvati nṛtye nṛtyāvati iṭṭini viṭṭini ciṭṭini nṛtyani nṛtyāvati svāhā
imāni bhagavan dhāraṇīpadāni gaṅgānadīvālikāsamais tathāgatair arhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhair bhāṣitāni, anumoditāni ca
atha khalu vaiśravaṇo mahārājo bhagavantam etad avocat
aṭṭe taṭṭe naṭṭe vanaṭṭe anaḍe nāḍi kunaḍi svāhā
ebhir bhagavan dhāraṇīpadaisteṣāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ pudgalānāṃ rakṣāṃ karomi, yojanaśatāccāhaṃ teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṛṇāṃ ca evaṃrūpāṇāṃ sūtrāntadhārakāṇāṃ rakṣā kṛtā bhaviṣyati, svastyayanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati
atha khalu virūḍhako mahārājo tasyām eva parṣadi saṃnipatito ’bhūt saṃniṣaṇṇaś ca kumbhāṇḍakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ
agaṇe gaṇe gauri gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi pukkasi saṃkule vrūsali sisi svāhā
imāni tāni bhagavan dhāraṇīmantrapadāni, yāni dvācatvāriṃśadbhir buddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu lambā ca nāma rākṣasī vilambā ca nāma rākṣasī kūṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī puṣpadantī ca nāma rākṣasī makuṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī keśinī ca nāma rākṣasī acalā ca nāma rākṣasī mālādhārī ca nāma rākṣasī kuntī ca nāma rākṣasī sarvasattvojohārī ca nāma rākṣasī hārītī ca nāma rākṣasī saputraparivārā etāḥ sarvā rākṣasyo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntāḥ
atha khalu tāḥ sarvā rākṣasya ekasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavata imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni prayacchanti sma
imaṃ śīrṣaṃ samāruhya mā kaścid drohī bhavatu dharmabhāṇakānāṃ yakṣo vā rākṣaso vā preto vā piśāco vā pūtano vā kṛtyo va vetālo vā kumbhāṇḍo vā stabdho vā omārako vā ostārako vā apasmārako vā yakṣakṛtyo vā amanuṣyakṛtyo vā manuṣyakṛtyo vā ekāhiko vā dvaitīyako vā traitīyako vā caturthako vā nityajvaro vā viṣamajvaro vā
atha khalu tā rākṣasya evasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavantam ābhir gāthābhir adhyabhāṣanta
saptadhāsya sphuṭenmūrdhā arjakasyeva mañjarī | ya imaṃ mantra śrutvā vai atikrameddharmabhāṇakam
yā gatirmātṛghātīnāṃ pitṛghātīna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistilapīḍānāṃ tilakūṭānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistulakūṭānāṃ kāṃsyakūṭāna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
evamuktvā tāḥ kuntipramukhā rākṣasyo bhagavantam etadūcuḥ - vayam api bhagavaṃsteṣām evaṃrūpāṇāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ, svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ kariṣyāma iti
asmin khalu punar dhāraṇīparivarte nirdiśyamāne aṣṭāṣaṣṭīnāṃ prāṇisahasrāṇām anutpattikadharmakṣāntipratilābho ’bhūt
iti śrīsaddharmapuṇḍarīke dharmaparyāye dhāraṇīparivarto nāmaikaviṃśatimaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): With these spells, O Lord, I shall guard those preachers over an extent of a hundred yoganas. Thus will those young men or young ladies of good family, who keep this Sûtrânta, be guarded, be safe.

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6：. | 藏本 (1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7)：.

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】梵本义译：即说咒曰：嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！ | 藏本 (17. Prajñāpāraṃitānayaśatapañcāśatikā; śer rab sna tshogs ka)：śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul brgya lṅa bcu pa |
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §5】梵本义译：即说咒曰：嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！ | 藏本 (25. Prajñāpāramitānāmāṣṭaśataka; śer rab sna tshogs ka)：bcom ldan ’das ma ’phags ma śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma mos pa la byams ma | yon tan dpag tu med pa daṅ ldan ma | de bźin gśegs pa thams cad kyi ye śes kyis rnam par (7) mkhyen pa ñid saṅs rgyas daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad kyi phyag bźes pa la phyag ’tshal lo ||
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (1 本)：25. Prajñāpāramitānāmāṣṭaśataka; śer rab sna tshogs ka · Tibetan Witness 2 · Tibetan Witness 3 · Tibetan Witness 4

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ pu N+ye pu N+ye མ་ཧཱ pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te།  ཨོཾ sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he མ་ཧཱ na ya pa ri bA re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam།  glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te།  'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri（EWTS: yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M pu N+ye pu N+ye ma hA pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te/ o~M sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he ma hA na ya pa ri bA re swA hA/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཨོཾ ha la ha la།  hi la hi lA ya།  ན་མོ dza ga na mi tsa nA ya།  ན་མོ na maHསྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ rnam par gzigs kyis བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to།  ། nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ gang la la zhig རིག་སྔགས ན་མོ bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ d+harmA ya།  na maHsaM g+hA ya།  ཨོཾ pa tsa pa tsa pA tsa ya pA tsa ya།  sarba b+hU tA nAM།  ts+tshin+da ya།  kI la ya།  ba ra bid+yA nAM སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang །  nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba cad la phan pa'i don dang །  nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang །  'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to།  ། ན་མོ bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ d+harmA ya།  na maHsaM g+hA ya།  ཨོཾ ka la ka la།  ki li ki li།  ku lu ku lu།  ku lo t+hA d+ha（EWTS: o~M ha la ha la/ hi la hi lA ya/ na mo dza ga na mi tsa nA ya/ na mo na maHswA hA/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig rig sngags na mo bud d+hA ya/ na mo d+harmA ya/ na maHsaM g+hA ya/ oM pa tsa pa tsa pA tsa ya pA tsa ya/ sarba b+hU tA nAM/ ts+tshin+da ya/ kI la ya/ ba ra bid+yA nAM swA hA/ nam mkha'i snying po sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud d+hA ya/ na mo d+harmA ya/ na maHsaM g+hA ya/ oM ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ku lo t+hA d+ha）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：na la se།  a na la saM b+ha be།  a na la sa ga tiM ga te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  he ma he ma།  ha ma ha ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a mi tot+b+ha be།  a mi ta saM b+ha be།  a mi ta bi krAn+te།  a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re།  a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ga ga na a ka ra།  ga ga na saM b+ha be།  ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de bzhin（EWTS: na la se/ a na la saM b+ha be/ a na la sa ga tiM ga te swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ he ma he ma/ ha ma ha ma swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a mi tot+b+ha be/ a mi ta saM b+ha be/ a mi ta bi krAn+te/ a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re/ a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ ga ga na a ka ra/ ga ga na saM b+ha be/ ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：legs so།  ། rigs kyi bu de'i phyir སྙིང་པོ gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing །  dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ brgyad kyi སྙིང་པོ nyon cig ། ཨོཾ མ་ཧཱ ཧཱུྃ མ་ཧཱ bI ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ 'dis ni dbus kyi བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས mchod do།  ། ཨོཾ hrI ཧཱུྃ པདྨ pri ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ mai hA rA Na སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  byams pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ A kA sha gar+b+hA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ swA hri rA dza ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun du bzang po'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ku ru b+ha na ra ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lag na rdo rje'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ shrI aM ra~M ga སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ni swA ra~M b+ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ k+Shi ti ha（EWTS: legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing / dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po nyon cig /o~M ma hA hU~M ma hA bI ra swA hA/ snying po 'dis ni dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do/ /o~M hrI hU~M pad+ma pri ya swA hA/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'o/ /o~M mai hA rA Na swA hA/ byams pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M A kA sha gar+b+hA ya swA hA/ nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po'o/ /o~M swA hri rA dza ya swA hA/ kun du bzang po'i snying po'o/ /o~M ku ru b+ha na ra ha swA hA/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /o~M shrI aM ra~M ga swA hA/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M ni swA ra~M b+ha swA hA/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i snying po'o/ /o~M k+Shi ti ha）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：123a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+ThA na hr-i da ya gu h+ya d+hA tu ka raN+Da nA ma d+hA ra NI ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi སྙིང་པོ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i གཟུངས ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：dag ste།  chos kyi sku dang །  longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang །  de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste།  dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i གཟུངས kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no།  ། na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM།  sarba ta thA ga tA nAM།  ཨོཾ b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau།  tsu lu tsu lu།  d+ha re d+ha re།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+hA tu d+ha re།  པདྨ gar+b+he།  dza ya ba re།  a tsa le།  sma ra ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+har+m+ma tsakra།  pra bar+t+ta na།  བཛྲ bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra།  a laM kr-i te།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  a d+hiSh+Thi te།  bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya།  bo bud+d+ha།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  d+hA tu gar+b+he སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ hr-i da ya།  d+hA tu mu dre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  su pra tiSh+Thi ta།  stu be ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te（EWTS: dag ste/ chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste/ dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no/ /na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM/ sarba ta thA ga tA nAM/ o~M b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau/ tsu lu tsu lu/ d+ha re d+ha re/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ d+hA tu d+ha re/ pad+ma gar+b+he/ dza ya ba re/ a tsa le/ sma ra ta thA ga ta/ d+har+m+ma tsakra/ pra bar+t+ta na/ badzra bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra/ a laM kr-i te/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ a d+hiSh+Thi te/ bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya/ bo bud+d+ha/ sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ d+hA tu gar+b+he swA hA/ sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te swA hA/ sarba ta thA ga ta hr-i da ya/ d+hA tu mu dre swA hA/ su pra tiSh+Thi ta/ stu be ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ hU~M hU~M swA hA/ o~M sarba ta thA ga ta uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni/ sarba ta thA ga ta d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  shAkya mu na ye།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te།  samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ a dzi te།  a dzi te།  a pa rA dzi te།  a dzi tan dza ya།  ha ra ha ra།  mai tri a ba lo ki te།  ka ra ka ra།  མ་ཧཱ sa ma ya sid+d+he།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze།  sma ra sma ra།  A sma kaM sa ma ya།  bo d+hi bo d+hi།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rtsa ba'i གསང་སྔགས so།  ། ཨོཾ mo hi mo hi།  མ་ཧཱ mo hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ'o།  ཨོཾ mu ni mu ni sma ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nye ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། གཟུངས 'di nyan pa tsam dang །  klog pa dang །  kha ton byed pa dang །  tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  །  ། rgya gar gyi mkhan po བཛྲ pA Ni dang །  bod kyi lots+tsha ba།  dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa།  །（EWTS: oM na mo b+ha ga ba te/ shAkya mu na ye/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM a dzi te/ a dzi te/ a pa rA dzi te/ a dzi tan dza ya/ ha ra ha ra/ mai tri a ba lo ki te/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hA sa ma ya sid+d+he/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ ma hA bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze/ sma ra sma ra/ A sma kaM sa ma ya/ bo d+hi bo d+hi/ ma hA bo d+hi swA hA/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags so/ /o~M mo hi mo hi/ ma hA mo hi swA hA/ snying po'o/ o~M mu ni mu ni sma ra swA hA/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gzungs 'di nyan pa tsam dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pA Ni dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba/ dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：166b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya many+dzu shrI swA khyA to nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：gsum la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ many+dzu shri ye།  ku mA ra b+hU tA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ dz+nyA nA lo ke།  tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni།  b+ha ga ba ti།  a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta བཛྲ pa ri pA la ya།  sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na།  ha na ha na།  sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM།  kle shA nuts+tshe da ya།  ba ra lak+Sha Na།  a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri།  bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya།  bud d+hA na de shA ya།  de ba།  nA ga།  yak+Sha།  ga na d+harba།  a su ra།  ga ru Da།  kin+na ra།  ma ho ra ga ། ba shes+tha pA ya།  a pa yaM dad ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro།  ། 'chi kar yang 'phags（EWTS: gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na mo b+ha ga ba te d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ na mo many+dzu shri ye/ ku mA ra b+hU tA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M dz+nyA nA lo ke/ tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni/ b+ha ga ba ti/ a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta badzra pa ri pA la ya/ sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na/ ha na ha na/ sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM/ kle shA nuts+tshe da ya/ ba ra lak+Sha Na/ a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri/ bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya/ bud d+hA na de shA ya/ de ba/ nA ga/ yak+Sha/ ga na d+harba/ a su ra/ ga ru Da/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ba shes+tha pA ya/ a pa yaM dad ti swA hA/ gzungs 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi kar yang 'phags）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha pA sha མ་ཧཱ dA na pA ra mi tA pA ri pU ra ya ཧཱུྃ།  da ra da ra།  bi bad+hi།  bi tsi traiH།  sarba satwA u pa b+ho ga ། sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  མ་ཧཱ dA na pU dza me g+ha pra brta ya།  ta ra ta ra།  tA ra ya མ་ཧཱ པདྨ ma Ni ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i སྙིང་པོ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha shI la།  saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ shud+d+ha sa twa པདྨ bi（EWTS: la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M a mo g+ha pA sha ma hA dA na pA ra mi tA pA ri pU ra ya hU~M/ da ra da ra/ bi bad+hi/ bi tsi traiH/ sarba satwA u pa b+ho ga /sarba ta thA ga ta/ ma hA dA na pU dza me g+ha pra brta ya/ ta ra ta ra/ tA ra ya ma hA pad+ma ma Ni hU~M phaT swA hA/ 'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M a mo g+ha shI la/ saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ ma hA shud+d+ha sa twa pad+ma bi）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·断除憍慢执障，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，彼、此尊（阳性主格），悉昙「e」韵字门：钩召发起三昧，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·钩召发起三昧），诚然、因为、实乃，呼请仁者圣众叹词

verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! great, vast, supreme, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! great, vast, supreme, accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·损减除灭忧苦），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性），驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！法轮、金轮、脉轮，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·损减除灭忧苦），驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu

verses.iast: bā ma sthi ta kandha de śa kṛṣṇa ji nā
verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），高兴驮，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍）

verses.iast: sarva satvā nāṃ siddhyantu mantra pa dā ya svāhā 'phags
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，彼、此尊（阳性主格）已，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，真言、密咒（护心密语），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！妙果圆成·妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满

verses.meaningEn: Sentient being, living creature, courage, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream and freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — dispelling sorrow

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·本不生体性），施度调伏，侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·钩召发起三昧），仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — samādhi invocation, quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·损减除灭忧苦），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），然而、而、实则，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·损减除灭忧苦）

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：rgya gar skad du།  བཛྲ sU k+Sh+ma a pra ti ha ta nA ma དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི།  bod skad du།  rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས།  sangs rgyas dang བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས rdo rje rigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so།  ། sangs rgyas kyi mthus gsang ba pa'i bdag po rdo rje ཧཱུྃ ཞེས་བྱ་བs bzhin rab tu 'bar ba bstan te།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi thad du 'dug go།  ། de'i tshe བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi thugs kyi sprul pa las bram ze'i khye'u cig byung ste།  གཟུངས sngags rnams rab tu brjod du gsol།  lag na rdo rjes smras pa།  bram ze'i khye'u rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang །  nga yis bde gshegs khro bo thams cad kyis rtag tu brjod pa'i yang snying 'di rab tu smras so།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  na ma sh+tsaN+Da བཛྲ pA Na ye།  མ་ཧཱ（EWTS: @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra sU k+Sh+ma a pra ti ha ta nA ma d+hA ra NI/ bod skad du/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus gsang ba pa'i bdag po rdo rje hU~M zhes bya bas bzhin rab tu 'bar ba bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'dug go/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sprul pa las bram ze'i khye'u cig byung ste/ gzungs sngags rnams rab tu brjod du gsol/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / nga yis bde gshegs khro bo thams cad kyis rtag tu brjod pa'i yang snying 'di rab tu smras so/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na ma sh+tsaN+Da badzra pA Na ye/ ma hA）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.iast: svāhā a ma le svāhā a mṛ te svāhā 'phags
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·神变善巧应化），向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！妙果圆成·妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness — miraculous skillful manifestation, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! fruition of enlightenment & awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·钩召发起三昧），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·摄受法流灌顶），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·本不生体性），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·摄受法流灌顶），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — samādhi invocation, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — consecrating Dharma-stream, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — sovereign spiritual mastery, quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — consecrating Dharma-stream, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），解脱系缚大力·造作离相，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，一切、普皆遍满，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄）
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all, every, complete, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery

verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·钩召发起三昧），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·诸根清净自在），仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·钩召发起三昧），生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — samādhi invocation, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — sovereign spiritual mastery, quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — purified faculties, quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — samādhi invocation, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so།  ། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu gtsug tor gyi gseb nas གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi 'di dag byung ngo །  ། ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ uSh+NI ShA ya shud+d+he bi ra dze bi ma le སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས bsrung ba mdzad du gsol།  ། ཨོཾ raM Shi ga Na pra shA sta sarba ta thA ga toSh+NI Sha si tA ta pa tre ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrU~MHSh+Tཨོཾ།  dzam+b+ha ni ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  s+t+wam+b+ha ni ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  mo ha na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrU~MHSh+Tཨོཾ།  pa ra bid+yA sa ma b+ha k+Sha Na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drA~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  sarba ba ra bid+yA ts+tsed na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drIhrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  sarba duSh+Ta nAM stam+b+ha na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  sarba yak+Sha rak+Sha sa gra hA NAM bi d+h+wan+sa na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+To།  tsa tu rA shI tI nAM gra ha sa ha srA NAM bi d+hA n+sa na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  aSh+Ta bi shatI nAM nak+Sha trA tA m+p+ra sA da na ka rI ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrIHSh+Tཨོཾ།  aSh+TA naM མ་ཧཱ gra

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·摄受法流灌顶），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），彼、彼尊（连音式）
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, he, that one

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：133b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ta thA ga toSh+nyASha si tA ta ba tra a ba rA dzi ta nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：'phags ma དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

verses.iast: du gsol de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gśegs
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·摄受法流灌顶），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），那个、那里，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — consecrating Dharma-stream, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, that, yonder, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — samādhi invocation

verses.iast: sṅags bka' scal to oṃ mai gholkā ya svāhā oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），解脱系缚大力·造作离相，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），嗡！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·大自在威德统摄），想必炬，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — sovereign spiritual mastery, surely + meteor, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ!

verses.iast: śitāṃ śa be svāhā oṃ raktāṃ ga ku mā rā
verses.meaningZh: 尖锐、淡薄，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！赤红、怀爱红光，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·损减除灭忧苦），勿、莫令，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍）

verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·损减除灭忧苦），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — dispelling sorrow, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! dark-blue, black, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising

verses.iast: ra ya pū ra ya pra ti jñā na sarva
verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·威神增益圆满），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），若字门（般若无分别圣智（jñāna）·远离寂静周遍），不、非、无，一切、普皆遍满
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — perfected spiritual vigor, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, non-dual prajñā gnosis (jñāna) — expansive quiescence, not, non-, all, every, complete

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), Hūṃ!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, bondage + O cha, making (reverent offering)

verses.meaningEn: All + evil, making (reverent offering), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech

verses.meaningEn: Dhāraṇī, moral discipline + carrying over + sick + breath + yes + Dhāraṇī, patience + carrying over + sick + breath + yes + Dhāraṇī, virya-paramita + by name + Dhāraṇī, dhyana-paramita + by name + Dhāraṇī, Perfection of Wisdom + by name + Dhāraṇī again and again, upholding, upholding, mighty + Tārā + by name + Dhāraṇī, Mahāmeghasūtra (Da Fangdeng Wuxiang Jing)

verses.meaningEn: Upholding, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency, Cintāmaṇi + Lokeśvara + by name + Dhāraṇī, Buddha + lord + by name + Dhāraṇī, lotus flower + glad at heart + yes + Dhāraṇī, all + Buddha + Bodhi, hero + yes + Dhāraṇī, noble + a star, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, unequalled + suffusion + course + sky + own-being + O completely purified

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṃdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命擎尊，请净除、涤荡清净！请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜·圆满清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + O supporting, purify! cleanse! thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! + O thoroughly pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.iast: 257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā
verses.meaningZh: 谛听妙闻·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，出有坏他，正法疾速，宝山王安住不动山尖，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Hearing, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (reverent offering), other, Dharma + O hastening, steadfast sacred mountain peak + O peaked, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.iast: mahatāca bhikṣu saṃghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，比丘，以圣僧伽、清净海众，俱，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），海会众·勇健·及
verses.meaningEn: Great, beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, by/through Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, with a half, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, assembly + strong + and
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.iast: kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṃ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，王海会众，湖两个，一样、也他，请执持、总持护念！海会众、圣众眷属尊，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride, king + O assembly, a lake + two, like, as, hold! bear! sustain! O assembly, host,retinue / in assembly, host,retinue, thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 眼、佛眼遍照，颦眉观音母·以及·圣救度佛母，具足才尊，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Eye, illuminating vision, Bhṛkuṭī + and indeed + Tārā, endowed with excellence, thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，原有债务佛母，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢，慈父
verses.meaningEn: Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), the original debt (feminine), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust, father
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，世尊末，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·妙行趣入，出有坏九，随一趣往
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, Bhagavān + end, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), nine, mostly ) look + going
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 世间·气息·是的，离名相假立·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，天人师，般问
verses.meaningEn: World + breath + yes, beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, śāstāraṃ, wisdom + ask
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，诚然、因为、实乃，一切智圣智，净无垢秽、纤尘不染，眼、佛眼遍照
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, for, indeed, surely, omniscient + primordial wisdom, utterly spotless, taintless, eye, illuminating vision
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 以世尊佛母！（呼格），殒·此边·活生生，造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: With/by O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! to die + the hither + of living, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), vajra seed syllable Huṃ, delighting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 趣往、途径，佛陀、觉者，破有相福德光·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，谁，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Going, way, Buddha, the Awakened One, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, kasya, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, samāptaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥·秋天·本刹·最上，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，权利之后，向佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness + fall + this + highest, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), right + or emphasizing particle, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: om padme padme padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，莲华氏族，极乐世界，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again, lotus flower + O origin, Western Pure Land, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, gatha + hymn of praise + understood, upholding, eight + upper, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, forward, star + te + going
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), glorious

verses.iast: ākārathāmate devī prajñāpāramitāśubhaḥ vajresatve vvajo pāpa ghaṇṭha prajñāpāra mitā
verses.meaningZh: 相忍耐力，天女、佛母明妃，般若波罗蜜多清净吉祥，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，罪业、恶不善业，破暗合集·离诸诤论无诤·远离虚妄安立，般若彼岸，有限、干脆
verses.meaningEn: Disposition + fortitude, goddess, sacred female deity, Perfection of Wisdom + auspicious, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, dissolving dense ignorance & conflict-free peace & beyond conceptual fabrication, Prajñā + carrying over, measured, defined, limited
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：matsayamaṇḍale- ||2|| ākārathāmate devī prajñāpāramitāśubhaḥ vajresatve vvajo pāpa ghaṇṭha prajñāpāra mitā ||3|| vailocanodbhava śirobhavavāmamakhe abhitābha-akṣommaḥ dhvajama vajaḍaghaṇṭhaḥ ratnanābhau amogha pāṇa ||4|| lalāṭarspavailocanaratnasambhavaḥ paścimaspaḥ amitābhaḥ vāmenaḥ amoghasiddhi ||5|| vairocanamahājotiḥ śukṛparṣṇumahodvalaṁ śvetavita rakṣaśāmaḥ catuvaktrābhavatu'haṁ ||6|| paramagu ruvajācārythaḥ vaj

verses.iast: vailocanodbhava śirobhavavāmamakhe abhitābha-akṣommaḥ dhvajama vajaḍaghaṇṭhaḥ ratnanābhau amogha pāṇa
verses.meaningZh: 极微·眼·氏族，头·愿成·左·欢乐，破有相福德光·真如实际，造作离相·六度满行清净·无我大慈三昧，法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·息灭诤怨，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立，不空、决定成就无虚，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + eye + origin, be! become! + left + O gay, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & selfless great loving-kindness, Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & pacifying conflict & turmoil, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), unfailing, infallible, never in vain, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：matsayamaṇḍale- ||2|| ākārathāmate devī prajñāpāramitāśubhaḥ vajresatve vvajo pāpa ghaṇṭha prajñāpāra mitā ||3|| vailocanodbhava śirobhavavāmamakhe abhitābha-akṣommaḥ dhvajama vajaḍaghaṇṭhaḥ ratnanābhau amogha pāṇa ||4|| lalāṭarspavailocanaratnasambhavaḥ paścimaspaḥ amitābhaḥ vāmenaḥ amoghasiddhi ||5|| vairocanamahājotiḥ śukṛparṣṇumahodvalaṁ śvetavita rakṣaśāmaḥ catuvaktrābhavatu'haṁ ||6|| paramagu ruvajācārythaḥ vaj

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，阿弥陀，左勇健，不空成就如来

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 10 大数据库「ALL-NIBS 陀罗尼保护计划（Asian Legacy Library & Nagarjuna Institute）」。完整呈现尼泊尔尼瓦尔写本外交原貌（Diplomatic Newar：「oṁ namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya | tadyathā | oṁ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṁ hrīḥ sbāhā ||」）与标准古典梵文校勘本（Normalized IAST）之双轨对照，并总结尼瓦尔正字法音变规律：sbāhā → svāhā (Newar bilabial-dental cluster)；post-r gemination simplified (sarvva → sarva, dharmma → dharma, āryya → ārya)；ṁ → ṃ (ISO 15919 anusvāra → standard IAST ṃ)。
recitationTipsZh: 尼瓦尔写本原貌特征：sbāhā → svāhā (Newar bilabial-dental cluster) · post-r gemination simplified (sarvva → sarva, dharmma → dharma, āryya → ārya) · ṁ → ṃ (ISO 15919 anusvāra → standard IAST ṃ)。上方已按标准古典梵语还原其天城文、悉昙梵字与现代梵音拼读。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya | tadyathā | oṁ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṁ hrīḥ sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya | tadyathā | oṁ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṁ hrīḥ sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya | tadyathā | oṁ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṁ hrīḥ sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṃ hrīḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吉祥、圣德威光，虚空慢动作，世间自在王（观音尊号），一切·苦·疗，摩尼宝珠莲华尊，吽（金刚心印）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, hole + crawling, Lokeśvara, Sovereign Lord of the World, all + suffering + heal, Maṇi jewel + O lotus flower, Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya | tadyathā | oṁ hrīḥ śrī-khasarpaṇa-lokeśvara sarvvaduḥkhapraśamana maṇipadme hūṁ hrīḥ sbāhā ||

verses.meaningEn: Four + virtue, drift + eye + O wind, of this, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux

verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & perfection of the six pāramitās & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), meditative wisdom

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, forward + wealth + dog + home

verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness (by spiritual power), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, may be, would become

verses.meaningEn: Voice + the Indian cuckoo, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & dissolving dense ignorance, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), star + to shake + womb?, vowel

verses.meaningEn: Doubt + O breath, making, bhavaḥ, can + whoever

verses.meaningEn: Thus + auspiciousness, Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, by name + Dhāraṇī, wisdom, samāptaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace, of words, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, truth + bark, truth-speaking, promise, vow (feminine) and awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namaḥ sarvvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ | oṁ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvvakṛtyakākhorddavināśani hūṁ mama hūṁ ni sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvakṛtyakākhordavināśani hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大白伞盖（清净护庇）尊，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，般罗底扬吉罗（大回遮母、总破邪咒母）尊，能灭除一切业行压镇尊，吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O White Parasol (pure protective canopy) / in White Parasol (pure protective canopy), O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, O Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess / in Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess, all + actions + O destroyer of an evil demon, Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namaḥ sarvvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ | oṁ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvvakṛtyakākhorddavināśani hūṁ mama hūṁ ni sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，吉祥安隐截至日子已，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil (imperative seal), well-being + having by day, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 立尊，一切处、普皆周遍，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·六度满行清净，罪业·勿·去

verses.meaningEn: A lake + particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, blissful, may they all abide in peace! all, every, complete, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 赏
verses.meaningEn: Reward
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），菩提萨埵别别解脱

verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 菩提心众疏，最上真言离言说·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Aspiration to enlightenment, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 心、菩提心、心识，闢·他·诸父，诸法，真如实际·一乘如实之道·造作离相，才鸣呼
verses.meaningEn: Mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, settle + tha + father, all things, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, excellence
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），天神·告诉·积累，在于变坏，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），自性称计
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, a god + say + piled up, in, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, own-being + measure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 一切有离，蕴·放置·长柄·十二处，渊博，嚩啰·幅度·优胜·彼
verses.meaningEn: All things or beings + lost, aggregate + put + stem + ayatana, to be seized, taken, held, gathered, gained, received, perceived, understood, learned, taking + width + winning + him
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: dharmanairātmya samatayā sva cittamādyanutyannaṃ śūnyatāsvabhāvamiti kosyavacanasyārthaḥ sarvabhāvavegatamiti bhāvaśabdena ātmādaya ucyante
verses.meaningZh: 法空，以萨麻丹，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，妙行迁变空·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，空性·自性·称计，真言宣演·造作离相，一切有·余力·彼·如是，以物声，我者残忍，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Inherent emptiness of dharmas, with/by to, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, emptiness + own-being + measure, uttering, all things or beings + jerk + him + thus, becoming + by, merciless, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·造作离相，我床坐，长寿护命·欢喜悦泽·生起不可得·尊胜，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·真如实际，不、非、无，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), self + state of seat, vitalizing, delighting, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, not, non-, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），作
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, kāraṇaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 彼等一切之·如此·解脱，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，业相，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Of them + so + O liberation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, activity + mark, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: evaṃ tāvadātmādayo bhāvāna vidyante prāgevatatsvabhāvaṃ cittamiti
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，物气息，向解假定今日汝，原来·彼·自性，心称计
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, becoming + breath, understanding + suppose now + to Thee, formerly + That + own-being, mind + measure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: ataḥ sarvabhāvavigataṃ ska tanasvabhāvaṃ cittaṃ bhavatītyāha
verses.meaningZh: 走道那么、游方，一切有离，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），裔胄自性，心、菩提心、心识，成办·经过·如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: Walk about, wander, run, all things or beings + lost, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, offspring + own-being, mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, becomes + course + spoke
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 蕴·放置·长柄·十二处，渊博，嚩啰·幅度·优胜·净水·鸿毛
verses.meaningEn: Aggregate + put + stem + ayatana, to be seized, taken, held, gathered, gained, received, perceived, understood, learned, taking + width + winning + water + down
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

provenance.rawSnippet:
śrī saṃpuṭodbhava tantra 

[Elder, G.R., The Saṃpuṭa tantra: edition and translation, chapters I-IV. Unpublished Ph. D. dissertation submitted to Columbia University, 1978]







THE SAṂPUṬA TANTRA - SANSKRIT EDITION 



(Chapter 1) <<pp36-63>> 

(oṃ) namo vajraḍākāya // 

evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatakāyavākcitta(hṛdaya)vajrayoṣidbhageṣu vijahāra // 

tatra khalu bhagavān aśītikoṭiyogīśvaramadhye vajragarbham avalokaḥ smitam akārṣīt // 

samanantaraṃ smite 'smin vajragarbha utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāñjalipuṭottatvā bhagavantam etad avocat // 

śrotum icchāmi jñānendra sarvatantranidānakaṃ / 
rahasyaṃ saṃpuṭodbhūtaṃ lakṣaṇam // 

bhagavān āha //

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Columbia University

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），心、心髓、根本心咒，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Columbia University

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：幻化·少年·彼·自性·诸黑闇之，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: illusion + young + That + own-being + of all unacquainted with, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: tadyathā kulaputra māyākāranāṭake pratyupasthite māyākāranirmitāṁ striyaṁ dṛṣṭvā kaścidrāgaparītavetāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：善男子，幻术者那罗，我身尊，幻术者化，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: a good man, conjurer + O actor, O I shall wait on  S, conjurer + a magic creation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: tadyathā sarvebhyo vṛkṣebhyaḥ prāgvanaṁ nāsti tadā ekaikasmādapi nāsti
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切富人，向诸茂盛树，依然呼吸，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，彼时，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: all + belonging to one's household, to all tree, as before + breathe, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), at that time, in that case, then, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: tadyathā sve bhṛtyāḥ svāni dhanāni yattu yasya parāyattaṁ na tattasyātmīyaṁ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，方位、滋补之，一切自，一切财，一乘如实之道·真如实际，凡彼…之，依存、受支配，不、非、无，彼·彼之·魔怔自我
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, of bearing, carrying, maintaining, nourishing, own, treasure (plural), supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), whose, of whom, dependent on, subject to, not, non-, That + his + characterized by a self
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: TTL< bodhicaryyāvatāra > 01AB [ MISSING FOLIO ] 02A hitaṃ punarapyeṣa samāgamaḥ kutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），入菩萨行论，跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，并立，第一义谛·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，来诣一起、会议，为谁的
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, A Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, hitaṃ, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, coming together, meeting, union, intercourse with, kutaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，犹如、如…所说，云健南
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), just as, according to, cloud + slaying
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: tathā kadācil lokasya puṇyeṣu matikṣaṇaṃ syāt
verses.meaningZh: 如是、亦复如是，造作离相·施度调伏·妙行迁变空，世间、世界之，于诸福德、胜妙功德中，慧一刹那，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in that same way, freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery & awakened conduct beyond flux, of world, realm, among/in merit, auspicious virtue, intelligence, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: tasmācchu [???] la [??????] ntu pāpasya maha [????] jjīyate'nyena śubhena kena saṃbodhicittaṃ yadi nāma na syāt
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·损减除灭忧苦），罪业、恶不善业之，酒席、节日，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·真如实际，以清净吉祥、善妙庄严，造作离相·离名相假立，桑菩提心，设使，名为、号曰，不、非、无，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — dispelling sorrow, of evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, feast, festival, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (by spiritual power), by/through auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), saṃ + aspiration to enlightenment, if, when, by name, called, not, non-, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·离一切相无相·第一义谛，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，天人、诸天护法
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, god, celestial deity (Deva)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: yata sukhenaiva sukhaṃ pravṛddhamutplāvayatyapramitā [??] ghān bhavaduḥkhaśatāni tartukīmairapi sa [???] nāni hartukāmaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 拘牵，乐·勇健·犹如，安乐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），愿成·苦·一切百，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，彼、此尊（阳性主格），阿支罗尊，以诸把手童子是的
verses.meaningEn: Held, restrained, checked, controlled, easy + strong + like, sukhaṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence, be! become! + suffering + hundred, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), he, that one, O naked, grip + child + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: bahusaukhyaśatāni bhoktukāmairna vimocyaṃ hi sadaiva bodhicittaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 多·福利·一切百，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，闢一样，诚然、因为、实乃，彼天命，菩提心
verses.meaningEn: Many + welfare + hundred, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, settle + the same, for, indeed, surely, he + belonging to or coming from the gods, aspiration to enlightenment
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: bhavacārakabandhano varā [???] tānāṃ suta ucyate kṣaṇena
verses.meaningZh: 有狱系缚，殊胜、胜愿、妙好，一线，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际，以一刹那
verses.meaningEn: Bondage, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, thread, fibre, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), by/through birth under favorable conditions
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: sa narāmaralokavandanīyo bhavati smodita eva [????????????] 02B gṛhītvā jinaratnapratimāṃ karotyanarghān
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），礼敬赞叹·离名相假立，成办、生起、安住，矣演，唯、正是、决定，跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，在家人已，胜者·珍宝·创始人，能作成办·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, venerating, becomes, arises, is, particle to express certainty + to expound, indeed, verily, alone, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising, having become a house or habitation, Victor + jewel + framer, making
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.meaningZh: 三婆吠
verses.meaningEn: Produced from liquids
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，归命，向玅依
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising, homage to beautiful + to
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Bearing, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, venerating
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 善逝·自我·疲惫·天衣·入，造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），犹如趣往，从合
verses.meaningEn: Sugata + self + be exhausted + garment + descent, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, just as + going to or in, from time, occasion, juncture
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: na hi kiñcidapūrvamatra vācyanna ca saṃgranthanakauśalaṃ mamāsti
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，诚然、因为、实乃，圆满充盈·造作离相，语言·假定今日·不以及我身福利，我之有
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, for, indeed, surely, fulfilling, words + suppose now + not and literary composition + welfare, my + is
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: ataeva na me parārthacintā svamano bhāva yituṃ kṛtaṃ mayedam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·最上真言离言说，不、非、无，于我、为我，利他思，自意，物，一乘如实之道·真如实际，所作、已成办，过去此
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, not, non-, to me, my, to benefit others + thought, own + mind, becoming, being, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, done, made, accomplished, made or consisting of + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: mama tāvadanena yāti vṛrddhiṃ kuśalaṃ bhāvayituṃ prasādavegaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），以乃至粮，揭帝、步调尊，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，善，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，淳余力
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), moreover + by, O gone, passed,, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, kuśalaṃ, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，归命敬礼·第一义谛，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·无住安立，风大自在除障种子
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, bowing (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & non-abiding equipoise (imperative seal), Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，获，许多·企求·义利·成就法
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, pratilabdhā, much + desirous + meaning + accomplishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: yadi nātra vicintyate hitaṃ punarapyeṣa samāgamaḥ kutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 设使，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，闢主顾，并立，第一义谛·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，来诣一起、会议，为谁的
verses.meaningEn: If, when, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, settle + =, hitaṃ, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, coming together, meeting, union, intercourse with, kutaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: rātro yathā me ghaghanāndhakāre vidyutkṣyaṇaṃ darśayati prakāsaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 晚上、随一也他，犹如、如…所说，于我、为我，想必·健南·暗尊，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，示，转载咳嗽
verses.meaningEn: Night, mostly as or, just as, according to, to me, my, surely + slaying + O dark, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, teach, forward + cough
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: buddhānubhāvena tathā kadācillokasya puṇyeṣu matiḥ kṣaṇa syāt
verses.meaningZh: 以佛陀体面，如是、亦复如是，几时·鹞鹰·谁，于诸福德、胜妙功德中，智慧，一刹那，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + by, thus, in that same way, when? at what time? how? With never, among/in merit, auspicious virtue, matiḥ, birth under favorable conditions, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: tasmācchubhaṃ durlla meva nityaṃ balaṃ tu pāpasya mahatsughoraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，常恒、永不间断，跋蓝，然而、而、实则，罪业、恶不善业之，广大·报刊往外·威怖
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, constantly, eternally, balaṃ, but, indeed, moreover, of evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, great + press out + formidable
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·损减除灭忧苦），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening (by spiritual power), primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — dispelling sorrow, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 闻，正念、忆持不忘，趣向、六趣、妙行，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news, tidings, utterance or prescription, mindfulness, recollection, course, path, realm of rebirth, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.iast: oṃ̐ namaḥ śrī sarvva buddha bodhisatvebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，吉祥、圣德威光，一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，向诸菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, all, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, to all Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 归命赞叹，向佛陀、觉者，尊愿悉获
verses.meaningEn: Homage + praise, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, may they to take!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.iast: namo bhagavatyai sarasvatyai sidhyantumantra yadā svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊佛母顶礼，向妙音天女（辩才天），愿诸真言章句悉皆成就真言，何时、若是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, to Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, may all mantra-padas succeed! + Mantra, when, if, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.iast: namaḥ svāhātyaya devī namasyāmi syāme prayachatu guṇaughaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圆满吉祥成就过·天女、佛母明妃·我具寿、表示敬意·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·破暗合集！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed, sin, goddess, sacred female deity, I to be worshipped, venerable, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & dissolving dense ignorance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀·诸菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊）·诸圣供、开始·诸菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, bringing forth, offering, presenting, beginning, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.iast: oṃ̐ hara hara mahānimitta hu̐ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！大相，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, great + sign, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.meaningZh: 归命赞叹，向诸殊胜·施予成就·出·枳，向诸大体相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage + praise, choicest + giving success + income + to, great + to all shape, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.iast: namaḥ samantavajrāṇāṃ oṃ̐ ha̐³ sphāṭayāmahe hu̐ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 归命普遍诸金刚之，嗡！不动明王因业清净虚空种子，广大殊胜·一切诸谛圆满，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal + of Vajra, Oṃ! Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, great (vocative invocation), vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.iast: oṃ̐ ha̐ hu̐ vajramaṇḍale bandha bandha hu̐ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不动明王因业清净虚空种子，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），金刚曼荼罗，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Vajra + O Maṇḍala, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.meaningZh: 归命赞叹，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage + praise, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚花尊，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + O flower, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：GAEKWADʼS ORIENTAL SERIES

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：l.1: Section: V []

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：l.1: Section: V []

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma sarvārthasādhana amṛte hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，一切义利成就法，甘露、不死妙法尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, all aims and benefits + accomplishing, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：l.1: Section: V []

Three times the Central Asian vowel -e is written with a long stroke and a flag-shaped hook to the right, but only once apparently because the Indian -e otherwise would have touched the preceding anusvāra. Five times the looped diacritic sign for -i is written. Cf. the description in AKh I, p. 297: “D. VI.1. MS. on paper; Brāhmī; No. 28. Note xv. Lefthand fragment, 4 1/2" 3", with string-hole, of a leaf numbered 70. Full size, probably 18" 3". Language: Sanskrit. Characters: upright Gupta of seventh or eighth century. Contents: apparently some Buddhist canonic

Six times the Central Asian vowel -e is written, but only once apparently because the Indian -e otherwise would have touched the preceding superscribed vowel. There are two separated fragments of Kha. i.60. Fragment Or.8212/25(3) is given here in italics and Kha. i.209 in bold.
